jobs.title: Paraprofessional
jobs.description:
At KIPP New Orleans, we see the gifts in everyone who walks through the doors of our schools. Especially our teachers. Their skill. Energy. Love. Their determination. On the good days, and the hard ones. So we support our teachers to make the most of those gifts in order to build academically excellent classrooms and create unlimited opportunities for all of our students.

The KIPP Difference | Together, a Future Without Limits

• Respect: For our teachers’ innate talent and desire to learn, for their professional growth and the lives they lead beyond our walls.
• Support: Our teachers always feel the KIPP Team and Family at their backs, with support to grow and opportunities to lead.
• Purpose: Together, we share an ambitious mission to create a future without limits. And we need talented teachers to realize it.

The responsibilities and essential functions of the role include:

Achievement | Teaching & Learning

• Deliver rigorous, standards-aligned instruction using HQIM; communicate daily objectives and success criteria; check for understanding throughout (cold call, turn & talk, exit tickets).
• Plan/adapt units and lessons that build conceptual understanding and fluency; script questions, models, exemplars, and anticipated misconceptions; align tasks and rubrics to the depth of standards.
• Use data to drive instruction: analyze daily work, interims, and state assessments; reteach, spiral, and extend; maintain small data trackers that inform tomorrow’s plan.
• Differentiate and scaffold using diverse strategies (choice, visuals, language objectives, sentence frames); provide accommodations/modifications with fidelity for students with IEP/504 plans; coordinate with DSS/ESL staff.
• Structure purposeful practice—independent work, small groups, centers, and peer discourse—that requires evidence, academic language, and grade-level thinking.
• Provide timely, actionable feedback (written and verbal) tied to rubrics; maintain accurate, transparent grades and make-up work systems.
• Assessment literacy: design/implement common assessments; ensure item alignment and reliability; use exemplars/anchors for calibration.

Hope | Positive Classroom Culture

• Establish safe, joyful routines (entry, materials, transitions, group work) that maximize time-on-task and protect learning time bell-to-bell.
• Affirm high expectations and growth mindset; select culturally sustaining texts, problems, and examples that reflect students’ identities and experiences.
• Apply school-wide behavior systems consistently and restoratively; use pre-corrections, de-escalation, and restorative conversations; log incidents per policy.
• Integrate SEL (explicit skills, mood checks, goal setting) to build belonging, resilience, and self-management; proactively teach replacement behaviors.

Community | School Culture & Partnerships

• Model school values and professionalism; meet deadlines; uphold duty coverage (arrival, transitions, lunch/recess, dismissal, testing).
• Build strong relationships with students and families via frequent, strengths-based communication; co-create goals and action plans.
• Communicate progress (grades, attendance, behavior, reading levels) through scheduled updates and family conferences with translators/interpretation as needed.
• Participate in key events—back-to-school nights, IEP/504 and EL meetings, data nights, testing, and community celebrations; support recruitment and retention activities.

Relentlessness | Growth Mindset

• Set ambitious goals for student mastery and classroom culture; track progress and publicly celebrate growth.
• Welcome coaching (observations, practice-based rehearsal) and implement feedback by the next lesson/cycle; reflect on impact using student work.
• Engage in PD and PLCs; contribute artifacts (plans, assessments, student work) that show PD-to-practice transfer.
• Collaborate to design/refine common assessments and lead/participate in data meetings that produce concrete reteach plans.

Elevation | Belongingness

• Plan and teach for access and rigor for every learner (multilingual learners, students with disabilities, advanced learners, newcomers/SLIFE).
• Examine outcomes and discipline data to reduce disproportionality; adjust instruction, grading, and routines accordingly.
• Create structures for student and family voice (surveys, feedback circles, classroom leadership roles) and act on insights.
• Uphold equitable grading and policies (clear rubrics, opportunities to revise/retake, transparency on late/missing work); ensure materials and displays reflect all students.

Professional & Operational Expectations

jobs.title: Manager, Payroll & Accounts Payable
jobs.description:
The Manager, Payroll & Accounts Payable leads payroll, accounts payable, vendor master-data review, and travel-and-expense operations to ensure accurate, timely, controlled payments and reliable accounting records. The role sets operating priorities, manages and develops the team, owns escalations and control execution, and drives continuous improvement across recurring, deadline-sensitive processes. The Manager partners with Human Resources, Accounting, Legal, Tax, business stakeholders, and external providers to maintain compliance, safeguard confidential data, and reduce operational and fraud risk.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

TEAM LEADERSHIP & OPERATING MANAGEMENT

• Lead Payroll and MDM Specialists and Accounts Payable Specialists by setting priorities, allocating work, reviewing quality, coaching performance, building capability, and maintaining coverage for critical deadlines.

• Establish clear service expectations, escalation paths, process ownership, and operating routines across payroll, accounts payable, master data, travel and expense, and payments.

PAYROLL GOVERNANCE & COMPLIANCE

• Oversee scheduled and off-cycle payroll processing, including inputs, earnings, deductions, taxes, adjustments, funding, approvals, and final payroll controls.

• Review payroll registers, variances, exceptions, reconciliations, funding needs, and required approvals; document review results and resolve or escalate material issues.

• Own payroll compliance operations, tax notices, records, audit support, year-end reporting including W2s, and escalated employee matters in coordination with HR, Tax, Legal, and external providers.

ACCOUNTS PAYABLE, EXPENSE & PAYMENT OPERATIONS

• Oversee invoice validation, coding, approvals, posting, payment scheduling, refunds, employee reimbursements, aging, exceptions, and supplier inquiries to support accurate and timely disbursement.

• Oversee payment runs, validate payment details and required approvals, coordinate funding, and resolve returned, voided, or exception payments.

• Manage 1099 activities, unclaimed-property support, period-end requirements, and audit-ready documentation.

MASTER DATA, CONTROLS & RISK MANAGEMENT

• Oversee vendor master-data controls, including setup and change reviews, tax documentation, sanctions screening, duplicate detection, banking verification and record retention.

• Maintain effective controls across processing, review, approvals, master data, expenses, and payments, including segregation of duties, data protection, confidentiality, fraud prevention, documentation, and business continuity; identify control gaps and implement corrective action.

PERFORMANCE, SYSTEMS & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

• Monitor service levels, backlogs, errors, deadlines, reconciliations, and team capacity; use data to identify root causes and prioritize corrective action.

• Coordinate payroll, payables, expense, and master-data issue resolution and testing with process owners, technical support, and external providers.

• Improve processes, reporting, documentation, automation, and use of approved AI-enabled productivity tools while maintaining human validation, access controls, and protection of confidential information.

YOU HAVE WHAT IT TAKES IF YOU HAVE:

• 5+ years of progressive experience in payroll, accounts payable, accounting operations, or a related field, including substantial hands-on payroll processing and review of registers, payments, reconciliations, controls, and documentation.

• 2+ years of direct people-management experience (formal or informal), including responsibility for work allocation, quality review, coaching, performance expectations, and deadline coverage.

• Experience managing multi-state payroll and at least one adjacent operating area such as accounts payable, vendor master data, employee expenses, payment operations, or accounting close support.
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Finance, Human Resources, or a related field.

IT WOULD ALSO BE GREAT IF YOU HAD:

• Experience leading payroll and accounts-payable operations in a multi-state, multi-entity, or regulated environment.

• Experience with UKG or a comparable payroll/timekeeping platform; a major ERP such as Intacct, NetSuite, or SAP; and procure-to-pay or expense platforms such as Coupa or Concur.

• Experience with payroll taxes, wage and hour requirements, incentive compensation, vendor and payment controls, 1099s, unclaimed property, audits, and year-end reporting.

jobs.title: Senior Human Factors Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function

The Senior Human Factors Engineer works closely with designers, clinical engineers, and technical product managers to inform and guide the development of new products and ensure that those products are safe and easy to use. As part of new product development projects, they conduct user research, analyze and characterize use-related risks, and conduct usability testing of products prior to launch. They have primary responsibility for creating usability risk analyses and conducting final usability validation studies. The Senior Human Factors Engineer also works closely with the regulatory group to create the usability engineering documentation

required for submission to medical device regulatory agencies.

Roles & Responsibilities:

• Collect and synthesize detailed information on how users interact with Intuitive products through various techniques including interviews, simulations, direct observations, task analyses, and persona development.
• Present results of field observations, research, and usability testing.
• Contribute to user interface designs by negotiating design recommendations to mitigate use errors and improve usability. Assist creation and revision of user-interface requirements documents.

• Design, execute, and report on usability (human factors) tests at various stages of product development from early prototypes all the way through formal FDA-mandated validation testing.
• Write and execute usability test protocols. Analyze test data and write test reports.
• Develop validation strategies for projects involving updates to existing products.
• Lead the efforts required to create and update usability risk analyses for Intuitive products
• Maintain traces between use risks, mitigations, and validation test cases.
• Reinforce a human centered design approach across the organization.
• Represent the Human Factors function on core teams for large projects.
• Coordinate human factors efforts across projects involving several sub-systems.
• Manage usability engineering activities within development projects and provide schedules and status to technical product managers and engineering project managers.
• Mentor junior human factors engineers (e.g. interns) and others in organization in usability engineering methods and best practices, as well as Intuitive product development processes.
• Prepare and review documentation for submission to regulatory agencies and notified bodies.
• Answer questions and provide additional justification and rationale to any questions received.
• Keep abreast of regulations and best practices for medical device human factors (e.g. IEC 62366, AAMI HE75, FDA Applying Human Factors and Usability Engineering to Medical Devices) and advise management regarding potential improvements to internal processes and regulatory issues related to usability engineering.

Skills, Experience, Education, & Training:

• Minimum BS in Human Factors Engineering, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science with human-computer interface (HCI) emphasis, Human Centered Design, or related field. MS strongly preferred.

• Experience in medical device, or similar regulated industry, a significant plus
• Ability to lead usability engineering activities (i.e. establishing usability requirements; creating usability risk analyses, test protocols, and test reports) for a complex, software-controlled electro-mechanical medical device
• Ability to interface with customers in a highly professional manner

The Office Service Associate is responsible for adding value in providing daily back office services for our client and teams.  Services include but are not limited to reprographics (copy) and mail services in both physical and digital environments, with support for services in hospitality, facilities, audio/visual, reception, and other Williams Lea service lines as needed.

Job duties

(* denotes an “essential function”)

• *Utilize appropriate logs for all office services work.
• *Ensure that job tickets are properly filled out before beginning work.
• *Perform work in office services, primarily reprographics, mail and intake functions according to established procedures.
• *Follow procedures to run jobs in proper order.
• *Communicate with supervisor or client on job or deadline issues.
• *Meet contracted deadlines for accepting, completing, and delivering all work.
• *Troubleshoot basic equipment problems.
• Be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a regular basis.
• Prioritize workflow.
• Performs Quality Assurance on own and work of others.
• Load machines with various paper, toner, supplies.
• Answer telephone, emails, and place service calls when needed.
• Interact with clients in person, over the phone or electronically.
• Adhere to Williams Lea policies in addition to client site policies.
• Use equipment and supplies in a cost-efficient manner.

• High school diploma or equivalent.
• Minimum (1) year office services experience preferably in a legal, banking or large corporate environment.
• Proficient using mail, phone, email, digital reprographics and mail equipment.
• Familiar with general back office procedures to meet and maintain client satisfaction.
• Proven customer service skills are required in order to create, maintain and enhance customer relationships.
• Good written and verbal communication skills, including professional telephone and email etiquette.
• Attention to detail with good organizational skills.
• Must be able to meet deadlines and complete all projects in a timely manner.
• Ability to handle sensitive and/or confidential documents and information.
• Able to make independent decisions that conform to business needs and policy.
• Good problem-solving skills, with the ability and understanding of when to escalate a problem to a supervisory level.
• Must work well in a team environment.
• Must be able to interact effectively with multi-functional and diverse backgrounds.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Must be self-motivated with positive can-do attitude.

jobs.title: Transcon Manager
jobs.description:
Department Manager manage the department and leads the team to achieving flawless operational execution, developing a strong and reliable team infrastructure, technical expertise, knowledgeable and promotable personnel while constantly driving efficiency, profitability and growth contributing our Vision and Mission Statement, making our promise real to all our employees and customers.

Key Deliverables

•Proactively monitor key metrics to achieve expected results, department excellence above 90%:

People - Total Commitment to Employee Satisfaction & Development.

• Timely & Valuable Performance Reviews every 12 months and 1:1s every 3 months.
• Team members to complete mandatory and 52-hrs. training per year/4.33 per month.

Operational Excellence - Drive Customer Satisfaction through Execution & Transparency.

• Operational performance KPI above 90%.
• Product OPA Audit Result.

Finance - Relentless Pursuit of Efficiency driving capacity, productivity (Increase SPP & Reduce EPS).

• OIBB Growth – 10% increase year over year and Ratio R:E = 2:1 Minimum.
• Increase department Shipment Count - 10% year over year.
• A/R within terms – 100% of A/R within 30 days of customers’ credit terms.
• Reserves - No Reserves (A/R, Provisions, Intercompany).
• Reduce EPS (Expense per Shipment).

Customers

• Revenue Growth – 10% increase year over year.
• 5% revenue diversification (New Business).
• 5% of New Revenue every year (New Logo).
• Customer Loyalty – Business reviews every 3 months score 100%.
• Customer Meetings – At least 8 face to face meetings per month.
• Customer Retention 100%.

Administration and Personnel Management:

• Exemplify and Teach Our Culture, Mission and Goals.
• Follow the 10 Critical Success Factors and the ‘What’s expected of a Manager’ guidelines.
• Servant Leadership mindset. Use team feedback to adapt and maximize the leadership capacities.
• Ensure that department is properly staffed, structured and organized and interview regularly.
• Ensure all needs and tools required are available for the Department to be successful in all areas.
• Support your team and help them develop their careers through to the next level of account management or other positions within Expeditors.
• Engage with team members daily, conduct check-in meetings regularly assisting them with ongoing feedback, coaching and mentoring.
• Be visionary as it relates to managing staff, processes and tools to be able to handle volume spikes, growth locally or supporting other branches.
• Define and establish a structure to cover operational needs of the dept., considering future growth.
• Own your self-development. Prepare, follow-up and execute on your personal development goals.
• Build healthy cross-functional relationship and work environment, promote team spirit and cohesiveness in the department.
• Ensure that company controls, policies, procedures, processes are understood and complied with.
• Support all Employee Satisfaction initiatives.
• Manage capacity and resource needs for the department.
• Define, execute and update department TBP, goals, drive execution and monitor the progress.

Operations Key Responsibilities:

•Effectively manage and monitor service execution within the Transcon department, leading and assisting our relentless pursuit of efficiency and operational excellence:

• Performance Management: Ensure oversight, including self-assessments and daily, weekly and monthly performance monitoring so that issues (root cause) are resolved proactively.
• Exception Management: Review all exceptions to drive efficiency internally (controlled) and through interacting with our customers (uncontrolled).
• Map and understand department process flow, constantly looking for areas to improve efficiency to offer customers better cycle times, service while improving margins.
• Actively participate in the optimization of systems and tools and continuously improve the efficiency, productivity and quality of the service.
• Make certain that client specific instructions are understood at the desk level to properly process shipments and invoices. Maintain SOPs updated for all customers.
• Ensure proper use of all Expeditor systems and tools, especially ETMS, CRM, Transcon workflow, etc. Make certain that files are logged correctly and timely with proper codes, trace types and events.
• Ensure that all correspondence within business unit is handled timely and professionally.
• Build and maintaining strong relationships with service providers and customers.
• Manage service provider program, ensuring high-level operational efficiency and complete evaluation of service providers, as necessary.
• Stay current with developments and changes in regulations or company offerings and educate staff.
• Escalate issues to Department Manager and Branch Operations Manager timely when needed.

Sales, Marketing and Growth:

• Define business development strategy to ensure existing customer revenue growth.
• Active involvement with sales, customer retention and development, and account management globally to maintain and develop relationships with existing and new customers.
• Drive Product Pipeline to achieve Net Revenue Growth goals (10% increase year over year).
• Support Project Manager Operations, T&I, and account management teams to make certain that customer requirements are both understood and properly Transitioned and implemented.
• Respond to requests for proposal, quotation or information timely and with market competitive pricing matching the scope of service required by the customer.
• Actively participate in customer visits and calls and ensure that they are documented in CRM.
• Prepare effective customer presentations and updates.
• Active involvement and Collaboration with Corridor Business Development Mgr. and Sales teams.

Finance Excellence:

• Comply with all our policies, including the credit policy.
• Monitor the Daily Branch Revenue report (Daily) to identify and correct errors timely.
• Ensure that all files are timely and correctly billed.
• Review department P&L monthly and understand department’s net revenue and expenses incurred.
• Review and manage department profitability at the customer and file level.
• Manage and ensure that all billed not paid and paid not billed items are properly handle and closed.
• Support with the team when necessary to solve customer A/R and communicate with customers regarding either late payments or invoice discrepancies.
• Participate on the preparation of the yearly budget and manage the efforts towards meeting budget.
• Ensure Department operates in compliance with all Finance Policies, including but not limited to: Timely Invoicing, Revenue Recognition, Accounting Do’s and Don’ts, Credit, etc.

Compliance:

• Ensure full adherence to all applicable Transcon and transportation regulations, maintaining the highest compliance standards.
• Serve as a role model for integrity by consistently following company policies and promoting a culture of accountability.
• Communicate policies and regulatory requirements to ensure team understanding and compliance.

Security, Health and Safety:

• Immediatel notify the Branch’s Health and Safety representative any unsafe condition that could put employees at risk in the workplace as well as any incident or accident.

To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following education, experience, and competencies:

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
• 4+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation operations, required.
• 2+ years of experience in domestic transportation, preferred.
• 3+ year of supervisory experience, required.
• 1+ year of Operations Manager experience, preferred.
• Proven success in business development, customer engagement, and strategic relationship management.
• Strong leadership skills, and developing high-performing teams, prioritizing employee satisfaction.
• Solid business acumen, including P&L management, commercial decision-making. Strong focus in customer satisfaction.
• Highly organized and Strategic planning.
• Leading change.
• Excellent analytical, project management, process improvement, and problem-solving capabilities.
• Strong influencing and communication skills.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and business systems.
• Process-oriented and commitment to continuous improvement.
• Results-driven, with a track record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
• Excellent negotiation skills and ability to build long-term partnerships.
• Strong interpersonal and communication abilities, including written, verbal, and presentation.
• English and Spanish fluency.

jobs.title: Fleet Support Administrator (Palm Beach DJT Airport)
jobs.description:
Are you a people person with a passion for delivering premium experiences and keeping operations running like a well-oiled machine? As a Fleet Support Administrator at SIXT, you'll be the face of our brand, welcoming customers, guiding them through their rental journey, and ensuring every vehicle is ready for the road. From the moment a customer walks through the door to the moment they drive away, you'll play a vital role in making it seamless, professional, and memorable. Enjoy flexible hours, endless growth opportunities, and a starting salary of $18.50 per hour.

YOUR ROLE AT SIXT

• You welcome every customer with a professional, friendly attitude, directing them to appropriate stations and maintaining efficient flow while ensuring a clean, organized front-of-house presence that reflects SIXT's premium brand standards
• You verify customer documents, check driver's license validity, and assist customers in selecting the right vehicle while handling exchanges to meet business needs
• You offer additional products and services such as prepaid fuel and toll passes, address customer questions and concerns, and finalize rental agreements by confirming documents and explaining charges with accurate receipts
• You complete return transactions by inspecting rental vehicles for damage, fuel levels, and mileage, advising customers on final charges while discreetly handling findings and directing issues to appropriate channels
• You perform daily inventory checks, manage vehicle availability, coordinate with dealerships and body shops for repairs, and schedule maintenance while obtaining estimates and generating purchase orders
• You prepare new vehicles for rental by adding documentation, decals, and tags, enter them into the inventory system, oversee vehicle disposal preparation, and ensure personal belongings are removed from returned vehicles

YOUR SKILLS MATTER

• Customer Service You have at least 1 year of customer service experience, ideally with a background in sales, service, or hospitality, and a genuine passion for creating memorable guest experience
• Organization & Analysis You are highly organized with strong analytical abilities, capable of managing fleet inventory, repair schedules, work orders, and documentation while delivering data-driven insights
• Education & Licensing You hold a high school diploma or GED, are at least 18 years old, hold a valid driver's license with a clean driving record, and are authorized to work in the United States
• Technical Skills You possess basic computer navigation skills and are familiar with Microsoft Office applications such as Excel
• Communication & Teamwork You have excellent communication skills and thrive as a team player in a fast-paced environment, coordinating effectively across departments with a positive attitude
• Schedule Flexibility You can work up to 40 hours per week, including day or evening shifts and weekend shifts

WHAT WE OFFER

• Comprehensive Benefits Package Enjoy healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision), life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and pet insurance, along with a 401k plan to secure your future
• Paid Time Off & Holidays Benefit from PTO, sick leave, and receive time and a half for working on public holidays
• Bonus Plan Take advantage of a bonus plan based on performance
• Employee Assistance Program Access support whenever needed through our Employee Assistance Program
• Exclusive Employee Rentals Benefit from employee-only rental rates, with family rental options and exclusive discounts for employees
• Uniform & Perks Receive a uniform with weekly dry cleaning, always ensuring a professional appearance

About us:

We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

jobs.title: Print Production Manager
jobs.description:
The Print and Media Production Manager is responsible for a large 24x5 digital print-on-demand production facility of 20-25 employees (25-50 peak season). Responsible for all associated activities in an on-demand environment including, but not limited to staffing, talent development, forecasting procurement, and plant capacities, meeting customer timelines, vendor relations, and process improvement.

The Media Factory manager will also interact with internal customers to ensure critical deadlines are met and utilize skills to further develop and maintain internal procedures. Additionally, working closely with upper management on research, development, and implementation of new processes and equipment will be required.

Your Tasks

• Maintain adequate staffing levels. Identify seasonal trends in volume and turnover
• Complete supervisor performance appraisals and wage reviews. Assist with associate appraisal and wage reviews
• Work with associates to identify and develop training, as well as develop department structure to meet customer’s needs
• Assist Director with department hiring decisions
• Resolution of issues within or between departments
• Be able to coach, mentor, and train employees, helping in their development. Participate in departmental training in an effort to improve efficiency. Consistently challenge the status quo and push others to improve via critical/constructive feedback
• Must have the ability to lead, drive and inspire change. Drive change by initiating and leading projects to improve current processes within the department as well as those that impact the entire organization
• Assist Director with special projects as needed and provide leadership within the team on a daily basis and in the absence of the Director to include creating a team environment to effectively manage deadlines, workload, and morale
• Responsible for 24 hr. print and binding production operations.
• Must coordinate staffing and schedule in order to meet all customer requirements.

• Associate degree or 5+ years in a management role, 3+ years high volume digital print & mail fulfillment manufacturing experience preferredSuccessful track record of developing and promoting talent into functional positions and leadership roles
• Strong Technical and mechanical troubleshooting skills across various production equipment are a must
• Proficiency in MS Office with emphasis on MS Excel
• Experience effectively managing labor and material costs at the department P&L cost center level
• Strong analytical skills along with excellent problem identification and resolution skills required
• Adept with forecasting and scheduling daily, weekly, and monthly production volumes
• Strong organizational skills with proven ability to utilize productivity standards to determine and prioritize workload and headcount across work centers and shifts a must
• Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to get results
• High attention to detail
• While performing the duties, the Media Factory manager may be required to work from a PC for a long period of time.
• Walk production floor to monitor production progress; assist with troubleshooting equipment production issues; occasionally lift or move objects up to 35lbs.

• Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, and Disability Pay.

• Paid Time Off, including paid holidays.

• Support of non-traditional inventory programs, including automated printing and print on demand

• Daily management of titles at remote locations, including recently established UK warehouse, through local printing and transfer programs

• Ownership of data flows from external vendors into Inventory maintained reports and dashboards

• Development and maintenance of operational best practices for the Inventory Management team, including regular updates to sales and returns status, stock review and clean-up, and reporting against established KPIs

• 1-2 years’ experience in data analysis or equivalent role
• Excellent analytical skills; comfortability with numbers and data
• Ability to proactively and creatively problem solve
• Strong organizational and time management skills

• Supervise and support team members, providing guidance, coaching, and performance feedback to ensure high standards of work
• Manage staff scheduling, time-off requests, and ensure adequate coverage to meet operational needs
• Assist in training new employees and facilitate ongoing professional development initiatives
• Monitor and analyze operational metrics, identifying opportunities for process improvement and efficiency gains
• Maintain a professional and supportive work environment that promotes teamwork and employee engagement
• Handle customer inquiries and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner
• Coordinate with management on inventory management, stock rotation, and merchandising standards
• Perform administrative duties including documentation, reporting, and record-keeping
• Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulations

Level I – Minimum

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

Additional support for projects in development for biocompatibility activities is a responsibility of this role.

Sci.) impact assessment notifications. Have knowledge on how to support notified body and internal audits, inspections, with respect to ISO 10993 compliance and documentation. Assist the biocompatibility team in development of functional training initiatives. Create a recurring training schedule for biocompatibility and change control

• Bachelor’s Degree in Life Science or related field with minimal 10 years of experience in a scientific role in the medical device or pharma industry OR Master’s degree (with thesis) in Life Science or related field with at least 8 years of experience in a scientific role in the medical device or pharma industry.

As Senior Product Manager –Filtration, you will own the P&L, strategy, and execution for Moen's Water Filtration portfolio. Maintaining a consumer-centric mindset and a strong understanding of consumer and customer needs, you will drive product strategy and execution across B2B and B2C channels. Partnering closely with Channel, Sales, and Digital/eCommerce, you will deliver an innovative product portfolio that achieves market share, revenue, and margin objectives.

You will develop actionable product plans, including defining product specifications, pricing, commercialization, and go-to-market strategies tailored to each channel. Your leadership will require strong alignment with R&D, Engineering, Project Management, and external suppliers to deliver leading-edge design and innovation, ensure successful product launches, and drive continued portfolio performance to help shape the future of Moen's Water Filtration business.

We're looking for a strategic, commercially minded leader who combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of water filtration technology, filter media, and testing requirements. You'll bring the ability to translate consumer insights, competitive analysis, and technical requirements into innovative, market-leading solutions that drive business growth.

POSITION LOCATION/TRAVEL: This is a hybrid role based in Deerfield, IL. This is a hybrid position based in our world-class Deerfield campus, with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays. The campus offers vibrant, collaborative workspaces, along with amenities for dining, onsite daycare, fitness, and recreation.

Travel of approximately 15–20% is required to support industry events, headquarters meetings, and other business-related activities.

What You'll Do

Filtration Portfolio Management

• Translate Point of Use Water Filtration strategy to an ongoing 3-year product roadmap across Moen products types for Wholesale and Retail channels.
• Manage the complete product lifecycle, including innovation, commercialization, portfolio optimization, and end-of-life decisions.
• Partner with Engineering and Suppliers on product plan execution
• Solve problems through critical thinking, clear communication and accountability
• Drive alignment through excellent communication and relationship building across departments
• Coordinate with Innovation and Consumer Insights to drive meaningful research that supports the business needs

Own the NPD Deliverables

• Lead the development of new products from concept through launch, including business case development, product requirements definition and post-launch performance evaluation.
• Drive alignment with partnering cross functions: Engineering, ID, Sourcing, Channel, and Sales priorities
• Troubleshoot project hurdles with Project Management and cross functional teams to ensure smooth and successful NPD process

Commercialize the product

• Define market segment priorities and partner with Channel Marketing establish Go To Market plans to achieve P&L objectives.
• Partner with Brand Marketing to align messaging with product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies that drive customer adoption and business growth.
• Own and deploy user training and documentation to support Sales, Customer Service and in-Channel needs
• Own demand planning inputs with alignment for new launches
• Support sales teams through training, participation in industry events, and ongoing engagement with partners and associations.

Financial Responsibility

• Drive category revenue, margin, market share, and innovation performance across multiple product platforms.
• Lead pricing decisions for filtration product portfolio, driving net sales and margin contribution to achieve P&L objectives.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field.
• 7+ years of product management experience with product lifecycle management, pricing, commercialization, consumer segmentation, and portfolio performance preferably within building products, and/or consumer or durable home goods.
• Experience managing water filtration products, with a strong understanding of filter media, filtration mechanisms, and associated technical requirements.
• Experience with P&L ownership and applying financial and market insights to product decision-making.
• Demonstrated success in developing innovative, new-to-portfolio products and leading successful product launches through a stage-gate or equivalent process.
• Strong understanding of B2B and B2C channels, consumer, customer, and channel needs, with the ability to translate insights and technical requirements into product strategy and roadmap priorities.
• Demonstrated ability to develop and support high-performing teams and collaborate across complex organizations.
• Experience partnering with Sales, Engineering, and external suppliers to bring differentiated, high-quality products to market.
• Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills, with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and SAP.
• Ability to travel approximately 15–20%.

jobs.title: Cargo Installation Lead
jobs.description:
As an active and hands-on member of the cargo team that leads installation functions at the established work sites. The leader will be dedicated to directing the installation of the Smiths-related systems and guiding the installation team to accomplish the MEP/RPM/LEP and/or HE rail installations on time and on budget working with the Program manager and his assigned leaders tasked with keeping the other activities (i.e. civil works) on schedule to complete the job as required. The leader will be dedicated to the site, and this will be a traveling position. The leader will have full responsibility of the installation & integration of the Smiths related systems to the customers equipment as noted by the site design documents. The leader will be expected to be present at the site on a weekly basis working at least 2 to 3 weeks out of the month to maintain schedules and efficiency of the installation.

SPECIFIC DUTIES, ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO:

• Subject Matter Expert (SME) on the system mechanics, electronics, and safety systems of the product
• Has all SDI service safety training and has had Specialized product specific Service Maintenance training, trained as an alternate Radiation Safety Officer (RSO).
• Manage the receipt and inventory of the Smiths materials on site, inspection post shipping to the site, advises and documents any damage to the PM for ordering replacements
• Leads the service installation team of FST’s & TST’s. Hold daily safety standup meetings and huddles to lay out the work for the day
• Coordinate the install of the equipment package at the site with the support of the onsite contractors and the assigned cargo team members
• Coordinate directly with SD/SDI operations/engineering for any issues such as server/networking configurations and updates, escalates to PM as needed
• Tests and commissions the system equipment to the approved CBP Site Acceptance Test Plan (SAT). Performs radiation surveys at the site
• Conducts IQI site testing and conducts the SAT test with the CBP test managers, compiles the CI list (serial numbers for all the equipment delivered to CBP)
• Organizes and de-mobilization from the site of all tools and support equipment
• Ensure successful Service operations by monitoring progress against plan, forecast and defined metrics as well as implementing corrective measures as needed (i.e. PM Compliance, Work Order management in Service Max, etc.)
• Convey the vision, set expectations and challenge staff to achieve Service’s operations and support goals.
• Develop and maintain a work culture that is successful and committed to excellent customer service.
• Participate in supplier and customer negotiations as needed to recognize opportunities, to ensure cost-efficiency and maintain alignment with company goals.
• Develop and build upon relationships with other functional disciplines within the company.
• Works across functions to ensure business is transacted accurately and within guidelines to the highest ethical standards
• Ability to travel regularly is a critical requirement to meet business objectives. Travel initiative is estimated at 60%.
• Comply with and ensure department compliance with Company health, safety and environmental policies
• Other duties as required

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor - Riverhead NY
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $17.25 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.description:
THE POSITION:

The Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for providing administrative support to the recruiting team. This role will assist with various tasks related to the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, scheduling interviews, and managing applicant tracking systems. The TA Specialist will deliver superior experiences to potential talent through the recruiting and hiring process and will maintain working relationships with internal stakeholders.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist for EVERSANA, you will be tasked with candidate engagement and coordination activities related to interviewing, background checks, and sourcing. You will demonstrate success by:

• Source and screen candidates using various methods, including job boards, social media, and employee referrals.
• Schedule and coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
• Manage and maintain applicant tracking systems, ensuring data accuracy and compliance.
• Assist with the onboarding process for new hires, including paperwork and orientation.
• Provide administrative support to the recruiting team, such as creating job postings, generating reports, and managing candidate communications.
• Assist with special projects and initiatives as needed.
• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
• All other duties as assigned.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, it is the policy of EVERSANA to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by an employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for EVERSANA. If reasonable accommodation is needed to perform the essential functions of your job position, please contact Human Resources.

EXPECTATIONS OF THE JOB:

• Travel (Less than 5%)
• Hours (40 hours per week, Monday through Friday)
• Partner with recruiters and people leaders to coordinate and schedule interviews, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for candidates and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer, Search and Conversational AI
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

This role will be based in Sunnyvale, San Francisco or New York.

The workforce is evolving at a scale and pace unseen since the Industrial Revolution, and LinkedIn Search is uniquely positioned to help. Join us as we transform LinkedIn Search from a traditional jobs and people lookup tool into an indispensable, AI-powered partner that connects 1B+ global users to economic opportunity.

As a Staff Product Designer, you will shape the future of next-gen search, content discovery, and conversational AI experiences. Operating at the intersection of deep technical architecture and human-centered design, you will lead zero-to-one initiatives within a mature global platform, turning ambitious AI capabilities into intuitive, beautiful, and transformative products.

Responsibilities:

• Architect Next-Gen Search & AI Experiences: Lead the end-to-end design of conversational AI, content discovery, and search interfaces across platforms. Craft experiences specifically optimized for non-deterministic outcomes
• Bridge Design, Science, and Deep Tech: Partner hand-in-hand with Engineering, Product, and AI Research Scientists to navigate complex search tech stacks. Leverage your technical aptitude to inform model requirements, system instructions, and cross-functional product strategy.
• Rapid Interactive Prototyping: Utilize advanced prototyping tools and AI-driven workflows to simulate live model responses, build interactive concepts, and validate dynamic user flows in rapid experimentation loops.
• Drive Vision Through Systems Thinking: Apply a rigorous systems-thinking approach to ensure individual UI components integrate seamlessly into a cohesive, global product ecosystem. Drive clarity out of ambiguity and shepherd radical, divergent ideas from initial concept to launch.
• Design for Responsible Global Impact: Craft visual, motion, and interaction patterns that set industry benchmarks. Ensure every experience adheres to world-class standards in localization, usability, safety, accessibility, and ethical AI.

Basic Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree in graphic design, design communication, human-computer interaction, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
• 8+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating leadership on complex, high-impact consumer products.
• Proven ability to lead design in ambiguous and technically rigorous problem spaces, setting direction and driving alignment across multiple partners or teams.
• Background in interaction and visual design expertise, with a refined sense of typography, layout, hierarchy, and motion.
• Deep UX fundamentals, including information architecture, system-level thinking, and designing for engagement and retention at scale.
• Fluency in Figma and modern prototyping workflows, with the ability to move between low- and high-fidelity as needed.
• Data-informed mindset, comfortable partnering with research and analytics to shape hypotheses, evaluate outcomes, and iterate.
• Experience in communication and storytelling skills, including experience presenting to senior leaders and influencing without authority.
• Experience understanding accessibility standards and inclusive design best practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Demonstrated AI & Search Expertise: Extensive experience designing complex software applications with specific expertise in consumer search including conversational AI, model tuning using reinforcement learning, supervised fine-tuning, and other industry best practices to deliver high-quality user outcomes.
• Proven Track Record of Impact: A history of shepherding radical ideas, fostering divergent design thinking, and shipping transformative zero-to-one products within scaled, highly matrixed environments.
• Deep Technical Aptitude: Comfort navigating technical architecture and working directly with AI/ML engineering teams. Experience using system instructions, AI tools, and interactive prototyping platforms (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Figma) to shape UX requirements.
• Systems & Craft Mastery: Exceptional fluency across visual design, motion design, interaction patterns, and scalable design systems across desktop and mobile platforms.
• Data-Informed & Action-Oriented: Ability to leverage behavioral data and user research methodologies to evaluate AI interactions, paired with the strong intuition needed to move forward confidently in the absence of data.
• Executive Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to articulate design rationale clearly and influence strategy across executive partners.
• Champion for Responsible AI: A passionate commitment to building ethical, safe, inclusive, and accessible products for a diverse global audience.

Suggested Skills:

• Product Thinking
• Visual Design
• Interaction Design
• AI Prototyping
• Data Literacy
• Storytelling
• Leadership

jobs.title: Engineer, Technology I
jobs.description:
AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Research (IR) organization is seeking an Engineer, Technology I to help deliver trusted, well-structured, AI-ready data products within ARCH, AbbVie’s R&D Convergence Hub. As part of the DELOS team — Data Exploration and Linked Outcome Solutions — this role helps build the reliable data foundations needed to advance analytics, reporting, knowledge graph capabilities, machine learning, and AI-enabled use cases across R&D.

In this role, you will independently design and develop data pipelines and curated data assets within assigned projects, applying established architecture, engineering patterns, and governance standards. You will collect, integrate, normalize, model, and document research data; implement quality checks; and support publication to the ARCH knowledge graph. Rather than developing AI models directly, you will prepare reliable, accessible, and appropriately governed data for analytics, data science, and AI-enabled use cases.

Working with R&D stakeholders, data scientists, machine learning engineers, platform teams, architects, and data owners, you will translate defined scientific and business requirements into dependable data solutions. You will perform routine and complex engineering tasks independently, understand project objectives and your contribution to them, adapt your approach when needed, and communicate progress, risks, and issues. You will collaborate with internal and contracted engineers on assigned work, seeking guidance on broader architecture decisions and escalating issues outside your scope.

Under the direction of the Associate Director – Data Strategy, AI & Knowledge Enablement, this role contributes to AbbVie’s R&D data transformation by delivering consistent, well-documented data solutions within agreed project scope and timelines. You will learn and apply new methods and technologies to help research partners use trusted data for scientific decision-making.

**This is a hybrid role based in Lake County, IL (Tue, Wed, Thu)

Responsibilities

• Data Pipeline & Product Development: Independently design and develop pipelines and curated data assets for assigned scientific or business use cases. Collect, integrate, normalize, model, and transform data from databases, applications, APIs, licensed external sources, and other systems using established engineering patterns.
• Reliable Project Delivery: Perform routine and complex engineering tasks competently and independently, producing reliable and consistent results within agreed timelines. Understand broader project objectives, organize assigned work, and adapt your approach when requirements or priorities change.
• AI & Knowledge Graph Data Preparation: Clean, standardize, enrich, and structure data and documents for downstream analytics, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and knowledge discovery. Organize metadata, support established chunking and embedding workflows, and prepare curated assets for publication to the ARCH knowledge graph.
• Data Quality & Technical Documentation: Implement defined data quality checks and maintain technical documentation for pipelines and data assets, including metadata, lineage, transformations, assumptions, and usage guidance. Apply established access, privacy, licensing, and governance requirements.
• Collaboration & Progress Communication: Work with scientific, business, engineering, and platform partners to clarify requirements and deliver assigned work. Clearly present project objectives, progress, risks, and issues; collaborate with internal and contracted contributors without responsibility for directing their delivery.
• Operations & Method Improvement: Monitor assigned pipelines for performance, freshness, failures, and resource use; troubleshoot and resolve issues within your scope and escalate when needed. Learn and implement new methods and technologies and contribute to reusable patterns and automation with guidance as appropriate.
• Compliance & Standards: Understand and adhere to applicable Corporate and Divisional policies, including code of conduct, safety, GxP compliance, data security, data governance, relevant regulatory or contractual requirements, and the software development lifecycle.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Data Engineering, Computer Science, Informatics, Life Sciences, or a related field plus 4 years of experience; Master’s Degree plus 2 years of experience.
• Practical experience developing data pipelines or data solutions using SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT patterns, with knowledge of workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow.
• Theoretical and practical knowledge of data integration, data modeling, data storage, and modern data platforms sufficient to independently complete routine and complex engineering tasks within established standards.
• Experience cleaning, standardizing, transforming, and documenting data for analytics or scientific use, including applying data quality checks and organizing metadata.
• Ability to organize assigned work, multitask, meet timelines, understand project objectives, adapt your approach when needed, and learn and apply new methods and technologies.
• Strong written and oral English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical work, present project objectives and progress, and collaborate with scientific, business, and technical partners.
• Hands-on data engineering: develop reusable, well-structured data assets for defined analytics and AI-enabled use cases.
• Data quality and documentation: apply established metadata, lineage, governance, and appropriate-use practices to assigned data assets.
• Technical problem-solving: apply practical knowledge of data platforms, pipelines, integration, and orchestration; learn and implement new tools and methods.
• Work planning and operational discipline: organize concurrent assignments, monitor pipelines, troubleshoot issues, meet timelines, and escalate risks when needed.
• Team collaboration: clarify requirements, share technical knowledge, and work effectively with internal and external contributors on assigned project tasks.
• Clear communication: explain technical concepts and present project objectives, progress, risks, and dependencies to scientific, business, and technical audiences.

Preferred

• Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences industry experience, particularly with research, discovery, translational, clinical, or scientific data.
• Familiarity with knowledge graphs, graph databases, ontology-based structures, semantic data, or linked-data concepts.
• Exposure to cloud or modern data platform technologies such as AWS, Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, or Neo4j, and to Agile delivery practices or tools such as Jira.
• Exposure to data preparation for machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, or vector search, and familiarity with governance, security, privacy, licensing, or documentation in regulated data environments.

Together, we are changing the world’s relationship with financial services. At Kunai, we help our clients modernize, capitalize on emerging trends, and evolve their business for the coming decades by remaining tech-agnostic and human-centered.

The Opportunity

As an AI Delivery Engineer on PwC’s client-facing Generative AI team, you work alongside client teams to turn business problems into AI applications that people use every day. You join a multidisciplinary delivery pod and take work from first discovery workshop through prototype, production release, and handoff to the client’s own engineers. 70% of your time is spent building on Amazon Bedrock and related AWS services, 30% working directly with client users and technical teams.

Responsibilities

• Map client workflows with business users and process owners, then define use cases, delivery backlogs, and measurable acceptance criteria

• Build working prototypes early and test them against representative client data and user feedback

• Develop agent workflows, retrieval and grounding, tool calling, and APIs using Python, Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, and Bedrock Knowledge Bases

• Integrate AI solutions with client systems using AWS Lambda, Amazon SageMaker, and approved data sources, with authentication and permission-aware access through AWS IAM

• Write automated tests and AI evaluations, and build deployment pipelines, monitoring, and error handling

• Assess each solution against agreed release criteria for quality, safety, latency, reliability, and cost

• Configure Amazon Bedrock Guardrails and work with security, privacy, and risk specialists to turn requirements into technical controls, audit evidence, and human review steps

• Co-build with client engineers and provide documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer so the client team can operate the solution

• Contribute reusable components, evaluation assets, and implementation patterns to PwC’s engineering community, within client confidentiality and IP obligations

• Support pursuits through technical demonstrations, feasibility assessments, and delivery estimates

What You Must Have

• 4+ years of experience building and deploying production software

• 3+ years of experience writing Python in production

• 3+ years of experience building on AWS, including AWS Lambda and AWS IAM

• 1+ year of experience building applications that use LLMs, including retrieval, structured outputs, tool calling, or agent workflows

• Experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders to clarify requirements and demonstrate progress

• Experience with version control, automated testing, and deployment pipelines

• Ability to travel up to 70%, typically M - Th, including on-site work with clients

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

What Sets You Apart

• Delivery experience with Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Bedrock Guardrails, or Amazon SageMaker

• Experience building at least one production application on AWS that calls a foundation model through Amazon Bedrock or another model API

• Experience building evaluation datasets, adversarial tests, or AI observability for a production system

• Experience with enterprise search, document processing, or structured and unstructured data pipelines

• Experience building tools or integrations using APIs or Model Context Protocol

• Proficiency in a second language such as TypeScript, Java, or Go

• AWS Certifications, such as Solutions Architect – Professional or Associate, or Certified Generative AI Developer

• Experience in financial services, consumer markets, or technology, media, and telecommunications, which make up PwC's client base

• Experience mentoring engineers

Compensation

- The salary range for the Senior Engineer is 135 - 170k. The salary range for the Staff Engineer is 164 - 220k.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Competitive compensation

• Access to industry leading diagnostic tools

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• Advanced mechanical aptitude and working knowledge of tools

• Extensive knowledge of construction equipment with an advanced understanding of schematics and diagrams

• Superior customer service, teamwork and verbal/written communication skills

Education and Experience:

Physical Requirements:

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

jobs.title: Sr Professional Services Consultant
jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai.

Role Overview

As a Consulting Engineer in Vectra AI Professional Services, you will lead technically complex customer implementations across enterprise and Federal environments. You will combine deep cybersecurity expertise, solution architecture, hands-on deployment, production-ready integrations, and threat analysis to help customers operationalize Vectra solutions and strengthen their security posture. This role requires independent ownership of customer engagements, strong technical judgment, and clear communication with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end implementation onboarding for enterprise and Federal customers, including solution architecture, design reviews, installation, configuration, troubleshooting, testing, validation, documentation, and operational handover.

• Deploy and configure Vectra AI products, including Detect, Recall, Stream, Match, and IDR/CDR, across on-premises, virtual, and cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

• Apply Vectra’s implementation methodology to validate traffic flows, assess sensor data health, identify coverage gaps, and tune triage workflows.

• Integrate Vectra into customer security ecosystems, including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and identity platforms, using built-in capabilities and production-ready custom API integration scripts.

• Provide expert technical guidance on solution designs, proofs of concept, and implementations; identify security architecture blind spots and recommend practical remediation.

• Analyze threats, reconstruct exploitation trails, and investigate attacker lateral movement within customer networks to inform detection, triage, and remediation guidance.

• Lead customer workshops and training on platform capabilities, investigative workflows, integrations, and day-to-day operations.

• Manage implementation plans, milestones, technical dependencies, and risks; maintain accurate deployment records and customer handover materials.

• Respond to and document customer requests, resolve implementation issues, and coordinate escalation of complex problems with appropriate internal teams.

• Conduct security research that improves understanding of emerging threats and translate findings into customer guidance and reusable delivery practices.

• Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, reusable integration assets, and continuous improvement of Professional Services delivery.

• Drive customer satisfaction through clear communication, reliable engagement delivery, and effective customer enablement.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, systems engineering, technical consulting, or customer environments, with demonstrated customer-facing implementation ownership.

• 2+ years of professional security consulting experience.

• Federal DoD TS/SCI clearance, required for the Federal customer scope of this role.

• Hands-on proficiency deploying, configuring, troubleshooting, and operating security platforms, including NDR/CDR, EDR, SIEM, and forensics-oriented tools.

Specific benefits offered varies by location, but commonly include health care insurance, income protection / life insurance, access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services, generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program.

Position: AI Product Management Intern
