What You'll Do

As an Intern at KEEN (KEENtern), you’ll dive into the exciting world of footwear, innovation, and community! You’ll get hands-on experience working alongside industry experts and contribute to shaping the future of KEEN.

As an AI Product Management KEENtern, you’ll help KEEN identify, design, test, and scale practical ways AI can make a meaningful difference for KEENers, our fans, and the business.

You’ll work across teams to understand how work happens today, where friction or opportunity exists, and where AI could help create better outcomes. You’ll turn those insights into clear opportunities, prototypes, pilots, and recommendations.

Essential Responsibilities

• Partner with teams across KEEN to map workflows, understand pain points, and identify high-potential AI opportunities.

• Research emerging AI capabilities, tools, and relevant examples from consumer, retail, footwear, and other industries.

• Help define AI use cases, including the problem to solve, intended users, desired outcomes, risks, data needs, and measures of success.

• Help document pilots, lessons learned, adoption signals, and potential business value for leadership and project teams.

• Create practical materials—such as playbooks, workflow maps, use-case briefs, training resources, or communications—that make new ways of working easier to understand and adopt.

• Contribute to responsible AI practices with privacy, security, accuracy, bias, brand, and human oversight in project work.

Minimum Qualifications

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Psychology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Operations, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, product management, process improvement, innovation, or digital transformation.

• Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, AI agents, and core concepts such as model limitations, evaluation, data quality, and human oversight; ideally demonstrated through hands-on projects, prototypes, coursework, research, or work experience building with AI.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to solve problems, analyze information, synthesize findings, and turn them into clear recommendations.

• Commitment to responsible handling of confidential information and sound judgment when using AI tools.

What We’re Looking For:

• We’re looking for a curious, action-oriented KEENtern who wants to help shape how work gets done in alignment with a human-centered and responsible AI approach

• You see AI as more than a tool for doing today’s work faster. You’re interested in asking better questions: What could be simpler? What could be smarter? What could become possible if we redesigned the workflow from the ground up?

• You bring a builder’s mindset. You are comfortable moving from ambiguity to action, listening closely to people’s real challenges, and turning ideas into practical experiments. You can balance optimism about emerging technology with sound judgment about people, brand, privacy, and responsible use.

• You believe the best use of AI makes people more capable—not less human. You’re excited to help KEENers spend less time on repetitive work and more time creating, solving problems, making better decisions, and delivering better outcomes for our fans and the planet.

We’re seeking someone who embodies our passion for creativity, sustainability, and the great outdoors. Our ideal KEENtern is:

• Passionate: Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast, committed to sustainability, or fascinated by footwear trends and innovation, you’re excited to engage with the world around you.

• Creatively Minded: You’re detail-oriented, love bringing fresh ideas to life, and have a knack for solving problems.

• A Strong Communicator: Whether it’s collaborating with a team or presenting ideas, you know how to express yourself clearly and effectively.

• Proactive & Eager to Learn: You’re curious, ready to ask questions, take initiative, and dive into new challenges with enthusiasm.

Why Intern with Us?

Being a KEENtern means you’re not just an intern—you’re a valued part of our KEEN community. Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Meaningful Work: Tackle real-world projects that make an impact, gaining valuable hands-on experience at a globally recognized brand.

• Collaborative Environment: Partner with talented teammates and work on a group project with other KEENterns.

• Networking Opportunities: Build connections with industry experts and mentors who can help shape your career.

• Perks & Benefits: Enjoy product discounts, a subsidized cafeteria, and an inspiring workspace.

• Outdoor Adventures: Immerse yourself in Portland – a vibrant city nestled between the mountains and the coast – a hub for all things outdoors, such as hiking, biking, rafting, camping, and climbing.

Program Requirements:

To qualify for this internship, you must:

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business, Psychology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Operations, Computer Science, or a related field.

• Be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship

• Commit to a 10-week program from mid-June through mid-August

• Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint

• Able to learn and adapt quickly to new software and tools

• Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail in preparation of presentations, reports, and materials

• Demonstrate strong organization skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks

• Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate with a team

• Able to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation, including using a computer for extended periods

Ready to Take the Next Step?
If you’re ready to take your passions to the next level and be part of a world-class team, please apply.

jobs.title: Assistant Restaurant Leader
jobs.description:
Your Role at Raising Cane’s:

The Assistant Restaurant Leader is responsible for supporting the Restaurant Leader in day-to-day operations of the restaurant and upholding Raising Cane’s standards and culture in all areas of restaurant operations.

The physical work environment includes working in a fast-paced kitchen environment (which requires extended periods of physical exertion, such as walking, standing, lifting and bending) and interacting with customers. It also includes both inside and outside work in varied temperatures, working with and around food products, common allergens, industrial equipment, commercial cleaning products that require the use of personal protective equipment and physical activities necessary to complete the responsibilities of the job.

Your Impact and Responsibilities

Purpose of the position:

• Hires and terminates all hourly, non-management crewmembers
• Owns the onboarding, status change and payroll process for all hourly crewmembers
• Creates crewmember work and training schedules
• Manages the performance of all hourly crewmembers (e.g. development, coaching, redirective communication and documentation, and other performance management tasks)
• Acts as manager on duty and opens and closes the restaurant
• Manages cash handling and ensures accountability

General to the role:

• Enforces Raising Cane’s policies and standards
• Executes shift management meeting Raising Cane’s operations and safety standards
• Uses required tools, forms and logs to support shift execution, document results and take corrective action when needed
• Deploys crewmembers during a shift
• Provides exemplary customer service
• Utilizes reward and recognition program for the crewmembers in the restaurant
• Authorizes employee functions requiring manager approval (e.g. discounts, promotions, timeclock overrides, etc.)
• Ensures cleanliness of the restaurant and ensures the facility is in good working order
• Completes other duties as assigned

Requirements for Success:

• Detail-oriented, organized and able to manage multiple priorities that may be constantly changing
• Self-driven, flexible, and highly energetic with strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills
• Able to work effectively and efficiently both independently and collaboratively
• Able to recognize and analyze problems, set goals, create plans and convert plans into action to solve problems
• Proficient in a variety of technology systems including Microsoft Office (Excel, Word and Outlook) and ability to learn and adapt to new systems quickly
• Able to work a variety of shifts including days, evenings and weekends and travel as needed for work-related functions and training
• 3+ years of restaurant or retail management experience
• New restaurant opening experience preferred
• Must be 18 years of age or older
• High school diploma or equivalent required, some college preferred
• Possess a valid driver’s license

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Director, Ad Sales & Partner Hub Solutions
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

About the Role

Engine is looking for a Partner Hub Solutions leader to grow and scale our advertising business across enterprise hotel chains, property management groups (PMGs), and destination marketing organizations (DMOs).

Partner Hub is Engine's advertising platform for the hospitality supply ecosystem. This role owns a defined portfolio of Partner Hub advertising customers and drives new business across the supply base — selling, launching, and managing campaigns across our media portfolio (Spotlight, Carousel, 2XR / Elevate Plus, Group Spotlight, and future ad units).

This is a hybrid account management and new business role. You will renew and expand a book of existing accounts, prospect and close new logos, build customized media proposals, quarterback campaign launches with Product and Engineering, and serve as the day-to-day commercial owner of your accounts.

This role is ideal for a media or marketing sales professional who wants to own outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise hospitality accounts — someone who is equally comfortable pitching a $500K annual program to a chain CMO and optimizing weekly performance reports to keep a live campaign on track.

What You'll Do

• Own a book of Partner Hub advertising accounts across hotel chains, PMGs, and DMOs — driving renewals, upsells, and cross-sells across Spotlight, Carousel, 2XR / Elevate Plus, and Group Spotlight

• Prospect, qualify, and close new business across the hospitality supply base — hotel chains, property management groups, and destination marketing organizations

• Build customized marketing proposals (deck, memo, and mocks) that translate customer objectives — occupancy, mid-week compression, group demand, seasonal need periods, market share — into specific media plans with clear ROAS assumptions

• Run campaigns end-to-end: brief creative, coordinate launch with Partner Hub PM and Engineering, monitor pacing and performance, deliver mid-flight optimizations, and produce end-of-flight recaps

• Serve as the day-to-day partner contact for your accounts, leading QBRs, campaign check-ins, and performance reviews

• Partner with Partner Hub PM and Engineering to surface customer feedback, prioritize campaign-blocking gaps, and inform the product roadmap

• Maintain accurate Salesforce hygiene across pipeline, forecast, and account activity, and contribute to weekly and monthly commercial reviews

• Represent Engine at partner-facing meetings, joint business planning sessions, and select industry events

What You'll Bring

• 10+ years of experience in media sales, marketing sales, ad-tech / mar-tech account roles, or destination / hospitality marketing

• Track record carrying quota and growing a book of enterprise accounts against both renewal and new-logo targets

• Background in media solutions, digital advertising, or marketing services is required; travel, hospitality, or destination-marketing industry experience is strongly preferred

• Strong proposal and deck-building skills — able to translate a customer brief into a specific, well-priced, ROAS-anchored media plan

• Fluency with campaign metrics (impressions, CTR, ROAS, incrementality, attributed room nights) and the ability to explain them clearly to non-technical partners

• Proficient in Salesforce, PowerPoint / Google Slides, and campaign performance / ROI analysis in spreadsheets

• Excellent written and verbal communication; poised in executive settings but willing to do the operational work to keep campaigns on track

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Applications for this role will be accepted through January 4, 2027 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$165,000—$195,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

• Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.

• Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture

• Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

jobs.title: Delivery Expert
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Do you know why Domino's Pizza hires so many drivers? Well, aside from the fact that our delicious pizza is the perfect solution for dinner for families all across the nation - we do it because we can. What do we mean by that, you ask? We mean that we offer a great flexible schedule that offers the hours you're looking for. That means you're free when you need to be. You'll have plenty of time left over for school, to hang with your friends, or whatever. Even if you need a second job for some extra cash, Domino's Pizza is the perfect place for you.

Right now Domino's is looking for qualified drivers to staff stores in your area. We're growing so fast it's hard to keep up, and that means Domino's has lots of ways for you to grow (if that's what you want), perhaps to management, perhaps beyond. Whether it's your hobby, main-gig, or supplemental job, apply online. We're bound to have just the thing for you.

ADVANCEMENT

Many of our team members began their careers as delivery drivers and today are successful Domino's franchise owners. From delivery driver to management, general manager to franchisee or Manager Corporate Operations, our stores offer a world of opportunity.

DIVERSITY

Our mission is to recognize, appreciate, value and utilize the unique talents and contributions of all individuals. To create an environment where all team members, because of their differences, can reach their highest potential.

SUMMARY STATEMENT

We take pride in our team members and our team members take pride in Domino's Pizza! Being the best pizza delivery company in the world requires exceptional team members working together. At Domino's Pizza, our people come first!

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND DUTIES

You must be 18 years of age or older

General job duties for all store team members

• Have a valid driver's license with a safe driving record meeting company standards as well as access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.
• You should possess navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area and must be able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings.
• Operate all equipment.
• Stock ingredients from delivery area to storage, work area, walk-in cooler.
• Prepare product.

Training

Orientation and training provided on the job.

Communication Skills

Ability to comprehend and give correct written instructions.

Ability to communicate verbally with customers and co-workers to process orders both over the phone and in person.

Essential Functions/Skills

• Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator).
• Must be able to make correct monetary change.
• Verbal, writing, and telephone skills to take and process orders.
• Motor coordination between eyes and hands/fingers to rapidly and accurately make precise movements with speed.
• Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard or touch screen.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

• Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
• In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
• Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
• Fumes from food odors.
• Exposure to cornmeal dust.
• Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
• Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
• Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

• Talking and hearing on telephone.
• Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
• Depth perception.
• Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS  including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile "bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

• Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
• Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
• Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

• Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.
• Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

• Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.
• Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

• Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
• Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving

jobs.title: Lab Operations Director, Genomics
jobs.description:
About Feanix Bio

Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.

We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions.

That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning.

We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork — just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before.

If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you.

About the role

Feanix is hiring a Director of Lab Operations to lead our genomics lab in Scotts Valley, California, and scale it into a high-throughput production operation that keeps pace with our commercial growth.

This is a senior leadership role. You’ll own the lab’s strategy and results end to end: throughput, quality, turnaround time, cost per sample, capacity planning, budget, staffing and the management team. You’ll set the 12–24 month plan that keeps lab capacity ahead of demand as we expand into new products and species. You’ll also stay close enough to the work to diagnose problems and step in when it matters.

We’re looking for a scientifically credible leader with a production mindset. You understand the science, but you measure success by whether samples move through the lab accurately, efficiently, on time and at the right cost. You build systems and teams that perform without you in the room, and you’re a trusted partner to the executive team on what the lab can deliver and what it needs to get there.

This role is in person in Scotts Valley, CA, Monday to Friday.

What you’ll own

Lab strategy and capacity planning

• Own the lab’s operating strategy and multi-year capacity plan, tied to commercial forecasts, new product lines and expansion into new species.

• Own the lab budget, including operating costs, capital expenditures, reagent spend and cost per sample. Drive unit costs down as volume grows.

• Plan when and how to add capacity: equipment, automation, headcount, shifts, space, and future sites if needed.

• Give leadership and the board clear visibility into lab capacity, throughput, quality, constraints, risks and upcoming investment needs.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, Science and Farm Ops so lab capabilities match what we sell and what we plan to launch.

Production and operational excellence

• Make sure production, quality and turnaround-time targets are met consistently as volume grows.

• Set up production planning, scheduling and operating rhythms that run reliably without day-to-day intervention from you.

• Define and own operational KPIs, including throughput, turnaround time, failure and rework rates, equipment uptime and utilization, cost per sample, and quality metrics.

• Find and remove the bottlenecks that limit scale, and drive improvements in throughput, reliability and efficiency.

• Manage key vendor and supplier relationships, including Illumina and other sequencing, reagent and equipment partners. Negotiate pricing, service agreements and supply continuity.

Quality systems

• Build a quality culture where accuracy, consistency and reproducibility are non-negotiable.

• Own the quality management system: SOPs, QC checkpoints, documentation, deviation management and corrective and preventive action (CAPA).

• Make sure failures are investigated systematically and root causes are fixed, not handled as one-offs.

• Get the lab ready for any certifications, audits or compliance standards that commercial growth may require.

• Use data to balance speed, cost, throughput and quality as the operation scales.

Sequencing and technology roadmap

• Oversee high-throughput next-generation sequencing (NGS) operations, with an emphasis on Illumina and other short-read technologies.

• Own the lab technology roadmap: evaluate and implement new sequencing platforms, automation, a LIMS (lab information management system) and equipment that improve scale, cost or quality.

• Partner with R&D and science teams on a disciplined process for moving new methods into stable, validated production workflows.

• Coordinate shared equipment and lab time with the research team, and set clear working norms between R&D and production.

Organizational leadership

• Build and lead the lab organization, including hiring and developing lab managers and supervisors who run day-to-day operations.

• Design the lab’s org structure, roles, career paths and staffing model (full-time and contingent) as volume grows.

• Set clear expectations and accountability for quality, output and execution at every level.

• Create a culture that’s energetic, collaborative and fun, while keeping a high bar for performance.

• Develop leaders in the lab so it scales beyond any one person, including you.

What we’re looking for

Required qualifications

• Master’s degree or PhD in molecular biology, genomics, genetics, biotechnology, biochemistry or a related field.

• 10+ years of laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading lab operations and 2+ years managing managers or supervisors.

• A track record of scaling a startup, early-stage or fast-growing commercial lab into a reliable, high-throughput production operation.

• Direct accountability for lab production, throughput, quality and cost, not only research or assay development.

• Experience owning a lab budget, including operating and capital planning, vendor negotiations and cost-per-sample improvement.

• Deep expertise in Illumina and short-read NGS technologies and their sample-prep and sequencing workflows.

• Experience building quality systems, SOPs, QC processes and production metrics from the ground up.

• Experience forecasting capacity and planning staffing, equipment and reagents against commercial demand.

• Strong root-cause analysis skills and a systems-level approach to fixing recurring problems.

• Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to report status, risks and tradeoffs to executives.

• Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup where processes and infrastructure are still being built.

Nice to have

• Experience scaling high-throughput genomics, molecular diagnostics or sequencing operations, ideally in agricultural or animal genomics.

• Experience leading automation programs and LIMS implementations.

• Experience with lab accreditation, certification or regulatory audits.

• Experience standing up a new lab site or significantly expanding an existing one.

• Experience transferring methods from R&D into commercial production at scale.

Who will thrive here

You’re scientifically credible but operationally driven. You see the lab as a production system and a strategic asset for the company, not a collection of experiments.

You think in quarters and years, not just shifts. You can see where demand is heading, plan the people, equipment and processes needed to meet it, and make the case to leadership with data.

You’re competitive about performance and like setting ambitious goals and hitting them. When something breaks, your instinct is to understand why, fix the underlying system and make sure it doesn’t happen again.

You build leaders, not just teams. You bring energy and humor while holding a serious standard for execution.

What success looks like

First 6 months

• The lab has clear production, quality, turnaround-time and cost targets and consistently meets them.

• QC processes catch issues early, and failures are investigated and fixed systematically.

• Leadership has clear, regular visibility into capacity, throughput, quality, cost and upcoming needs.

• You’ve assessed the lab team and started building the management layer needed to scale.

First 12 months

• A 12–24 month capacity and investment plan is approved and on track, tied to commercial forecasts and new product lines.

• Lab capacity scales predictably with demand, and cost per sample is improving.

• Lab managers and supervisors run day-to-day operations with clear ownership and accountability.

• SOPs and quality systems are documented, followed, measured and continuously improved.

• The lab team works with a strong sense of ownership, urgency and pride.

Compensation and Benefits

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or transfers at this time.

Actual starting pay for this role is determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to qualifications, experience, relevant skills, education, and geographic location. Employees are offered a variety of benefits to empower them with the resources and flexibility they need to enjoy success on the job and to live a healthy life.

We offer a flexible, remote-friendly work environment for most roles, along with a growing benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401k,  pet insurance, flexible paid time off; and paid parental leave, including up to twelve weeks of paid leave and/or supplemental pay coordination with applicable state benefits.

Pay Transparency

$150,000—$180,000 USD

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or transfers at this time.

Compensation is based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and location. Benefits include equity options, medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k); flexible PTO; paid parental leave; and pet insurance.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agent Auth
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the role

Agents are becoming first-class users of the internet. They sign in, call APIs, deploy code, and act on behalf of people and teams. That raises questions the web was never designed to answer: Who is this agent? Who does it work for? What is it allowed to do, for how long, and how do we know?

As an engineer on the [Agent Auth and Identity] team, you'll help answer those questions. You'll build the systems that let agents and people authenticate, delegate access, and act safely across Vercel and the services our customers connect to. This is foundational work: identity and authorization sit underneath everything we ship, and getting them right for agents will shape how modern software gets built.

The scope is intentionally broad. You might spend one quarter designing how credentials are issued and scoped for autonomous agents, and the next building the developer-facing APIs and SDKs that make secure auth feel effortless. You'll own systems end-to-end, from design through long-term operation in production.

We're looking for engineers who care deeply about security and developer experience in equal measure, enjoy working on problems without established playbooks, and want to define how trust works in an agentic world.

What you'll do

• Design, build, and operate the identity, authentication, and authorization systems that power Vercel and our Customers for both people and agents.

• Shape how agents prove who they are, act on behalf of users and teams, and receive scoped, time-bound, auditable access.

• Build secure, scalable APIs, services, and SDKs that make auth simple for developers and their agents to adopt.

• Work with modern and emerging standards (such as OAuth 2.x, OIDC, and agent-focused protocols) and help influence where they go next.

• Lead projects end-to-end: identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver improvements in security, reliability, and developer experience.

• Partner closely with product, security, and platform teams across Vercel to make identity a strength of every product we ship.

• Participate in the on-call rotation, taking responsibility for the reliability of critical systems.

• Contribute to open source and the broader community conversation on agent identity and trust.

• Write clean, efficient, tested, and well-documented code that others can build upon confidently.

What you need

• [3+] years of experience designing, building, and operating backend systems in production at scale.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable backend language and the willingness to work primarily in TypeScript.

• Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, such as sessions, tokens, OAuth/OIDC flows, permission models, and secrets management.

• A security-minded approach to engineering: you think about threat models, least privilege, and failure modes as part of design, not as an afterthought.

• A track record of end-to-end ownership, from design and implementation through to long-term operation.

• Ability to reason about architectural tradeoffs, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.

• Strong cross-team collaboration skills and the ability to drive alignment toward shared goals.

• Curiosity and comfort working in a fast-moving space where the right answers are still being figured out.

Bonus if you

• Have built or operated identity providers, auth platforms, or access-control systems used by other developers.

• Have experience with delegated authorization, workload identity, service-to-service auth, or machine credentials.

• Have worked on LLM-powered agents, tool calling, or protocols like MCP.

• Have experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Are familiar with React or Next.js.

• Have contributed to open-source projects or standards bodies.

Benefits & Compensation

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow: we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The base pay range for this role is $196,000 – $294,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. They serve as the primary point of contact for their assigned clients by answering client emails and leading weekly calls. They also design and execute Paid Media channel strategy. The Director, Sales (Regional) is responsible for leading Loenbro’s sales efforts within a defined geographic region, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and revenue goals. Reporting to the Vice President, Sales, this role oversees a regional team of Key Account Managers and Preconstruction Coordinators, providing leadership, guidance, and accountability to drive growth across multiple markets and service lines.

This role will define the technical roadmap, security architecture, and integration patterns that support scalable, secure, and compliant API and event-driven solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.

• Lead the architecture and technical roadmap for the Azure Enterprise Integration Gateway.

• Design and govern solutions using Azure API Management (APIM), Application Gateway, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, Logic Apps, Key Vault, API Center, and Developer Portal.

• Define enterprise integration patterns across Azure, on-premises, and multi-cloud environments, including API-led, event-driven, and publish-subscribe architectures.

• Review API designs, code, and platform implementations to ensure adherence to architecture standards and best practices.

• Produce and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, deployment guides, and operational runbooks.

• Collaborate with enterprise architects, integration teams, MuleSoft architects, and program leadership to align standards, governance, and release management.

Here's What You Need:

• 8+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years in enterprise integration architecture focused on Microsoft Azure.

• Deep expertise with Azure API Management (APIM), Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure integration services.

• Experience designing hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures.

• Proven experience leading Azure API Platform ATO initiatives and compliance activities.

• Hands-on experience with Terraform-based Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and DevSecOps practices.

• Strong knowledge of platform security, continuous monitoring, POA&M remediation, and compliance frameworks.

• Experience designing and implementing Zero Trust security architectures.

• Familiarity with MuleSoft integrations and hybrid enterprise environments.

• Ability to lead technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and review platform and API designs.

Required Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

• Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

• Experience with MCP Gateway, agent orchestration, and AI-enabled integration platforms.

• Knowledge of AI governance and policy enforcement frameworks.

• Experience developing architecture standards, operational runbooks, and enterprise documentation.

• Experience supporting large-scale federal or highly regulated environments.

US Citizen

jobs.title: Software Rotation Program Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE PROGRAM

The Alarm.com Software Rotation Program is a structured, cohort-based experience designed for exceptional early-career engineers who want to build deep technical expertise across Alarm.com's most strategic product areas. Over the course of three years, participants complete multiple technical and customer focused rotations before transitioning into a Software Engineer role.

This is not a traditional early-career role. We are looking for engineers who are intellectually curious, technically rigorous, and eager to contribute meaningfully from day one. Each rotation is a genuine team placement with real ownership — participants are embedded engineers, not observers.

A core principle of this program is building engineers who understand Alarm.com's customers as deeply as they understand the code. Participants will be intentionally exposed to customer-facing projects throughout their rotations — learning to evaluate technical decisions not just for correctness, but for the real-world impact they have on the millions of homeowners, businesses, and service providers who rely on Alarm.com every day.

This position is part of a cohort-based program. To ensure all participants begin rotations together and receive a consistent onboarding and development experience, employment for all cohort members begins on a single, unified start date.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Across all rotations, program participants will:

• Design, implement, and test new software features with full engineering ownership

• Contribute to the innovation and improvement of existing products and systems

• Analyze functional requirements and translate product specifications into quality software

• Research, evaluate, and integrate emerging technologies relevant to each rotation area

• Take ownership of assigned projects and drive them to completion on schedule

• Collaborate with QA, product, and cross-functional engineering teams on testing and deployment

• Deliver end-of-rotation presentations to leadership, demonstrating technical growth and business impact

• Engage with customer-facing product areas to develop a deep understanding of end-user needs — learning how engineering decisions directly shape the experience of Alarm.com's customers

• Apply a customer-first lens when designing and evaluating solutions, considering usability, reliability, and real world impact alongside technical correctness

• Participate in customer feedback reviews, product discussions, and cross-functional sessions that connect engineering work to the people it serves

• Other duties as assigned

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline

• 0+ years of professional software development experience (internship experience counts)

• Demonstrated ability to write clean, thoughtful, well-tested code

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a tenacious, self-directed work style

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills — ability to explain technical ideas clearly to varied audiences

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment

• Passion for building high-quality consumer technology products

• Genuine curiosity about AI, IoT, and the intersection of software and hardware

• Ability to think through the customer lens — genuine interest in understanding how your work affects real people, and willingness to engage with product feedback, customer context, and end-user outcomes

• Available to begin employment on the designated cohort start date (see above)

• Travel as needed to meet rotation requirements and temporary relocation (housing provided)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience or coursework in machine learning, computer vision, or AI-adjacent domains

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or platform engineering

• Previous relevant internship(s) in software engineering, applied AI, platform/infrastructure, or a related technical discipline — candidates with hands-on industry experience in areas aligned to our rotation tracks are strongly preferred

• Contributions to open source projects or a strong personal/academic project portfolio

• Experience working on or directly adjacent to customer-facing features, products, or support — any role where understanding the end user was part of the job

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

• Dedicated mentor and rotation manager throughout the program

• Regular 1:1s, mid-rotation check-ins, and structured performance feedback

• Presentation skills coaching and executive exposure opportunities

• Networking with Engineering Directors and senior leadership

• A clear, structured path to Software Engineer position

• Rotations outside of a traditional software engineering career path

• Base salary: $105,000–$110,000 | Annual bonus: $5,000 | Merit increases eligible under standard company guidelines

Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time.

Expected Start Date: June 14, 2027 - Candidates must be available to begin full-time employment on this date. By applying to this role, candidates confirm their availability to begin on the designated cohort start date.

WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM?

• Collaborate with outstanding people: We hire only the best. Our standards are high and our employees enjoy working alongside other high achievers.

• Make an immediate impact: New employees can expect to be given real responsibility for bringing new technologies to the marketplace. You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team!

• Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business.

• Community and Camaraderie: One of our core values is to 'Keep It Fun,' which to us means fostering a strong sense of community. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work.

• Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week.

COMPANY INFO

Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Millions of homeowners and businesses rely on Alarm.com's technology to secure, monitor, and manage their environments from anywhere. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people.

For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.

COMPANY BENEFITS

Our total rewards package is designed to support you holistically—in your health, your finances, and your life outside of work. The package includes medical plans with company subsidies, a Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution, and a 401(k) with an employer match. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with paid vacation that increases with tenure, paid holidays, wellness time, and paid maternity and bonding leave. To complete the package, we also provide company-paid disability and life insurance, all within a collaborative and casual work environment.

Alarm.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer

In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Connect
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role

Vercel Connect helps developers give agents and AI-built apps secure access to the data, tools, and events they need—without wrestling with OAuth, credentials, and integration complexity. We’re currently building two things: 1) a platform for managing agent identity, access and permissions and 2) a set of rich connectors for the 1000s of systems (like Linear, Slack, GitHub, Google, etc.) that agents will need to talk to.

We’re solving core problems like agent identity and delegated access, tool approval and standards around making agents aware of changes on 3rd party platforms.

As a senior engineer on this team you'll not only own our APIs, token infrastructure, authorization, SDKs, and more, but work with external companies to make it easier for developers to build agents that integrate with their products. You’ll need to balance both high uptime and fast performance with flexibility to allow for seamless connection to many systems that weren’t designed with agents in mind. If you’re looking for a role that will put you at the center of how agent identity and credentials work, this is it!

What You Will Do

• Ship provider integrations end to end — auth flows, token exchange, app registration, and the configuration UI — from generic API-key and OAuth presets through bespoke cases like Snowflake Partner Connect, Slack manager apps, and Microsoft Entra.

• Own and improve our infrastructure (uptime, performance, secure storage of credentials and keys) and developer experience for Connect

• Work with industry leaders within and outside of Vercel to propose and implement new authentication and authorization protocols for AI era

• Build and harden event forwarding — signature verification inbound, project-scoped identity outbound, delivered to the right deployment and environment.

• Make Connect the obvious way to give an agent a credential, extending the SDKs , consent-redirect flow, and framework adapters.

• Reduce the cost of the next hundred integrations, so most new providers become configuration rather than code.

• Work directly with the teams building on Connect, and turn what you learn into platform improvements.

About You

• 6+ years building and operating production backend or full-stack systems, with a track record of owning a service or platform surface rather than a feature.

• You deeply understand your users problems and work in a focused manner to address them, leveling up the product you’re working on over time.

• Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC, and JWTs — not just wiring up a client library, but reasoning about authorization codes, PKCE, refresh semantics, audience and scope restriction, token exchange, and what each of those actually protects against.

• A security instinct for integration code specifically — SSRF and DNS rebinding, confused-deputy and mix-up attacks, redirect-URI validation, webhook signature verification, tenant isolation. You've either found these bugs or fixed them.

• Strong TypeScript, and comfort developing backend and frontend components.

• Experience integrating with many third-party APIs, an appetite for the reality of it — undocumented behavior, non-compliant OAuth, inconsistent errors — and the judgment to absorb that mess behind a clean abstraction.

• You're comfortable with ambiguity, ship incrementally against a large surface, and communicate clearly with the teams building on top of you.

• You push the envelope of leveraging agents and AI in ur dev workflow, giving you the insight to help build the agent platform of the future

Bonus Points

• You've built or operated an OAuth authorization server, an identity provider, or a multi-tenant integrations platform.

• Experience with MCP, agent tool-calling, or delegated-access and consent patterns.

• Prior work on integration marketplaces, partner engineering, or webhook infrastructure at scale.

• Open source contributions, particularly in the auth, Next.js, or agent tooling ecosystems.

Compensation & Benefits:

• Competitive compensation package, including equity.

• Inclusive Healthcare Package.

• Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

• Flexible Time Off.

• We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Join IVX Health as an HR Business Partner

Brentwood, TN | Hybrid | Local Candidates Only

Make a Difference. Build Culture. Drive Performance.

Are you an experienced HR professional with a strong background in employee relations, a bias for action, and experience in healthcare or a regulated industry? IVX Health is hiring a local HR Business Partner to support our growing national footprint.

This role is ideal for someone who leads with confidence, communicates with clarity, and isn’t afraid to take initiative—whether resolving complex issues, coaching leaders, or shaping culture in a fast-paced, patient-focused environment.

• This role is hybrid working at our Corporate HQ in Brentwood, TN at least 3 days per week.

What You’ll Do

• Resolve with Care and Integrity – Lead employee relations cases with a calm, compliant, and fair approach

• Support Growth – Coach managers on feedback, performance conversations, and team development

• Ensure Compliance – Interpret federal and state employment laws across multiple states

• Partner on Recruiting – Work closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring leaders to support seamless onboarding and workforce planning

• Reinforce Culture – Champion engagement, DEI, and culture-building initiatives that bring our values to life

• Travel with Purpose – Conduct quarterly field visits to strengthen relationships and understand the unique needs of each market

What We're Looking For

You might be a great fit for this role if you

• Have strong employee relations experience, ideally supporting multi-site or healthcare environments

• Are confident coaching leaders through tough conversations, performance issues, and team development

• Bring a compliance-first mindset with practical knowledge of federal and state employment laws

• Thrive in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where no two days look the same

• Are highly organized, proactive, and a strong communicator with excellent follow-through

• Enjoy both strategic work and hands-on support, shifting easily between coaching, documentation, policy, and planning

• Feel energized by building relationships, both in-person and virtually, across diverse teams

• Are excited to travel and build relationships with leaders across the org.

Essential Competencies and Skills

• Data-Driven Decision Making – Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret HR metrics and data to drive informed decisions and actionable insights

• Influence & Partnership – Capable of influencing and partnering effectively with different levels of the organization to achieve results quickly

• Strategic HR Expertise – Strong understanding and application of HR principles and practices in alignment with business objectives

• Broad HR Knowledge – Knowledgeable in multiple HR disciplines including compensation, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, D&I, performance management, and employment law

• Communication Excellence – Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information and influence stakeholders

• Organizational Skills – Excellent ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines with keen attention to detail

• Collaboration – Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, fostering a positive work culture and contributing to team success

• Tech Savvy – Proficiency with standard office software (Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams) and HR tech tools

Required Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

• SHRM Certified Professional (SHRM-CP) and/or PHR Certification preferred, but not required

• 5+ years of experience in Human Resources, with responsibilities that align closely to core generalist functions (e.g., employee relations, performance management, compliance, benefits, etc.) preferably in a healthcare or related field

• Strong background in employee relations, including coaching leaders, addressing workplace concerns, and conducting investigations

Why You’ll Love Working at IVX Health

• Mission-Driven Work: We help people with chronic conditions live healthier lives—and you’ll play a direct role in supporting the teams who make that possible.

• Big Impact, National Reach: Support field teams across the country while staying rooted in a tight-knit, values-based home office team.

• Collaborative HR Ecosystem: You won’t operate in a silo. Our HR/ People Operations, Recruiting, Benefits, Payroll, and Learning & Development teams work closely together, partnering daily to create a seamless and supportive employee experience.

• Growth You Can See: IVX is scaling fast—and you’ll have opportunities to grow your HR career alongside our expanding footprint.

• Culture That Feels Different: We lead with kindness, do what’s right, and never settle. Here, HR is a strategic partner—not just a policy gatekeeper.

• Ideas Welcome: We value insight, initiative, and action. If you see a better way—we want to hear it.

About IVX Health

IVX Health is a national provider of infusion and injection therapy for patients managing complex chronic conditions. Through a patient-centered approach focused on comfort, convenience, clinical excellence, and exceptional service, we're redefining the care experience and improving lives every day. As a growing healthcare organization, we're committed to supporting our employees with meaningful work, professional development opportunities, and a culture built on collaboration, innovation, and purpose.

Guided by Our Purpose

Mission: To improve the lives of those we care for by redefining the care experience.
Vision: To be the nation's preferred destination for pharmaceutical care of complex chronic conditions.
Values: Be Kind. Do What's Right. Never Settle. Make It Happen. Enjoy the Ride.

Benefits & Perks

Eligible employees may receive:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

• Prescription Drug Coverage and Telemedicine Services

• Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA), and Flexible Spending Options

• 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match

• Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance

• Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Coverage

• Fertility and Family Planning Support

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

*This is a remote position that must be based in EST in the U.S. with a strong preference for someone based in the greater Boston area.

Job Summary

As Senior Manager, Revenue Enablement, you’ll lead a team of Revenue Enablement business partners supporting Tines’ sales organization (Account Executive, Solution Engineering, Sales Development, and Partnerships). You’ll play a critical role in developing the capabilities, skills, and behaviors that help our sales teams execute effectively as we continue to scale.

This is a player/coach role. You’ll lead, coach, and develop a small team of enablement professionals while personally driving strategic initiatives that support our evolving sales priorities. You’ll partner closely with Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs, identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, and translate company strategy into practical enablement programs and experiences.

We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on leader who knows how to build and develop high-performing teams, influence without authority, and bring structure and focus to a fast-moving environment. You’ll help our sellers evolve alongside our business, including developing the capabilities to move beyond individual product and use-case conversations toward broader platform-level, value-based selling.

What you'll do:

Lead and develop a high-performing enablement team

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Revenue Enablement business partners, building their capabilities as strategic partners to sales leadership.

• Establish clear expectations, priorities, and operating rhythms that enable the team to deliver consistent, high-quality support across the pre-sales organization.

• Empower team members to take ownership of their respective areas, make sound decisions, and proactively identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness.

• Provide ongoing coaching, feedback, and development to help team members grow their strategic influence, business acumen, and enablement expertise.

• Balance team capacity and competing business priorities, ensuring resources are focused on the opportunities with the greatest potential impact.

Drive strategic revenue enablement

• Translate company and GTM priorities into an enablement strategy and roadmap that supports the evolving needs of our sales organization.

• Partner with sales leaders to understand business challenges, identify capability gaps, and determine the most effective enablement interventions.

• Lead strategic enablement initiatives that improve seller effectiveness, strengthen sales execution, and support our broader GTM strategy.

• Help sellers evolve from product- and use-case-led conversations to broader platform selling, connecting Tines’ capabilities to customer challenges and business outcomes.

• Build scalable approaches to developing seller knowledge, skills, and capabilities through a combination of learning, practice, coaching, and reinforcement.

• Remain close to the work, personally leading key initiatives and stepping in where your expertise can make the greatest difference.

Build and scale enablement business partnerships

• Continuously improve the processes and practices that enable the team to scale effectively.

• Identify opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and AI to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of enablement.

• Partner with Revenue Operations and other stakeholders to understand performance trends and identify opportunities to improve sales execution.

• Share insights and recommendations with enablement and sales leadership to continuously evolve our approach.

Collaborate across the business

• Build trusted relationships with Sales Leadership and frontline managers, serving as a strategic partner in developing their teams.

• Partner with our CX enablement business partner, programmatic enablement team members, and cross-functional partners to align enablement with business priorities and translate full GTM enablement into effective seller enablement.

• Work closely with frontline managers to equip them to reinforce learning, coach their teams, and sustain improvements in seller capabilities.

What you bring to the table:

• Extensive experience in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, or a related GTM function within a B2B SaaS or technology organization.

• Experience managing and developing enablement professionals, ideally business partners or individuals supporting distinct sales functions or segments.

• A track record of building, scaling, or meaningfully evolving an enablement team, function, or operating model.

• Experience translating business strategy into enablement strategies, programs, and practical interventions that improve sales effectiveness.

• Experience supporting a complex or evolving sales motion, ideally helping sellers move from product- or use-case-led selling toward broader platform, solution, or value-based selling.

• Strong understanding of how sellers develop capabilities and how frontline managers can reinforce those capabilities through coaching and practice.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build trusted partnerships, and navigate competing priorities.

• Strong strategic thinking and execution skills, with the ability to balance longer-term planning with hands-on delivery.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving organization where priorities can shift and not every challenge has an established playbook.

• Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with an interest in experimenting with new tools and applying them to improve the way GTM teams work.

Bonus points:

• Think strategically, execute practically: You can connect the bigger picture to the work that needs to happen today.

• Lead through others: You invest in developing your team, creating clarity, and empowering people to take ownership.

• Build with the business: You partner closely with stakeholders, understand their challenges, and focus on solving meaningful problems.

• Embrace change: You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, adapting as the business evolves, and finding ways forward.

• Experiment and improve: You bring curiosity, challenge existing approaches, and look for better ways to work.

• Relate to your core audience: You have been in sales, sales development, solutions engineering, or partnerships and have worked within the AI or IT markets.

Target Annual Compensation: $185k - $210k salary + 10% bonus + equity

jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer, Mechanical and Fluid Systems
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We are seeking a Senior Test Engineer, Mechanical and Fluid Systems to design, build, and operate large-scale test equipment for hydraulic turbines, electrical generation powertrains, and high-power equipment. You will own test systems end to end: concept, structural and fluid design in Siemens NX, fabrication, assembly, commissioning, and operation.

This is a builder's role. We're looking for someone who has taken large-scale systems from a blank page to a running system, and who knows machining and additive processes firsthand. You'll make prototype parts when speed matters and work alongside our shop team, tradespeople, and vendors to build structures and piping that safely handle pressurized water, air, and heavy loads.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis. You will own your designs cradle-to-grave, from first concept through fabrication and deployment at sea. If you are an excellent engineer, regardless of your background, we want you to apply.

We strive to be the best engineering team on the planet and we compensate our team accordingly.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, modify, and operate custom test rigs for hydraulic turbines, powertrains, and power electronics systems.

• Design load-bearing test structures, including frames, stands, weldments, tank supports, rigging, and lifting fixtures, in Siemens NX. Produce fabrication drawings with weld callouts, GD&T, and machined interface features.

• Design fluid systems and piping networks, including flow and pressure-drop analysis and the sizing and selection of pumps, valves, regulators, and piping.

• Design process piping and plant layouts that can be deployed quickly, and design tanks and vessels for large-volume fluid storage.

• Develop P&IDs, test methodologies, procedures, and safety protocols for test systems.

• Machine, 3D print, and assemble prototype parts and fixtures as needed, and decide what to make in-house versus outsource.

• Integrate mechanical systems with electrical, controls, and data acquisition systems in cross-functional teams.

• Direct technicians, tradespeople, and subcontractors through fabrication, integration, and test operations. Manage vendor procurement.

• Perform hands-on assembly, troubleshooting, and real-time and post-test data review.

• Mentor less-experienced engineers and set design and analysis standards the team builds on.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering.

• Strong foundation in fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and structural analysis, including hand calculations.

• 7+ years designing, building, and testing large-scale mechanical, structural, or fluid systems.

• A track record of owning at least three large-scale systems from design through commissioning.

• Expert-level Siemens NX for structural design and fabrication drawings. Teamcenter or similar PLM.

• Hands-on experience with machining (mills, lathes) and professional 3D printing for prototypes and fixtures.

• Process piping design, specification, and installation.

• Design of custom machined and welded components for fixtures and structures.

• Understanding of ASME/ANSI piping and pressure vessel codes. Familiarity with NFPA 79.

• Industrial safety practices (DFMEA, PFMEA, HAZOP).

• Working knowledge of electrical power systems and connector selection.

• Experience directing skilled trades and subcontractors.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Desired Qualifications

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering, or 5 years of additional experience in lieu of an advanced degree.

• Experience with finite element analysis

• Commissioning and proof testing of fluid systems for pressurized, cryogenic, vacuum, or elevated-temperature service.

• Pipe supports, tooling, and fixtures for test stands.

• Crane operations, lift planning, and moving large structures.

• Experience designing welded steel structures using American Welding Society D1.1 and ASME BPVC applied to novel hardware.

• Both small-scale rapid R&D stands and large-scale systems.

• Delivering on tight schedules with creative solutions.

• Background in power generation, renewable energy, or heavy industrial equipment.

• Heat exchangers and fluid conditioning equipment.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Travel to vendors and test sites as needed

• Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexiblePTO and flexible working hours.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $175,000 - $235,000.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location
