jobs.title: Director, Commercial Real Estate Origination
jobs.location: Addison, TX; Montpelier, VT; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

About Us

NLG Capital, the investment management company of NLG, manages approximately $40+ billion in AUM. Our purpose is simple – to allow NLG to keep its promises. How we do this – an obsessive focus on delivering investment results. We drive results through a rigorous but collaborative investment process, and we hold ourselves to the highest of standards, both as investors and teammates. While our process is based on rigor, our culture is based on our guiding principles: Meritocracy, Uncompromising Transparency, Intellectual Honesty, Performance Driven Learning, Relentless Pursuit of Excellence. These principles serve as the foundation of our team.  They govern the way we conduct ourselves, how we interact with teammates and how we approach every investment decision.  We act with the integrity and humility required to make the investment decision that is right for the firm, and ultimately our policyholders.  Our culture has been deliberately built to foster curiosity and provide opportunities to learn and grow, both as people and investors. The flat and collaborative nature of our team promotes an atmosphere where the best ideas are continually expressed and rewarded. Our pursuit of excellence is unwavering.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The Director, Commercial Mortgage Originations is a senior originator to lead the sourcing, structuring, and execution of commercial real estate debt investments.  This role is responsible for developing a consistent pipeline of institutional-quality opportunities and advancing the firm’s credit strategy and portfolio objectives.  The position is relationship-driven, focused on originating transactions across core property types while partnering closely with underwriting, asset management, and senior leadership through closing.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days.  Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.  The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Origination & Relationship Management

• Build and maintain a pipeline of high-quality investment opportunities.

• Develop and manage relationships with sponsors, brokers, and mortgage bankers.

• Travel to key markets for client meetings, broker engagement, and site visits.

• Represent NLG Capital through industry engagement and conferences.

Underwriting & Structuring

• Originate, structure, and close commercial mortgage loans (typically $15M–$60M).

• Underwrite stabilized, transitional (bridge), and construction loans.

• Assess business plans, lease-up risk, capital expenditures, and exit strategies.

• Structure loans within credit parameters aligned with risk-return objectives.

• Perform cash flow analysis, market evaluation, and sponsor credit review.

Execution & Credit Approval

• Prepare and present investment memoranda to internal credit committees.

• Negotiate loan terms, pricing, covenants, and legal documentation.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders through closing.

Portfolio & Market Strategy

• Monitor market conditions and capital markets trends.

• Partner with portfolio management on diversification across assets and geographies.

• Collaborate with asset management to support portfolio performance and risk mitigation.

All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, or related field and 6 - 8 years of related experience.

• 6 or more years of commercial real estate lending experience with a track record of originations.

• Experience underwriting stabilized, transitional/bridge, and construction loans.

• Strong knowledge of credit underwriting, real estate fundamentals, and loan structuring.

• Established network of sponsors, brokers, and mortgage bankers.

• Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.

• Experience using commercial real estate (CRE) software used for valuation and cash flow modeling.

• Strong analytical, research, and communication skills.

• High integrity, sound judgment, and disciplined risk approach.

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA with concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field.

• At least 8 years progressive experience commercial real estate lending and origination.

• Experience with ARGUS CRE Valuation software.

AI Proficiency Expectations

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

• Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

• Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

• Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

• Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life’s AI guiding principles.

• Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention and intellectual property.

Benefits

• Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range.  The base pay range for this position is the range National Life reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors, including: prior experience and job-related knowledge; education, training and certificates; current business needs; and market factors.  The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.

Additional Compensation and Benefits. The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in National Life’s discretionary annual incentive programs, subject to the rules governing such programs. If hired, the employee will be in an "at-will position" and National Life reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation or benefit program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

National Life is accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis and the role remains open until filled.

Salary Pay Range

$135,000—$198,000 USD

Life Insurance Company of the Southwest is not an authorized insurer in New York and does not conduct insurance business in New York. jobs.title: Technical Success Manager
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Black Duck, a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Application Security Testing, is hiring a Technical Success Manager (TSM) to drive adoption and prove the value of our solutions across our enterprise customers. TSMs are hands-on technologists who configure and tune our solutions and show measurable software risk reduction to customer security, engineering, and executive teams.

The Role

Your job is to drive adoption and prove value. You work closely with the account team to drive renewals and delight customers. You do the technical work yourself, including problems without a known answer. You partner with a Customer Success Engineer (CSE) when the work requires custom code, CI/CD or API integration builds, or architecture judgment specific to the customer's environment.

What You'll Do

Technical ownership

• Drive adoption across customer development teams after onboarding, expanding coverage to new teams, repositories, and use cases.

• Configure and tune the platform: scan policies and rules, scan and server performance, standard SSO setup, and custom reports and dashboards.

• Guide vulnerability remediation and prioritization using CVE, CWE, and OWASP context.

• Support SBOM generation and review (CycloneDX, SPDX) and open source risk questions.

• Troubleshoot technical issues directly and coordinate first line triage with Support and Engineering through resolution.

• Enable customer teams on scanning, UI and CLI usage, problem diagnosis, and best practices, and develop internal champions.

Adoption, value, and renewals

• Confirm why the customer bought, then build and maintain a success plan with measurable adoption and technical outcomes.

• Build working relationships with AppSec, engineering, and executive stakeholders, and know who has influence over adoption.

• Participate in Executive Business Reviews, highlighting the progress you and the customer have made and proving value.

• Monitor adoption and customer health, flag risk early, and partner with the account team on save plans.

• Work closely with the account team to drive renewals by supplying the technical value story and proof points.

• Identify expansion opportunities and hand them to Sales with a validated technical case. You do not carry a quota.

• Advocate for customers internally, feed field gaps back to Product and Engineering, and turn successful customers into references.

You'll Have

• 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as TAM, sales engineer, solutions architect, or implementation consultant.

• Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and DAST: running scans, tuning results, and triaging findings yourself.

• Strong knowledge of application security, vulnerabilities, and open source licensing.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins.

• Software development experience in C/C++, Java, C#, or similar, plus comfort with scripting and REST APIs.

• A track record driving adoption and proving value across a portfolio of enterprise accounts, working alongside account teams on renewals.

• Practical fluency using AI tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, and customer communication.

• Ability to travel up to 25%.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

• TAM, solutions architect, or sales engineer experience in AppSec or DevSecOps.

• Security certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, or CEH.

• Experience with enterprise-scale web development, microservices, and containers.

• Experience with regulated environments and standards such as PCI DSS, ISO 26262, MISRA, AUTOSAR, or DISA STIG.

Pay Range

$106,600—$133,300 USD

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

The Special Events Manager supports the planning and delivery of safe, secure, and well-coordinated events for a pharmaceutical manufacturing company. The role partners with internal stakeholders, event organizers, site leadership, and external service providers to identify risks and implement appropriate protective-services plans.

Events may take place at manufacturing sites, corporate offices, off-site venues, or other locations. The manager helps ensure that event plans align with company policies, site access and safety requirements, applicable regulations, and the needs of employees, visitors, executives, and other attendees.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and coordinate protective-services plans for company events, including meetings, conferences, executive engagements, employee events, and visits by external stakeholders.
• Conduct or coordinate comprehensive event-specific threat and vulnerability assessments, incorporating available intelligence, threat indicators, historical incidents, attendee profiles, venue vulnerabilities, and operational considerations.
• Develop risk-based mitigation strategies and provide actionable security recommendations to inform leadership decisions and protective-services planning.
• Monitor and evaluate relevant security threats and emerging risks that could affect company events, personnel, facilities, or operations.
• Translate intelligence and threat information into actionable recommendations, communicate changes in the threat environment to appropriate stakeholders, and adjust event security plans as necessary.
• Assess event-related risks, locations, attendance, schedules, and operating conditions; recommend proportionate security measures.
• Coordinate with event owners and business partners to incorporate security considerations early in the planning process.
• Work with site Protective Services, facilities, environmental health and safety, emergency management, communications, legal, human resources, and other relevant teams.
• Coordinate event access controls, credentialing, visitor screening, staffing, traffic and parking plans, venue security, and incident-response procedures, as appropriate.
• Support protective-services planning for executive and other high-profile attendees in coordination with the appropriate internal teams.
• Prepare event security briefs, staffing plans, contact lists, post orders, contingency plans, and other operational documents.
• Oversee contracted security and event-service providers; communicate expectations and monitor performance.
• Ensure event teams understand applicable site procedures, including visitor management, restricted-area controls, emergency procedures, and relevant manufacturing-site requirements.
• Monitor event conditions and adjust plans in response to changing risks, schedules, attendance, or operational needs.
• Document incidents, observations, and after-action findings; recommend improvements for future events.
• Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling sensitive event, personnel, operational, or security information.
• Track event-related resources and expenses and contribute to planning, reporting, and continuous improvement.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s degree in security management, emergency management, criminal justice, business, hospitality, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
• Experience coordinating security, protective services, emergency management, or operational planning for events or complex facilities.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams and external service providers.
• Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and respond calmly to changing conditions.
• Proficiency with standard business software and tools used for planning, communication, and documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in pharmaceutical, life-sciences, healthcare, manufacturing, law enforcement, or another regulated operating environment.
• Experience with program development, development of policy and protocols, and scenario-based planning for operational readiness.
• Experience planning events at facilities with controlled access, restricted areas, or sensitive operations.
• Relevant professional training or certifications in security, emergency management, event safety, or project management.
• Experience supporting executive events, VIP visits, or events involving external stakeholders.
• Familiarity with incident command, business continuity, emergency response, and risk-assessment practices.

Work Environment and Schedule

This position may require work at manufacturing sites, offices, and off-site venues. Event schedules may include occasional early mornings, evenings, weekends, or holidays. Travel may be required based on event needs. The role may involve walking venues, conducting site walkthroughs, and working in active operational environments while following applicable safety requirements.

Success in the Role

Success in this role means event organizers and Protective Services partners receive timely, practical guidance; event plans address foreseeable risks and operational requirements; providers understand their responsibilities; and lessons from events are used to strengthen future planning.

jobs.title: Millwright (Launch Hardware) - Night Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

MILLWRIGHT (LAUNCH HARDWARE)

As part of the Launch Hardware Fabrication & Tooling team you will work on building and improving the mechanical systems at our rocket launch facilities. You will be on the ground floor, getting your hands dirty and contributing directly to the success of future launches.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Read blueprints, diagrams and schematic drawings to determine work procedures

• Install stationary industrial machinery and mechanical equipment according to layout plans using hand and power tools

• Inspect and examine machinery and equipment to detect irregularities and malfunctions

• Adjust machinery and repairing or replacing defective parts

• Install, troubleshoot and maintain power transmission, vacuum, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, pumps, motors and programmable logic controls

• Operate rigging equipment and dollies to place heavy machinery and parts

• Fit bearings, align gears and shafts, attach motors, and connect couplings and belts to precise tolerances

• Align and test equipment, and make any necessary adjustments

• Perform predictive and operational procedures

• Operate machine tools to fabricate parts required during overhaul, maintenance or set-up of machinery

• Ensure operating safety devices function properly on completion of repairs, modifications and installations

• Sharpen and maintain cutting tools

• Keep detailed and accurate maintenance reports and documentation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate

• 3+ years of professional experience in a manufacturing/production or tooling environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience using inspection equipment, such as micrometers, gauge blocks, dial indicators, height gauges

• Able to use and learn a variety of software to observe, analyze, evaluate, and communicate pertinent information

• Demonstrated leadership and dependability

• Able to adapt to an extremely dynamic work environment while maintaining a positive attitude

• Able to find solutions to problems through diverse thinking while utilizing a varied experience

• Able to maintain the highest level of safety on the job site and bring new ideas of how to continue to work safely and effectively in new locations and changing environments

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to pass Air Force background check for Cape Canaveral

• Ability to work the following shift: Monday – Friday 6:00pm – 6:00am

• Ability to work weekends when needed to meet critical launch milestones

• Ability to lift heavy objects (up to 50 lbs.) unassisted

• Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings and climbing hand over hand

• Ability to work at elevated heights (up to 100 feet)

• Typically exposed to work in extreme outdoor environments – heat, cold, rain

• Work performed in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Travel to other sites may be required, up to 15% of the time

jobs.title: Industry Marketing, Financial Services Lead
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Position Overview:

The Financial Services industry operates in one of the most complex, highly regulated, and high-stakes environments, where trust is hard-earned, customer expectations are rising, and the cost of getting it wrong is significant. Success demands exceptionally high standards across security, compliance, and customer experience, all while navigating legacy systems, fragmented data, and the growing pressure to innovate at the pace of a rapidly evolving digital world.

As Industry Marketing Lead for Financial Services, you know the industry inside and out, and you understand the evolving needs of marketers in this space. An extended member of the Braze Product Marketing team, you’ll own every element of how Braze shows up in this market. You’ll set the strategy, write the industry narrative and positioning, create the plays the field can run, and develop the solutions that address the financial marketer’s unique regulatory and engagement challenges. You’ll work closely with sales, product, partnerships, customer success teams, and other Braze marketing teams to build Braze’s Financial Services business. This role’s day-to-day allows for both building strategy and hands-on execution as we continue to invest in this key industry.

Key Responsibilities:

Architect the Industry Marketing strategy:

• Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive marketing strategy tailored to the Financial Services industry.

• Collaborate with revenue and product teams to align Braze’s products and value proposition with industry-specific marketing objectives and business outcomes.

• Develop a go-to-market strategy targeting key Financial Services audiences, leveraging industry insights to drive platform adoption.

• Build a roadmap of 1:many and 1:few assets (sub-industry POVs, GTM plays, pitch narratives, demo stories) for the most important segments of Financial Services

Own and deliver the financial services narrative and point of view

• Develop and evolve Braze’s financial services narrative, including our sub-industry narratives.

• Pair product launches with financial services insights and use cases. Show how our new products solve real financial services problems like driving deposits, streamlining onboarding and building long-term customer trust.

• Write sharp, data-backed thought leadership, building with media and research partners. Develop proprietary financial benchmarks and best practices.

• Offer technical perspectives, considerations and trends as a part of the Financial Services narratives.

Be the field’s financial services expert

• Represent Braze on stage at Financial Services specific events and in Financial Services publications.

• Bring field and customer insight back to Product, PMM, Sales and leadership to shape priorities.

• Collaborate on key enablement and education deliverables that help educate the broader organization on the Financial Services industry.

• Support a small set of strategic pursuits and executive business reviews. Use what you learn there to improve how we go to market.

Turn customers and partners into proof

• Partner with Customer Success, Sales and Customer Marketing to find, develop and publish financial services customer evidence (case studies, quotes, speakers, references).

• Work with Partnerships to build joint Financial Services stories with technology partners and services partners. Help bring partners into our Financial Services roadmap.

• Train Revenue teams and facilitate the ongoing exchange of knowledge and best practices.

Who You Are:

• Financial Services native. Ideally with a consumer-facing marketing background in banking, insurance, wealth management, or FinTech.

• You know how Financial Services brands run. You are well versed in customer acquisition and onboarding, product cross-sell, deepening wallet penetration, lifetime value, digital-first experiences, and the KPIs leaders are measured on.

• Executive storyteller. You can turn complicated technology, including AI, into plain language a CMO or CFO cares about. You are an outstanding writer and presenter, and you easily adapt your messaging to your audience.

• Builds to scale. You’d rather create a play 50 sellers use than a deck one seller uses.

• Brings people along. You build trust across Sales, CS, PMM, Partnerships, Events and Content, and you push back when something’s off.

• Uses AI at work. You use AI tools to research, write and build faster, and you can explain AI concepts like agentic, generative and predictive to customers.

Qualifications:

• BA/BS degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus.

• 7+ years in B2B marketing, product marketing, financial services marketing, consulting or a strategy role, with significant time focused on Financial Services.

• A track record of building industry or go-to-market strategies that drove pipeline and revenue.

• Strong executive presence; experience speaking at industry events is a plus.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing relationships with key stakeholders.

• Practical experience leveraging AI-powered marketing tools and automation to improve personalization, experimentation, operational efficiency, and team productivity

• Experience with customer engagement, martech or data platforms (CEPs, CDPs, commerce platforms, data clouds) is a plus.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $112,000 and $157,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $131,000 and $187,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

• Competitive compensation that may include equity

• Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans

• Flexible paid time off

• Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability

• Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave

• Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend

• A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation

• Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching

• Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze

• Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

• To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application.

• To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com.

Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page.

Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144)

Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review.

To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here.

Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

jobs.title: Vice President, Audience Insights
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

About the Role

The New York Times is hiring a Vice President, Audience Insights to lead a high-impact team of researchers working to inform company-wide priorities.

You will oversee rigorous, insightful, and actionable research for partners spanning our data, design, growth, product, marketing, and strategy organizations, as well as the newsroom. You will also work with company leaders to shape a research agenda that helps The Times continue to understand, reach, and engage the audiences that our mission and business rely on.

This is a hybrid position, and you will work out of our NYC headquarters at least three days per week. You will report to the SVP, Strategy and Corporate Development.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Lead and mentor a team of multidisciplinary researchers, and nurture the team’s joyful and collaborative culture.

• Oversee audience research programs with product and design teams to define our target audiences, understand their needs, and inform roadmaps.

• Oversee audience research that shapes our marketing strategy, creative development and messages, and measures the effectiveness of our campaigns and other communications.

• Oversee research to help drive audience engagement with our site and apps, subscription conversion, retention and win-back.

• Shape audience research programs that support newsroom strategic priorities.

• Communicate widely about both internal and external research, putting findings in context for Times executives and teams.

• Harness best practices for research, including the use of A.I., that enhance productivity and quality while maintaining methodological integrity.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of the value of journalistic independence, and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications

• 15+ years of experience in primary research, market research, UX research, and consumer insights, including in a content or digital product company.

• 7+ years of experience managing high-performing teams and navigating matrixed stakeholder environments.

• Demonstrated ability to influence decisions through research-based insights.

Preferred Qualifications

• Advanced degree in a quantitative or social science field.

• Experience with both digital product design and traditional market research.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Toast Ticketing
jobs.description:
Locations: US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast Tables is Toast's reservations and waitlist product. Thousands of restaurants run their dining room on it: reservations, waitlist, and payments, built into the Toast point of sale. Toast Ticketing is the newest part of it. It lets a restaurant or venue sell tickets to its own events (a wine dinner, a comedy night, a holiday pre-order) on its public booking page, take payment, and check guests in at the door.

About this roll* (Responsibilities)

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own Toast Ticketing end to end. Ticketing is in open beta: any restaurant on Tables Plus (the paid tier of Toast Tables) can turn it on themselves, guests buy tickets on the restaurant's public booking page, and the host scans them in at the door. The next job is product-market fit, a commercial motion with sales and onboarding, and general availability. This is a senior individual contributor role. You report to the Toast Tables product lead and work day to day with the engineers who build ticketing, a design partner, and go-to-market (GTM) partners in sales, onboarding, and marketing.

You spend a lot of time with customers: on calls, on site, and watching real events get published, sell, and run. The restaurants running events on it talk to us every week, and what they tell us sets the backlog. You have a strong sense for the next right thing to build, and you keep scope tight so the team ships what matters most. You use AI tools every day to prototype, research, analyze data, and check your own thinking.

In this role, you will:

• Own the ticketing roadmap and strategy from open beta to general availability to scale, including where ticketing fits in Toast's guest platform and how it reaches venues beyond today's restaurants.

• Run the weekly build loop with engineering: framing problems, deciding what ships each week and why, and measuring results.

• Learn where early customers get value and where they get stuck, and use that to decide what to double down on and what to drop.

• Carry commercialization with GTM and leadership: pricing and packaging recommendations, rep enablement, and the funnel from enabled to first event to repeat seller.

• Keep live customers healthy: enablement, tax configuration edge cases, and payment issues, owning escalations directly until a support motion exists.

• Own the numbers the business runs on: restaurants selling tickets, ticket sales, and fee revenue. Set the goals, measure them, and let the data change course.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 8+ years of product management experience, including owning a product or major product area and its results.

• You've taken an early product from first customers to product-market fit and meaningful growth.

• You can point to product decisions that came directly from time spent with customers.

• You've owned a revenue product end to end: pricing conversations, GTM partnership, and executive communication, not just a backlog.

• You pull your own numbers, set goals up front, and let the data change your mind.

• You use AI tools regularly in your work and can explain specifically how.

• You write and speak clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.

Special Sauce (Nice to have)

• Experience with payments, commerce, ticketing, or marketplace products.

• Restaurant or hospitality tech experience, or another operationally complex industry.

• Experience taking a zero-to-one product to market inside a larger company.

• Experience pricing and packaging a new product.

• You pull your own data with SQL or similar tools, or you prototype in code today.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. $190,000—$304,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

The GIS Analyst will play a crucial role in supporting the development, maintenance, and operation of the Geographic Information System (GIS) for the City of Holyoke. • Digitize, edit, and maintain GIS data derived from engineering as-builts, GPS field collection, and red-lined drawings.

• Generate map products and perform spatial analyses for internal departments, engineering projects, and presentations.
• Provide support for GIS-related requests from various departments and deliver training to staff as needed.

• Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems, Geography, Environmental Science, Engineering Technology, or a related field.

• Experience with digitizing as-builts and editing features in geodatabases.

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period. To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website. Using our Carvana Certified 150-point inspection process, we’re able to verify that every vehicle meets our rigorous mechanical and cosmetic standards.

We strive to provide only the highest quality vehicles to our customers in our mission to deliver a no-hassle, better car buying experience. We are actively looking for passionate and talented individuals who can help us deliver on that promise.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Keep reading below to see what we’re looking for!

Position Overview:
Line Lead is a front-line supervisor role, responsible for directly managing and developing a team of hourly associates in an Inspection Center to regularly achieve production targets.

What you’ll be doing:

• Manage the movement of cars into and out of the Inspection Center safely for repairs, while meeting or exceeding set production and quality goals.

• Meet or exceed inventory production goals on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.

• Oversee day-to-day activities of assigned team; identify team’s strengths and weaknesses; determine areas of opportunity and the appropriate steps to improve.

• Engage assigned team, provide appropriate coaching, development and performance management; offer feedback and demonstrate desired skills.

• Create a work and team environment that inspires positive communication, team cohesion, and adherence to Carvana’s Values.

• Proactively communicate information to team members, providing clear understanding of expectations, performance measures, and goals.

• Prevent and resolve conflict among team members.

• Monitor and ensure adherence to systems, policies, procedures, and performance standards.

• Review and approve identified mechanical and physical defects of incoming inventory.

• Lead a team of production associates and partner with the Inspection Center General Manager to repair or reject inventory based on estimated cost of repairs and/or the overall quality of the vehicle.

• Train a team of production associates using Quality Control standards to identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, minimizing re-checks and delays in production.

• Identify and complete repairs effectively and efficiently the first time, to minimize re-work and delays in production.

• Conscientiously work in ways that decrease the possibility of injury to yourself or other team members in the shop due to spills or other preventable hazardous conditions.

• Effectively manage multiple associates, including ensuring appropriate employee development and performance management.

What the job requires:
To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• High School Diploma or GED equivalent

• Experience using computers

• Must be at least 18 years of age

• Demonstrated functional expertise in one or more areas pertaining to Carvana’s reconditioning process

• Demonstrated understanding of our current reconditioning processes and lean principles

• Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record (no DUIs and no more than two moving violations in the last 3 years).

• Must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently; majority of lifting from knee to shoulder heights; other lifting required from various levels

• Requires standing for extended periods of time with frequent stretching, reaching, walking, stooping, pushing, and/or pulling in an environment that may be cold, hot, noisy, and wet and may have fumes or odors due to vehicle maintenance.

• Requires use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to effectively delegate tasks to team members.

• Ability to communicate and interact with others effectively in a professional, courteous manner.

• Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both written and oral.

• Ability to maintain high volume and high-quality content in a fast-paced environment.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.

• Ability to resolve complex issues with guidance from others.

• Ability to work overtime and on weekends.

• Ability to work variable schedule(s) as necessary.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Position with a competitive salary

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy, both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Legal stuff
Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Senior Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
Customer Success · New York · Full-time, Hybrid

Elliptic has been tracking down crypto crime since 2013, trusted by banks, businesses, and governments worldwide to keep the financial system safe. Today, our compliance tools cover the large majority of global crypto exchange volume, and a $120m Series D is fueling the next stage of that work.

You’ll own Elliptic’s most strategic enterprise customers across the Americas. Their compliance, risk and intelligence programs involve several teams and executives on each side. This is an individual contributor role, so your influence comes from how well you lead accounts, not from a title.

Within six months you’ll have an account plan and a clear view of renewal risk for every key customer. You’ll also have built trusted relationships with their executives and seen at least one complex, multi-team use case through to a successful outcome.

 - Proven retention and expansion results in large accounts, with renewal forecasts that leaders can rely on

 - The presence to run executive business reviews and tell a clear value story to C-suite audiences

 - The ability to get Support, Solutions, Product and Engineering behind one plan without formal authority

 - Fluency with AI tools as part of your daily workflow, you use them to move faster and think better, and you know when not to trust them

Bonus points for AML experience in crypto or financial services, familiarity with blockchain and digital assets, or work with US banks or exchanges on compliance or financial crime programs.

What you’ll do

 - Own health, retention and expansion across your AMER enterprise portfolio, with an account plan and stakeholder map for every key customer

 - Lead renewal cycles end to end, from forecasting risk to negotiating terms

 - Run executive business reviews that prove ROI and build senior-level trust in Elliptic

 - Coordinate complex, multi-team use cases across Elliptic, keeping internal leaders informed early on risk and opportunity

What we offer you

 - Competitive salary, plus share options

 - 25 days of annual leave, plus US national holidays

 - Health insurance

 - A personal training budget

 - The laptop and equipment you need, plus a home office allowance

 - Full access to Spill mental health support

We hire for trajectory as much as track record. If this sounds like you, apply even if you don’t tick every box, we’d genuinely rather meet you than miss you.

jobs.title: Strategic Growth Partner (NYC)
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   

The Role: 

We are seeking a Strategic Growth Partner to join our dynamic Strategic Growth team. This role is pivotal to attracting the best financial advisors to Savvy Wealth and will report directly to our SGP Manager.

Your primary responsibility will be to identify, source, and nurture financial advisors and wealth managers with transferrable books of business to the firm. This will be done through prospecting, lead qualification, and effective reporting. Primary prospecting efforts will be conducted via digital channels (e.g. advisor databases, email campaigns, and social media) as well as phone-based (cold-calling).

You will work closely with the Strategic Growth team to understand the ideal target profile for advisors, outreach to prospective advisors across various channels, and build a pipeline of exceptional candidates who align with our company's values and vision.

Responsibilities:

 - Conduct proactive outbound prospecting to identify and engage potential financial advisors

 - Research and analyze target companies and industries to understand their needs and challenges

 - Initiate contact with financial advisors through cold calls, emails, and social media outreach

 - Qualify leads by conducting effective discovery conversations to uncover their pain points and requirements

 - Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of lead interactions and account information in our CRM system

 - Stay up-to-date on industry trends, best practices, and competitive talent landscapes

 - Assist in the development and implementation of recruiting strategies and initiatives

Must Have:

 - 1-2 years of full-cycle recruiting and/or sales experience. 

 - Bachelor’s degree  

 - Highly motivated and resilient by achieving targets consistently

 - Ability to quickly build rapport, primarily via phone-based or video communication

 - Proficiency in using CRM software and sales tools (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Recruiter, GSuite, and more).

 - Comfortable working in an early-stage startup environment

Nice to Have:

 - Direct experience with navigating the complexities of recruiting and/or selling to financial advisors/ wealth managers

 - Experience at a RIA, broker-dealer, wirehouse and/or custodian

 - Ideally from the Financial Sector or experience in revenue-producing recruitment

 - Master’s degree is a plus
   
   


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

jobs.title: Data Product Director
jobs.description:
THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are looking for a Product Director to join our Data Products team within Fanduel Technology.

This leader is accountable for Marketing’s data product strategy, governance, adoption, and modernization agenda, including advancing a scalable data-as-a-product operating model. As a Data Product Director, you will play a critical role in defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Marketing data team. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Analytics, Data Engineering, ML and AI Engineering, Data Science, Data Governance, Application Product and Engineering and Business stakeholders. You will be responsible for understanding market trends, identifying customer requirements, and translating them into data features and enhancements. This position requires strong technical knowledge, strategic thinking, and excellent communication skills.

The role will transform data into a strategic business asset by establishing trusted, reusable, and well-governed data products as the preferred foundation for analytics, insights, activation, and performance measurement. This leader will align investments with business priorities, champion a data-driven culture, and deliver measurable improvements in marketing effectiveness, customer outcomes, and decision-making.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

• Define and lead the multi-year Marketing Data Products & Platforms strategy and roadmap, aligning data investments with business priorities, customer outcomes, and enterprise objectives.

• Partner across Marketing, Analytics, Data, Technology, and Business leadership teams to shape and execute the future-state marketing data and analytics strategy.

• Participate and represent data in Marketing's analytics modernization strategy, ensuring capabilities evolve to meet current and future business needs.

• Champion the adoption of trusted, reusable, and well-governed data products that improve measurement, insights, activation, and decision-making.

• Drive the transition from fragmented data assets toward standardized "gold" data products that serve as the foundation for analytics across Marketing.

• Leverage analytics, AI, and emerging data capabilities to enhance marketing performance, customer outcomes, and business growth.

• Strengthen confidence in data through consistent governance, business ownership, and clear definitions of critical data assets.

• Ensure data products and analytics outputs meet regulatory, risk, and business requirements while maintaining trust across stakeholders.

• Serve as a strategic advisor to senior business leaders on analytics, insights, and data-driven decision-making in marketing domain.

·       Collaborate with teams from all around the business to understand data challenges and opportunities

• Build, lead, and develop high-performing data product team that works across the organization to build data product capabilities.

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

Proven experience (8-10 years) in Product Management, preferably in the data platform or big data domain.

• Deep understanding of data products, analytics operating models, enterprise data strategy, and trusted data management.

• Experience leveraging analytics, AI, and customer insights to improve marketing effectiveness, customer engagement, and business growth.

• Knowledge of marketing, customer, digital, activation, and performance measurement frameworks.

• Experience translating complex business and customer needs into actionable insights and measurable outcomes.

• Ability to balance strategic vision with execution and drive enterprise adoption of data products and analytics capabilities.

• Experience working with Data Technologies like Databricks, data warehouse and data pipeline technologies.

• Strong understanding of data management concepts, data engineering, data governance, and related technologies.

• Experience using SQL, Python and a variety of reporting and data visualization tools.

• Familiarity with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), audience management, and related MarTech tools like Xtremepush, Hightouch or similar is preferred

• A self-starter able to work both autonomously with minimal supervision and collaboratively within an agile team.

• Track record of managing, developing and coaching team members.

• Strong leadership skills and the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing Data and Technology (R14345)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Manager, Marketing Data and Technology to own the reliability of the data and technical processes that support Oportun’s marketing ecosystem. You’ll ensure marketing data is accurate, complete, consistent, and available across platforms and internal systems to support campaign execution, measurement, attribution, and growth.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You’ll serve as the primary owner for assigned MarTech systems, integrations, and tracking processes, working independently to identify issues, recommend solutions, and drive improvements through implementation. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and external vendors to keep systems reliable and data flowing correctly.

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

• You’ll own marketing data quality across assigned platforms and internal databases, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timely delivery.

• You’ll build and maintain validation, reconciliation, monitoring, and alerting processes to identify missing records, discrepancies, and failed data flows.

• You’ll investigate root causes of data and integration issues and drive solutions through implementation and ongoing monitoring.

• You’ll manage website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics, tag management configurations, pixels, and event implementations.

• You’ll configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, and data integrations between marketing vendors and internal systems.

• You’ll use Python or SQL to query, validate, transform, and reconcile data and automate recurring operational tasks.

• You’ll manage and troubleshoot assigned MarTech tools and configurations to support reliable data collection, audience activation, and reporting.

• You’ll establish and maintain consistent UTM parameters, campaign naming conventions, and tracking standards to improve attribution and measurement.

• You’ll identify data gaps, process weaknesses, and opportunities to improve tracking, integrations, automation, and operational efficiency.

• You’ll document data flows, tracking definitions, configurations, validation procedures, and troubleshooting processes to support team continuity and reliable operations.

• You’ll coordinate with cross-functional partners and vendors on requirements, testing, releases, issue resolution, priorities, and risks.

• You’ll look for practical ways to use AI and automation to improve data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational efficiency.

• You'll look for ways to use AI tools thoughtfully — to work smarter, reduce manual work, and make better decisions faster

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on technical marketer who enjoys solving data and systems problems and taking ownership from issue identification through resolution. You’re comfortable working independently, but you also know when to bring in the right partners.

You’re detail-oriented, proactive, and process-minded. You care about data quality, clear documentation, and reliable systems, and you consistently look for ways to make technical workflows more scalable and efficient.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

• 5+ years of relevant experience in marketing technology, marketing data operations, data engineering, marketing analytics, or a similar technical role.

• Proficiency in Python or SQL, with the ability to independently write, troubleshoot, and maintain code for data validation, transformation, or automation.

• Hands-on experience managing website tagging and tracking, including Google Analytics and a tag management platform such as Google Tag Manager or Tealium.

• Experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting REST APIs, webhooks, and data integrations.

• Experience reconciling data across systems, implementing quality checks, and resolving underlying data issues.

• Demonstrated ability to serve as the primary owner of assigned systems and processes in a small team environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues, recommend practical solutions, and follow through on implementation.

• Strong organizational, documentation, communication, and project management skills.

• Ability to work autonomously across teams, vendors, and time zones while managing competing priorities.

Nice to Have

• Experience establishing or maintaining website and digital tagging frameworks and marketing attribution data.

• Experience with Databricks, customer data platforms, Amplitude, Iterable, or similar marketing and analytics tools.

• Experience with scripting, workflow automation, scheduled data jobs, or monitoring tools.

• Experience in financial services or another environment involving sensitive customer data.

• Familiarity with data privacy, access controls, and governance requirements.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, or automation.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

Why Oportun

What's in it for you

Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment.

Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include:

Mexico Benefits:

Medical Insurance
Savings Fund
Life Insurance
Internet and Electricity Allowance
Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave

Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers   #LI-REMOTE #LI-VR1

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here:  https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/.

We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3).

jobs.title: Senior Mortgage Underwriter
jobs.location: Onsite Hybrid - Palo Alto (CA), New York City (NY), or Phoenix (AZ)
jobs.description:
About Pylon

America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand.

We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API.

Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury.

Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it.

Join us in building America’s mortgage rails.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking an entrepreneurial Senior Mortgage Underwriter to join our Platform team. You’ll underwrite loans end to end and act as the expert human judgment behind our automated Decisioning engine, which ensures efficient, compliant loan origination.

You’ll work directly with customers on complex files and give hands-on feedback to our product and engineering teams. That feedback helps the platform handle more underwriting automatically over time.

We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about working with flexible automated systems with rigorous oversight that can scale, this role is for you.




ABOUT YOU

 - Possess expert-level knowledge of the entire mortgage lending process, detailed underwriting knowledge specific to loan requirements and comprehensive understanding of federal, state, and regulatory guidelines related to residential mortgage lending.

 - Comfortable operating in highly regulated industry whilst optimizing for performance. You build with a compliance first lens, respect regulations, continuously review, and update processes as needed.

 - Obsess over the customer and uphold the highest standard. You build for our customers and their borrowers, doing whatever it takes to make them successful on the platform.

 - Adhere to a scalable software first approach, operational workaround last. You surface issues, lead discussions around long-term solutions, document them, and manage temporary manual workarounds if needed.

 - Ability to oversee numerous 3rd party fulfillment partners, ensuring high quality, on-time originations. You build deep relationships and drive consistent results.

 - Have strong, principled opinions that you’re willing to defend. We have a culture of vigorous discussion and debate on decisions. We’ll push you to articulate your choices, and defend them where necessary.

 - Have great ideas, and lots of them. You should see opportunities all around you to make the product and team better. We’ll provide the environment to act on those ideas.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Underwrite residential mortgage files across Conventional, Jumbo, Non-QM, and Government products, reviewing credit, income, assets, and collateral against guidelines.

 - Issue clear, accurate conditions and clear them promptly to reduce reconditioning and unnecessary submission turns.

 - Conduct 2nd level reviews, handle exceptions, and manage escalations to ensure quality control.

 - Regularly assess and enhance our Underwriting Systems to ensure smooth file flow, high quality, regulatory compliance and efficiency.

 - Act as a subject matter expert, aiding decision-making and driving product improvement.

 - Work closely with internal teams, partners, and engineering to drive product improvements and optimize the fulfillment infrastructure.

 - Maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage origination and regulations to ensure compliance.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 3+ years of experience in underwriting across diverse loan types, including Conventional, Jumbo, Non-QM, and Government across purchase and refinance.

 - Experience working on mortgage products within a fintech environment is strongly preferred.
