jobs.title: Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist
jobs.description:
As our pharmacy continues to grow, this is an exciting opportunity to bring your clinical expertise, regulatory knowledge and leadership experience to an ambitious and evolving business. Working closely with our Superintendent Pharmacist, you will help shape the future of our pharmacy, strengthen professional standards and support the delivery of safe, effective patient care at scale.

We are looking for someone who is confident in their clinical and regulatory knowledge, understands the importance of patient safety and is ready to take on a position with significant accountability, influence and leadership.



What is the Job?

At Montu, every prescription represents a patient waiting for treatment that can make a genuine difference to their quality of life.

Our pharmacy processes over 50,000 prescriptions each month, with continued month-on-month growth of approximately 10%. As our operation continues to scale, the Deputy Superintendent Pharmacist will work in close partnership with the Superintendent Pharmacist across all areas of clinical and regulatory governance.

You will take a leading role in the day-to-day clinical operation of the pharmacy, providing specialist regulatory expertise in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs, supporting professional standards and ensuring patient safety remains central to everything we do.

You will provide clear clinical and regulatory guidance, identify and manage risks, support inspections and audits, and contribute to the ongoing development of our pharmacy systems, processes and governance frameworks.

You will also deputise for the Superintendent Pharmacist when required, helping to balance the demands of a high-volume pharmacy operation with the professional, legal and regulatory standards expected of us.



What Will You Be Doing?

Clinical Governance and Regulatory Compliance

 - Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to maintain clinical governance and professional standards across Montu Pharmacy.

 - Support compliance with GPhC standards, MHRA regulations and all relevant statutory and professional requirements.

 - Lead the day-to-day clinical operation, providing clear guidance and direction to clinical and operational teams.

 - Take an active role in regulatory inspections, audits and compliance reviews, ensuring the pharmacy remains inspection-ready.

 - Identify, assess and manage regulatory risks, implementing appropriate corrective and preventative actions.

 - Review and maintain pharmacy policies, procedures and governance frameworks.

 - Maintain oversight of professional accountability, patient safety and regulatory reporting requirements.



Controlled Drugs Governance (Schedule 2)

 - Act as a specialist in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation, working alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to ensure compliance with relevant legislation.

 - Oversee appropriate systems and controls for the safe storage, handling, dispensing, recording and management of Controlled Drugs.

 - Ensure accurate, auditable records are maintained, with effective monitoring and reconciliation processes.

 - Identify and address potential compliance risks, incidents and discrepancies.

 - Support the development of Controlled Drugs governance processes that remain effective as prescription volumes increase.



Professional Leadership and Team Development

 - Provide clinical leadership alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist to a pharmacy workforce of over 100 colleagues.

 - Support the maintenance of professional standards and competencies across the pharmacy.

 - Oversee competency frameworks, training requirements and ongoing professional development.

 - Work with pharmacy leaders to promote accountability, patient safety and continuous improvement.

 - Provide guidance on complex clinical, professional and regulatory matters.

 - Collaborate with operational leadership to maintain accuracy, efficiency and patient-centred care.



Pharmacy Operations, Systems and SOPs

 - Maintain oversight of pharmacy systems, processes and Standard Operating Procedures.

 - Ensure operational practices remain compliant, efficient and appropriate for the scale of the business.

 - Identify opportunities to improve patient safety, dispensing accuracy and operational efficiency.

 - Support the implementation of pharmacy technology, automation and system improvements.

 - Ensure appropriate governance is maintained when introducing new processes, technologies and services.

 - Work closely with operational teams to balance prescription volumes, service delivery and regulatory requirements.



Strategy and Business Growth

 - Work alongside the Superintendent Pharmacist, General Manager of Pharmacy, Medical Director and senior leadership team to support the clinical and regulatory strategy.

 - Provide regulatory expertise when evaluating new services, products and business opportunities.

 - Support regulatory readiness for pharmacy expansion and operational growth.

 - Help develop scalable governance frameworks that support increasing prescription volumes.

 - Contribute to decisions relating to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

 - Ensure regulatory considerations remain central to business planning and operational decision-making.



Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced pharmacist with the expertise, confidence and ambition to make a meaningful contribution to the leadership of our pharmacy.

You will have strong clinical judgement, excellent regulatory knowledge and a thorough understanding of the professional standards required within a complex, high-volume pharmacy environment.

You will be particularly confident in Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs legislation and compliance, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance to both clinical and non-clinical colleagues.

This role requires someone who can see the bigger picture. You will understand the importance of operational performance, commercial awareness and business growth, while ensuring patient safety and regulatory compliance are never compromised.

You will be comfortable joining a growing business, building relationships across teams and bringing fresh perspectives to the way we work. Above all, we are looking for someone who leads by example, communicates effectively, remains calm under pressure and has the confidence to challenge, influence and make informed decisions.



What Experience Will You Need?



Essential

 - Current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).

 - Extensive knowledge of GPhC Standards for Pharmacy Professionals and relevant pharmacy legislation.

 - Demonstrable knowledge of Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs regulation and compliance in practice.

 - Experience leading clinical pharmacy operations within a high-volume or complex environment.

 - Strong understanding of MHRA regulations, including relevant requirements relating to importing, wholesaling and medicines storage.

 - Strong knowledge of pharmacy governance, risk management and Standard Operating Procedures.

 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections, audits and compliance frameworks.

 - Ability to provide clear clinical and regulatory guidance and influence decisions across clinical and operational teams.

 - Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Commercial awareness and an understanding of operational performance, KPIs and business growth.

Desirable

 - Previous experience in, or deputising for, a senior pharmacy leadership position.

 - Experience supporting pharmacy technology, automation or systems implementation.



What Does Success Look Like?

Within your first 12 months, you will have:

 - Strengthened Schedule 2 Controlled Drugs governance, ensuring processes remain compliant, auditable and scalable.

 - Supported the development and maintenance of robust pharmacy governance frameworks.

 - Helped establish clear professional competency, training and development standards.

 - Played an active role in preparing for and supporting regulatory inspections and audits.

 - Identified and supported meaningful improvements to pharmacy systems, technology and automation.

 - Contributed to shaping the clinical and regulatory strategy of Montu Pharmacy
   
   

What we offer

 - Bupa Private Healthcare Scheme

 - 25 days holiday (rising to 27 after one year & 30 after 3 years) + bank holidays

 - 5% matched pension

 - Cycle-to-work scheme

 - Opportunities for development and growth

 - A dynamic and supportive work environment

 - 

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

jobs.title: Advisory Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.

jobs.title: Diesel Fuel Systems Calibration Engineer
jobs.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a Diesel Fuel Systems Calibration Engineer to support the development, calibration, and validation of diesel fuel-system control functions. This entry-level position is well suited for a recent engineering graduate with relevant hands-on experience gained through internships, co-ops, university research, or student vehicle programs.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in engine systems, controls, and system-level engineering, combined with an analytical mindset and the ability to use modern engineering tools to solve calibration challenges.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop, optimize, and validate diesel fuel-system control parameters to meet engineering targets for emissions, fuel consumption, performance, drivability, diagnostics, and robustness.
• Perform calibration and validation using engine and chassis dynamometers, test vehicles, test tracks, and open-road testing.
• Calibrate and evaluate fuel-system functions including rail-pressure control, injection quantity, injection timing, multiple-injection strategies, and diagnostic functions.
• Analyze interactions between ECU software and controls, calibration parameters, sensors, actuators, fuel-system components, and engine behavior.
• Plan and execute calibration tests, analyze measurement data, evaluate results against engineering targets, and recommend calibration changes.
• Utilize and support the development of advanced calibration and data-acquisition tools to support data analysis, model-based calibration, optimization, and automation.
• Perform system-level troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of fuel-system, controls, calibration, and vehicle performance issues.
• Evaluate and present engine, powertrain, and vehicle test results and communicate technical conclusions to engineering teams and customers.
• Collaborate with controls, systems, software, hardware, and test engineers to resolve technical issues and achieve project targets.
• Participate in local and international calibration networks to exchange technical knowledge and stay current with control-system and calibration developments.
• Support vehicle validation programs, including winter, summer, and altitude testing, with travel of up to 12 weeks per year.

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, or a closely related engineering discipline.
• 1-3 years of experience with engine controls, powertrain systems, fuel systems, or vehicle technologies through an internship, co-op, professional experience, university research, Formula SAE, EcoCAR, or a similar vehicle program.
• Fundamental understanding of internal combustion engines, control systems, sensors, actuators, and feedback control.
• Strong system-level problem-solving and analytical skills.
• Experience with engineering data acquisition, analysis, and modeling tools such as MATLAB/Simulink, ETAS tools, or comparable engineering environments.
• Experience using Python as an engineering analysis or automation tool.
• Exposure to AI or machine-learning methods applied to engineering problems or engineering data.
• Strong technical communication and teamwork skills.
• Valid driver's license and willingness and ability to travel up to 12 weeks per year in support of vehicle testing and validation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous internship, co-op, or project experience in diesel engine, fuel-system, powertrain, or controls calibration.
• Understanding of diesel engine and common-rail fuel-injection technologies.
• Hands-on experience working with complex control functions and Electronic Control Units (ECUs).
• Experience with automotive calibration and data-acquisition tools such as ETAS INCA, CANape, or similar tools.
• Experience with engine dynamometer, chassis dynamometer, or vehicle testing.
• Understanding of the relationship between fuel injection, combustion, emissions, performance, fuel economy, and drivability.
• Experience with model-based calibration, data analytics, optimization, or automated calibration methods.
• Strong data-analysis and technical presentation skills.
• A passion for automotive engineering and hands-on development of complex powertrain systems.

Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only.  Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Payroll
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

In the role of Senior Manager, Global Payroll, you will report to the Sr. Director Total Rewards.

We are considering applicants for the location(s) of LA.

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Manager, Global Payroll to lead and manage our global payroll operations. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in payroll strategy, compliance, and best practices, coupled with proven experience in payroll system implementations across multiple regions. This leadership role demands a  hands-on leader that thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, a strategic thinker who can drive process improvements, ensure compliance with local tax laws, and streamline payroll operations globally.

The Senior Manager, Global Payroll will collaborate closely with the The People Team, Finance, and People Technology teams, ensuring that payroll systems are optimized and aligned with organizational goals. They will play a pivotal role in driving process  optimization and innovation, leveraging technology and automation to enhance operational efficiency, and maintaining a high level of employee satisfaction with accurate and timely payroll processing.

Core Areas of Responsibility

Payroll Strategy & Management

• Lead and oversee the end-to-end global payroll process for Crunchyroll ensuring the accurate and timely processing of payroll for all employees across multiple countries.

• Develop, implement, and maintain payroll strategies, policies, and best practices to ensure consistency, efficiency, and compliance globally

Global Payroll Systems Implementation

• Lead and manage payroll setup for newly established entities, ensuring operational readiness, regulatory compliance, and alignment with global payroll standards.

• Support business expansion into new markets by overseeing payroll implementation, including vendor coordination, system configuration, and integration with existing payroll and HR systems.

• Partner cross-functionally with People Technology, People Operations, Finance, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless payroll transitions, accurate data integration, and scalable processes that support global growth.

Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure full compliance with local, state, federal, and international tax regulations and labor laws.

• Stay up-to-date with global tax and regulatory changes, making necessary adjustments to payroll processes and systems as required.

• Identify and mitigate payroll-related risks and implement controls to reduce errors, penalties, and audit issues.

Team Leadership & Development

• Build and lead a high-performing, global payroll team, providing guidance, training, and development to ensure a strong, skilled workforce.

• Foster a collaborative, solution-oriented environment within the payroll team and across other departments.

Vendor Management

• Manage relationships with third-party payroll vendors and external partners to ensure they meet contractual obligations and deliver high-quality service.

• Regularly review vendor performance and evaluate new solutions or alternatives for improving global payroll efficiency.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging technology and automation to optimize payroll processes and reduce manual intervention.

• Identify opportunities to streamline payroll operations, including pay cycles, reporting, and system functionality.

About You

We get excited about candidates, like you, because...

• 8+ Years of overall payroll experience, 5+ years of global payroll experience with in-house payroll processing in a high volume

• Demonstrated experience with global expansion, payroll setup, continuous improvement, and M&A integrations.

• Demonstrated strong leadership capabilities with the ability to balance strategic oversight and hands-on execution to ensure operational excellence

• Deep knowledge and experience working with payroll vendors & platform technologies; includes Workday Payroll and CloudPay

• Proven leader directing, managing, and nurturing global teams

• Thinks analytically, focuses on the larger picture, and is able to drill into the detail and understand the impact

• Manage a high degree of change in a fast paced, complex, and demanding environment.

• Growth mindset: learning on a continuous basis as key to learning through opportunity and adversity

• Exceptional communication skills & ability to influence; ability to work effectively across all levels & layers of the organization

About the Team

The People Team's mission is to enable talent across our company to make an impact while innovating for the future. Our team is global in nature and focuses on client service while being genuine, authentic, and empathetic to employees and their needs across the organization.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

jobs.title: KIP Spring 2027 - Development Intern - Media Research Center
jobs.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!


About Media Research Center:
 
The Media Research Center (MRC) is America’s premier media watchdog. Since 1987, MRC has exposed left-wing bias in news and pop culture, defended free speech, and fought Big Tech censorship of conservatives. With powerful tools like its TV news archive and CensorTrack database, MRC provides hard evidence of bias and censorship. We educate the public and shape the national conversation across platforms that generate over 500 million weekly impressions.
 
About the role 
Are you passionate about protecting free speech and calling out censorship in the digital age? The Media Research Center is seeking a Free Speech America Intern to join the team working to expose Big Tech’s suppression of conservative voices. As an intern, you will help monitor censorship trends across major platforms like Google, Facebook, and X/Twitter, while researching and compiling examples of bias for publication and outreach.
 
This is a hands-on opportunity for students and recent graduates who want to be part of the fight to hold Big Tech accountable and inform the public about the growing threat to online expression.
 
This internship is designed for students and recent graduates. The position is in-person only at MRC headquarters; remote work is not available.

QUALIFICATIONS

Compensation & Total Rewards

The compensation package listed is for 1st year OTE, which are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. On-target earnings (OTE) represent the total potential income an employee can earn by achieving 100% of their performance goals. It combines a base salary with commissions and serves as an estimated figure rather than a guaranteed amount, providing a guideline based on average performance outcomes.

Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter, SG&A
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

TECHNICAL RECRUITER, SG&A

As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission-critical positions (pun intended). The SG&A recruiting team owns hiring for all corporate functions within SpaceX, including but not limited to: IT, Application Software, Environmental Health & Safety, Physical Security, InfoSec, Construction, and Materials Engineering. In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX, and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration, yet require a high degree of autonomy. So, while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:

• Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker

• Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates

• Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking

• Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews

• Give tours to candidates before their onsite

• Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates

• Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the offer process including initiating background checks, negotiating offer packages and extending offer letters

Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience. Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates. No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of recruiting experience; or associate degree and 2+ years of experience; or 3+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 2+ years of technical recruiting experience

• 2+ years of experience recruiting for IT, InfoSec, materials engineering, software engineering, environmental health & safety, construction or physical security

• Experience with in-house recruiting

• Experience with high volume recruiting

• Experience recruiting skilled labor

• Strong tenure with demonstrated success in recruiting roles

• Full life cycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing

• Comfort with reviewing, evaluating and reporting on recruiting data

• Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields

• Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.

• Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders

• Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates

• Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions

• Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• This position is based in Cape Canaveral, FL, and requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

As the Senior Infrastructure Engineer, you will serve as the senior technical authority for enterprise infrastructure modernization, technology strategy, and innovation supporting the Army Research Laboratory. You will partner with government leadership and engineering teams to assess current environments, evaluate emerging technologies, and develop solutions that enhance operational efficiency, cybersecurity, resilience, automation, and mission effectiveness.

Leveraging expertise across enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, networking, virtualization, identity management, endpoint management, and cybersecurity, you will provide strategic guidance, lead technical assessments, and recommend innovative solutions that support long-term mission objectives. • Develop technical white papers, decision briefs, recommendations, and executive presentations for Government stakeholders.
• Present findings, recommendations, risks, and modernization strategies to Government and contractor leadership.

jobs.title: Veterinary Technician - Anesthesia
jobs.description:
Come grow with us at VCSG! We are expanding our Anesthesia service and are looking for experience Anesthesia Veterinary Technicians to join our team.

Who We Are

Veterinary Care & Specialty Group (VCSG) is Chattanooga’s largest multi-specialty and emergency hospital, where compassionate care meets cutting-edge medicine. At VCSG, we are committed to providing exceptional specialty and emergency care while fostering a supportive and collaborative team environment. We believe that excellence in patient care starts with a workplace where professionals feel valued, empowered, and inspired to grow — because when our team thrives, so do our patients.

Who We Are Looking For

Our ideal candidate is detail-oriented and thorough, with a strong commitment to accuracy—especially during critical moments. They bring excellent communication and interpersonal skills, allowing them to collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients alike. Thriving in a fast-paced environment, they can confidently juggle multiple priorities while remaining compassionate, dependable, and a true team player.

What You Can Expect To Do

• Pre-Procedure Prep: Use your skills to ensure the patient, equipment, medications, and procedure areas are ready for planned and emergent procedures.

• Anesthesia Administration: You’ll be responsible for inducing and maintaining patients under general anesthesia and sedation, including injectable, inhalant, and CRI anesthesia.

• Patient Monitoring: During procedures, you’re the go-to for adjusting anesthesia levels and ensuring everything’s running like clockwork. If anything seems off, you’re quick on your feet and ready to respond to emergencies.

• Recovery: As the patient starts to wake up, you’re there to monitor and ensure a safe and gentle recovery.

• Record-Keeping: You’ll keep detailed records of the anesthetic procedures—what was used, how the patient responded, and any other events along the way.

• Collaboration: You will partner with our various department teams to plan and coordinate anesthesia protocols for each patient, while communicating with the team on patient status.

• Equipment Management: Perform routine maintenance on anesthesia equipment, ensuring functionality and safety. Calibrate and troubleshoot anesthesia machines, ventilators, and monitoring devices. Keep an inventory of anesthesia-related supplies and medications.

• Patient Advocacy: Advocate for the well-being and comfort of patients before, during, and after anesthesia. Implement and maintain protocols for pre-anesthetic patient assessment and post-anesthetic recovery.

Qualifications Required

• 1-2 years of anesthetic monitoring in a veterinary setting, with a preference for a surgery or specialty/referral practice.

• Strong knowledge of veterinary anesthetic drugs and their effects, backed by specialized training and expertise

• Skilled in venipuncture, IV catheter placement, anesthesia monitoring, drug calculations, and other technical skills.

• Strong medical math skills and experience with drug calculations.

• Attention to detail, must be thorough in your work, with a focus on accuracy, especially in critical moments

• Excellent communication and people skills. .

Preferred - Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT) or equivalent certification

Take the next step in your veterinary career: We are committed to training and growth, providing you with in-person didactic, hands-on, and virtual learning.

Provide exceptional patient care: Our hospital was built from the ground up with the highest level of care in mind. You will be using the latest equipment and technology alongside board-certified specialists across multiple disciplines.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Urban Solutions powers the bike-sharing and scooter-sharing systems that move millions of people in over 60 cities worldwide. We built North America's first automated bike-share system and continue to lead the micromobility revolution. Our systems operate globally - from Citi Bike in New York to BIXI in Montreal, Divvy in Chicago, Capital Bikeshare in DC, and iconic systems in Austin, Barcelona, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Detroit, Dubai, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto, and beyond.

We're not just technology providers - we operate these systems, building the software, hardware, and operations that make urban micromobility work at scale. LUS is a global business with teams and partners across North America, Europe, and Latin America, and our international footprint is growing. We're launching in new markets, introducing next-generation bikes and stations, and expanding some of the largest bikeshare systems in the world.

Ready to shape how millions of people move through their cities every day?

As the Chief of Staff for LUS, you will report to the Head of LUS serving as both a strategic thought partner and a hands-on executor. You'll help shape priorities and tradeoffs with the Head of LUS and their leadership team, then turn those priorities into plans, processes, and results. You'll own the planning, operating rhythm, and communications that keep a global, multi-function organization aligned, and you'll lead high-priority initiatives from scoping through delivery. A successful CoS is neither a shadow nor a gatekeeper. They're a force multiplier for leadership who drives decisions to closure and makes the organization work better.

A great candidate brings structured problem-solving and executive communication skills, a bias toward action, and comfort with ambiguity. You'll work across product, hardware, operations, commercial, finance, policy, legal, and people teams, both within LUS and across Lyft.

Responsibilities:

• Strategic thought partnership: Act as a sounding board to the Head of LUS on priorities, tradeoffs, and organizational decisions; bring a point of view and clear recommendations, backed by data and analysis

• Planning and goal-setting: Own the LUS annual planning and OKR process, from timelines and frameworks through final plans; track progress against goals, surface dependencies and risks early, and drive course corrections

• Operating rhythm and governance: Design and continually improve how the LUS leadership team operates, including staff meetings, business reviews, offsites, and decision forums, so that decisions get made and followed through

jobs.title: Director Partner Programs & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply.  Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.



Partners are one of Kong's biggest levers for AI Gateway pipeline and bookings, and our partner business is growing fast. Kong is hiring a Director, Partner Operations to build the operating model that helps it scale.

You'll be the operating partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders, sitting in Revenue Operations. You own how partner business flows through Kong — registration, deal structure, attribution, crediting, and payout — and you bring an AI-first mindset to how it runs.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Business partner to Ecosystem leadership
Serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Ecosystem VP and Partner Sales leaders across theaters. Run an AI-assisted operating cadence — forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs, and executive reporting — where the prep is automated and meetings go to decisions. Facilitate cross-functional alignment on people, then process, then systems, so changes are agreed before they are configured.

Partner GTM strategy & planning
Lead annual and quarterly planning for the partner organization, including targets, capacity, and coverage. Help build a business that maximizes the impact of partner investments and resources. 

Rules of engagement, deal registration & attribution
Own the rules that govern how partner deals are registered, protected, sourced, and credited, including sourced vs. influenced credit, lookback windows, and the line between partner credit and partner marketing credit. Encode them into systems and agents so they apply automatically.

Partner lead & deal workflows: Define and own how partner-touched leads and deals move between ADR, PSD, and AE, including routing, SLAs, and prioritization. Cover partner event leads, prospective partners, existing partners, and deal registrations, and give PSDs one view of the leads that need their action.

Partner deal execution
Partner with Deal Desk, Finance, and Legal to make partner deals easy to structure, discount, and book across resale, referral, and cloud marketplace routes

Partner compensation & crediting
Partner with Incentive Compensation on channel-neutral crediting and referral fees, so sellers choose the best route to market.

Manage cloud marketplace operations: Own Kong’s cloud marketplace operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including listings, private offers, channel partner private offers (CPPOs), and co-sell registration. Lead the launch of marketplaces in new regions, and manage marketplace dynamics with Deal Desk, Finance, and the cloud alliances team, including fees, customer commit drawdown, and partner involvement on marketplace deals.

Performance insights & data quality
Define and report the partner KPIs that matter, give every partner leader a run-the-business view, and keep partner data accurate.

Partner marketing measurement & MDF
Work closely with Partner Marketing and Marketing Ops to define how partner marketing is measured. Tie MDF and event spend to registered deals by capturing funding source on deal registrations, and report sourced and influenced pipeline separately.
Operational playbooks & enablement
Build and maintain the partner operations handbook and repeatable workflows, from partner onboarding to software access, including prospective partner intake and ADR and PSD training on routing rules, so every seller knows the process on day one.

Systems & data architecture
Own partner data design and routing rules. That includes partner account structure, alignment of deal registration approval with lead routing, and alerts when opportunities open on partner accounts. Evaluate whether the PRM remains the right long-term fit.

AI & automation roadmap
Own the Partner Operations AI roadmap: find the highest-leverage workflows, build or buy the agents and automations, and measure the hours returned to the field. Own business requirements for partner tooling across Salesforce, PRM, and CPQ.

Lean, high-output team
Build a small team of AI-native operators, and work across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success to drive change as the ecosystem scales.

Required Experience:

 - 10+ years in Partner or Channel Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Strategy & Operations at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure software company, including 3+ years leading partner operations - with direct ownership of deal registration, rules of engagement, and partner attribution.

 - 3+ years experience operating a multi-type, multi-region partner ecosystem - GSIs, regional SIs, resellers, distributors, ISVs, and hyperscalers.

 - Hands-on partner deal execution end to end - resale, referral, and cloud marketplace transactions, partner discounting, and order form requirements - in partnership with Deal Desk and Finance.

 - 3+ years experience leading partner planning - targets, quota, capacity, and coverage  and designing channel-neutral crediting with Incentive Compensation.

 - Proven track record as a trusted advisor to VP-level Partner or Sales leaders, with the presence to hold a governance line and the judgment to know when to evolve it.

 - Deep Salesforce fluency (opportunity design, sourcing fields, reporting) plus PRM and BI tools, and hands-on use of AI tools to automate ops workflows.

Preferred experience:

 - Hyperscaler co-sell and marketplace mechanics: AWS ACE and ISV Accelerate, Marketplace private offers, Microsoft co-sell, and Google Cloud Partner Advantage.

 - Experience supporting a shift to usage-based or consumption pricing and reflecting it in partner deal structures and crediting.

 - Experience leading a team from building processes to running them at scale.

 - API, cloud infrastructure, or AI platform experience.

About Kong: 

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. jobs.title: Sr Technical Success Manager
jobs.description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Black Duck, a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Application Security Testing, is hiring a Technical Success Manager (TSM) to drive adoption and prove the value of our solutions across our enterprise customers. TSMs are hands-on technologists who configure and tune our solutions and show measurable software risk reduction to customer security, engineering, and executive teams.

The Role

Your job is to drive adoption and prove value. You work closely with the account team to drive renewals and delight customers. You do the technical work yourself, including problems without a known answer. You partner with a Customer Success Engineer (CSE) when the work requires custom code, CI/CD or API integration builds, or architecture judgment specific to the customer's environment.

What You'll Do

Technical ownership

• Drive adoption across customer development teams after onboarding, expanding coverage to new teams, repositories, and use cases.

• Configure and tune the platform: scan policies and rules, scan and server performance, standard SSO setup, and custom reports and dashboards.

• Guide vulnerability remediation and prioritization using CVE, CWE, and OWASP context.

• Support SBOM generation and review (CycloneDX, SPDX) and open source risk questions.

• Troubleshoot technical issues directly and coordinate first line triage with Support and Engineering through resolution.

• Enable customer teams on scanning, UI and CLI usage, problem diagnosis, and best practices, and develop internal champions.

Adoption, value, and renewals

• Confirm why the customer bought, then build and maintain a success plan with measurable adoption and technical outcomes.

• Build working relationships with AppSec, engineering, and executive stakeholders, and know who has influence over adoption.

• Participate in Executive Business Reviews, highlighting the progress you and the customer have made and proving value.

• Monitor adoption and customer health, flag risk early, and partner with the account team on save plans.

• Work closely with the account team to drive renewals by supplying the technical value story and proof points.

• Identify expansion opportunities and hand them to Sales with a validated technical case. You do not carry a quota.

• Advocate for customers internally, feed field gaps back to Product and Engineering, and turn successful customers into references.

You'll Have

• 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as TAM, sales engineer, solutions architect, or implementation consultant.

• Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and DAST: running scans, tuning results, and triaging findings yourself.

• Strong knowledge of application security, vulnerabilities, and open source licensing.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps tooling such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, and Jenkins.

• Software development experience in C/C++, Java, C#, or similar, plus comfort with scripting and REST APIs.

• A track record driving adoption and proving value across a portfolio of enterprise accounts, working alongside account teams on renewals.

• Practical fluency using AI tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, and customer communication.

• Ability to travel up to 25%.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred

• TAM, solutions architect, or sales engineer experience in AppSec or DevSecOps.

• Security certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, or CEH.

• Experience with enterprise-scale web development, microservices, and containers.

• Experience with regulated environments and standards such as PCI DSS, ISO 26262, MISRA, AUTOSAR, or DISA STIG.

Pay Range

$95,400—$119,200 USD

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Black Duck complies with all applicable laws prohibiting employment discrimination in every jurisdiction where it operates and provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior Azure Platform / DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Azure Platform / DevOps Engineer

About Makai


Makai uses best-in-class AI and data to solve real-world operational and strategic challenges at scale. We help businesses with enterprise automation, human-machine teaming, product design and development, and market intelligence. Until now, people have had to learn and adapt to software. Makai creates solutions that adapt to people because technology will never be 100% accurate. People are essential for all of our human-machine teaming solutions.

About the role


At Makai, we build and run cloud platforms for clients in healthcare and other high-stakes industries. You take a platform from an empty Azure subscription to production, make the architecture calls and live with them, and own the infrastructure as code, the pipelines and the monitoring. Much of this runs inside our clients’ own Azure environments, so you work with their infrastructure teams daily: reviewing their designs, explaining what we need and why, and keeping work moving when it depends on them.

The ideal candidate will be able to

 - Design, build and maintain Azure environments with Terraform across multiple subscriptions, from networking and identity to a running application

 - Build and maintain CI/CD for applications and infrastructure in Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and similar platforms: release promotion with approvals, secure deployment identities and repository synchronization

 - Operate the compute and runtime platforms, from virtual machines to containers and PaaS: base images, upgrades, patching, rolling deployments, autoscaling and capacity planning

 - Design and tune monitoring, logging and alerting with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights

 - Design and operate the identity and access model: Entra ID, SSO, workload identities, role- and attribute-based access control, privileged and just-in-time access, and secrets in Key Vault

 - Design and maintain secure network architectures: hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN, private endpoints and DNS, Application Gateway and WAF, Azure Firewall, NSGs and isolation between environments

 - Maintain security and compliance: vulnerability remediation, patching, Azure Policy, and audits against client policies and regulatory frameworks

 - Design and run backup, high availability and disaster recovery: recovery objectives, zone and region redundancy, restore testing, DR drills and failover

 - Own production changes and incidents: formal change management with verification and rollback, and troubleshooting through to root cause

 - Act as the technical counterpart to clients’ infrastructure and security teams: design reviews, proposals, change requests and runbooks



Qualifications

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, building and operating production Azure environments

 - Expert-level Terraform: you have owned large multi-environment, multi-subscription Azure codebases, designed their code and state structure, and carried out major refactors and state migrations on live infrastructure

 - Proven experience designing CI/CD systems for both applications and infrastructure on Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms, across many repositories and environments

 - Strong Linux systems administration background, with a deep understanding of how servers are provisioned, configured and run, and hands-on troubleshooting of services, containers, storage and networking at the OS level

 - Fluency in Bash and PowerShell; Python is a plus

 - Deep understanding of Microsoft Entra ID and of identity protocols such as OIDC, OAuth 2.0 and SAML, and of Azure’s control-plane and data-plane authorization models

 - Proven experience designing, implementing and testing high availability and disaster recovery for production systems, with a solid understanding of the SLAs and recovery limits of Azure services

 - Hands-on experience with Azure compute services such as Virtual Machines and VM Scale Sets, App Service and Container Apps

 - Experience building observability on Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights, and fluency in KQL

 - Solid working knowledge of Azure networking, particularly hub-and-spoke topologies, private connectivity and DNS

 - Experience operating Azure data services such as Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure SQL Database, Azure Managed Redis, Cosmos DB and Azure Storage

 - Excellent technical writing and live communication: documentation others can act on without you, and a composed, precise manner on client calls and during incidents

 - Candidates must be authorized to work in the US. No visa sponsorship is available for this position.



How we work


Small senior teams, real ownership. We'd rather have one engineer who understands a platform top to bottom than several who each own a slice.

Core values for Makai employees



 - Be a flexible, innovative and creative thinker

 - Be congenial and a team player

 - Be self-sufficient

 - Be self-driven with an ownership mentality

 - Have a strong work ethic

jobs.title: Learning and Development Specialist
jobs.description:
About Hone

Hone is an online medical clinic at the forefront of transforming healthcare and enhancing longevity. We use cutting-edge scientific advancements to empower men and women to take control of their health and unlock their full potential. Our people are the heart of everything we do and drive our success. We approach every project through our brand values:

• Fight for the Customer

• Execute Ruthlessly

• Communicate Candidly, Clearly, and Kindly

• Collaborate Selflessly

• Practice Calculated Risk-Taking

• Maximize Joy and Gratitude

Hone has been fully virtual from day one and will continue to be a remote-first employer.

Our Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is a mission-driven, motivated multi-tasker who is invested in work that is fulfilling and impactful. They embrace change and tackle challenges with enthusiasm. They have an “all-in” disposition towards work, understanding that we are a fast-paced, high-growth organization with evolving priorities. They can excel at both independent tasks and collaborative work, leading with clear and candid communication. They exhibit humble leadership—the ability to drive initiatives forward while remaining excited about continuous learning and development opportunities. They feel strongly about being part of a team that advocates for people to live longer and better lives.

At Hone Health, we are on a mission to create a world where age is no longer a limitation. We believe that by empowering individuals to take charge of their health with the right tools, tools that go beyond the capabilities of traditional healthcare, we can help them live their best possible lives, regardless of age.

We’re looking for a Learning and Development Specialist who shares this vision. You’ll start by owning training for our Patient Care Team, from the first day of a new hire’s class through the ramp to full pace and ongoing learning after that. As the company grows, this role can expand into company-wide training and into leading a team of trainers.

About the Role

You’ll be the owner of care team training, end to end. You’ll design and run new hire training, build practice and assessments, track how new hires ramp, and use what you find to close gaps for the wider team. For now, you’re the only trainer. You’ll set the direction, decide what to build first, and see it through without waiting to be told. You’ll work with care team leaders, QA, and Pharmacy Ops. You’ll be measured on how quickly new hires reach full pace and how well gaps get fixed.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the care team training program end to end: set the strategy, build and deliver new hire training with practice and assessments, and keep improving it.

• Track how each new hire is ramping, so we can see who’s on track, who isn’t, and where the gaps are.

• Use quality audits, performance data, and manager feedback to find training gaps, and build training that closes them.

• Keep training current as treatments, services, and workflows change.

• Work with cross-functional teams and subject matter experts (Pharmacy Ops, Clinical, QA) to keep content accurate.

• Make sure training is ready to run when the business needs a class.

Qualifications

• Self-driven, with a record of owning a program end to end, from strategy through delivery and improvement.

• Experience designing and running training for a high-volume support or care team, preferably in healthcare or telemedicine.

• Experience using performance or quality data to find gaps and measure whether training works.

• Strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.

• Proven ability to handle challenging situations with patience and professionalism.

• Strong organization skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

• Familiarity with learning management systems and training tools.

How we hire

Finalists complete a short case study and present it to our team.

If you’re passionate about helping others thrive and have the drive to make a meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and why you are interested in this position.

Salary Range

The salary range for this role is between $70,000 and $80,000, depending on experience.

Benefits*

Hone wants our team to be in the best condition of their lives, so we offer a range of benefits including:

• A remote-first work environment

• Competitive compensation and equity options

• Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage

• Short-term disability and basic life coverage

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

• Lifestyle Spending Accounts (LSAs)

• We follow federal holidays and have uncapped time off for exempt employees

• Budget for the technology tools you need (laptop, monitor, and/or special software)

• A focus on company-sponsored activities to foster engagement (both virtual and in-person)

• Waived membership fees for any Hone team members utilizing Hone products

*These benefits are available to full-time, regular employees, and not to independent contractors, part-time employees, temporary employees, or interns.

We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace committed to building a team culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: Sr. Onboarding Consultant
jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

 - Newsweek's America's Greatest Startup Workplaces (2026)

 - Fortune Best Workplaces in New York™ (2026)

 - Great Place to Work Certified™ 
   
   


THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a Sr Deployment Strategist to lead our largest, most complex advisor transitions and help build the onboarding processes that support our next stage of growth. You’ll own onboarding from planning through implementation, making the move to Savvy smooth for advisors and getting them up and running quickly. This is a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with Operations, Growth, Product, and Marketing to execute transitions and improve how we onboard at scale.

Who you are:

 - You’re never tired of learning. You’re able to self-teach new platforms and ways of working.

 - You appreciate direct communication. You’re both an active communicator and an eager listener. You’re motivated by feedback and see every setback as an opportunity to grow.

 - You can pivot on the fly. We are fast-growing, so our priorities are constantly evolving. What you worked on last month may not be the same next month.

 - You have a humble and “can do” attitude. Our teams create high-quality work on quick timelines.

 - You want to be part of a winning team. We’re stronger together, and you’re a person who embraces being pushed out of your comfort zone.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

Enterprise Deployment

 - Lead enterprise onboarding: Own the transition lifecycle for enterprise and high-AUM advisor groups, from signing through post-join asset transition, as the senior point of contact for advisor principals, and operations leads.

 - Coordinate across teams: Keep complex transitions on track with Compliance, Legal, IT, Client Service, and Product, and escalate blockers early to maximize impact in the first 90 days.

 - Enable Early Adoption: Deliver initial training and resources that empower advisors to quickly leverage Savvy’s software, tools, and financial products.

 - Deliver Speed to Revenue: Drive revenue results for the company by onboarding advisors quickly. Act as a day-to-day contact for advisors during the transition process.

 - Balance several onboarding and activation processes while maintaining clear communications with stakeholders and remaining adaptive in a rapidly evolving environment.

 - Monitor and report on transition progress and potential risk situations. Coordinate with the Client Servicing Team to ensure smooth client account transitions.

Raising the Bar

 - Raise the bar for the team: Build playbooks and templates the enterprise transition playbook and templates, track transition speed, and be the go-to resource for other Onboarding Managers on complex transitions.

 - Share lessons from enterprise transitions so the whole team gets faster.

 - Spot where our process breaks at scale and work with Product and Operations to fix it.
   


MUST HAVE:

 - 5+ years of experience in consulting, implementation, project management, onboarding, or a related client-facing role. We welcome consultants looking to move into an operating role and own outcomes from planning through execution.

 - A track record of leading complex projects with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and meaningful business impact. This could include client implementations, business transformations, or enterprise transitions.

 - Strong client relationship skills. You build trust, communicate clearly, and help people navigate unfamiliar processes and important decisions.

 - The ability to turn complex information into clear guidance, presentations, and training tailored to different audiences.

 - A collaborative, low-ego approach and strong ownership. You’re comfortable setting the plan, getting into the details, and following through.

 - Strong organization and prioritization skills. You can manage several workstreams, anticipate roadblocks, and keep people aligned on deadlines and next steps.

 - A drive to solve complex problems and turn what you learn into repeatable, scalable processes.

 - Comfort working in a fast-growing business where priorities evolve and you’ll help create the playbook.

 - The ability to learn new technologies, workflows, and industries quickly. Prior experience in technology, fintech, or wealth management is helpful, but not required.
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Prior work experience in the Wealth Management industry

 - Prior work experience at a high-growth start up

 - Prior experience in the financial services industry

 - Familiarity with advisor transition frameworks and the compliance and registration steps that come with them.
   


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Savvy Wealth is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive work environment that values diversity and individual contributions.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - We offer a generous relocation package to help top talent make the move to our NYC office

 - Unlimited PTO + paid company holidays

 - Access to holistic medical, dental, and vision plans

 - Company 401(k) (including Mega backdoor Roth options), Commuter, and HSA/FSA plans 

 - NYC office in Union Square

 - Lunch and snacks provided in the office, & dinner if you stay late

 - Access to virtual mental health care (Spring Health) and health concierge (Rightway) to help you find the right care

 - Access to counseling for stress management, dependent care, nutrition, fitness, legal, and financial issues (Guardian WorkLifeMatters EAP)

 - Benefits are available to full-time employees

jobs.title: Mixed Pet Veterinary Hospital - Veterinary Technician
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

[Licensed/Certified/Registered] Veterinary Technician

Compensation: $XX–$XX/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

Position Summary:

The [Licensed/Certified/Registered] Veterinary Technician plays a vital role in assisting veterinarians and the medical support team to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compassionate care to pets and their families. This position is responsible for performing a variety of technical, clinical, and client education duties that enhance efficiency, promote a safe and collaborative hospital environment, and elevate the overall client experience. This role also assists in maintaining consistent, excellent medical standards and operational flow.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provide high-quality nursing care to hospitalized patients, including IV catheter placement, CRI management, medication administration, feeding tube placement, and ongoing monitoring.

• Prepare, monitor, and recover patients undergoing surgical procedures, ensuring patient safety and comfort throughout all phases of care.

• Assist veterinarians during examinations, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures, providing proper restraint, preparation, and patient monitoring.

• Perform laboratory diagnostics including urinalysis, hematology, fecals, and cytology; accurately document, interpret, and communicate results as appropriate.

• Operate and maintain diagnostic equipment, including radiology and ultrasound systems, in compliance with safety and regulatory standards.

• Prepare and administer medications, vaccines, and treatments as prescribed, maintaining strict compliance with DEA, OSHA, and hospital regulations.

• Maintain accurate daily controlled drug logs and ensure proper handling, storage, and documentation of controlled substances.

• Create, review, and enter treatment plans accurately in the medical record system.

• Support hospital operations through accurate medical recordkeeping, charge entry, and chart auditing.

• Provide compassionate, clear client education related to preventative care, treatment plans, medications, products, and nutritional recommendations.

• Maintain clean, organized, and well-stocked treatment and surgical areas, ensuring sterile conditions for medical and surgical procedures.

• Monitor inventory levels, rotate stock, and assist with ordering medical supplies as needed.

• Promote a positive and professional workplace culture through effective communication, teamwork, and collaboration across departments.

• Perform additional duties as assigned based on hospital needs.

• Ensure all duties are performed in accordance with state practice acts, legal requirements, and hospital policies.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Licensed/Certified/Registered Veterinary Technician credential required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in anesthesia monitoring, venipuncture, laboratory procedures, radiology, and dentistry.

• Basic computer literacy, including the ability to navigate practice management software and use Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Maintains professionalism, composure, and sound judgment in emotionally charged or high-stress situations.

Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

Who Are We Looking For?

If you answered in the affirmative, then maybe you have what it takes to join VUDU squad. Our team is passionate about data and logic, and we cover every aspect of data analysis and observational reporting from AI-powered BI agents to enterprise feed automation.

We’re looking for someone who loves to solve problems and wants to learn how to build out great data-product solutions. You will work with senior members of the squad translating end-user needs into focused, actionable steps that result in timely solution deliveries. You will learn and execute our requirement-intake processes, and implement new solutions using our data stack to solve for those requirements. But that is just the start, while you learn our process, you will be expected to carry forward your knowledge and work with the larger team learning to build AI-powered solutions that scale for long term growth and expand our group’s bandwidth across the organization.

If you are someone who dives into whatever challenge is placed in front of you, you will find endless challenge at Vestwell on the VUDU squad; the good kind that leaves you a little winded but much the wiser. We are not an old-school financial company. We are disruptors. We use state of the art tools and we work to win.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Understand project goals and stakeholder requirements; identify opportunities; and translate inputs into buildable features with clear executions

• Effectively communicate and share plans and decisions: in and out, up and down

• Partner with developers to break down product requirements into discrete tasks with clear functional requirements/acceptance criteria

• Assist QA team in understanding the appropriate positive and negative test cases to ensure test coverage and a high level of code quality

• Provide iterative feedback to the development team, including identifying bugs and assisting in resolution

• Complete functional testing and provide initial product sign-off when features are ready for end-user verification

Requirements
The Necessities

• College degree

• Business / Math degree

• Ability to thoroughly understand and document business/functional requirements and use cases

• Working understanding or the SDLC

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, project-oriented environment to meet deadlines under tight time constraints

• Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment consisting of Product, Engineering, and QA resources

• Excellent communication skills, both in verbal and written formats

• Must have the ability to interface with internal stakeholders

• Experience with SQL, must be able to read it and write it to some provable extent

This role will be based in either the New York, Austin, King of Prussia, or Scottsdale office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

The expected base salary range for this position is $70K - $80K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

Full-Time Employee Benefits
We’re an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

Interview Process
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.
