jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT POLYMARKET

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Marketing team at Polymarket is responsible for telling the world what Polymarket is, why it matters, and why trading here is better than reading a poll. We work across growth, brand, comms, and product, and we move fast because the news moves fast.

As Head of Product Marketing, you'll own how we bring Polymarket's product to market. You'll sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, and Comms, translating what we're building into clear positioning, compelling stories, and go-to-market strategies that drive adoption and usage.

You'll help shape how we position the product, which audiences we prioritize, how we launch new features and verticals, and how we communicate the value of Polymarket to both existing and prospective traders. You'll bring customer insights and competitive intelligence back into Product, ensuring we're not just marketing what we build, but helping inform what we build.

This is a high-ownership role with significant surface area. You'll touch everything from new market verticals and trading mechanics to mobile onboarding, rewards, and major company-level launches. You'll also have the opportunity to build and scale the Product Marketing function as Polymarket grows.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product marketing strategy and function, including positioning, messaging, audience strategy, and go-to-market planning.

 - Partner closely with Product and Growth leadership to shape product strategy based on customer insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends.

 - Develop clear positioning and messaging for Polymarket's product, features, market verticals, and key initiatives.

 - Own go-to-market strategy for major product launches, from defining the audience and narrative through channel strategy, execution, and post-launch analysis.

 - Build launch frameworks and processes that enable Product, Marketing, Growth, and Comms to move quickly and stay aligned.

 - Develop deep understanding of Polymarket's users, including why they trade, what drives adoption, and where we can improve conversion and retention.

 - Translate complex product mechanics into simple, compelling narratives that make sense to both existing traders and new audiences.

 - Lead competitive research and market intelligence, using those insights to inform positioning and product decisions.

 - Partner with Brand, Social, Communications, and Growth to ensure product messaging is consistent and differentiated across every channel.

 - Establish measurement frameworks for product marketing and evaluate launches based on adoption, engagement, trading activity, and revenue.

 - Lead post-launch analysis and turn learnings into improvements to product positioning, messaging, and future GTM strategy.

 - Build and manage the Product Marketing team as the function grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years of experience in product marketing, ideally at a high-growth consumer technology company.

 - Has owned product marketing strategy and major B2C go-to-market launches from positioning through execution and measurement.

 - Exceptional at translating complex products or concepts into simple, compelling positioning and messaging.

 - Strong strategic thinker who can connect customer insights, product strategy, and business objectives.

 - Proven ability to influence Product, Growth, Brand, and Comms teams without relying on direct authority.

 - Deep understanding of customer research, competitive intelligence, segmentation, positioning, and go-to-market strategy.

 - Excellent written and verbal communicator. Can write everything from a one-line product message to a comprehensive GTM strategy.

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities change quickly and launches can be driven by breaking news or live events.

 - Highly analytical and comfortable using data to understand product adoption, customer behavior, and marketing performance.

 - Strong operator who can move between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

 - (Plus) Genuine interest in news, sports, politics, or financial markets.

 - (Plus) Experience with event-driven products or marketing tied to live sports, elections, breaking news, or other real-time events.

 - (Plus) Experience building or managing a Product Marketing team.


BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary & equity

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

 - 401k match

 - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories




PAY TRANSPARENCY

Base salary range: $300,000 to $375,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

We’re looking for a Lead Technical Recruiter to join our technical recruiting team and own full-cycle recruiting across engineering functions. As a senior individual contributor, you’ll partner directly with engineering leaders to translate hiring needs into targeted recruiting strategies, build high-quality pipelines, and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

This role combines strategic partnership with hands-on execution. You’ll independently manage complex searches, engage hard-to-find talent, and guide candidates and hiring teams through the recruiting process from intake to offer acceptance.

Responsibilities

• Own full-cycle recruiting for engineering and technical roles, from intake and sourcing through interviews, offer negotiation, and closing.

• Partner with engineering leaders to define role requirements, calibrate candidate profiles, and establish effective interview and assessment plans.

• Build diverse, high-quality talent pipelines through proactive outreach, talent mapping, market research, and creative sourcing channels.

• Develop targeted outreach strategies that engage passive candidates and build relationships with high-priority talent.

• Quickly turn new hiring priorities into actionable search plans, independently building pipelines and moving qualified candidates through the funnel.

• Conduct recruiter screens to assess relevant experience, motivations, and alignment with role requirements.

• Serve as a trusted talent advisor, sharing market insights and providing clear recommendations on search strategy, candidate profiles, and hiring decisions.

• Manage multiple searches and adapt to shifting priorities while maintaining momentum and a strong candidate experience.

• Use recruiting data to evaluate pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and recommend adjustments that improve hiring outcomes.

• Partner with compensation, People, and business stakeholders to develop competitive offers and support successful candidate closing.

• Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity in Greenhouse.

• Share best practices, support teammates, and improve recruiting processes to help the team scale.

Experience and Skills

• 6+ years of technical recruiting experience, including full-cycle ownership of engineering searches.

• A proven track record of hiring technical talent across multiple levels, including senior individual contributors and engineering leadership.

jobs.title: Weekend AM Anchor/MSJ
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

KTHV11, a TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in Little Rock, Arkansas, is seeking an engaging Anchor/Multi-Skilled Journalist to lead our Saturday morning newscasts and report stories that matter across central Arkansas. This journalist will help viewers start their weekend informed, prepared and connected to their communities. We are looking for a journalist with strong news judgment, clear and conversational on-air delivery, and the curiosity to find the people and context behind the headlines. The successful candidate will work closely with producers and the newsroom team to shape useful, accurate newscasts, while also reporting, shooting, writing and editing original stories for broadcast and digital platforms. This is a visible newsroom role that calls for a dependable teammate, a thoughtful community presence and a calm, flexible approach to breaking news.

Responsibilities
• Anchor THV11 Morning News on Saturday with accuracy, warmth, authority and energy.
• Partner with producers, editors, photographers and newsroom leaders to plan and deliver clear, compelling newscasts; contribute ideas, editorial judgment and strong writing.
• Prepare for each broadcast by reviewing scripts, confirming facts and pronunciations, tracking developing stories and making timely updates as news changes.
• Report, write, shoot, produce and edit original stories and live reports for television, streaming, mobile and social platforms.
• Develop enterprise and community-focused stories through social listening, public records, independent research and trusted local sources.
• Build and maintain relationships with people and organizations throughout Northwest Arkansas and the River Valley, reflecting the range of communities in our viewing area.
• Use social media and digital tools to discover story ideas, engage with the audience and distribute accurate, useful journalism.
• Create or contribute to digital content, including web stories, video, live updates, images and social posts, in coordination with the newsroom.
• Deliver clear, authoritative live coverage during breaking news and severe weather, adapting quickly while following newsroom standards and direction.
• Represent THV11 professionally at community events
• Serve as a fill-in anchor and fulfill other duties as assigned

Requirements
• 1-3 years news anchor/reporting experience preferred
• Journalism, communications or related degree preferred
• Excellent writing, interviewing and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex issues in clear, conversational language.
• Sound editorial judgment and a demonstrated commitment to accuracy, fairness, ethics and accountability.
• Ability to shoot and edit video and produce content for broadcast and digital platforms.
• Experience with newsroom systems, editing tools and graphics
• Ability to report, publish and engage with the community on social media daily.
• Ability to work any shift in a 24/7 newsroom environment
• Knowledge of central Arkansas is a plus

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Commercial Systems (Fixed Term)
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager, Commercial Systems (Contract) to provide interim leadership of Commercial Systems within Commercial Operations during a period of transition. In this role, you will own the intake, prioritization, and delivery of initiatives that support our Commercial teams by working with Systems partner teams from across the organization. You will set direction and stay hands-on to keep programs moving, with a high degree of autonomy. This is a 3 month contract with potential for extension.

• Turn ambiguous business requests into clear, documented requirements that admins, engineers, and vendors can build against

This is a remote role based in the US.

What you'll bring

jobs.title: Premium Cash Assistant
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you’ll help us to achieve it

We value being close to our customers and agents, so if you enjoy contact with customers, we have an excellent opportunity for you!
As a Premium Cash Assistant, you will be the first point of contact for our customers and agents. Under the supervision of the Premium Cash Officer, you will manage the daily reconciliation of transactions in our Premium Agency based in Bamako or the upcountry.

In this role, you’ll;

• Help agents nearby with liquidity needs (deposits and withdrawals).

• Support agent/client needs (Wave's offer, opening accounts, how the system works, the app, physical card…).

• Maintain daily reconciliation of premium points.

• Ensure that all cash management transactions are correctly recorded in the treasury system.

• Request promptly sufficient funds to ensure rebalance with agents/clients.

• Report any discrepancies or challenges encountered to the Premium Cash Officer.

• Report fake bills to Leadership.

Key Details

• Location: You'll be based in Mopti.

• Work authorization in Mali is required.

• This is a fixed-term position, 6 months contract.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

• 2+ years experience as a cashier in cash management, reconciliation, liquidity management, cash handling, or delivery.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or equivalent.

• Strong proficiency in French.

• Previous experience in front-office customer service or in the banking sector.

• Be very vigilant, detail-oriented, and have strong integrity.

• Knowing Wave products is an added value.

• Speaking English and a local language (Bamanakan, Sarakole) is an added advantage.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.

• Love owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.

• Are intellectually curious and creative in the way you go about tackling problems.

• Are willing to go the distance to get something done.

• Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination.

• Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Program Development Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Authentic is a tech-enabled MGA (managing general agent). We design and run insurance programs for specific kinds of businesses, like restaurants, gyms, and power producers. Brokers bring us the businesses that need coverage, and carriers back our policies. Every program runs on a platform we built ourselves, and we own every line of code behind it. Engineers and insurance experts build it side by side in New York and Dayton, Ohio. Since our founding in 2022, we’ve grown to 80+ people and been named to the 2026 CB Insights Insurtech 50.

The Role

The Program Development Manager leads the Dayton team that builds Authentic's insurance programs. The team turns approved rates, rules and forms into live configuration in Authentic's policy administration system (PAS), and handles the steady flow of changes that live programs need. You'll start by managing a small team of 5-6 Program Developers and will be responsible for building and growing that team as our program portfolio expands. You'll own how their work is planned, prioritized and delivered, and stay close enough to the work to pick up builds yourself.

This role reports to the VP of Programs and sits within Authentic's Programs department. The Programs department designs and builds Authentic's insurance programs end to end: the Program Design team handles market research, actuarial studies, rate development, forms and state filings, and the Program Developers configure and launch those programs in Authentic's policy administration system.

This is a player-coach role for a people leader, not a software engineer. We're looking for someone who has managed people and projects, is comfortable around technology, and genuinely enjoys helping others grow. Insurance experience isn't required; we'll teach you the domain. As the team and our program portfolio expand, there is real room to grow your scope.

What You'll Do

• Team Leadership & Development Manage a growing team, currently 5-6 Program Developers: set priorities, run weekly 1:1s, give regular feedback and lead performance reviews. Coach developers on build quality, problem solving and ownership, and create clear paths for them to take on more complex work over time. Be a visible, on-the-ground presence in the Dayton office: available, approachable and checking in on how the work and the people are doing. Build and scale the team: partner with the VP of Programs on headcount planning, hiring, onboarding and training as the team grows. Build the team's documentation, playbooks and best practices so knowledge doesn't live in one person's head.

• Program Build & Delivery Own the team's workload end to end: intake, scoping, prioritization, assignment and delivery tracking for program builds and configuration changes. Oversee the build and configuration of rates, rules and forms in the PAS, making sure live programs match approved rate development and filings. Manage the queue of inbound Operations requests (endorsements, build configuration, class mappings and form attachments), setting turnaround expectations and keeping requesters informed. Run new program launches as projects: timelines, dependencies, QA testing in staging and go-live readiness. Keep a consistent review and release process for configuration changes the team ships through GitHub to carrier programs, tenants, products and coverages. Spot recurring bugs and requests and turn them into process or tooling fixes.

• Hands-On Work Take on builds, configuration tasks and bug fixes yourself, especially early on and during busy periods. Learn the PAS and configuration workflow well enough to unblock developers, check their work and estimate effort accurately.

• Cross-Functional Partnership Work closely with the actuarial and program design teams, including Product Analysts, so rate, rule and form work moves cleanly from filing to build. Partner with Operations, underwriting and program stakeholders to set priorities and communicate timelines. Notice where handoffs between departments break down and propose practical fixes, from clearer SOPs to better intake processes.

Who You Are

• We're looking for a people leader who is comfortable with technology, not a software engineer. You don't need insurance experience. If you're smart, thoughtful and interested in how insurance programs get built, we'll teach you the rest. 5+ years of professional experience, including 1-2 years managing people (direct reports preferred; formal team lead experience considered). Proven project management skills: you've run several workstreams at once, managed dependencies and deadlines, and kept stakeholders informed. Background in IT, technical operations, systems implementation or another tech-adjacent environment. A genuine desire to develop people, with real examples of coaching someone to grow in their role. Comfortable with technical and configuration systems, and willing to learn basic coding and Git workflows (no software engineering background required). Some strategic thinking: you can see how your team's work connects to the rest of the business and improve how it gets done. Clear, proactive written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong judgment, organization and attention to detail. Able to work onsite in Dayton, OH.

Nice to Have

• Experience in insurance, insurtech or financial services, especially with a policy administration system (an in-house PAS, Guidewire, Duck Creek or similar). Exposure to rating, rules or forms configuration, or to SERFF filings. Hands-on time with GitHub, configuration-as-code or basic scripting and query languages (for example, SQL or Python). Experience leading an implementation, configuration or business systems team. Experience growing a team through hiring, onboarding and building out its processes. Formal project management training (PMP, Agile or Scrum). Advanced Excel skills.

Our (FTE) benefits

• Competitive salary, equity, and role trajectory

• Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family

• 401(k) plan with company match

• Unlimited PTO

• Paid parental leave

About Authentic

Authentic builds the infrastructure that program insurance runs on. We partner with leading brokerages to design and manage custom insurance programs, backed by A and A- rated carriers operating nationwide. Brokers bring the data and distribution. We bring everything else: the technology, the capacity, and the underwriting expertise to stand up specialized programs at speed and build them to last.  We’re a Series A company backed by top investors, including FirstMark Capital, Zigg Capital, Slow Ventures, Clocktower, Commerce Ventures, and Altai. We’ve grown over 15x in the past year with a massive market opportunity ahead.

Authentic is committed to building an inclusive working environment regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race, education, age, or other personal characteristics. We believe that people do their best work when they can be themselves, and different perspectives and experiences make us stronger as a team. We’re proud of the supportive and inclusive workplace we're building together and are always working to make it even better.

jobs.title: Assistant General Manager
jobs.description:
*Relocation required in 6-18 months from starting the position

About Us

ADESA, a Carvana owned company, currently the nation’s second-largest physical wholesale vehicle auction  operating over 50 locations throughout the US. Our auction sites, some up to 200 acres, provide a wide array of vehicle services including logistics management, repair & reconditioning, and auction remarketing for well over one million vehicles annually. Many of our locations also serve as Carvana distribution hubs and reconditioning facilities, making our sites vibrant and full of passionate people who enjoy serving our customers.

We work in a service industry and embrace a “we” versus “I” culture – help others, and they will help you. Our industry is fun, fast-paced, and competitive – and filled with the best people who are passionate about what they do.

We’re excited about the future! As an industry leader, ADESA is undergoing a multi-year expansion including sizable investments in facilities, digital auction capabilities, and supporting our customer’s growth! We are looking for great people who want to take this journey with us. Get a sneak peek into life at ADESA!

Role

As an ADESA Assistant General  Manager, you will lead a high performing vehicle operations team and support the customer experience at an auction site.  Our AGMs maintain a strong understanding of operational, sales, and financial processes.  Those who communicate effectively, as well as understand the importance of maintaining relationships, will thrive in this position. We are looking for a motivated, encouraging leader who demonstrates our core values daily and maintains a strong passion for leadership, integrity, adaptability, and positivity.

The Assistant General Manager role at ADESA is an amazing opportunity for a passionate leader looking to accelerate their career in the fast-paced automotive world.   You'll be at the forefront of innovation, applying operational, sales, and financial abilities to enhance customer satisfaction, while you sharpen your skills to prepare you for continued career growth potential across our organization.  If you thrive in a high expectation, high accountability role and are ready to accelerate your career with a Fortune 500 company that values leadership, integrity, adaptability, and positivity, ADESA is your road to success.

Impact

A committed Assistant General Manager is dedicated to developing a customer service driven and operationally efficient team.  You will develop strategy and inspire the team to achieve operational objectives related to customer needs. You will contribute to our business growth in an innovative atmosphere as a valued member of our ADESA community.

Responsibilities

People Leadership and Team Development

• Lead from the front by setting the cultural tone and facilitating an environment of positivity, customer focus, strong morale, and team collaboration.

• Recruit and hire exceptional team members, and utilize performance management tools to ensure development of their careers.

• Resolve employee relations challenges, complaints, suggestions, etc. using sound human relations principles. Follow-through and communicate employee relations problems to the General Manager and evaluate and take positive, consistent, disciplinary action on infractions of company policies and procedures as defined in the employee disciplinary policy.

• Ensure proper follow-through on all directives, bulletins, schedules, and accounting from the General Manager, designated manager, or other corporate sources.

• Frequently and effectively communicate across the team and ensure the flow of cross functional communication between departments.

Business Development

• Lead the dealer consignment and commercial account teams in accordance with corporate guidelines to ensure achievement of maximum sales volume in the most profitable way possible.

• Support end to end solutions for all customers and advise the sales team with demonstrated knowledge on products, services, and maximization of technology.

• Ensure the use of marketing tools on selected customer accounts as instructed.

• Leverage strong business acumen; monitor all local competition and recommend competitive strategies to the General Manager and marketing department.

• Attend Profit and Loss Statement reviews each accounting period with the Controller and General Manager. Manage sales records, controllable expenses and cost items affecting profitability.

• Monitor all customer accounts and work with other managers to ensure compliance with sale plan layouts, corporate requirements, and other directives. Advise and assist with corrective procedures or collecting outstanding receivables, if needed.

Customer Service

• Create and maintain positive rapport and trusted relationships with customers and employees in a transparent, reliable, and positive manner and act as the at-auction point person for customer related needs.

• Ensure that fast and friendly service is provided to all customers in support of growth to the customer base. Resolve any customer complaints in a friendly, courteous manner. Advise the General Manager or designated manager of all serious complaints or incidences.

Operations & Process Execution

• Turn operational and process initiatives into actionable tasks; support operational administration to move vehicles through the process with strong understanding of processes, collaboration across the organization, and communication internally.

• Inspect work performed by auction operations to ensure that the work conforms to the customer’s request.

Compliance and Safety

• Monitor and control all facility conditions, vehicles, property and equipment for property cleanliness, maintenance, and safety.

• Develop strong partnerships with the corporate teams to implement and ensure compliance with all company initiatives, policies, procedures, and applicable state and federal laws are always followed.

• Monitor and ensure compliance with all contractual customer, contractor, and supplier agreements.

Skills & Attributes

• Excel in a fast-pace, high-pressure environment where speed and quality are paramount

• Self-motivated in order to drive efficiency, teamwork, and the best customer experience possible

• Ability to always demonstrate polished and professional behavior

jobs.title: Premium Cash Officer
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Being close to our customers and agents is fundamental for us. If you thrive on customer interaction and have a knack for managing liquidity, the Premium Cash Officer position might be a perfect fit.

As a Premium Cash Officer within our premium agency, your primary responsibility would be overseeing the agency's operations.

In this role, you’ll;

• Manage cash in and out between the Safe and Premium Cash Assistant accounts.

• Hold end-of-day bill counting and produce a daily bill counting statement.

• Ensure that all cash management transactions are correctly recorded in the treasury system.

• Promptly request sufficient funds to ensure rebalancing with agents/clients.

• Ensure transactions with cash-in-transit companies (Cash in/Cash out).

• Report discrepancies or challenges encountered by Premium Cash Assistants.

• Report fake bills to management.

• Ensure that furniture and materials are in good use and that the office is well secured.

• Manage and, if needed, escalate relevant feedback to management that may impact the agency's activity.

Key details

• Location: You'll be based in Freetown.

• Work authorization in Mali is required.

• This is a permanent position.

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer (26 weeks for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers) and subsidized child care when you return to work.

• We help you live your fullest life now- we subsidize gym memberships and fitness classes.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space.

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience as a cashier in cash management, reconciliation, liquidity management, cash handling, or delivery.

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or an equivalent.

• Strong proficiency in English.

• Previous experience in front-office customer service or in the banking sector.

• Be very vigilant, detail-oriented, and have strong integrity.

• Knowing Wave products is an added value.

• Speaking a local language is an added advantage.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are excessively detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.

• Love owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.

• Are intellectually curious and creative in the way you go about tackling problems.

• Are comfortable defaulting to over-communication and overreaching when it comes to coordination.

• Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Director of Product Marketing (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Hi, Future Homie!

At Homebase, you’ll join a team that’s bold, fast-moving, and obsessed with helping small businesses thrive. We build with empathy, act with urgency, and take big swings that drive real-world impact. Here, every Homie shows up to raise the bar, support one another, and celebrate wins as a team.

We’re not just building an app—we’re building unstoppable teams. So what do you say, are you in?


 📍Your Impact Starts Here

As our Director of Product Marketing, you will own how Homebase wins small business owners. That means the story we tell, how we price and package, which industries we go after, and what sales and support say on every call. Homebase has grown from a suite of tools for hourly teams into AI that takes care of an owner's least favorite work for them. More than 150,000 businesses already run on it. Most owners who would love Homebase have never heard of us, and your work decides how fast that changes.

You will report to our CMO, lead our Product Marketing team, and work daily with Growth, Creative, Product, Sales, and Support. Every campaign, landing page, sales script, and support conversation starts from what your team learns and builds.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll write the first draft of the narrative yourself and run the team with AI built into its work.

These are the key ways you’ll contribute and create impact in this role:

The Homebase story

 - Own the company narrative and the testing system behind it. New messages go into market with frequent testing and are judged on conversion.

 - Make sure Growth, Creative, Sales, Support, Product, and PR tell one story with the outcome owners care about up front and our product as the proof.

Pricing and packaging

 - Own how we price and package Homebase so an owner understands it in seconds, and it grows revenue per customer.

 - Ship pricing and packaging changes, and measure each one on conversion and revenue.

Industry go-to-market

 - Use data to choose the industries we go after first, then run a cross-functional pod to execute vertical growth campaigns.

 - Build the kit every channel runs on, including owner insights, competitor maps, ad and landing page messaging, creator briefs, and Sales and Support scripts.

Sales, support, and customer growth

 - Give Sales and Support the scripts, plays, bundles, and offers they use on every call, and refresh them regularly from what reps hear and why deals are lost.

Products and customer insight

 - Partner with Product so Team App, Payroll, Cash Out, and Hiring are positioned to win with the story carried through sign-up, trial, and an owner's first 30 days.

 - Build a customer insight engine with regular owner conversations, a panel you can hear from in days, and a running read on the market.

Team leadership

 - Decide how the team is organized and what it works on each quarter, and say no to work that doesn't move revenue.

 - Grow the people on your team into bigger roles, and run the team on the same weekly cadence as Growth with AI built into research, briefs, testing, and analysis.

What success looks like

 - In your first 90 days, you've talked with dozens of owners and our new narrative and first industry kits are running in market. Your team has a clear plan for the next two quarters.

 - By month 6, you know within two weeks which message is winning, and industry campaigns are beating general ones. Your first pricing and packaging changes are live and measured.

 - By month 12, Sales and Support run your plays on their calls, and revenue per customer is growing. Growth and Creative start new campaigns from your team's story and owner insight.



🚀 The Foundation for Success - These are the experiences and strengths that will set you up for success in this role:

 - 8+ years in Product Marketing or go-to-market roles. You have led a team of Product Marketers and grown people into bigger roles.

 - You have built a company narrative from customer insight and got a leadership team with strong views behind it. You can show what it did to growth once it shipped.

 - You have owned pricing and packaging decisions with real data behind them and a measurable result on revenue or conversion.

 - You have worked side by side with growth teams in a self-serve or high-velocity business and judged messaging on conversion.

 - You have built industry or segment go-to-market programs that marketing and sales actually ran.

 - You use AI in your own work every day and can show how you check what it produces.

 - Bonus points if you have: Experience marketing to small businesses or hourly teams, a background in HR, payroll, or fintech software, and pricing work in freemium-to-paid models.

 - This role is probably not for you if
   
   - Your best work is brand campaigns, launch plans, or positioning that lives in slides.
   
   - Your playbook comes from enterprise, sales-led businesses with long deal cycles. Most of our owners buy on their own, and we judge messaging by whether they convert.
   
   - You need months of research before anything ships. We test in weeks and learn in market.
   
   - You prefer to direct from a distance. We need a leader who still writes the first version of the story.



🤝  The Homie Way - These principles guide everything we do—from how we work and make decisions to how we show up for each other.

 - 💡 Be Customer Obsessed – Solve problems with empathy and creativity.

 - ⚡ Move Fast, Learn Fast – Experiment, take action, and grow every day.

 - 🎯 Own Your Impact – Think big, focus on what matters, and make decisions you stand behind.

 - 🏆 Master Your Craft – Excellence fuels impact—show up, step up, and make your mark.

 - 🏅 Win Together – Put goals over roles, lead with trust, and connect to our mission and each other.



What We Offer (United States) 

 - 💰 Ownership & Financial Security: Stock options + 401(k) with 4% match

 - 🏥 Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage + FSA options

 - ⏰ Flexible Time: Unlimited PTO (salaried) + company holidays

 - 🤖 AI access, for real: We invest in builders and believe that curiosity shouldn't have a paywall. That means you'll have access to paid AI tools with minimal restrictions, so you can build, experiment, and level up your craft.

 - 👶 Family Support: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave (after 6 months of service)

 - 🌟 Work Your Way: Work From Anywhere Month + meeting-free weeks yearly

 - 💼 Our Hybrid Rhythm: We believe collaboration drives impact. That’s why Tuesdays and Wednesdays are our required in-office days—a time to move faster as a team, build deeper connections, make better decisions, and build together.
   
   

What We Offer (Canada)

What to Expect During the Interview Process

Homebase will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.



👋 Hey, We’re Homebase

Homebase is the everything app for hourly teams—built to simplify the day-to-day and superpower local businesses. With tools for scheduling, time clocks, payroll, communication, HR, and more, we help teams stay connected and in control. jobs.title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
ABOUT US:

Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company developing a scalable technology platform to power critical infrastructure, mission operations, and the future of flight. We apply aerospace engineering and quality standards across our products, delivering high performance, reliability, and efficiency for the most demanding operating environments. Astro Mechanica is backed by leading venture and strategic investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Giant Step Capital, United Airlines Ventures, and Voyager Ventures.

 


WHO WE ARE:

We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

 


WHO YOU ARE:

You're not a traditional recruiter, and that's exactly what we're looking for.



You know that hiring exceptional technical talent requires more than posting jobs, running searches, and following established recruiting playbooks. You're creative, resourceful, intellectually curious, and relentless in finding people who are exceptional at what they do, especially when those people are difficult to find and even harder to recruit.



You thrive in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity is the norm, and speed matters. You don't wait for someone to hand you a process or tell you what to do. You figure things out, challenge assumptions, and build better ways of working.



You're a systems thinker who can zoom out to see the bigger picture while obsessing over the details that make a difference. You understand that great recruiting is both an art and a science, combining market intelligence, creative problem-solving, exceptional judgment, and deeply personalized candidate engagement.



You have a high bar for talent and an equally high bar for your own work. You know how to identify rare technical talent, earn the trust of exceptional engineers, and create a white-glove candidate experience that reflects the caliber of the company you're helping build.



Above all, you're energized by the opportunity to help build one of the strongest technical teams in aerospace.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Find extraordinary talent. Own full-cycle recruiting for some of our most challenging and business-critical roles, from highly specialized engineers in propulsion, test, and manufacturing to senior technical leaders

 - Go beyond traditional sourcing. Develop creative, unconventional strategies to identify and engage exceptional people who aren't actively looking. Map talent ecosystems, uncover hidden networks, and find candidates others overlook

 - Be a strategic talent partner. Work directly with senior leadership and hiring managers to understand complex technical challenges, define what exceptional talent looks like, and build thoughtful hiring strategies

 - Operate with speed and precision. Move quickly without compromising quality. Anticipate obstacles, solve problems proactively, and create momentum in an environment where hiring exceptional people is a top priority

 - Deliver an exceptional candidate experience. Build authentic relationships with highly sought-after talent through thoughtful, personalized outreach and white-glove engagement. Every interaction should reflect our standards for excellence.

 - Build systems, not just pipelines. Think critically about how we recruit. Identify inefficiencies, experiment with new approaches, and build scalable systems that make us faster, smarter, and more effective

 - Raise the bar. Bring strong judgment and conviction to talent assessment. Challenge assumptions, push for excellence, and help ensure every hire makes the team stronger.

 - Close the hard ones. Understand what motivates exceptional technical talent and craft compelling, individualized approaches to bringing them onboard
   
    


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - 8+ years of recruiting experience, with a track record of hiring exceptional technical talent in fast-growing startups, deep-tech, aerospace, or hardware engineering environments

 - Demonstrated success identifying, engaging, and closing rare, highly sought-after technical talent, particularly in competitive or highly specialized markets

 - A creative, unconventional approach to sourcing and problem-solving. You have examples of searches where you went well beyond traditional recruiting methods to find the right person

 - Strong systems thinking and an instinct for building better processes, tools, and ways of working rather than simply operating within existing ones

 - The ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, exercise independent judgment, and deliver results with minimal direction

 - Exceptional relationship-building skills and the ability to earn credibility with deeply technical candidates, engineering leaders, and executives

 - An obsessive attention to detail and a commitment to delivering a highly personalized, thoughtful candidate experience

 - A high bar for excellence, strong ownership mentality, and genuine pride in your craft

 - A willingness to challenge conventional wisdom, experiment, take calculated risks, and continuously improve

 - Genuine curiosity about aerospace, aviation, and the engineering challenges we're solving
   
    


PERKS & BENEFITS:

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

 - 401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

 - Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

 - Flexible work environment
   
    


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytical Development
jobs.description:
About Loyal

Loyal is a clinical-stage veterinary medicine company developing longevity drugs for dogs. Our mission is to help dogs live longer, healthier lives.

We're pioneering a new category of veterinary prescription drugs that proactively and preventatively target the underlying drivers of aging, delaying the onset of disease and preserving quality of life as dogs age. We've already made significant progress in our mission to develop the first FDA-approved drugs to extend canine lifespan: as of early 2026 we've completed two of three major FDA review sections for our lead program, LOY-002, and are targeting submission of the third and final section later this year.

Loyal is a well-funded startup with teams of scientists, veterinarians, engineers, operators, and creatives. You'll help us continue on our path of earning FDA approval for the first lifespan extension medicine for any species, and change what's possible for the dogs we love.

About the role

The Senior Director, Analytical Development provides strategic leadership for all analytical development across Loyal’s pipeline and future commercial products. This is a hands-on role in a lean, virtual company. You’ll set the strategy and do the work, including authoring the analytical content of CVM submissions. You’ll build and scale the AD organization, leveraging internal and external partners, with deep expertise in OSD analytics and FDA regulatory requirements.

You will be reporting to our Vice President of Manufacturing.

Your daily work will include

• Set and execute the global analytical development and quality control strategy aligned with Loyal’s corporate and CMC objectives.

• Serve as the accountable executive for GMP analytical operations, ensuring inspection-ready systems, data integrity, PAI readiness at Loyal and CDMOs, and sustained regulatory compliance.

• Act as a senior CMC leader on cross-functional program teams, influencing development strategy, timelines, and investment decisions.

• Lead the development, validation, transfer, and lifecycle management of analytical methods and control strategies, with immediate focus on small-molecule oral solid dosage products, while supporting additional modalities as the pipeline evolves.

• Own the dissolution strategy, including discriminating method development, validation, and the dissolution data package for CVM submissions.

• Author and review the analytical content of the NADA CMC technical section, including method validation summaries, specification justifications, stability narratives, and deficiency responses.

• Lead the drug substance analytical strategy including method development and validation, specifications, impurity control, stability programs, reference standards, and testing at API manufacturers and starting material suppliers

• Own the stability strategy across the pipeline, including protocol design, statistical evaluation, shelf-life assignment and trending.

• Lead cross-functional identification and lifecycle management of CQAs, specifications, and control strategies.

• Establish and oversee commercial QC operations, including governance of external GMP testing laboratories and service providers.

• Provide executive oversight of deviations, investigations, OOS/OOT events, and CAPAs related to analytical and QC activities.

• Serve as a senior analytical subject-matter expert in interactions with FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM) and other global animal health regulatory agencies, including regulatory submissions, responses, and inspections.

• Select, manage, and govern external analytical laboratories, CDMOs (as applicable), and other partners to ensure technical performance, compliance, and cost effectiveness.

• Build, scale, and lead a high-performing QC and analytical development organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing senior technical leaders.

• Establish operating models that balance internal capabilities with strategic outsourcing to support a growing and commercial portfolio.

• Manage resource and budget planning, aligning analytical and QC investments with pipeline priorities and long-term business objectives.

About you

• Ph.D., M.S., or B.S. in Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

• 18+ years of progressive experience in analytical development and quality control for pharmaceutical products, with deep expertise in small-molecule oral solid dosage forms.

• Demonstrated experience spanning early development, clinical programs, commercial launch, and post-approval lifecycle management.

• Proven success building and leading analytical and/or QC organizations, including hiring, mentoring, and developing senior technical leaders.

• Extensive experience with analytical method development, phase-appropriate validation, method transfer, and GMP QC operations.

• Direct experience interacting with FDA on regulatory submissions, responses, meetings, and inspections, with working knowledge of ICH guidelines.

• Track record of effective oversight of external GMP testing laboratories and analytical service providers, including governance, performance management, and quality issue resolution.

• Track record of leading the analytical and control-strategy content of NADA/NDA CMC sections through approval, including deficiency responses and pre-approval inspections

• Strategic mindset with the ability to translate scientific and regulatory complexity into clear, actionable business recommendations.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, growth-stage environment, balancing hands-on technical leadership with executive-level decision-making.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage credibly with executive leadership, regulators, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of animal health regulatory requirements, including FDA CVM and VICH guidelines.

Salary Range: $230,000 - $280,000

Loyal benefits

• Full-coverage health insurance — medical, dental and vision — for you and your dependents

• $1,000 home office equipment stipend

• $1,200/year learning budget for books, courses, etc.

• $250/month wellness budget for gym, cleaners, spa, food, etc.

• All 3-day weekends are turned into 4-day weekends 🎉

• Unlimited vacation and paid holidays

• Paw-ternity leave — adopt a dog and get a day off with your new family member 🐶

• Competitive salary

• Company equity options grant for new hires

Loyal is founded and led by a first-gen female CEO and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against applicants based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

Our values

Moonshots, derisked methodically

Bringing the first longevity drug to market is an extremely difficult technical and social pursuit. To achieve this we must take bigger bets than the field has historically made, paired with the technical rigor to de-risk them step by step. We plan on both short and extremely long timescales, and we have the conviction to see our vision through to success or failure.

Opportunity is at the intersection

We lean into combining disciplines, expertise, and perspectives not normally adjacent. We design our organization to facilitate cross-pollination and cross-collaboration. We reject silos.

Expertise without ego

Titles do not determine who has a voice. We push back on each other, ask questions instead of issuing orders, and try to prove ourselves wrong. We are emotionally attached to the outcome, not our personal hypotheses, and welcome being challenged instead of treating it as a threat.

High agency, high humility

Most of what we're doing has never been done before, so we can't rely on established precedents to guide our way. We move forward to generate clarity, build strategies resilient to the fact that we don't know what we don't know, and design small experiments where we can fail safely, without jeopardizing the bigger mission.

Lead with transparency and context

We proactively and consistently share the why behind our strategy - not just the what - because we believe sharing context enables great people to make great decisions.

Empathy and respect for all life

Our patients are not just numbers. We deeply respect the value of every life, large and small and take our ethical responsibility to the families we treat extremely seriously.

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

• In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

• PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

In a healthcare SaaS environment where reliability and security affect patient care, this role is held to a high standard. Success means consistently demonstrating the responsibilities below, combining technical depth with collaboration, communication, and sound judgment, rather than excelling in any one area alone.

Technical

Leadership & Mentorship

• Mentor automation skills

Strategy & Vision

Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years of professional QA engineering experience, including ownership of complex work end-to-end.

• Hands-on experience executing test cases and documenting defects clearly.

• Experience with test automation, API testing, and CI/CD integration.

• Experience building test frameworks from the ground up.

• Understanding of QA methodologies and quality metrics.

Why This Role

This role offers the chance to grow both your impact and your craft. You will take on progressively harder problems, work alongside strong colleagues, and see your contributions matter beyond your immediate team — because quality engineering done well is a direct contribution to safer, more reliable care.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

However, for far too long, organizations have relied on outdated technology and manual processes to handle these processes, driving up costs, slowing down decisions, and frustrating customers.

The Hyperscience Hypercell platform unlocks the value of an organization’s back office data through the automation of end-to-end processes, and transforms complex documents into LLM and RAG-ready data to power new enterprise GenAI experiences. This enables organizations to transform manual, siloed processes into a strategic advantage, resulting in a faster path to decisions, actions, and revenue; positive and engaging customer, public, and patient experiences; and dramatic increases in productivity.

Leading organizations including American Express, Charles Schwab, HM Revenue and Customs, Mars, Stryker, The United States Social Security Administration, The United States Department of Veterans Affairs, and several others use the Hypercell platform to achieve a faster path to decisions, dramatic increases in productivity, and unparalleled business impact.

Hyperscience is funded by top tier investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, Battery, FirstMark, Stripes, and Tiger Global.


ABOUT THE ROLE: 

At Hyperscience, we transform how enterprise organizations work by applying AI and automation to mission-critical document processes. Reliable, high-granularity customer data is essential to delivering value to our customers and driving informed strategic decisions across our product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

As a Senior Technical Program Manager for Data, you will serve as the operational and strategic anchor for our Data Foundations initiatives. In this role, you will combine technical program management rigor with product discovery practices, dedicating approximately 60–70% of your focus to cross-functional program execution and 30 - 40% to product scoping and customer use-case analysis. You will lead cross-team execution without direct authority, operationalize platform health assessments, and shape product telemetry into trusted insights with a clear path to building data-first capabilities directly into the Hyperscience platform.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - End-to-End Program Ownership: Lead enterprise data initiatives across product telemetry, platform health metrics, and modern analytics infrastructure from inception through broad organizational adoption and enablement sessions.

 - Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across Engineering, Product, Sales, and Customer Operations to resolve technical dependencies and drive timely delivery without direct reporting lines.

 - Product & Technical Scoping: Author detailed technical requirements, user stories, and execution roadmaps that translate complex business needs into deliverable milestones.

 - Data Architecture & Reliability: Partner with engineering teams to scale pipeline reliability, improve data event streaming, and establish clear service level agreements.

 - Governance & Standardization: Establish reliable data governance frameworks, unified data definitions, and write requirements for automated anomaly detection.

 - Delivery Operations: Implement transparent intake processes and milestone tracking, conduct team meetings and regular stakeholder updates to identify risks early and ensure predictable delivery.




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Technical Program Experience: Demonstrate 5 -8 years of technical program management experience successfully delivering complex, multi-team data programs in high-growth technology environments.

 - Hands-On Data Literacy: Write proficient SQL queries independently to explore schemas, validate datasets, and investigate anomalies without waiting on engineering support.

 - Modern Data Stack Knowledge: Apply foundational understanding of modern cloud data architectures, including tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Fivetran.

 - AI Tool Fluency: Utilize AI-assisted developer utilities, such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, to accelerate analytical workflows and technical problem-solving.

 - Stakeholder Management: Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both executive leaders and software engineers while steering cross-functional alignment.

 - Educational Foundation: Possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or equivalent practical experience.




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Product Management Exposure: Bring practical experience conducting customer discovery, authoring requirement documents, and developing multi-quarter product roadmaps.

 - Data Engineering Background: Leverage past experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or business intelligence prior to technical program management.

 - Python Proficiency: Ability to conduct exploratory analyses and lightweight automation workflows using Python.

 - Governance Expertise: Navigate regulatory compliance, data privacy standards, and enterprise data cataloging programs.

 - Industry Certifications: Hold recognized professional credentials such as PMP, PMI-ACP, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or Snowflake SnowPro.

Our core values, including "Innovation that Transforms," "Lead with Trust," and a "Win Together" ethos, guide our collaborative culture.
