jobs.title: Ръководител отдел  - Mall Veliko Tarnovo
jobs.description:
Като ръководител отдел ти ще си лидерът, който подкрепя и мотивира своя екип. Приемайки нашата приобщаваща култура, която насърчава екипна работа и предприемачески дух, ще създадеш среда, в която всеки може да се развива. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Ръководиш екипа към предоставяне на неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като гарантираш отлични оперативни и мърчандайзинг стандарти, докато с увереност представяш и продаваш нашите продукти.
• Носиш отговорност за представянето на магазина.
• Анализираш продажбите, идентифицираш възможности за подобрение, поставяш амбициозни цели и създаваш стратегии за повишаване на резултатите, печалбата и ефективното управление на наличностите.
• Организираш работния процес и графика на екипа, като гарантираш безпроблемно отваряне и затваряне на магазина.
• Избираш нови таланти, провеждаш обучения и развиваш екипа, като същевременно насърчаваш приобщаваща култура, екипна работа, професионално развитие и иновативно мислене.
• Следиш най-новите модни тенденции, предпочитанията на клиентите и динамиката на пазара, за да подсигуриш актуалност и конкурентно предимство.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.
• Промотираш активно лоялната ни програма.

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в управлението на екип в сферата на търговията.
• Умения за планиране, анализ и проследяване, използвайки различни системи и отчети.

И човек, който е…​

• Уверен и вдъхновяващ лидер, който развива екипа си и олицетворява ценностите и културата на компанията.
• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения и целеустременост в решаването на проблеми.
• Мотивиран да създаде неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като с увереност препоръчва и продава нашите продукти.
• Проявява интерес към модните тенденции, динамиката на пазара и анализира конкурентите с цел увеличаване на продажбите.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Адаптивен, аналитичен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.
• С добри познания както писмени така и говорими по английски език.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78€;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Бонусна система, формираща се от определени условия;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на пълен работен ден, намираща се в град Велико Търново.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на английски език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

* Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Lead Digital Producer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, US; Remote, CA, US
jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

As a Lead Digital Producer on Pinterest’s House of Creative team, you'll lead complex digital experiences with primary ownership of production for Pinterest’s business-facing web ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Technology, Marketing, and Operations, partnering closely with Digital Strategy, Design, and cross-functional teams to turn business and creative ambition into scalable, executable digital experiences.

The Business Site will be the primary priority, but the remit is broader than a single website. This producer will also lead production across campaign and launch experiences, event and registration platforms, newsroom and other digital touchpoints that require strong creative, technical, and operational leadership.

This is not a traditional website project-management role. We’re looking for a senior producer who combines strong digital production expertise with technical fluency, strategic judgment, and the ability to lead complex cross-functional teams through ambiguity.

What you’ll do:

• Lead end-to-end digital production from early definition through launch across websites, campaign experiences, event/registration platforms, and other digital touchpoints

• Translate digital strategy, business requirements, and creative ambition into clear production approaches, scopes, workbacks, staffing plans, budgets, technical requirements, and launch plans

• Partner closely with Digital Strategy and Site leads on roadmap execution, sequencing, feasibility, platform implications, and production tradeoffs

• Partner deeply with Design and UX to determine how creative ideas can be realized across responsive experiences, design systems, reusable components, and technical constraints

• Evaluate platforms, vendors, and implementation approaches against business, creative, technical, operational, and financial requirements; help determine when to use an existing platform, third-party solution, or custom build

• Bring working fluency across CMS environments, integrations/APIs, analytics and tracking, accessibility, localization, privacy/legal requirements, QA, SEO, and digital release processes

• Serve as the connective tissue across Strategy, Design, Engineering, Analytics, SEO, Marketing, Comms, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners, creating clear ownership, milestones, dependencies, decisions, and handoffs

• Anticipate technical and operational risk, surface tradeoffs early, and ensure changes in scope, timing, requirements, or platform capability lead to explicit decisions rather than downstream teams silently absorbing the impact

• Build strong production rhythms and repeatable systems that improve visibility, accountability, speed, and scalability across the digital portfolio

• Manage and evaluate external digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and specialist vendors

• Use AI thoughtfully to accelerate appropriate digital-production workflows such as research, requirements synthesis, planning, documentation, QA support, and repetitive tasks while maintaining critical judgment, accuracy, privacy, and ownership of final outcomes

What we’re looking for:

• A minimum of 7 years of experience in digital production, web production, creative technology production, or a closely related discipline across agency and/or in-house teams

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as marketing, communications, digital media or a related field, or equivalent experience

• Demonstrated experience leading complex digital experiences end to end, including large websites, platform implementations, campaign experiences, event/registration experiences, or comparable digital products

• Strong technical fluency and the ability to evaluate platforms, vendors, integrations, CMS approaches, implementation complexity, and technical risk without needing to be the engineer

• Proven ability to lead highly cross-functional programs across Strategy, Design/UX, Engineering, Marketing, Analytics, SEO, Legal/Privacy, Localization, and external partners

• Strong strategic judgment and the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear production options, recommendations, and tradeoffs

• Excellent communication and leadership presence, including the ability to influence without authority and make complex technical or operational issues understandable to senior stakeholders

• Experience in using AI to improve the speed and quality of research, planning, documentation or other core work

• Strong operational discipline across scoping, resourcing, budgets, schedules, dependencies, QA, launch readiness, and risk management

• Experience evaluating and managing digital agencies, development partners, platforms, and vendors

• Comfortable operating autonomously across multiple workstreams and serving as a trusted digital-production partner to senior Creative, Marketing, and Digital Strategy leaders

Relocation Statement:

• This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times every 6-months and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,400 firms in nearly 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. US: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without requiring current or future visa sponsorship (for example, employment-based visas such as H-1B, F-1/OPT, or similar), and must be authorized to begin work in the U.S. on their first day of employment.

The Role

Addepar holds an extensive financial dataset, and the Research Engineering team works with financial researchers to turn it into insight. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, build, and optimize our next-generation Research Platform. The work spans big data in Databricks, web applications, and everything in between.

We’re a small, growing team that values collaboration and learning. You’ll work on enterprise risk calculation engines and private fund analytics and benchmarking tools. These tools handle large data volumes and complex asset classes. Institutional investors use them to measure, model, and manage risk across billions of dollars in global portfolios.

As our global footprint grows, we want a senior engineer to lead key architectural work, mentor teammates, and help build resilient, high-throughput systems. If you like owning technical problems, keep learning, and write clear, maintainable code that supports our expansion, we’d love to hear from you.

• Work across the stack, including Python, Databricks, Java, and web technologies

• Take projects through the full software lifecycle: design, architecture, prototyping, development, release, iteration, and monitoring

• Build new systems and improve existing ones, from small fixes to large projects

• Partner with researchers and product managers to shape the platform’s direction

• Share knowledge through design reviews, code reviews, and mentoring

Who You Are-Required

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

• Strong experience with Python or Java

• Experience designing and operating production systems

• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical collaborators

Helpful, but not required

• Experience with Databricks, Spark, or other large-scale data processing

• Experience with web application development

• Familiarity with financial data, risk analytics, or investment concepts

Addepar takes a market-based approach to pay. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Additionally, these ranges reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

Base Salary Range

$134,000—$209,000 USD

Our Values

• Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.

• Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.

• Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.

• Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.

• Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.description:
A career that’s the whole package!

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

Location: Hybrid - Houston, TX or Boston, MA

Reports to: Manager, Product Marketing

A quick snapshot…

As the Senior Product Marketing Manager for Conga’s Document Automation pillar, you lead and own the full go‑to‑market (GTM) strategy, positioning, and cross‑functional orchestration for Conga Composer, Conga Sign, and the broader Document Automation portfolio. You’ll shape the vision, messaging, and growth strategy for one of Conga’s largest product pillars, ensuring consistent market differentiation, scalable enablement, and strategic alignment across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Partners, and Marketing.

Why it’s a big deal…

Document Automation is central to Conga’s vision and a core driver of customer acquisition and expansion. Your strategic leadership will:

• Define and evolve our pillar‑level value proposition.

• Drive multi‑product adoption, competitive positioning, and pipeline contribution.

• Influence product direction through deep market, customer, and competitive insight.

• Ensure Conga wins- not just on features, but on a unified, compelling story that resonates with business and IT decision makers.

Product Marketing sits at the center of GTM alignment. You will orchestrate launches, craft strategic messaging, shape sales enablement, and act as the connective tissue between Product, the field, and the market. This role is essential in ensuring that Conga’s Document Automation products maintain and expand their leadership position in a rapidly evolving category.

Positioning, Messaging & Storytelling
You will own and evolve the Document Automation pillar narrative, ensuring it remains compelling, differentiated, and aligned with Conga’s broader platform message. You will develop persona‑based messaging that supports use cases, competitive dynamics, and customer decision journeys.

Go-to-Market Leadership
You will lead the pillar‑level GTM strategy for launches, enhancements, and major initiatives. You own launch frameworks, GTM briefs, and cross‑functional readiness plans, ensuring every team is equipped and aligned. You will use customer and market evidence to influence product direction and prioritization.

Sales Enablement
You will create and maintain the core suite of sales enablement resources, including playbooks, pitch decks, competitive battlecards, and demo narratives, and deliver ongoing training to ensure field teams can confidently position the Document Automation portfolio.

Customer & Market Insights
You will gather insights through customer interviews, win/loss analysis, ROI research, and competitive monitoring. You will translate these insights into recommendations that inform product roadmap, GTM strategy, and messaging decisions.

Content & Campaign Partnership
You will collaborate with Demand Gen, Content, and Brand teams to create high‑impact materials such as case studies, solution briefs, videos, web content, and thought leadership assets. You ensure all campaign activity reflects accurate messaging, product value, and use‑case alignment.

Cross-Functional Alignment
You will ensure that every GTM‑related team, from Product to Sales to RevOps, has clarity on positioning, use cases, segments, and strategic direction. You will serve as the single‑threaded owner responsible for ensuring alignment and consistency across the entire Document Automation pillar.

Are you the person we’re looking for?

Related experience.
You bring more than five years of B2B SaaS product marketing experience, ideally within document automation, document generation, eSignature, workflow automation, RLM, CLM, CPQ, or the Salesforce ecosystem. You have a strong history of owning end‑to‑end GTM responsibilities, including product launches, messaging frameworks, sales enablement strategy, and market insight development. You are experienced in partnering directly with product management and revenue leadership at a strategic level.

Strategic owner & product storyteller.
You develop pillar‑level narratives, articulate category differentiation, and influence roadmap visibility. You excel at translating complex capabilities into crisp, compelling value propositions that resonate with multiple personas- from admins to CIOs.

Natural collaborator.
You’re a relationship‑builder who partners closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Partner teams to ensure GTM alignment. You influence without authority and lead with clarity.

Clear, deliberate, and collaborative communicator.
You are clear and concise when you speak and write -- and even creative in terms of ensuring your messages are received and understood. You develop and communicate a deep understanding of market needs, pain points, use cases and business processes, including buyer personas, customer needs and technology ecosystems, complete with positioning and messaging, and product proof points.

Innovative and Proactive Planning.
You continually explore new GTM approaches, experiment with emerging tactics, and bring data‑driven insights to refine campaigns, messaging effectiveness, and enablement materials.

Product Expertise.
Deeply understand your products’ capabilities and differentiators as well as relevant market trends and competitive landscape, to develop easily understood value propositions for different stakeholders in the buying process to enable the Sales organization to effectively deliver Conga’s Document Automation value proposition.

Here’s what will give you an edge…

Resourceful & Collaborative.
You approach challenges with curiosity and initiative, leveraging colleagues, your network, and available resources to solve problems and drive progress. You share insights and apply knowledge across the business wherever it supports success.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
You consistently produce high‑quality, compelling content and messaging designed for senior business and technical decision makers. You communicate with clarity, impact, and confidence.

Work experience.
Your work reflects strong analytical thinking, creativity, and executional discipline. You bring exceptional project management and organizational skills, enabling you to lead cross‑functional initiatives that land on message, on time, and on budget.

Quality oriented.
You maintain strong processes that minimize errors and ensure accuracy. When mistakes occur, you take accountability, correct them quickly, and implement improvements that strengthen future execution. It’s your transparency, authenticity and humility is what sets you apart from the rest.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
You thrive in collaborative discussions and are comfortable initiating them. You read and adapt to different communication styles and actively listen to build connection and collect accurate information that supports effective problem‑solving.

Innovative Thinking.
You stay adaptable in a rapidly evolving market. You confidently leverage AI tools to increase efficiency and quality in your work, and you share best practices to help colleagues maximize value from emerging technologies.

Industry expertise.
Experience with Document Automation, document generation, eSignature, process workflows, or revenue lifecycle management is helpful but not required. What matters most is your ability to quickly master complex enterprise ecosystems and connect technical capabilities to customer outcomes.

In the spirit of the Conga Edge, we strive to design easy-to-understand compensation programs that are fair and free from any type of discrimination.  In keeping with this approach, we are committed to delivering competitive compensation and benefits packages to our employees worldwide and communicating transparently about the structure of our compensation programs.

Don’t meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. jobs.title: Logistics Technician
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Execute day-to-day receiving and shipping operations: verify quantities, inspect for damage, and update tracking systems in real time.

 - Tag, label, and log assets accurately into asset management systems from the moment they arrive on site.

 - Pull and stage parts for technicians and engineers fast — no one waits on you for a part.

 - Support cycle counts and physical inventory audits to maintain 99%+ accuracy, and flag shortages before they block deployment or break-fix work.

 - Keep the warehouse and staging areas organized, safe, and ready for rapid deployment, break-fix, and project material turns.

 - Assist with RMA processing, warranty claims, and vendor returns under the direction of the Logistics Lead.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

jobs.title: Principal Financial/Sales Commissions Analyst
jobs.description:
Who we are

At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go-to-market acceleration has driven industry-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years.

What we do

The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and ~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride!

Role overview

The CarGurus Sales Commissions team is seeking an experienced Principal Financial / Sales Commissions Analyst with exceptional analytical, financial modeling, and communication skills. Reporting to the Director of Sales Incentives, this role will translate complex financial and sales performance data into actionable insights and recommendations that inform sales compensation strategy and business decisions.

As a key partner to senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Go-to-Market (GTM), you will lead financial modeling, evaluate incentive plan effectiveness, and present findings and recommendations to executive leadership. Success requires strong business judgment, the ability to structure ambiguous problems, and confidence engaging senior stakeholders on complex decisions and tradeoffs.

You will also lead commission plan modeling and the quarterly quota-setting process, while helping strengthen the systems, processes, and controls that support accurate and predictable commission payments.

What You’ll Do

• Lead financial analysis and modeling to evaluate incentive plan designs, quota scenarios, and GTM changes, assessing their impact on sales performance, compensation expense, and business objectives.

• Translate complex analysis into clear executive insights, developing presentations and recommendations that explain key findings, assumptions, risks, and tradeoffs.

• Partner closely with senior leaders across Sales, Finance, GTM, and other functions to understand business needs, evaluate alternatives, and build alignment on compensation and quota decisions.

• Analyze attainment, payout trends, and plan effectiveness to identify performance drivers, emerging risks, and opportunities to improve incentive design.

• Lead the quarterly quota-setting process, coordinating inputs, validating assumptions, modeling allocations, and driving timely execution across stakeholders.

• Develop and maintain scalable financial models and reporting that support business planning, forecasting, and ongoing performance evaluation.

• Provide technical leadership for CaptivateIQ, including plan configuration, data integration, troubleshooting, and optimization in partnership with the commission team.

• Partner with the commission team to validate calculations, investigate complex payout issues, and support timely, accurate commission payments.

• Improve and document repeatable processes, strengthen SOX controls, and maintain audit-ready support for commission calculations and plan changes.

• Lead special projects and ad hoc analyses, managing competing priorities and communicating progress, findings, and decisions to stakeholders.

What You’ll Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, sales compensation, sales operations, or a related function, with increasing ownership of complex analysis and business recommendations.

• Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience building scenario models, validating assumptions, and evaluating financial and operational impacts.

• Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, with the ability to build accurate, scalable, and clearly documented models.

• Excellent written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex or ambiguous information into concise narratives and actionable recommendations for executive audiences.

• 2 years of experience working directly with executive stakeholders, presenting findings, discussing tradeoffs, and influencing decisions preferred.

• Strong business acumen and structured problem-solving skills, including the judgment to challenge assumptions constructively and connect detailed analysis to broader business priorities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, build effective relationships, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries.

• Experience with sales compensation structures, quota setting, and commission processes.

• Experience with CaptivateIQ or a comparable commission platform and familiarity with Salesforce; hands-on configuration and troubleshooting experience is preferred.

• Strong attention to detail, ownership, and project management skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• SQL and Python are a plus, not required.

The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles.

Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Position Pay Range

$115,000—$145,000 USD

Working at CarGurus

We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best-in-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work-life balance and individual well-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives.

CarGurus may require in-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate.

We welcome all

CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That’s why we hope you’ll apply even if you don’t check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Partner Integrations
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

The Senior Software Engineer on the Partner Integrations team plays a key technical role in how NodeZero connects to the security ecosystem. Our integrations with CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Splunk, ServiceNow, and dozens of other platforms are how customers turn NodeZero findings into action — they're not an afterthought, they're a core part of the product. You will design, build, and maintain integration architecture, contribute to reliability and observability standards, and work on key integration surfaces across the platform.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role. You will write production code, participate in architecture design, collaborate with peer engineers, and help solve complex integration challenges alongside team leadership. The team is building a portfolio of integrations on a shared framework — your job is to build on and enhance that framework to ensure every integration is reliable, maintainable, and seamless for our customers. This role reports to the Partner Integrations Engineering Manager.

Responsibilities

 - Design, build, test, and maintain integrations between NodeZero and partner platforms, including security, SIEM, SOAR, and ITSM tools.

 - Own assigned integrations end to end—from understanding partner APIs and requirements through implementation, launch, and production support.

 - Implement reliable integration patterns for authentication, event delivery, retries, idempotency, pagination, rate limits, schema mapping, and partial failures.

 - Contribute improvements to the shared integration framework, testing practices, documentation, and observability.

 - Monitor and troubleshoot integrations in production; investigate issues, identify root causes, and deliver fixes that prevent recurrence.

 - Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and partner technical teams to clarify requirements, resolve API questions, and communicate risks and progress.

 - Participate in design and code reviews, and help teammates improve through knowledge sharing and constructive feedback.

 

What You'll Bring

 - Several years of professional software engineering experience, including building and supporting production APIs, integrations, or backend services.

 - Proficiency in Go or Python and experience delivering maintainable, well-tested production code.

 - Practical understanding of API integration patterns, such as OAuth 2.0 or API keys, webhooks, pagination, rate limiting, retries, idempotency, and schema evolution.

 - Experience handling distributed-systems failure modes, including duplicate or delayed events, partial failures, and partner API changes.

 - Experience using logs, metrics, alerts, and dashboards to understand and troubleshoot production systems.

 - Comfort working in cloud-native or containerized environments, such as AWS and Kubernetes.

 - Strong collaboration skills: can work through ambiguity with partners and internal teams, explain technical tradeoffs, and follow through on commitments.

 - Interest in improving shared systems and helping other engineers succeed, while remaining hands-on.

 
 

Nice to Haves

 - Hands-on experience with any of Horizon3's integration partners: CrowdStrike Falcon, SentinelOne, Splunk, ServiceNow, Jira, or similar enterprise security and ITSM platforms

 - Background in the cybersecurity ecosystem — understanding how SOC teams, MSSPs, and security engineers actually use the tools NodeZero integrates with

 - Experience designing field-mapping schemas for cross-platform data translation

 - Familiarity with integration certification processes (vendor marketplace programs, partner API agreements)

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $199,000 - $235,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate’s location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. 



Application Note

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE)
jobs.description:
Be Challenged and Make a Difference 
 
In a world of technology, people make the difference. We believe if we invest in great people, then great things will happen. At AnaVation, we provide unmatched value to our customers and employees through innovative solutions and an engaging culture. 


Description of Task to be Performed: 
AnaVation is seeking a highly motivated Information Systems Security Engineer(ISSE) to support a high-visible contract and will be responsible for delivering cybersecurity engineering, secure software development, DevSecOps integration, and Risk Management Framework (RMF) implementation across Department of Defense. The ISSE will serve as an embedded cybersecurity engineer working alongside Government engineers, Cyber Operations Teams (COT), Cyber Penetration Teams (CPT), software developers, cloud engineers, and DevSecOps personnel to engineer, implement, automate, and continuously improve cybersecurity controls supporting mission applications and cloud services. This position supports secure capability delivery across multiple value streams and classification levels while enabling Continuous Authority to Operate (cATO), Zero Trust, and cloud-native cybersecurity initiatives.
Position Responsibilities:  The Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) provides cybersecurity engineering expertise throughout the system development lifecycle by designing, implementing, testing, and sustaining security controls that enable secure software delivery within agile and DevSecOps environments.
Responsibilities include:
Integrate cybersecurity requirements into cloud-native applications, Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized workloads throughout the software development lifecycle.
Engineer and implement security controls supporting Risk Management Framework (RMF) authorization, Continuous Authority to Operate (cATO), and continuous monitoring objectives.
Identify, assess, and remediate cybersecurity vulnerabilities through vulnerability management, security engineering, and technical risk mitigation activities.
Design and implement Zero Trust security architectures, container hardening, and cloud security best practices across mission environments.
Collaborate daily with Government leadership, Cyber Operations Teams (COT), Cyber Penetration Teams (CPT), software developers, cloud engineers, and cybersecurity assessors to integrate security into Agile and DevSecOps workflows. 
Support cybersecurity assessments, penetration testing, security control validation, and remediation of assessment findings.
Implement and maintain Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), security baselines, and secure configuration standards across development, testing, staging, production, and classified environments.
Evaluate cybersecurity risks and develop technical security solutions that balance mission requirements with enterprise security objectives.
Implement cybersecurity automation, improving engineering efficiencies, and strengthening the overall security posture. 
Enable the delivery of resilient, mission-ready software capabilities that support secure operations and accelerate capability delivery to the warfighter.
Serve as the cybersecurity lead supporting all contract value streams.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is looking for an Asset Improvement Lead to help us enhance and renovate our real estate portfolio of offices and factories. In this role, you will be responsible for supporting the business lines with continued facility projects that allow Anduril to continue to scale. You will need to be a self starter that drives clarity and a high level of execution. This will require detail, organization and planning to move quickly with accuracy. If you are someone who has relentless commitment to deliver then this role is for you. This opportunity for an Asset Improvement Manager will help us enhance and renovate our real estate portfolio of offices and factories focusing on optimizing and improving existing spaces.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• External Project Management and Coordination: Plan, coordinate and oversee small-scale construction projects. Maintain strong relationships with contractors, consultants, vendors, and regulatory agencies. Collaborate closely with contractors and vendors to ensure alignment of construction activities with asset improvement objectives.

• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for all asset improvement projects. Advise in all phases of any given small-scale project: programming, design, pre-construction, closeout, and operations. Communicate project progress, challenges, and solutions to key internal stakeholders. Collaborate functionally with departments like Security, Network Engineering, Facilities Management, Marketing, Kitchen Operations, Manufacturing, EHS, Legal, and many others.

• Budget and Financial Oversight: Develop and manage budgets for asset improvement projects. Create and maintain budget trackers. Prepare and present financial reports to senior executives. Generate accurate cost estimates at all stages of a project lifecycle.

• Set Up Projects for Success: Achieve (as much as possible) early end-user alignment on scope and requirements to minimize change orders and scheduling delays. Workshop requirements with end users including providing cost-effective alternatives where needed.

• Help Implement Consistent Design and Equipment Standards: Create templates and processes to better manage the large volume of small projects. Catalogue building and line-specific equipment (where applicable), including infrastructure requirements like structural support, power, ventilation, temperature, and others.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive experience in Construction Management or Facilities Management

• Extreme orderliness when it comes to document control

• Excellent project management skills, with a proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget

• Ability to think creatively and strategically about space utilization

• Effective communication and interpersonal skills

US Salary Range

$142,000—$188,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Sr. Lead, Canada
jobs.description:
Canada is one of Wise's fastest-growing markets and a key strategic priority in North America. Canadians increasingly use Wise as a day-to-day account – moving money internationally, spending abroad, and paying for groceries and subscriptions – and we're looking for someone to lead the next phase of that growth.

You'll own the growth of Wise in Canada, accountable for new customer acquisition and contribution margin. You'll define the Canadian GTM – messaging, positioning, channel mix, and budget allocation – and work in close collaboration with channel leads based in London on campaign execution and optimization, and with the Regional Growth and Product teams on new features and promotions. You'll also be the voice of the Canadian customer, feeding insights back to the Regional Product team to shape the roadmap.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Execution

• Define the go-to-market strategy for Wise in Canada, including messaging, positioning, channel mix, and budget allocation.
• Own new customer acquisition and contribution margin growth for the Canadian market.
• Build and maintain a deep understanding of the Canadian customer and competitive landscape.

Cross-Functional Execution

• Work closely with channel leads based in London on campaign execution and optimization across the funnel.
• Partner with Regional Growth and Product teams on new features and promotions that support Canadian growth.
• Represent the interests of Canadian customers, capturing and feeding insights back to the Regional Product team for product improvements.

Channel Oversight:

• Review, challenge, and add value to channel leads' plans and performance, bringing enough depth in acquisition channels to be a credible second opinion, not just a stakeholder.

Product & Customer Expertise

• Become an expert in selling the product – understand the customer, their objections, and what actually converts.
• Bring that expertise back into planning, positioning, and channel strategy.

• You're data-driven. You understand unit economics, payback period, and opportunity sizing, and you use them to make budget and channel decisions.
• You have experience running geo tests, A/B tests, and other incrementality experiments, partnering with Marketing Analytics and Marketing Science teams on test design, and using opportunity sizing to prioritize where to invest.
• You have experience owning a marketing budget and being accountable for its return.
• You're an influential leader who can work cross-functionally across regional and global teams, without direct authority over every lever.
• You communicate clearly and persuasively, with both regional and global stakeholders.
• You're entrepreneurial and self-directed, comfortable operating in a matrix organization with ambiguity and competing priorities.
• You have previous experience working alongside Product.
• You have deep enough experience across acquisition channels to review, challenge, and improve the work of channel specialists, even without owning execution yourself.

Nice to have

• Experience marketing in Canada or another market with strong newcomer/immigrant customer segments.
• Experience in FinTech or another regulated industry.
• French-language business proficiency.

• Workplace Model: This role is in Austin, Texas, US and is a hybrid role requiring office presence (at least 3 days); it is not a fully remote position. During your first 3 months in the role, you will be expected to be 100% in the office.

jobs.title: Build Supervisor (Starship)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BUILD SUPERVISOR (STARSHIP)

The Build Supervisor is responsible for leading a team of fabricators, welders, and technicians building the primary and secondary structures for the Starship and Super Heavy vehicles. The Build Supervisor is the most influential person on-site to drive progress on an hour-by-hour and day-by-day basis. The Supervisor of the team will take technical direction from the engineering team and turn it into reality by building, retaining, and managing their team effectively; distributing labor resources, prioritizing certain aspects of the build, and setting headcount requirements where necessary. The Supervisor is also a key enabler to a productive, fun, and hard-working culture. For this role specifically, it is highly important that the Supervisor is an inspiring leader, oftentimes working side by side with their build team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Supervise shop floor activity, including daily schedules and workflow

• Lead and manage a staff of ~30 technicians including all performance management related tasks

• Review work instructions and make change recommendations when needed

• Assess and vet appropriate skillsets as needed

• Identify training needs and develop training programs

• Provide required data and reporting to support departmental metrics and improvement objectives

• Monitor labor hours and overtime, and implement improvement plans and time management with staff

• Accomplish production results by communicating job expectations; planning, monitoring, appraising job results

• Effectively organize, assign and track work/deliverables for the team, ensuring seamless progression through multi-shift work schedules

• Initiate and foster a spirit of cooperation within and between departments

• Ensure product quality and conformance to specifications

• Maintain tooling and consumable supply inventory

• Improve area safety and efficiency through regular auditing and continuous improvement

• Continuously improve process and manpower efficiency, utilization and productivity

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of experience in final assembly production: aviation, aerospace, mechanical systems

• 2+ years of experience in leading a team or a project

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• A&P license

• Experience applying lean manufacturing principles and efficiency methods

• 8+ years of experience in final assembly and production in a fast paced manufacturing environment

• Experience bringing teams and processes from development to production highly desirable

• Familiarity with design for manufacturability, kaizen, lean manufacturing, six sigma, and failure mode effects analysis

• Ability to effectively communicate (verbal and written) with Engineering and Production

• Able to adapt to constant changing work assignments and fast paced work environment

• Excellent concentration and attention to detail with outstanding work efficiency and accuracy

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends, which varies depending on site operational needs; flexibility required

• Must be available to work 1st shift (6:00am - 6:00pm) or 2nd shift (6:00pm - 6:00am)

• Flight hardware is typically built in tight quarters and physical dexterity is required

• Work performed in an environment with exposure to fumes, odors, and noise

• Stand: Up to 10 hours per day

• Sit: Up to 1 hour

• Push/Pull: Up to 75lbs. (unassisted) 30 minutes to 1 hour per day

• Overhead reach: Up to 6 hours per day

• Walk: Up to 1 hour per day

• Lift/Carry: Up to 50lbs. (unassisted) 30 minutes to 1 hour per day

• Climb (ladder/stairs): Up to 6 hours per day

• Kneel/Crouch: Up to 6 hours per day

• Upper body twist: Up to 6 hours per day

• Ability to work in temperatures over 80 degrees 6 hours or greater per day

• Candidate must be capable of safely working at heights (up to 500ft), in confined spaces, using an air purifying respirator, operating heavy equipment and machinery, and performing the physical requirements of the job listed in the job description. Candidate may be required to complete a pre-employment questionnaire and/or physical to confirm these capabilities, which may include a medical history review

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Facility Environmental Health & Safety Manager
jobs.description:
Facility Environmental Health & Safety Manager

Triumvirate Environmental, one of North America’s largest environmental services firms, is seeking an experienced Facility EH&S Manager to support its recycling and manufacturing facility in Jeannette, Pennsylvania. This position supports safe, compliant operations across regulated medical waste receiving and processing, recovered material handling, and polymer lumber manufacturing.

The successful candidate will work closely with facility leadership, Production, Maintenance, Engineering, and Corporate Compliance to reduce risk, maintain regulatory compliance, and promote a positive learning safety culture rooted in continuous improvement. This role requires regular presence on the production floor, engagement with employees across operating shifts, and a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can translate EHS requirements into practical operating procedures.

Triumvirate Environmental serves leading organizations in higher education, life sciences, healthcare, and advanced manufacturing, providing diverse services and expertise to meet their compliance needs. We take pride in a culture that fosters learning, growth, creativity, and a deep commitment to excellence. We strive to WOW both our employees and our customers.

This position reports to the Northeast Regional EHST Manager and works closely with Jeannette facility leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partner with facility leadership, Production, Maintenance, and Engineering to identify and prioritize EHS risks, develop targeted risk reduction plans, and integrate safe work practices into daily facility and manufacturing activities.

• Develop, implement, and maintain facility EHS programs and procedures supporting regulated medical waste receiving, storage, treatment and processing, recovered material handling, and polymer lumber manufacturing.

• Lead task and equipment risk assessments and job hazard analyses for routine and nonroutine activities, including startup, shutdown, cleaning, jam clearing, maintenance, and production changeovers. Prioritize engineering controls and verify the effectiveness of safeguards.

• Coordinate machine safety and hazardous energy control programs with Maintenance and Engineering, including machine guarding, interlocks, equipment-specific lockout/tagout procedures, training, and periodic inspections.

• Support compliant waste acceptance and handling practices, including incoming material inspections, segregation, storage controls, management of rejected or nonconforming waste, and required tracking documentation.

• Partner with Operations and Corporate Compliance to verify required treatment and processing controls, monitoring, validation, and records. Ensure process deviations are escalated and affected materials are managed according to approved procedures before advancing to downstream production.

• Maintain a facility compliance calendar and inspection-ready records for applicable waste processing, air, wastewater, stormwater, and other environmental requirements. Coordinate permit renewals, monitoring, reporting, and regulatory inspections with Corporate Compliance and designated facility personnel.

• Conduct regular facility inspections and coordinate EHS audits across operating shifts, covering production equipment, waste storage, maintenance activities, housekeeping, docks, and pedestrian and powered industrial truck interactions.

• Coordinate industrial hygiene assessments and exposure evaluations addressing biological hazards, sharps, noise, heat, dust, fumes, and chemicals, as applicable. Work with qualified resources to implement controls and support PPE, respiratory protection, hearing conservation, and medical surveillance programs.

• Integrate EHS review into new equipment installations, process modifications, feedstock changes, production increases, and facility layout changes. Coordinate hazard assessments, permit applicability reviews, procedure updates, and verification of safeguards before startup.

• Support contractor and maintenance safety through orientation, work coordination, and verification of applicable controls for hazardous energy, hot work, confined spaces, electrical hazards, and work at height.

• Lead incident, near-miss, and exposure investigations using Human and Organizational Performance principles to identify contributing system conditions. Track corrective and preventive actions through timely completion and effectiveness verification.

• Develop and conduct role-specific EHS training for production, maintenance, receiving, shipping, supervisory, and temporary personnel. Collaborate with the Training Department to maintain accurate records and verify employee understanding and competency.

• Maintain facility emergency preparedness and response plans and coordinate training and drills for credible scenarios, including fires, spills, biological exposures, treatment failures, utility interruptions, and severe weather.

• Facilitate facility safety meetings, employee observations, and practical coaching to strengthen employee participation and identify opportunities for improvement. Maintain EHS data systems, including incident reporting and injury tracking, and communicate performance trends and priorities to facility leadership.

• Coordinate EHS controls for receiving, shipping, docks, yard traffic, and onsite material movement. Work with designated transportation personnel on shipment-related compliance issues affecting facility operations.

• Support medical surveillance programs and assist with the enforcement of the drug and alcohol policy.

Basic Requirements:

• 5–7+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor’s degree in environmental health and safety, occupational safety, environmental science, engineering, or a related field.

• Working knowledge of OSHA general industry standards and applicable federal and Pennsylvania environmental requirements.

• Experience supporting environmental compliance programs, inspections, recordkeeping, and regulatory reporting.

• Experience developing and conducting employee training.

• Ability to investigate incidents, analyze contributing factors, and coordinate effective corrective actions.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, including the ability to work effectively with production employees, maintenance personnel, supervisors, and facility leadership.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow actions through completion.

jobs.title: Director, Post Production Operations & Support
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The New York Times is continuing to expand its video journalism, identifying compelling video and audio stories across the depth and breadth of our report. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on-camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, pioneering Visual Investigations, and Shows. We are looking for a Director of Post Production Operations and Support to oversee the video post-production workflows, systems, and technical support that enable reliable newsroom video and show production at scale. This role sits within the newsroom's Media Operations team, works across all field and studio production, and manages a team of post production and technical specialists charged with developing, implementing, and supporting best-in-class workflows for our video journalism.

You will report to the Head of Media Operations and partner closely with the senior leaders overseeing our video journalism, the Director of Studios, and the leaders of production management, editorial operations, and cinematography. You are a collaborative, supportive leader with excellent communication skills and a future-oriented approach.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the Post Production Operations and Support function supporting all newsroom shows and video journalism produced globally (current video operations in New York, Washington, D.C., Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, and Seoul)

• Design, implement, and continuously optimize end-to-end post-production workflows to support fast-turnaround breaking news, Shows, Reporter Video, Field production, and long-form Visual InvestigationsWorkflows including but not limited to: ingest, cloud asset management, cloud edit, captioning and graphics, and finishing/publishing

• Lead the ongoing transition to cloud and automated workflows to minimize friction for studio and remote production

• Manage, develop, and grow the global post production operations and support team, including career development, performance management, hiring and training

• Partner with the Director of Studios on production readiness and the integration of studio systems with post-production and publishing workflows

• Partner with the IT and Networking functions to manage and scale post-production infrastructure, ranging from storage to high-speed file transfer systems

• Partner with the Audio Engineering team to unify holistic Audio and Video post workflows

• Oversee current and future vendor relationships across video and multimedia software, cloud services, media asset management and related services, ensuring production teams have best-in-class tools at their disposal

• Oversee the implementation and continuous customization of our MAM, to ensure our teams have workflows that best suit their needs, and that all video assets are properly tagged, searchable, and archived

• Establish, socialize, and maintain quality control standards for color, and other disciplines central to publishing video assets

• Collaborate closely with Editorial leadership to align post-production resources with editorial priorities and initiatives

• Maintain current documentation, training and technical onboarding for producers, editors, journalists, engineers and other newsroom partners

• Establish coverage, escalation and incident-response protocols for breaking news, major events, live productions and after-hours Show support

• Track operational measures including incident response and resolution, system reliability and quality control, and stakeholder satisfaction

• Partner with Media Operations leadership on annual budgets, procurement, vendor management, lifecycle planning and resource allocation

• Source and manage freelance technical and post-production support where needed

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

• You will report to the Head of Media Operations

Basic Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in video post-production operations

• 5+ years of management experience

• Experience supporting both studio and field production

• Proven deep knowledge of production and post-production systems, media asset management, cloud workflows, networking and digital publishing workflows

• Proven ability to build and continuously improve scalable systems while supporting urgent, deadline-driven production

• Demonstrated experience managing technology budgets, vendors, procurement and equipment lifecycles

• Proven experience leading technical teams in a fast-moving newsroom, media or broadcast environment

Preferred Qualifications:

• Newsroom experience is strongly preferred

• Experience supporting shows, podcasts, episodic content or other repeatable multimedia production

• Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with a record of motivating teams, attracting and developing talent, and working effectively across the newsroom

• Excellent operational, organizational and communication skills, including the ability to manage competing deadlines and translate complex technical issues for non-technical stakeholders

• A systems-oriented problem solver who can develop scalable solutions while remaining calm under pressure

• Willingness to manage or provide after-hours, night and weekend incident or coverage support as breaking news requires

• Knowledge of The Times' digital video competitors and the video landscape

REQ-020899

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

For roles outside of the U.S., information on benefits will be provided during the interview process.

The annual base pay range for this role is between:

$170,000—$190,000 USD

Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:

We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.

If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available here.

The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email reasonable.accommodations@nytimes.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

For information about The New York Times' privacy practices for job applicants, click here.

This is done by bad actors to collect personal information and money from victims. All legitimate job opportunities from The New York Times will be accessible through The New York Times careers site.
