jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Best Equipment is a family-owned and operated environmental equipment dealership headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. We provide premium equipment sales and service in industries such as garbage and recycling, sweeping, sewer, hydro excavation, and underground operations. Serving municipalities and contractors across Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and Michigan. We pride ourselves on exceptional customer service, and our family values are at the heart of everything we do.

Summary of the Position

The goal of this position is to drive sales growth, increase market share, and deliver exceptional customer support. The primary focus will be on prospecting new business, developing existing accounts, and building long-term customer relationships within the contractor, industrial, and municipal markets throughout Central and Western Michigan.

We are seeking a self-motivated, high-performing Outside Sales Representative for a home-based, field-focused position. While the role is based remotely, it requires significant travel throughout the assigned territory to meet with customers, develop business opportunities, and provide on-site support. A background in heavy-duty or municipal equipment is preferred but not required. Comprehensive sales and product training will be provided, along with ongoing professional development throughout your career.

This position requires frequent travel within the assigned territory, including overnight stays, as well as occasional out-of-territory travel for trade shows, company meetings, and industry events.

Key Responsibilities

• Sell, train, and deliver environmental equipment to Best Equipment’s customers and prospects.
• Follow up on leads, referrals, and requests with urgency.
• Create and maintain a product matrix for all customers via Salesforce, tracking products owned, ages, and serial numbers.
• Use Salesforce CRM to manage daily activities, customer notes, quoting, and order submissions.
• Prepare and conduct product presentations and demonstrations for qualified prospects.
• Recommend, quote, prepare bids, collect purchase orders (POs), and deliver sold equipment, ensuring all delivery paperwork is completed.
• Maintain and develop strong product and industry knowledge.
• Address customer complaints and issues promptly, maintaining clear communication across departments.
• Understand and support established sales policies and procedures.
• Promote the company’s preventive maintenance (PM) programs to customers within the territory.
• Maintain required paperwork, expense reports, forecasts, and other documentation as directed by management.

Qualifications

• Required: At least 3 years of sales experience.
• Strong skills in customer, territory, and time management.
• Highly organized with the ability to identify and solve problems.
• Preferred experience in a dealership atmosphere.
• Experience selling heavy equipment to contractors and/or municipalities is a plus, but not required.
• High level of professionalism.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a strong desire to serve customers.
• Willingness to go above and beyond to assist others.
• Working knowledge of Pandadoc, Tableau, Monday.com, and Google Drive (preferred but not required).
• Proficiency in G Suite, MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Experience with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
• Ability to obtain a Class A CDL within 90 days of hire.

jobs.title: Territory Manager (IL, Western Chicago Suburbs)
jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is one of the fastest-growing startups in the healthcare industry, working tirelessly to connect people everywhere to life-saving mental health treatment. Our Outreach team members are the lifeblood of our business; they know our product, partners, and patients better than anyone. In this role, you’ll be joining a team of passionate professionals who are dedicated wholeheartedly to our mission.

You’ll build relationships with clinical partners in your local community and provide much-needed resources to thousands of people struggling with their mental health. You'll be a champion of Charlie Health and ensure that every possible patient, parent, and provider can access our programs. While this work can be challenging, we set the bar high knowing that every decision we make directly impacts our communities.

In your role, you’ll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers, with room for everyone to excel and grow in their careers. You’ll also receive competitive benefits, ensuring you have the resources to thrive both personally and professionally.

At Charlie Health, we believe in leading with our “why” and connecting with our purpose every day. Join us to find not only a career but a calling.

Responsibilities

• Develop and operationalize GTM strategy for efficient new market penetration

• Create, build, and manage relationships with referral sources across priority markets

• Go in the field 4 - 5 days/week to lead meetings with patients, parents, and providers to uncover needs, address barriers to treatment, and cement community partnerships

• Design strategies to better support and engage referral partners across different channels

• Deepen Charlie Health’s penetration across existing partnerships

• Attend and lead various educational meetings, marketing presentations, and networking events both in person and via conference call

• Synthesize and share market feedback from partners, patients, and stakeholders to inform go-forward marketing and product strategies

• Work closely with internal partners including marketing, product, client success, and legal to deliver on GTM goals

Requirements

• Must be based in Western Chicago Suburbs, IL

• Must be fluent in English

• You have 1-4 years proven sales experience - owning & overachieving KPIs is a plus

• Experience working with or selling to healthcare organizations a plus

• Ability to travel locally with reliable transportation & valid drivers license (within ~1 hour driving distance) 4-5 days/week for meetings with potential referral partners

• Ability to energize, advise & persuade senior corporate personnel

• Strong interpersonal, relationship-building and listening skills, with a natural, consultative style

• Strong project management skills, with a demonstrable ability to corral and manage details in a fast-paced, fluid environment

• Experience with Microsoft Office, Salesforce & Zoom is a plus

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Additional Information

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $75,000 and $90,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role offers an uncapped performance-based bonus. Please note, pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location, experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. #LI-HYBRID

Our Values

• Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.

• Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.

• Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Responsibilities:

• Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards.
• Provides appropriate post-phlebotomy patient care.
• Identifies need for patient medical assistance and call code as appropriate.
• Reviews/Records refrigerator temperature(s) and QC/QA records. Areas of concern are recorded through the Corrective Action Log and reported to maintenance for repair. Findings are reported to supervisor or manager.
• Use manual requisitions and labels specimens appropriately.
• Label and process specimens according to establishes protocols and policies.
• Must effectively procure blood specimens from infant, adult, geriatric, and wheelchair bound patients.
• Must demonstrate competency for age related responsibilities.
• Understands the operation and maintenance of equipment pertinent to the job.

• Prioritizes tasks and is able to multi-task.
• Performs and collects phlebotomy specimens within cost and maintains efforts of a less than 2 percent recollection or cancellation rate.
• Follows TJC National Patient Safety goals in regard to two patient identifiers and handwashing.
• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers.
• Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person or recourse to do so.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments.
• Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes and improve and grow services we provide.
• Communicates and notifies Laboratory and/or Physician of problems with specimen procurement to ensure optimal care.
• Provides follow up on test results to appropriate individuals in a professional and courteous manner.
• Continuously updated on information by reading emails and demonstrates compliance in MediaLab.
• Maintains a safe work environment, holds self-accountable for safe work practices, performs all aspects of daily work in a manner that contributes and ensures an environment of patient safety.
• Adheres to all recommendations and requirements of the Lab and Hospital Safety Committee.
• Performs all aspects of patient care in a manner that optimizes patient safety and reduces the likelihood of medical/health care errors.
• Complies with all organizational policies regarding ethical business practices.
• Performs clerical duties directly related to handling and processing of lab specimens.
• Performs clerical work; faxing, printing, filing, reviewing, and verbally releasing laboratory results.
• Initiates the meeting of responsibilities without prompting and can complete tasks independently without immediate supervision.
• Demonstrates the values of team concept on a consistent basis.
• Interacts with all team members in a professional manner and aids/assists coworkers to complete assigned tasks.
• Travel to additional sites when needed.

Required:

• High School diploma or equivalent.
• Phlebotomy certification through a nationally recognized organization or training from a phlebotomy school or medical institution or one or more years of phlebotomy experience in a healthcare setting.

Preferred:

• Experience performing phlebotomy on a broad range of patient’s types.
• Experience with processing lab specimens, transferring specimens, and handling a centrifuge.
• Familiar with medical EMR systems.

We’re looking for Auto Painters with a minimum of 5 years of professional automotive painting experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Painter, you’ll be expected to be highly skilled in painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of paint roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see other roles available to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Paint Prepper (min 6 months professional experience): prepare vehicles for cosmetic paintwork, including sanding, masking, taping, bagging, unbagging/tear down, and buffing

• Entry-Level Painter (min 1 year professional experience): prime vehicles and perform final sanding before the vehicle is painted, along with buffing, touch-up, paint mixing, and airbrush.

• Mid-Level Painter (min 3 years professional experience): match/mix paint color and use water-based paint to paint the vehicle inside our paint booths

• Experienced Painter (min 5 years professional experience): painting (base coats, tri-coats, solid, metallic, and clear coats), blending adjacent panels, and paint correcting vehicles.

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Traction Power Project Engineer
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Traction Power Project Engineer to join our dedicated team in Philadelphia, PA. This position will be directly involved with the design and analysis of DC or AC traction power systems for railways, light rail transit (LRT), or other electrified transportation networks.

Responsibilities:

• Assist senior engineers in the design and analysis of traction power distribution systems, including substations, overhead catenary systems (OCS), and third rail systems.
• Support the development of electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and equipment layouts using CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, MicroStation).
• Perform calculations related to voltage drop, current flow, and power system performance.
• Assist in the preparation of technical reports, specifications, and construction documents.
• Conduct field inspections and site visits to gather data and observe construction activities.
• Assist in the testing and commissioning of traction power equipment.
• Assist in the preparation of as-built drawings and documentation.
• Perform other duties as assigned by the supervisor.
• Collaborate with other engineering disciplines and project stakeholders
• Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and codes (e.g., NESC, IEEE).
• Maintain accurate project records and documentation.

Minimum Qualifications

• BS Degree in Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field and 4 years relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Experience with electrical power systems, circuit analysis and electrical theory.
• Experience with AC and DC power concepts.
• Experience with power system analysis software (e.g., ETAP, SKM Power Tools).
• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license or ability to obtain within two (2) years of hire.
• Ability and willingness to obtain AECOM Project Manager (PM) certification within two (2) years of hire.
• Valid US Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices. As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review.

Preferred Qualifications

• 6 years work experience in performing Traction Power projects
• Strong interest in railway or transit systems
• Knowledge of Traction Power Load Flow Simulation Software’s( e.g, Train, ETRAX, Openpowernet)
• Electrical Engineering Degree with a focus on Power Systems
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Familiarity with AutoCAD or similar drafting software is a plus
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
• Strong work ethic and attention to detail
• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new technologies
• Desire to work in a fast paced dynamic work environment

• Relocation assistance may be available for this role
• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
• For more information, please visit AECOM Transportation

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Creative Producer, Performance Creative (Remote)
jobs.description:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).

About the Role

Monks is looking to expand our creative service capabilities by hiring a full-time Creative Producer for our Performance Creative team. Reporting to a Senior Creative Producer, you will partner with our Accounts Services team and alongside clients to develop creative that drives results.

Creative Responsibilities:

• Possess an understanding of direct response media, platform best practices and creative execution for the sake of performance, along with willingness to learn the details of paid media strategy.

• Understand short-form video production processes, timelines, and how to run a project efficiently.

• Serve as the fulcrum between concept and execution, working closely in collaboration with clients and creative teams of Designers and Editor / Animators.

• Helping translate creative/client briefs into direct response design, video and animation assets for paid platforms (including but not limited to Facebook, Google, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube), both net-new and from existing client materials.

• You are a people-person and self-starter, who can speak creative in a way that bridges client vision with team collaboration throughout a timely production process.

• You kickstart new projects by reaching out to the right people at the right time and by being the right person when clients reach out to us -- responding to client briefs and co-creating pitches, treatments and proposals.

• You are timely and punctual, setting up meetings and acting alongside our in-house creatives from pitch to proposal to delivery. You’re the pacer and peacemaker and guiding oversight on creative projects, principally responsible for timely and exceptional delivery.

• Scoping and quoting projects to agency rates, as well as establishing and maintaining project schedules.

• Comfort with copywriting / script concept and development alongside teams and clients.

• Act as the quality-assurance bridge between our internal team and our clients, providing internal feedback that makes external deliveries smooth.

Creative Responsibilities:

• Partner with Editor/Animators and Designers on a variety of deliverables. As part of the team, you’ll collaborate with creative team members nationally.

• Look after the creative production process and improve the work by offering new angles, best practices and practical solutions -- ensuring projects meet and exceed our standards.

• Be keen to learn from others and push yourself to make good work into great work.

• Partner alongside Account & Channel teams in order to find opportunities to foster and grow new opportunities for the agency.

• Working across teams and time zones to develop design concepts to drive client paid media performance.

About You

The essentials:

• 2-5 years technical experience with performance creative production (preferably at a performance-focused agency)

• Portfolio is required

• Client-facing communication experience

• Exceptional organizational skills, exhibited in a fast-paced environment

• Deep familiarity with short form content and production cadences

• 4 year college degree (preferably in a related field) or equivalent work experience

Not a must, but a plus:

• Experience with Facebook/Instagram ad design

• Experience with banner ad design (IAB standards)

• Ability to generate Presentation decks (Google Slides, Powerpoint, etc.)

• B2C and B2B experience

• Previous agency experience

• UGC production experience

Additional Skills:

• Attention to detail

• Creative and can adapt to changing circumstances

• Can prioritize and work within specific time frames

• Solid project management and ability to stay organized

• Openness to team and client feedback

• Strong time management skills to be effective and efficient

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

#LI-OG1 #LI-Remote

What We Offer

Benefits

• Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance - more about our coverage here!

• Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays

• 401k with company contribution

• Paid parental leave

• Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being

• Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network

• A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!

• Authentic commitment to DEI efforts and sustainable growth. (Why Sir Martin Sorrell signed The Climate Pledge here!)

This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.

Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.

Salary Range:

$75,000—$85,000 USD

About Monks

Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.

This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: Experienced Auto Body Technician (Day Shift) - $8,000 bonus
jobs.description:
Key Details:

• Location: 15511 E 155th St, Belton, MO 64012

• Schedule & Shift: Monday through Friday from 6:00am to 3:00pm (plus overtime opportunities)

We’re looking for Autobody Technicians with a minimum of 5 years of professional automotive bodywork experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Heavy Body Technician, you’ll be expected to train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including:

• Heavy plastic welding/stapling

• Heavy metal pulling, straightening, shrinking, and stud welding

• Roof and rocker panel repair

Large area, heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)
At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of prep roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

De Beers Group is a company with a sparkling future.

We provide equality of opportunity to enable everyone to fulfil their potential. Please inform us should there be any special requirements that should be considered as part of your application.

Building Forever

Sustainability is at the heart of our decision-making – it is how we do business.   Building Forever is key to our purpose as it represents our ambitious and holistic sustainability framework and is central to our ability to deliver long-term value to our communities and partners. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Mission Success, NCR
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As a Senior Manager at Onebrief, you will serve as the senior-most leader responsible for the success, strategic direction, and growth of a portfolio of Department of War customers. You will own the customer relationship at every level of the organization, from end users to Generals, Admirals, and senior civilian leadership, positioning Onebrief as a trusted strategic partner across the Department of War.

This role extends beyond traditional customer success. You will establish strategic priorities across your accounts, develop executive-level relationships, influence organizational adoption, and translate customer needs into measurable business outcomes. You will be responsible for driving retention, expansion, and long-term growth while ensuring Onebrief delivers meaningful operational impact to its customers.

You will also provide leadership and direction to a team, establishing account priorities, allocating resources, and ensuring consistent execution across your portfolio. Success requires a combination of strategic thinking, organizational influence, military operational knowledge, and the ability to navigate complex government environments to maximize the value and adoption of Onebrief.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - Serve as the senior-most field representative for your portfolio, establishing strategic direction and building alignment across internal teams and government stakeholders to advance customer objectives and company priorities.

 - Provide strategic direction, mentorship, and oversight to a team of Partner Engagement Managers, establishing priorities, managing performance, and ensuring alignment with broader account objectives.

 - Translate customer requirements, operational challenges, and emerging needs into actionable feedback for Product and Engineering while maintaining deep technical expertise across the Onebrief platform.

 - Identify and develop strategic growth opportunities across commands, services, and organizations, translating customer relationships and product impact into expanded business opportunities.

 - Lead strategic engagement with Allies and Partners, extending Onebrief’s value proposition and identifying opportunities for international expansion.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Extensive experience operating within large-scale military or government organizations, with demonstrated ability to engage effectively with senior military leaders, General/Flag Officers, and senior civilian executives.

 - Experience leading or supporting large-scale staff planning, gained through Professional Military Education and/or military service, with a strong understanding of Department of War operational environments.

 - Demonstrated experience leading customer-facing teams, managing complex accounts, or directing strategic initiatives across multiple stakeholders and organizations.

 - Proven ability to develop and execute account growth strategies, including customer retention, contract renewals, expansion, and identifying new business opportunities. Experience working directly with contracting and budget officials on projects ranging from small UFR (or similar procurement path) based purchases to large-scale programmatic acquisitions.

 - Experience navigating major military planning exercises and understanding the protocols and requirements for software deployment on classified networks.

 - Demonstrated ability to influence organizational adoption of software or technology solutions within large, complex government environments.

 - Strong technical aptitude and ability to develop deep expertise in the Onebrief platform, engage technical subject matter experts, and troubleshoot complex cross-platform issues.

 - Experience coordinating complex customer requirements, incidents, and escalations across customer organizations and internal Product and Engineering teams.

 - Exceptional communication, executive presence, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at every level.

 - You hold a current Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI and have the ability to access DoW facilities and installations.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - You are a strategic leader. You can operate at both the executive and tactical levels, translating broad organizational objectives into actionable strategies while maintaining accountability for execution and results.

 - You understand the defense ecosystem. You have a strong understanding of Department of War organizational structures, military planning processes, command relationships, and the complexities of operating across Services and Combatant Commands.

 - You are commercially minded. You understand how customer relationships, product adoption, and operational impact translate into retention, expansion, and revenue growth.

 - You are an effective people leader. You have experience developing talent, directing teams, allocating resources, and establishing accountability across complex portfolios.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Senior Manager will:

 - Establish a comprehensive understanding of assigned accounts, including organizational structures, key stakeholders, contracts, customer requirements, and strategic priorities.

 - Develop and execute account strategies that support customer mission objectives and Onebrief’s long-term business goals.

 - Establish executive sponsorship and strengthen Onebrief’s position as a strategic partner.

 - Own retention and renewal strategies across the portfolio.

 - Develop a risk analysis framework for your accounts to proactively identify and address complex customer retention challenges.

 - Effectively allocate team resources based on account complexity, customer needs, and strategic importance.


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

The Home Loan Officer position involves the proficient execution of home lending tasks in alignment with STCU loan standards. The position focuses on originating and closing loans from external and internal sources, including conventional, government, and construction loans. The role emphasizes achieving high volume, accurate, and timely completion of residential mortgage origination functions.

Core Job / Requirements/Outcomes

• Meet mortgage loan production standards by performing high volume lending functions accurately, timely, and in alignment with STCU loan standards and procedures.
• Guide qualified borrowers through the mortgage loan origination process successfully by setting clear expectations with borrowers on timelines, loan conditions and closing dates, as well as evaluating loan application materials and making recommendations that align with STCU policies and/or secondary market guidelines.
• Identify and coordinate opportunities with other departments to maximize their expertise to fulfill corporate objectives and extend financial aid by being proficient in STCU’s products, systems, and procedures as well as developing strong relationships.

Other Essential Functions

• Maintain accurate and current knowledge of all residential loan programs, guidelines, and procedures; to include conventional, Government (FHA/VA), construction, and other STCU portfolio products.

• Take ownership of issues by acting as the member’s advocate.
• Follow through on all commitments.
• Maintain knowledge in and adhere to policies, procedures, and established processes in order to support compliance requirements for the department and the organization overall.
• Recommend policy / procedural changes and process improvements to assist in the achievement of the strategic goals of the organization.
• Contribute to and support a positive work environment to ensure an effective, high performing and cohesive team.

Qualifications

Education High school diploma or equivalent is required. Some college is preferred.

Certifications National Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS) registration under the terms of the SAFE Act of 2008 must be completed upon hire.

Job Experience Minimum of three years of lending experience in a financial services environment. Knowledge of mortgage terms, title insurance and required mortgage processing procedures required.

Software Skills Proficient knowledge of MS Office programs including Outlook, Word, Excel and Teams.

Other Skills Bilingual abilities, including the ability to read, write, and speak Spanish fluently, may be required depending on the needs of the individual role and will be noted in the specific job posting.

Physical Demands Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 10 pounds with accommodations.

Work Conditions Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high-stress, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.

Travel Demands Reliable transportation is required due to frequent travel to branches and other locations. Must possess ability to travel short and long distances to meet member and credit union expectations and build business relationships. This role involves frequent travel to worksites in Eastern Washington and Northern Idaho regions. Significant portion of time is spent in the field, interacting with members, and conducting visits.

jobs.description:

SUPPORT TECHNICIAN (STARSHIP) – TEMPORARY

Support Technicians will assist Starship and Super Heavy production operations at the SpaceX South Texas build site in Starbase, TX. jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile and our global partners are building the first and only space-based cellular broadband network to be accessible by standard smartphones. Called SpaceMobile, this ultra-powerful network is being designed to provide connectivity at 4G/5G speeds everywhere on the planet – on land, at sea and in flight.

Company Overview

AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio, designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate connectivity gaps faced by today’s billions of mobile subscribers and bring broadband access to those who remain unconnected. [1.0 JD Template 10 | Word]

Position Overview

AST SpaceMobile is seeking a Warehouse Associate to support all warehouse and logistics operations, including shipping, receiving, inventory control, order fulfillment, material handling, packaging, and inventory accuracy. This role ensures materials and products are received, stored, tracked, packaged, and shipped accurately while supporting production and operational requirements.

The Warehouse Associate utilizes handheld scanners, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), ERP systems, computers, and Microsoft Office applications to process inventory transactions, fulfill customer and production requests, and maintain accurate inventory records. Inventory primarily consists of aerospace-related components maintained in significant quantities.

Key Responsibilities

Shipping & Receiving

• Receive, inspect, unload, and verify incoming shipments against purchase orders, packing slips, and shipping documentation.

• Process, package, and prepare outbound shipments according to company and customer requirements.

• Coordinate shipments with carriers and maintain shipping and receiving schedules.

• Identify and report shortages, damaged goods, discrepancies, and incorrect shipments.

Inventory Control & Record Management

• Maintain accurate inventory records using WMS, ERP systems, handheld scanners, and computers.

• Monitor quantities, types, and values of materials, equipment, and supplies.

• Perform cycle counts and assist with physical inventory audits.

• Research and resolve inventory discrepancies.

• Maintain documentation of inventory transactions and warehouse activities.

• Monitor inventory levels and escalate shortages or concerns.

Order Fulfillment & Material Handling

• Pick, sort, stage, bag, issue, and prepare materials for shipments or internal production use.

• Accurately fulfill customer orders and internal production requests.

• Verify item numbers, lot numbers, serial numbers, quantities, and shipment details.

• Complete orders accurately and within established deadlines.

• Perform stock replenishment, bin transfers, and inventory relocations.

Packaging & Logistics

• Package products according to company standards and customer specifications.

• Label, wrap, and secure shipments to prevent transportation damage.

• Process delivery requests and track shipment status through completion.

• Generate shipping documentation and complete shipping transactions.

Warehouse Operations

• Organize and maintain warehouse storage locations and inventory areas.

• Ensure materials are properly labeled and stored.

• Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives and warehouse efficiency programs.

• Assist production and logistics teams as necessary.

Equipment Operation

• Safely operate forklifts, pallet jacks, hand trucks, lifting equipment, and packaging machinery.

• Perform routine equipment inspections and report maintenance concerns.

• Maintain forklift certification or obtain certification as required.

Safety & Compliance

• Follow all company safety policies, procedures, and warehouse regulations.

• Utilize required PPE and safe lifting practices.

• Comply with inventory control, quality assurance, and shipping procedures.

• Participate in safety meetings and required training.

• Respond appropriately during emergency situations.

Administrative Support

• Utilize Microsoft Office applications and warehouse management software.

• Complete data entry and inventory transactions.

• Perform additional duties assigned by management.

Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Valid Driver’s License required.

Experience

• 0–1 year of warehouse, shipping and receiving, inventory control, logistics, material handling, manufacturing, distribution, or related experience.

• Experience working in a fast-paced warehouse or production environment preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle and/or NetSuite.

• Forklift certification or ability to obtain certification.

• Experience in shipping, receiving, inventory control, warehousing, logistics, manufacturing, or distribution operations.

Soft Skills

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

• Commitment to quality, safety, and continuous improvement.

Technology Stack

• Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)

• Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Systems

• Oracle (Preferred)

• NetSuite (Preferred)

• Microsoft Excel

• Microsoft Word

• Microsoft Outlook

• Handheld Scanners

• Tablets and Laptops

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in a warehouse and manufacturing environment.

• Frequent standing, walking, bending, stooping, kneeling, squatting, climbing, reaching, and balancing.

• Ability to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods.

• Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 35 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Ability to operate machinery, production equipment, and material handling equipment.

• Ability to perform repetitive hand movements and computer work.

• Ability to visually inspect inventory, labels, parts, and documentation.

• Ability to communicate effectively through speaking and hearing.

• Ability to work in environments with noise, dust, airborne particles, and varying temperatures.

• Ability to work rotating shifts, weekends, and holidays as required.

• Ability to comply with all safety and PPE requirements.

Additional Information

This opportunity offers the chance to join a rapidly growing aerospace company, develop valuable logistics and inventory management skills, and build a long-term career within the space technology industry.

jobs.title: Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY & SOURCELIGHT

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion.  As a spin-out of Focused Energy, SourceLight is turning breakthrough laser-driven radiation source technology into practical solutions for some of the world's most demanding inspection and material characterization challenges. 

We are building on cutting-edge scientific innovation to develop scalable technology for industrial applications, including nuclear waste characterization, security screening, and non-destructive testing of safety-critical components.

As our technology moves from development toward industrial application, building a robust and scalable supply chain is essential to our success.




YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a Procurement & Supply Chain Manager to establish and lead this function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of procurement and supplier strategy across the company, shaping how we identify, qualify, engage, and manage suppliers while ensuring our engineering teams have the components and resources they need to deliver.

You will work closely with our Product and Engineering teams, Finance, Legal, and external partners to establish company-wide procurement standards, negotiate complex technical and commercial agreements, and build a supplier ecosystem capable of supporting our growth.

Initially operating as a senior individual contributor, you will have significant autonomy and influence over how this function develops. As SourceLight scales, you will have the opportunity to expand the team, introduce new capabilities, and evolve procurement and supply chain into a fully established organizational function.

If you enjoy building structure in a fast-moving technical environment, navigating complex supplier relationships, and creating the operational foundations that enable innovative technology to reach the market, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and lead the Procurement & Supply Chain function: Establish the strategy, processes, tools, and operating standards required to support procurement across all SourceLight product and engineering teams.

 - Develop a strategic supplier ecosystem: Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage suppliers across specialized technical categories, particularly high-value optical, laser, mechanical, electrical, and other advanced hardware components.

 - Own sourcing and commercial negotiations: Lead supplier selection, RFQs, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, lead-time agreements, and framework contracts to secure favorable terms while balancing cost, quality, technical requirements, and delivery timelines.

 - Manage complex technical agreements: Lead commercial negotiations for strategic supplier agreements and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs), partnering with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership to ensure appropriate commercial, operational, and contractual outcomes.

 - Enable engineering and product teams: Take ownership of procurement activities from request through purchase order and supplier follow-up, allowing technical teams to focus on engineering, integration, testing, and product development.

 - Establish scalable procurement processes: Implement standardized purchasing workflows, supplier documentation, approval processes, contract management practices, and procurement systems that support transparency, efficiency, and accountability.

 - Drive supply chain planning and risk management: Monitor supplier capacity, component availability, lead times, delivery performance, and potential supply disruptions. Develop mitigation strategies for critical components and proactively communicate risks to stakeholders.

 - Partner with Finance and Legal: Coordinate purchase order approvals, budget alignment, payment processes, contract reviews, and compliance requirements while maintaining clear decision-making and escalation pathways.

 - Ensure quality and compliance: Establish supplier qualification and performance standards that account for technical specifications, quality requirements, cleanroom and safety considerations, and applicable regulatory or industry requirements.

 - Build visibility and accountability: Develop reporting on procurement status, supplier performance, purchasing cycle times, cost savings, delivery risks, and sourcing priorities to support informed operational decisions.

 - Scale the function over time: Identify future capability and resourcing needs, contribute to hiring plans, and establish the processes and knowledge base required to develop and lead a growing Procurement & Supply Chain team.




WHO YOU ARE

 - You bring significant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, or technical purchasing, ideally within a complex engineering, hardware, deep-tech, industrial technology, or advanced manufacturing environment.

 - You have experience building or significantly improving procurement processes and supplier management practices, ideally within a growing organization where structure and systems are still evolving.

 - You are comfortable managing technically complex sourcing activities, working with engineers to understand requirements, and translating technical needs into effective commercial and supplier strategies.

 - You have a strong track record of negotiating supplier agreements, pricing, delivery terms, and commercial contracts, with the confidence to manage high-value and strategically important supplier relationships.

 - You understand the importance of balancing cost, quality, lead time, technical risk, and long-term supplier reliability when making sourcing decisions.

 - You have experience developing supplier qualification frameworks, evaluating supplier performance, and proactively managing supply chain risks and constraints.

 - You are highly organized and process-oriented, with the ability to establish practical, scalable workflows without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

 - You operate with a high degree of ownership and independence, bringing structure to ambiguous situations and making sound decisions while knowing when to involve stakeholders or escalate.

 - You are a strong cross-functional partner who communicates proactively, builds trust with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and can influence decisions without relying on formal authority.

 - You are comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor today while thinking strategically about the capabilities, processes, and team structure needed for tomorrow.

 - You are motivated by the opportunity to build a function, develop future team members, and grow into broader leadership responsibility as the organization scales.

 - You communicate confidently in English; German language skills are an advantage.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Auberge Collection is seeking a Security Operations Engineer to operate and improve security tools and response practices across Home Office, cloud and hotel environments. The role leads technical incident response, advances vulnerability remediation, oversees managed security provider performance, and supports security controls and audit readiness.

Based in Bethesda, this role partners with Technology, Regional IT, property teams and external providers. The MSSP provides contracted monitoring and coverage; this role owns Auberge’s internal technical escalation and response. It does not require solo, continuous 24×7 monitoring.

Key responsibilities

Security platforms and operations

• Responsible for the effectiveness and lifecycle of Auberge’s security tools—including SIEM, EDR, vulnerability management, identity, email, DLP and cloud security—directly or in partnership with third-party providers.
• Strengthen security monitoring across Home Office and hotel environments by improving data visibility, alert accuracy, system integrations, response playbooks and control coverage.
• Partner with platform owners to maintain secure configurations and current access controls, oversee privileged account management, and keep architecture and integration documentation accurate and up to date.
• Identify capability gaps and recommend practical improvements to the Director of Cybersecurity.

Incident response and vulnerabilities

• Investigate and lead technical response to phishing, malware, account compromise, unauthorized access, data exposure and other incidents.
• Coordinate containment, recovery, evidence, communications and post-incident reviews with the Director, MSSP, Regional IT, property leaders and affected teams.
• Escalate high-severity incidents promptly and support the designated incident leader.
• Prioritize vulnerabilities by risk, assign remediation, manage exceptions, validate fixes and report progress.
• Identify recurring incidents and control weaknesses, and drive corrective actions with accountable owners.

Provider oversight and hotel security

• Coordinate MSSP delivery, including alert quality, escalation paths, playbooks, service levels and improvement plans; raise coverage gaps and unresolved risks.
• Provide an escalation path for Regional IT and properties, coordinating response through established operating structures.
• Maintain practical hotel security scorecards and review material risks and corrective actions with Technology and property leaders.
• Support PCI and privacy assessments with technical evidence, control testing and remediation of assigned findings.
• Review security needs for cloud, applications, integrations, major changes and property openings; maintain procedures and technical documentation.

Automation and AI-enabled workflows

• Build security-focused scripts, integrations and workflows for alert enrichment, investigation, phishing analysis, vulnerability prioritization, case documentation and reporting.
• Apply least privilege, secure credential handling, data minimization, audit logging and human review; test accuracy, reliability and operational value.
• Keep consequential actions, including containment, access changes and external communications, within approved authorization and escalation controls.
• Partner with Enterprise Data & AI and AI Engineering when workflows require shared AI services, governed data access or production applications.

Required qualifications

• Five or more years in security operations, security engineering, incident response or a related field.
• Hands-on experience administering or improving SIEM, EDR, vulnerability, identity, cloud security or similar platforms.
• Experience investigating incidents, coordinating technical response, managing vulnerability remediation and working with managed security providers.
• Working knowledge of security controls, audit evidence, identity and access, least privilege, endpoint and cloud security, and data protection.
• Practical scripting or automation experience with APIs, workflow tools, Python, PowerShell, JavaScript or similar.
• Clear risk communication, documentation and collaboration skills across distributed technical and hotel operations teams.
• Sound judgment in evaluating AI-generated information before consequential action.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in hospitality, retail or another multi-site environment.
• Experience with security automation, SOAR, AI-enabled workflows or agentic systems.
• Familiarity with PCI DSS, privacy requirements, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK or OWASP guidance for LLMs and agentic applications.
• Experience with security dashboards, risk scorecards or executive reporting.
• CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, Security+ or equivalent practical experience.

The long-term vision of TRI’s Accelerated Materials Design and Discovery (AMDD) program is to accelerate the development of truly emissions-free mobility. Realizing this vision will require the discovery of new materials and devices for batteries, fuel cells, and more. Our aim at TRI is to merge sophisticated computational materials modeling, new experimental data, artificial intelligence, and automation to significantly accelerate materials research in this area. Our focus is on developing tools and capabilities to enable this acceleration. We collaborate closely with a dozen universities and national labs and our colleagues across global Toyota. AMDD seeks to develop and translate the newest technologies into practice, both within Toyota and the open research community, more broadly.
 
This Internship
We are looking for an intern researcher to contribute to the development of atomistic catalysis modeling that bridges the gap between current simulation (e.g. DFT) and in-situ catalysis experiments. We will develop reasoning models with embedded chemical and atomistic descriptors as well as experimental parameters and measurements. Your day-to-day may include: literature review of computational methods and model construction and validation. We welcome you to join a unique team of scientists and engineers where you will constantly learn new skills at the interface of materials science and thoughtful

jobs.title: VP of Customer Success
jobs.description:
AssetWatch serves global manufacturers by powering manufacturing uptime through the delivery of an unparalleled condition monitoring experience, with a passion to care about the assets our customers care for every day. We are a devoted and capable team that includes world-renowned engineers and distinguished business leaders united by a common goal – To build the future of predictive maintenance. As we enter the next phase of rapid growth, we are seeking people to help lead the journey.

At AssetWatch, we are committed to maximizing manufacturing uptime by delivering a proactive condition monitoring experience. Our team of experts shares a common goal: to be the world's leading condition monitoring platform, helping manufacturers eliminate unplanned downtime worldwide.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Customer Success is a senior executive leader who owns the commercial performance of AssetWatch's installed customer base, maximizing long-term customer value through world-class adoption, retention, expansion, and operational excellence. This position plays a critical role in shaping AssetWatch's post-sale strategy and market position, with direct accountability for customer outcomes, team performance, and enterprise-wide customer-centric initiatives.

The Vice President of Customer Success is expected to build a world-class Customer Success organization capable of supporting a business scaling to $200M+ ARR while maintaining industry-leading retention and customer satisfaction and is responsible to lead a team across multiple levels and regions, ensuring consistent delivery of world-class service, driving product adoption, and embedding AI-powered solutions and best practices throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Vision and Organizational Leadership

• Develop and execute customer success strategy aligned with revenue targets and product roadmap.

• Own the recurring revenue performance of the installed customer base as represented by key performance indicators with direct accountability that are appropriate for the business as it scales: NRR, GRR, churn, expansion revenue growth, NPS, and customer health scores.

• Define customer segmentation and lifecycle models that optimize value realization and maximize ROI for customers and AssetWatch.

• Lead the post-sale organization to drive product adoption, customer experience excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

• Establish measurable operating targets appropriate to the business as it evolves and scales.

• Present quarterly customer health, retention, and expansion trends to the Executive Leadership Team.

Building and Scaling High-Performing Teams

• Recruit and develop exceptional talent, establishing a culture of excellence and accountability.

• Build organizational infrastructure to support global scaling across multiple regions, with emphasis on Mexico and EU/UK operations.

• Foster a continuous learning culture.

• Hold the team accountable to performance standards while maintaining collaboration , and mutual support.

• Implement standards that raise the bar for team capabilities, methodologies, and customer outcomes.

AI Integration and Operational Innovation

• Reimagine Customer Success as an AI-enabled organization, leveraging automation, predictive intelligence and agentic workflows to materially improve customer outcomes while increasing CSM productivity and scalability:

• Lead strategic integration of AI capabilities into CS operations.

• Champion AI adoption for predictive analytics, health scoring, churn prevention, and personalized engagement.

• Evaluate and implement AI-powered CS tools including AI health platforms, ChatGPT integration, and automated insights engines.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure customer feedback informs AI roadmap and seamless platform integration.

Customer Outcomes and Growth

• Own gross and net revenue retention targets and churn reduction initiatives.

• Develop and operationalize CS lifecycle frameworks (onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal, expansion). Target Time-to-Value of 30 days or less

• Develop executive relationships with the company’s largest 30-50 enterprise/strategic customers. Personally sponsor strategic recovery plans and drive an Executive Sponsor Program.

• Lead initiatives to maximize adoption and ROI of condition monitoring solutions across customer manufacturing operations.

• Execute programs including Business Reviews, executive sponsor relationships, and customer advisory boards. Target quarterly executive reviews for 100% of top 20 accounts.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Alignment

• VP Customer Success owns renewal strategy, expansion identification, customer health, while partnering with Sales on commercial negotiations, pricing, strategic/enterprise expansions.

• Partner with Sales, Product, Marketing, Engineering, and Operations to ensure seamless handoffs and customer-centric decision-making.

• Collaborate on feature prioritization and product roadmap informed by customer feedback.

• Collaborate with Sales on renewal forecasting and expansion opportunities.

• Own monthly forecasting of renewals, churn, contraction and expansion with forecast accuracy of +/-5%.

• Partner with Marketing on retention campaigns, case studies, and reference programs.

• Own the post-implementation customer lifecycle, but also be jointly accountable with the implementation leader for achieving rapid time-to-value and a seamless transition.

Process Improvement and Operational Excellence

• Run the Customer Success group like an operating business:

• Design and optimize CS processes, playbooks, and SOPs that scale with growth.

• Lead evolution of CS technology stack and CDP to ensure data integrity, actionable insights, and seamless integration with sales, marketing, and product systems.

• Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks through continuous improvement, retrospectives, and feedback loops.

• Develop training and enablement programs. Target new CSM onboarding completion within 30 days with 80%+ competency scores.

International Expansion and Geographic Scaling

• Lead CS strategy for international expansion in Mexico and EU/UK with cultural competency and localized approaches. Scale international operations to support aggressive annual revenue growth.

• Build and manage remote, distributed teams across time zones and geographies with strong processes and communication cadences.

• Navigate diverse regulatory and contractual environments. Maintain 100% compliance with local labor and data privacy regulations.

Qualifications

• Proven experience leading Customer Success through rapid scale (approximately $75M-$200M+ ARR) including organizational redesign, systems evolution, customer segmentation, and operating model transformation.

• Experience managing a large recurring revenue base through customer lifecycle economics including CAC recovery, expansion efficiency, retention, and customer lifetime value optimization.

• Industry Knowledge: Experience in SaaS, HaaS, IoT, predictive maintenance, manufacturing, or similar B2B sectors strongly preferred. Minimum 3+ years in one of these sectors. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle, SaaS metrics, and renewal/expansion economics.

• Leadership: Proven ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing organizations at scale. Strong track record of recruiting talent, developing leaders, and creating accountability. Must have managed 60+ direct and indirect reports across multiple management layers, with demonstrated success elevating team performance.

• Strategic Execution: Ability to develop and execute strategies that drive measurable improvements in retention, NRR, NPS, and expansion revenue.

• Global Experience: Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed teams. Minimum 2+ years managing remote teams. International experience in Mexico, EU/UK highly valued.

• Technical and AI Fluency: Comfort with technology, data analytics, and AI/machine learning applications. Ability to quickly learn and champion technologies that enhance customer outcomes.

• Customer-Centric: Committed to customer success and advocacy. Proven ability to balance customer needs with business objectives using data-informed decisions.

Desired Skills and Attributes

• Executive Presence: Communicates with clarity and conviction to all stakeholder levels including C-suite. Inspires teams and drives organizational alignment around customer-centric vision.

• Data-Driven: Proficient in analyzing metrics, extracting insights, and translating data into actionable business decisions. Comfortable with dashboards and analytics platforms.

• Change Agent: Thrives in dynamic environments. Comfortable with ambiguity. Leads organizational change and actively innovates to improve processes and outcomes.

• Talent Developer: Exceptional ability to develop talent and create advancement pathways. Mentors and builds stronger organization.

• Operationally Rigorous: Establishes clear metrics, accountability structures, and continuous improvement processes.

• Manufacturing Acumen: Understanding of manufacturing operations, predictive maintenance, IoT, condition monitoring, and asset-intensive industries. Deep understanding of manufacturing personas and ability to speak fluently with manufacturing customers about business outcomes.

• Bilingual: English fluency required. Spanish or other language skills are a plus. Comfortable travelling to Mexico or other international markets.

• Collaborative: Fosters cross-functional partnerships. Skilled at influencing without direct authority and building consensus.

• Results-Oriented: Ambitious and motivated by impact. Drives accountability and delivers results while maintaining high ethical standards.

#LI-REMOTE

The base salary range for this full-time position is posted below, plus equity and benefits. Variable pay, bonuses, and other cash compensation will be discussed throughout the interview process.

The salary range was determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range applicable to your location during the hiring process.

AssetWatch Salary Range (US)

$220,000—$260,000 USD

What We Offer:
AssetWatch is a remote-first company that puts people at the center of everything we do. We want our team members to thrive - that’s why we offer a range of benefits and perks designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

• Competitive compensation package including stock options

• Flexible work schedule

• Comprehensive benefits including retirement plan match

• Opportunity to make a real impact every day

• Work with a dynamic and growing team

• Unlimited PTO

We have a distributed team that works remotely across locations in the United States and Ontario, Canada. Collaboration within core working hours is required.
