jobs.title: Data Governance & Reporting Analyst
jobs.description:
At Syngenta, trusted data and innovative analytics are essential to driving smarter business decisions and advancing our digital transformation.

We are seeking a Data Governance & Reporting Analyst to bridge business priorities with reliable data, scalable analytics solutions, and sustainable digital products. This role offers a unique opportunity to influence how data is governed, managed, and transformed into meaningful business insights across North America.

The position combines two equally important areas of responsibility: Data Governance & Data Products and Analytics Application Ownership & Delivery. Working collaboratively with business stakeholders, data owners, technology teams, and global partners, you will help establish effective governance practices, modernize reporting capabilities, and deliver analytics products that create measurable business value.

If you enjoy connecting people, processes, and technology to solve complex business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must be able to travel to our Greensboro, North Carolina, location as needed to support business operations, meetings, and other organizational priorities.

Accountabilities

Data Governance & Data Products

• Establish and support practical data governance frameworks, including ownership, stewardship, standards, controls, decision rights, and escalation processes.
• Collaborate with business data owners and stewards to define critical data elements, business terminology, data quality expectations, and acceptance criteria.
• Maintain and enhance enterprise data catalog information, including metadata, business definitions, ownership, lineage, and analytics product relationships.
• Coordinate the prioritization and resolution of data quality issues by assessing business impact, engaging accountable teams, and monitoring corrective actions.
• Define and manage reusable data products, including their purpose, target users, business outcomes, service expectations, adoption measures, and lifecycle requirements.
• Promote governed data products and sustainable analytics solutions while minimizing duplication and ensuring alignment with privacy, security, and compliance requirements.
• Integrate data governance principles into emerging AI-enabled products and enterprise digital transformation initiatives.

Analytics Application Ownership & Delivery

• Partner with business stakeholders to identify analytics needs, define business outcomes, and translate requirements into actionable user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable deliverables.
• Own and prioritize analytics product backlogs and roadmaps, balancing business value, resource capacity, dependencies, risks, and long-term sustainability.
• Guide analytics solutions throughout the product lifecycle, including discovery, design, development, implementation, adoption, continuous improvement, and retirement.
• Lead reporting modernization and rationalization efforts by promoting reusable solutions, evaluating new dashboard requests, and supporting legacy reporting transitions.
• Provide product ownership for the existing Qlik reporting environment, partnering with technical specialists to evaluate requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support transition activities.
• Coordinate cross-functional delivery teams and external partners, facilitate Agile activities, manage dependencies, and communicate project progress, risks, and decisions.
• Drive stakeholder engagement, product demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release readiness, and adoption while supporting SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise transformation initiatives.

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Business, Technology, Analytics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
• 8+ years of experience in data governance, data management, business intelligence, analytics product ownership, business analysis, or digital product delivery.
• Demonstrated experience implementing or supporting enterprise data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship, metadata management, data quality, and governance controls.
• Proven experience managing analytics products or reporting portfolios, including requirements gathering, backlog prioritization, delivery coordination, stakeholder engagement, and product lifecycle management.
• Strong understanding of analytics product management, business requirements analysis, Agile delivery methodologies, and user acceptance processes.
• Ability to interpret data flows, models, and technical dependencies to support informed business and governance decisions without requiring hands-on data engineering expertise.
• Excellent communication, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across business and technical teams. Fluency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with enterprise reporting and visualization platforms, particularly Qlik Sense or comparable business intelligence solutions.
• Familiarity with enterprise data catalogs and modern analytics platforms, including Alation, Databricks, or similar technologies.
• Experience supporting ERP modernization, SAP S/4HANA implementations, or enterprise reporting transformation initiatives.
• Knowledge of data product lifecycle management, reporting rationalization, and reusable enterprise analytics solutions.
• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, external suppliers, or globally distributed delivery resources.
• Understanding of AI-enabled analytics, large language model (LLM) applications, and the importance of high-quality governed data.
• Experience applying change management and stakeholder engagement strategies to drive technology adoption and organizational transformation.

• Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship

What We Offer:

• A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.
• Full Benefit Package (Medical, Dental & Vision) that starts your first day.
• 401k plan with company match, Profit Sharing & Retirement Savings Contribution.

jobs.title: Assistant General Counsel, Intellectual Property
jobs.description:
IP Counsel

Department: Legal
Location: Somerville, MA (on-site)

About Formlabs:

A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build.

Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software must all work at micron-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem.

That’s what we do.

At Formlabs, we’re building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they’re building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA.

Your Impact:

This role owns our patent portfolio strategy by building metrics to inform a global approach.  You'll work closely with R&D and inventors who create new technologies to guide our future growth. Additionally, we operate as a lean legal team, so you'll have an exciting opportunity to expand beyond IP and advise business leaders globally on other areas of law, such as corporate, commercial, employment, and general litigation matters.

What You'll Do:

• Own patent portfolio value, not just volume: build the metrics and criteria that determine what Formlabs patents, maintains, or cuts, and track cost against actual competitive value.

• Set global patent strategy across the U.S. and internationally, weighing where protection is worth pursuing given Formlabs' cross-border risk.

• Draft, file, and prosecute patent applications with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) and international patent offices, including the European Patent Office (EPO) and the China National Intellectual Property Administration (CNIPA).

• Run freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses, patentability assessments, and portfolio risk reviews to keep Formlabs building on solid ground.

• Partner directly with R&D to catch patentable inventions early, before they're buried in a lab notebook.

• Manage outside counsel across prosecution, opinions, and any disputes, keeping cost and quality in check.

• Support IP litigation, opposition proceedings, and enforcement when they come up.

• Step outside the patent portfolio to pitch in on key manufacturing, vendor, and supplier agreements, as well as other strategic commercial contracts.

• Pick up other generalist legal matters as they surface, from trade compliance to general litigation support, so the legal team can work collaboratively and best support any area of the business that needs our help.

About You:

• J.D. and admission to at least one state bar, plus registration to practice before the USPTO (patent bar).

• Undergraduate degree in engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field. You need to be able to read a claim chart and the underlying spec without a translator.

• Deep expertise in U.S. patent law, plus working knowledge of major international patent systems; experience with trademark and trade secret law.

• A track record in patent drafting, prosecution, and portfolio management, ideally where you can point to real decisions you made about what to file and what not to file.

• At least 3 years at a top-tier law firm focused on patent work.

• While you index on patent work, you’re excited about an expanded scope to learn to operate as a generalist, taking on whatever tasks the business requires. You thrive in an “every day is different” environment and enjoy the challenge of solving novel problems as they arise.

• Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving, global company where you're juggling more than one live priority at a time.

Bonus Skills:

• In-house legal experience at a hardware or hard-tech company.

• Experience with Chinese manufacturing operations.

• Experience with matters before the EPO and CNIPA.

• Experience with global copyright law, commercial transactions, and licensing agreements.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation:

Equity is a big part of the compensation package at Formlabs - every employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. We have a lot of confidence in the products we’re building and the impact we’re making, and you should too.

Base pay is the other part of our compensation package, and it is carefully determined based on your skills, experience, and expected impact. Equity and base pay combine to make up your total compensation package at Formlabs.

The hourly base pay range for this role is:

$150,000—$225,000 USD

jobs.title: VP, GTM Operations & Programs
jobs.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co http://Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co http://Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co http://Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Vibe’s go-to-market organization is the engine of the business: Sales, SDRs, Customer Success and Account Management, and behind them the three functions that make every one of those teams faster: GTM Operations, Events and Partnerships. As VP, GTM Operations & Programs, you’ll own those three functions, reporting directly to Quentin Marchese, Vibe’s CRO. You’ll lead GTM Operations directly and build the layer of leads and directors it needs; the leaders of Events and Partnerships will report to you. Your job is to make the whole engine pull in the same direction: one plan, one set of targets, clear accountability, and real leverage for every seller, SDR and account manager on the floor. This is the seat that decides how the engine is planned and measured, and how fast it corrects when something drifts, at a business on the road to $1B, with Walmart’s data and reach now behind it. Three reasons someone great would want this job: you’ll own the engine behind one of the fastest-growing sales organizations in media, you’ll build on Sonar, Vibe’s own GTM app, where operators ship their own tools with AI instead of waiting on a vendor roadmap, and you’ll design the function and its organization yourself, with a direct line to the CRO.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Make the engine pull in one direction

 - Own the operating cadence of the GTM organization: planning, targets, pipeline reviews and the rules of engagement every team plays by

 - Own the systems and processes Sales, SDRs, CSMs and AMs run on every day: Salesforce as the system of record, Sonar as the operating surface, routing and data quality

 - Own the numbers the GTM organization runs on, so every team reads the same pipeline and the same revenue

 - Make sure Events and Partnerships are built into the plan and the targets, not bolted on next to them

Turn events into pipeline

 - Partner with the Director of Events and Experiences on the annual events roadmap

 - Own the pipeline mechanics around every event, from pre-event targeting to on-site capture, follow-up and attribution, so every event shows its revenue

 - Connect events with partnerships and marketing, so the calendar drives the partner program and the market plan

Turn partnerships into revenue for sellers

 - Partner with the partnerships team on the agency program, technology and measurement partners, and the Walmart Connect partner ecosystem

 - Make partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue visible and attributable

 - Make sure every partner launch reaches sellers with the enablement they need, and set the bar for which partnerships get built

Build the function, with AI

 - Lead the GTM Operations team and build the layer of leads and directors it needs as it grows

 - Set the roadmap for the GTM Operations, Events and Partnerships surfaces in Sonar and ship with your team: at Vibe, operators build their own tools with Claude rather than filing tickets

 - Decide what gets built next and what gets killed, based on adoption and revenue outcomes
   
   


WHAT YOU NEED

 - 10+ years in go-to-market or revenue operations, including 5+ years leading leaders

 - An acute GTM sense: you know how a sales organization works day to day, and you’ve run the operations behind one. You’re an operator with a GTM instinct, not a systems administrator

 - You hold your own with sales leaders: you can take their read of the business, test it against the data and come back with a better answer

 - You’ve run more than systems: events, partnerships or comparable programs, with pipeline results attached

 - You’ve designed an organization from first principles, not just inherited one

 - You build with AI yourself and expect your team to, with specific examples of what it changed


NICE TO HAVES

 - Ad tech or CTV experience

 - Experience with a consumption or usage-based revenue model, where spend moves daily and there are no fixed contract baselines

 - You’ve been through an acquisition
   
   


OUR VALUES

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.




WHAT WE OFFER

For candidates based in New York, NY, base pay for this role is $275k–$350k, plus a competitive variable component.



At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

 - Variable pay — based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

 - Hybrid flexibility — We’re in NYC’s Flatiron District and our team is in 4 days a week.

 - Full health coverage — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 - 401(k) with matching — We invest in your future, not just your output.

 - Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need. We measure results, not hours.

 - Parental leave — Paid leave for all parents.

 - Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.
   
   


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

 1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We’ll share context; you’ll share yours.

 2. Manager interview — Meet the person you’d work with directly.

 3. Take-home assignment + live debrief — A real problem, not a trick. We’ll work through it together.

 4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we’re holding a consistent, high bar.

 5. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

 6. Offer — Fast. We don’t let good decisions sit.
    
    


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

• Sterke probleemoplossende vaardigheden en aandacht voor detail
• Kennis van Agile ontwikkelingsmethodologieën
• Het vermogen om efficiënt te werken in een snelle, collaboratieve omgeving

Wat bieden wij jou?

• Een bruto maandsalaris tot €5500 o.b.v. fulltime (fulltime werkweek bedraagt 38,16 uur)
• Goede secundaire voorwaarden zoals aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling, 26 vakantiedagen (ook mogelijkheid tot bijkopen) en andere voordelen
• Een uitdagende werkomgeving binnen een ambitieuze, internationale en sterk groeiende organisatie
• De mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen de organisatie
• Een team met enthousiaste en gedreven collega’s
• Flexibele werkmogelijkheden: hybride werken voor een goede werk-privébalans (balans ligt ongeveer op 50% met afgesproken kantoordagen).

Kortom: een echte uitdaging voor een ambitieuze, energieke en creatieve professional die denkt in oplossingen!

Interesse? Solliciteer direct!

Herken jij jezelf in deze vacature? Dan ontvangen we graag je cv via onze website. Twijfel je of jouw profiel volledig aansluit? Ook dan moedigen we je aan om te reageren. We kijken graag samen naar jouw talenten en mogelijkheden binnen Eurofins.

Heb je vragen naar aanleiding van de vacature of jouw sollicitatie? Neem gerust contact op via calvin.pohlman@sc.eurofinseu.com.

Let op: sollicitaties die per e-mail worden ingestuurd, worden niet in behandeling genomen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

Over Eurofins

Eurofins Scientific is een internationaal beursgenoteerd life sciences bedrijf dat haar klanten voorziet van hoogwaardig laboratoriumonderzoek en advies. Eurofins is wereldwijd marktleider op het gebied van bio-analytische testen voor levensmiddelen, water, milieu, cosmetica, farmaceutische producten en contract research voor agro science. Daarnaast is Eurofins één van de grootste aanbieders ter wereld in testing en laboratorium services in genomics, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences, medicijnontwikkeling en clinical studies. Eurofins gebruikt daarvoor haar portfolio van ruim 200.000 unieke analysemethoden en een ongekend hoog kennisniveau en expertise.

Eurofins bestaat wereldwijd uit circa 65.000 medewerkers, verdeeld over 900 hyper moderne laboratoria en is actief in 60 landen met een pro-forma omzet van 6.95€ Mio in 2024. Eurofins kent sterke groeiambities (CAGR 24%) met naast zeer sterke autonome groei middels eigen start-ups ook jaarlijks een groot aantal acquisities.

De geaccrediteerde laboratoria van Eurofins Milieu bieden in Nederland een uitgebreid pakket aan chemische, fysische en biologische analyses in alle milieu matrices. Door jarenlange ervaring heeft zij uitvoerige kennis op het gebied van zowel routinematige analyses als niet standaard analyses waaronder analyses van bijzondere verbindingen en microverontreinigingen. Eurofins is marktleider op het gebied van specialistisch onderzoek; opdrachtgevers zijn onder meer waterkwaliteitsbeheerders, Rijkswaterstaat, provinciale en gemeentelijke overheden, milieu-adviesbureaus, industrie en aannemers. Circa 600 gemotiveerde deskundigen verzorgen het traject van monstername tot aan de digitale rapportage van de analyseresultaten. Analyses vinden voornamelijk plaats in de grote laboratoria in Amsterdam (Eurofins Omegam) en Barneveld (Eurofins Analytico).

Let your passion shine as Accounting Intern

Belong in a place where you can be yourself and love what you do. Join our community and we will support you to realize your potential. jobs.title: (Junior) Accountmanager
jobs.description:
Als Accountmanager ben jij het gezicht van Eurofins in de markt. Je rol is uitgesproken naar buiten gericht: je bent dagelijks bij (potentiële) klanten aan tafel, opent nieuwe deuren en zet actief in op het binnenhalen en binden van nieuwe klanten. Je opereert in een prijs gedreven milieumarkt, waarin onderscheidend vermogen niet alleen uit tarief komt, maar juist uit de relatie, het vertrouwen en de toegevoegde waarde die jij weet op te bouwen. Het duurzaam ontwikkelen van klantrelaties is dan ook de kern van jouw succes.

Wij hebben recentelijk een gloednieuw, hypermodern laboratorium in Amersfoort geopend, het grootste milieulab van Nederland. Dankzij verregaande innovatie en automatisering zijn we in staat een groter deel van de markt te bedienen dan ooit tevoren. Om die groeiambities waar te maken, zoeken we een gedreven Accountmanager die zich volledig richt op het actief aantrekken van nieuwe klanten. Dit is een rol met veel vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid: jij bepaalt je aanpak, jij zit aan het stuur.

Dit doe je niet alleen, maar samen met een team van Accountmanagers, een Business Development Manager, Customer Support, R&D en Operations. Je werkt voornamelijk vanuit de locaties Amsterdam en Amersfoort, maar bent bovenal veel onderweg richting de klant.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
One Team. All Heart. All Hustle.

At Merchants Fleet, we believe great work happens when talented people come together with a shared commitment to service, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Our Heart & Hustle culture is built on integrity, adaptability, innovation, and a passion for delivering results. About the Role

As the Accounting Manager, you'll play a critical leadership role within our Planning, Analysis & Consulting (FPAC) organization. You'll oversee key aspects of the monthly close and financial reporting process, support company audits, lead and develop accounting team members, and drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and accuracy across the organization.

This position offers the opportunity to influence business outcomes, collaborate cross-functionally, and help shape the future of accounting operations at Merchants Fleet.

What You'll Do

• Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and reliability of accounting data and financial information.

• Analyze accounting and operational processes and recommend improvements that drive efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness.

• Lead, coach, and develop accounting team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.

• Partner with business leaders and stakeholders across the organization to support financial reporting and business objectives.

• Participate in special projects and strategic initiatives that support company growth and operational excellence.

What Makes You Successful

What You'll Bring

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Team

Finance Operations (FinOps) builds the data foundation that CoreWeave’s finance organization runs on. We own the core finance data models, reporting, and tools that FP&A and Accounting rely on to plan, forecast, and report on the business.

About the Role

The Senior Financial Analyst, Finance Operations will sit at the intersection of business intelligence and finance. This role is roughly 70% BI and 30% finance. You will write SQL, design data models, and build reporting that finance leaders use every close and forecast cycle. You will also understand the finance behind the numbers, so you can spot when something doesn’t look right and explain why.

As CoreWeave grows, so does the scope of what finance needs from its data. You will help automate manual processes, improve data quality, and expand the reporting the team delivers.

What You’ll Do

• Build and maintain finance data models that serve as a trusted source of truth for planning, forecasting, and reporting.

• Replace manual data loads and spreadsheet processes with repeatable, systematic pipelines.

• Design dashboards and reports for close, budget versus actuals, forecasting, and executive reporting.

• Define and govern key finance and business metrics so they are calculated consistently across the organization.

• Reconcile reporting to source systems and the general ledger, and resolve data issues before they reach stakeholders.

• Work with FP&A, Accounting, and Data Engineering to turn finance questions into data requirements and deliver solutions.

• Bring BI discipline to a finance team, including documentation, testing, version control, and data quality.

Who You Are

• You have a bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

• You have 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, or financial analysis, including at least 3 years writing SQL in a production setting.

• You have advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and performance tuning on large datasets.

• You understand BI best practices, including dimensional modeling (star schemas, conformed dimensions, slowly changing dimensions), semantic layers, and data governance.

• You have experience building dashboards and reports in a modern BI tool such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Sigma.

• You have solid finance fundamentals, including the three financial statements, P&L structure, budgeting and forecasting cycles, budget-versus-actuals analysis, and month-end close.

• You can reconcile data to the general ledger and explain variances to finance stakeholders.

• You are deeply familiar with AI tools, skills, and agents, and use sound judgment about how and when to apply AI in your work—including where it can speed up analysis and where human review still matters.

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical trade-offs to finance partners and finance logic to engineers.

• You have a strong sense of ownership and treat changes to finance data with care because you know who relies on it.

Preferred Skills

• Experience in an FP&A, Finance Systems, or Finance Operations team at a high-growth or public company.

• Familiarity with ERP and CRM data, such as NetSuite and Salesforce.

• Experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery.

• Experience with Python, dbt, or similar data transformation tools.

• Experience in the cloud or technology industry.

Wondering if you’re a good fit?

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

• You love connecting teams and ensuring every campaign runs smoothly from start to finish.

• You’re curious about how strategy, brand, creative, and execution all interlock to drive real business impact.

• You’re an expert at managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects and keeping everyone aligned without missing a detail.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $75,000 to $110,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

jobs.description:
The O.P. Psych Therapist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

• The therapist provides outpatient psychiatric treatment services to persons suffering from psychiatric/chemical dependency difficulties and/or their families/significant others. The therapist must be knowledgeable in areas of assessment, counseling, therapy, relapse prevention, referral and recovery, and will consider the specific needs and behaviors of specific age groups. The therapist is responsible for establishing a therapeutic alliance with the patient and is considered the patient’s advocate.

Responsibilities:

ASSESSMENT/PROBLEM IDENTIFICATION

• Demonstrates an understanding of the trans theoretical model, including stages of change and motivational interviewing. Consistently maintains the spirit of motivational interviewing when interviewing the patients.
• Demonstrates an understanding of Recovery Based Services and attends to the four major dimensions that support recovery: Health, Home, Purpose and Community.
• Assesses and records patient status, identifying the psychological and emotional needs of the patient and family/support system.
• Organizes the assessment data so that they are accurate, complete and accessible.
• Collaborates with the patient to develop the Comprehensive Problem List.
• Collaborates with the registered nurse to assure that the patient’s nursing/medical needs are addressed.
• Assesses discharge planning needs including identification of needed referrals and initiates the discharge planning process.
• Completes intake assessments and assess the treatment needs of callers seeking psychiatric/chemical dependency treatment.

GOAL SETTING/PLANNING

• Primarily responsible for the development of the Phased Treatment Plan, recommends updates of treatment plans, and contributes to the discharge planning for program patients. Incorporates principles of age-specific care into the Phased Treatment Plan.
• Collaborates with the patient to identify treatment goals and methods during each phase of treatment.
• Begins plans for discharge at time of admission; consults with physician, registered nurse, patient and family regarding the discharge plan.
• Identifies patient/family teaching needs on admission and throughout treatment.
• Arranges conferences with family or other members of health team when indicated to plan care.

IMPLEMENTATION/INTERVENTION

• Provides group therapy sessions and educational seminars for psychiatric and/or chemically dependent patients and their families.
• Provides individual and family counseling to primary patients and other patients in the outpatient programs as needed.
• Provides outpatient psychotherapy in various modalities including individual, family/marital and groups.
• Utilizes evidence-based interventions for each phase of treatment.
• Utilizes self-report or behavioral measures to evaluate patient’s progress toward goals.
• Documents all assessments, interventions and patient response. Maintains clinical records in accordance with department policy.
• Provides referral to the appropriate level of care for intakes.
• Participates in annual screening events or community education presentations.

EVALUATION

jobs.title: SDR Team Lead - US
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 






IN OFFICE ROLE - BOSTON, MA

This role is based in our office in Boston, MA. Please only apply if you are located in Boston and can commit to 4-5 days in Office.

What this job actually is

This is a build job, and the thing you build is a team.

When you join, BLP has no US pipeline, no US playbook, and a team that is either half-hired or not hired yet. What you get instead: a VP of Business Development who has done this before and works with you directly, a US country lead sitting next to you, and a DACH SDR team whose playbook you can borrow from.

Your job is to act as a Playercoach. Your task is to put 6 to 8 SDRs on the ground in Boston, get them ramped, and own US pipeline as the priority number. You will hire most of the team, coach them daily, and write the US playbook as you go. Some of it you will take from what already works in DACH. A lot of it you will figure out, because nobody here has sold into this market yet. Until the first reps are being hired, you are comfortable being hands on and do the groundwork to create pipeline yourself.

If you want to manage a running team inside a proven motion or spend your day building reports, this is the wrong role. If you want to stand up a motion yourself and own the result, read on.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our SDR Team Lead in the US, you own outbound pipeline generation into US enterprise manufacturing and industrial accounts through a team of SDRs you hire, ramp, and lead. You own the US SDR pipeline number, the processes underneath it, and the local playbook.

You report directly to the VP of Business Development, with a dotted line to the US country lead, who you will work with closely on targeting, handoffs, and how the SDR and AE motions fit together. You are the first SDR leader on US soil. Until the team is fully built and running, you are a player-coach: on the phones enough to know what works, and leading the team that scales it.

We will build this together. You own the ground game, I give you feedback, and we iterate fast.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Hire the founding US SDR team of 6 to 8 reps: set the bar, run the interview loop, and make the calls on who gets in.

 - Own the US SDR pipeline number and forecast it accurately to the VP of Business Development.

 - Build the processes: outbound cadence, qualification, SDR-to-AE handoff, and CRM hygiene in HubSpot.

 - Coach the team daily: call reviews, weekly 1:1s, and live feedback that turns new reps into producers.

 - Ramp the team fast with an onboarding you own and keep improving.

 - Adapt the DACH playbook to the US market and own what is genuinely US-specific.

 - Partner tightly with the US country lead and the AEs on targeting, account strategy, and how the two motions work together.




WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

This is the part that separates the role from a standard SDR management seat.

 - The US SDR function from scratch: the hiring bar, the ramp plan, the cadence, and the metrics you run the team on.

 - The US playbook: which segments respond, which triggers matter, and which openers land with US finance and procurement buyers. You start from DACH and correct it with real US calls.

 - The US ICP, validated with RevOps. We go in with a labeled hypothesis based on our DACH profile, and your team's calls are how we prove or fix it.

 - The scorecard and review cadence that make performance visible and coachable, so the second and third hires ramp faster than the first.




THE TOOLS

Your team works with a lean outbound stack: HubSpot as the CRM and single source of truth, Clay for enrichment and signal-based prospecting, Claude for research and AI-assisted work, and LinkMatch to keep LinkedIn and HubSpot in sync without manual logging. Outbound today is mostly phone and LinkedIn led. You will help decide what we add as the motion matures.




WE'RE EXCITED ABOUT YOU BECAUSE

 - You have managed an SDR or BDR team before, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS, and you have hired and ramped reps yourself rather than inheriting a finished team.

 - You have carried and hit a pipeline number as a leader, and you can forecast it honestly.

 - You know the US market and US enterprise buyers, ideally with exposure to Finance, Procurement, or Operations personas.

 - You coach well. You can sit on a call, name what went wrong, and show the rep a better version, week after week.

 - You are comfortable with ambiguity. No inbound, no case studies, and a team you still have to hire does not rattle you, it interests you.

 - You build a team culture where high standards and genuine enjoyment live in the same room, and where ramped reps pass on what they learn to the next hires.

 - You take ownership, ask for help when you are stuck, act on feedback fast, and hold your team to the same.

 - Exposure to ERP, Purchase-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash processes, or to selling into Finance and Procurement, is a strong plus.




BONUS POINTS

 - You have stood up an SDR team in a new market or a new region before.

 - You know the ERP domain, or have led teams selling Finance, Procurement, or industrial software.

 - You already know HubSpot and Clay, and you have built scorecards and review cadences from scratch.




WHAT YOU'LL GET

 - Comprehensive benefits. Medical, dental and vision for you and your family through. Life insurance and short- and long-term disability are fully paid by BLP.

 - Location. This role is based in our Boston office. You will spend regular time with the VP of Business Development, your DACH counterparts, and HQ in Zürich.

 - A real mandate. You own the US SDR function end to end, with a direct line to the VP of Business Development and the room to build it your way.

 - High earning potential. A competitive US leadership package with uncapped commission tied to your team's performance.

 - Room to grow. As the US team scales past this first group, you grow with it. You are early in a market we are only just opening.

 - Strong colleagues. You will work alongside people from serious academic and commercial backgrounds who care about doing the work well.



Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers http://blp.digital/company/careers.

CoreWeave’s GTM Finance team is a critical partner to our rapidly growing Sales organization. As we scale, our team is focused on building repeatable processes, enabling high-velocity decision-making, and ensuring our sales partners can deliver best-in-class client experiences. In this role, you will serve as a key business partner to Account Executives, Account Managers, and Revenue leadership, offering support in structuring and evaluating commercial proposals. You’ll dig deep into deal economics, model financial outcomes, and creatively problem-solve to find paths that align customer needs with CoreWeave’s strategic and financial objectives. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT BLACKSMITH

 - We started by building infrastructure to run CI workloads really fast. Our first product helps companies run GitHub Actions substantially faster and cheaper by owning and operating our own global fleet of bare-metal machines rather than renting generic cloud VMs.

 - Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 7,000+ companies and tens of millions in ARR. We’ve grown 10x so far in 2026.

 - We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves.

 - We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team.

 - Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier.

 - We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will drive adoption of this new category across complex organizations with 1,000+ employees. You’ll help enterprises modernize CI, reduce cloud spend, and transform developer productivity at scale.

This is a founding Enterprise role, shaping how we sell into the largest, most sophisticated engineering organizations in the world.




WHY BLACKSMITH

 - We orchestrate millions of VMs monthly on our own bare-metal CI cloud.

 - Over 600+ companies trust Blacksmith to power production CI at scale.

 - Our founders built large-scale distributed systems at Cockroach Labs and Faire.

 - YC W24 alum backed by a top-tier VC.

 - Reached $1M ARR in under 12 months with a team of four.

 - Enterprise is our next breakout growth engine — and you will help define it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise AE, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and drive large, complex sales cycles involving engineering leadership, DevOps, platform teams, procurement, security, finance, and C-suite stakeholders.

You will:

 - Break into new Fortune 1000-level accounts

 - Shape multi-party evaluations

 - Run deep technical and commercial cycles

 - Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver value across engineering and executive personas

This is a hunter role with full ownership of territory strategy, pipeline creation, deal execution, and expansion opportunities.

You’ll influence GTM strategy, product direction, and the overall enterprise motion as one of the earliest members of our upmarket sales team.




WHAT YOU’LL DO




DRIVE NET-NEW ENTERPRISE REVENUE

 - Prospect and penetrate organizations with 1,000+ employees, targeting platform, DevOps, and engineering leadership.

 - Strategically multithread across technical and business stakeholders.

 - Build account plans, define win strategies, and execute toward large, multi-year agreements.


OWN COMPLEX, HIGH-VALUE SALES CYCLES END-TO-END

 - Lead discovery, scoping, and qualification using modern enterprise methodologies (MEDDICC, Challenger, etc.).

 - Collaborate with Solutions Engineering on demos, benchmarking, and POCs.

 - Navigate procurement, legal, finance, and risk/security assessments.

 - Drive commercial negotiations to close six- and seven-figure deals.


CREATE AND SCALE YOUR OWN PIPELINE

 - Build high-quality outbound strategies tailored to enterprise engineering organizations.

 - Leverage signals around CI workload patterns, cloud cost pressures, and internal shift-left initiatives to identify high-probability targets.

 - Partner closely with SDR, marketing, and founders to refine outreach and messaging.


ACT AS A TRUSTED ADVISOR TO ENGINEERING LEADERS

 - Understand CI architecture, cloud optimization strategies, ephemeral compute, and developer productivity metrics.

 - Translate performance improvements into enterprise-level ROI and business impact narratives.

 - Position Blacksmith competitively against hyperscalers, self-hosted runners, and traditional infrastructure alternatives.
   


COLLABORATE CROSS-FUNCTIONALLY

 - Work with product to shape roadmap priorities based on enterprise needs.

 - Partner with Customer Success on adoption, expansion, and executive alignment.

 - Contribute to sales playbooks, messaging, and early enterprise GTM frameworks.




YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience. Selling horizontal SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, CI/CD, or highly technical platforms to organizations with 1,000+ employees.

 - A proven track record of closing large enterprise deals ($100K+). You consistently exceed quota and have strong W2 history to show it.

 - Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder cycles. You’ve sold into:
   
   - VP/Director-level engineering
   
   - Platform/SRE/DevOps teams
   
   - CIO/CTO organizations
   
   - Procurement, legal, finance, and security teams

 - Strong technical acumen. You understand — or can quickly learn — concepts like CI/CD pipelines, ephemeral compute, containerization, cloud cost management, and modern DevOps tooling.

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with autonomy. You thrive in early-stage environments where processes aren’t fully defined, and you enjoy building the motion, not just executing it.

 - A consultative, value-driven approach. You excel at uncovering pain, aligning technical requirements to outcomes, and crafting enterprise-level ROI narratives.

 - Executive presence & exceptional communication skills. You can influence senior engineering and business leaders with clarity and confidence.




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience selling infra or developer platforms (CI/CD, cloud, DevOps tooling, performance engineering).

 - Strong understanding of cloud cost optimization or compute-intensive workloads.

 - Experience as an early GTM hire building enterprise sales processes from scratch.

 - Curiosity about AI, automation, and modern engineering pipelines.
   


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary + meaningful equity upside

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Early-exercise stock options

 - 12 weeks fully paid parental leave (U.S.)

 - Quarterly offsites

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators, including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.


ROLE IMPACT

We're looking for a Product Lead to bring clear direction and consistent execution to our product team within Engineering. You'll help turn the infrastructure behind frontier AI into a product that developers and researchers can use to build, evaluate, and improve their own models. You'll lead the team's product work, stay close to design and implementation, and work with our founders and technical leads to choose what matters most. San Francisco is our preferred location; remote is possible for the right candidate.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Set a focused product direction with the founders and technical leads. Turn customer needs and new technical capabilities into clear choices about what we build next.

 - Shape the connected customer experience across our whole platform: environments, evaluations, training, deployment, and traces. Partner with the teams building Model Factory, inference, and sandboxes to make those workflows work together.

 - Work directly with customers and our own researchers. Use their real workloads to find friction, test ideas, and turn useful experiments into dependable product features.

 - Stay hands-on through prototypes, product specs, design reviews, and working sessions with engineers.

 - Measure whether the product helps people succeed: time to a first useful result, repeat usage, production adoption, and where customers need help. Use that evidence to improve the roadmap.


REQUIREMENTS

 - You've built and grown a technical product that (a lot of) people use in production.

 - You’ve led teams while balancing remaining hands-on, and understand when to direct execution vs. getting involved yourself.

 - You have the technical depth to prototype, work with APIs, and reason through system tradeoffs with engineers. Experience in developer tools, AI infrastructure, or ML platforms is required.

 - You care about how a product feels in use and strive to make each experience more simple or useful.

 - Design engineering experience is a big plus: you combine bold product vision with exceptional taste and a track record of shipping polished experiences.

 - You learn directly from customers, write clearly, and can turn an ambiguous problem into a concrete next step.

 - You're obsessed with building open superintelligence and putting the tools and know-how to create it in the hands of ambitious people everywhere.

Particularly useful domain experience: Ownership of training, inference, multi-agent, RL, continual learning, and/or evaluations systems.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - $200,000–$300,000 base salary plus meaningful equity

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Full medical, dental, and vision (covered for employees and dependents).

 - Flexible PTO.

 - $200/month health & wellness benefit.

Show us a product you're proud of, what you personally built or led, and how it changed after real people started using it.

Document in the medical record with the abbreviation NG

Graduate of an accredited registered nursing program.

Graduate of an accredited registered nursing program. Eligible to sit for NCLEX – A nursing graduate shall cease practice as a nursing graduate immediately if the nursing graduate fails two attempts at the NCLEX exam or has not successfully taken and passed the NCLEX exam within 120 days of application to the board of nursing.

A nursing graduate shall cease practice as a nursing graduate:

(a) No later than 120 days after the date the nursing graduate submitted an application to the Board; or

(b) Immediately if the nursing graduate fails the second NCLEX examination.

A nursing graduate may not:

(a) Work without the physical presence of and direct supervision by a registered nurse;

(b) Refer to oneself or practice as a registered nurse (RN) or licensed practical nurse (LPN);

(c) Be considered a staff person for purposes of a staffing pattern;

(d) Accept charge responsibilities; or

(e) Perform initial patient assessment or the first patient assessment of a shift, develop patient plans of care, evaluate or document patient discharge, or independently administer medications or intravenous therapy.

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

jobs.title: Applied AI Researcher
jobs.description:
Midstream is an AI-native financial operating system for health systems, founded by experienced entrepreneurs and backed by top-tier investors. We give finance, supply chain, and managed care teams real-time visibility into where margin is at risk, with a precise action plan for capturing it before it's gone.

Purpose-built for healthcare's complexity, Midstream transforms structured, unstructured, and external data into instant, contract-aware insights that drive smarter decisions. Our AI agents unify spend and revenue operations across the full back-office, learning and adapting with every interaction and delivering always-on intelligence that no point solution or one-off engagement can match.

We're compressing months to minutes and turning post-period hindsight into in-the-moment foresight. The tempo of healthcare finance is changing, and Midstream is leading it.




OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for Applied Researchers who are excited to push the boundaries of what AI can accomplish in healthcare. You'll develop intelligent agents and models that uncover financial opportunities hidden within complex health system contracts, spend, and operational data, helping some of the country's largest health systems recover meaningful value.

Working closely with Engineering, Product, and our subject matter experts, you'll turn complex, manual analyses into intelligent, scalable workflows. You'll have the opportunity to experiment with new approaches, develop novel capabilities, and directly measure the financial impact of what you build.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems, moves quickly from experimentation to results, and is motivated by seeing their work make a tangible difference.


HOW YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT

Build and improve our core AI agents

Own the development and continuous improvement of agents that identify and validate financial opportunities across healthcare supply chain, pharmacy, and managed care. Experiment with new approaches, systematically improve performance, and measure success by the value your agents uncover.

Turn complex data into actionable intelligence

Investigate large, messy healthcare datasets to uncover patterns, anomalies, and relationships that reveal financial opportunities. Develop models and analytical approaches to problems such as pricing discrepancies, contract optimization, underpayments, and negotiation opportunities.

Automate how we find value

Work closely with our Value Engineers to understand the complex analyses they perform today and translate those workflows into reliable, AI-powered capabilities. Help reduce manual effort while improving the speed, accuracy, and scale of opportunity identification and validation.

Advance our agentic capabilities

Develop novel approaches to information extraction and agentic workflows, including frameworks that make it faster to build and deploy new extractors across complex healthcare documents. Collaborate with Engineering to translate successful research into scalable product capabilities.

Build with rigor and measurable outcomes

Define clear evaluation frameworks and performance metrics from the start. Continuously test, debug, and improve models and agents, ensuring that gains in technical performance translate into measurable financial value for our customers.

Collaborate to shape our platform

Partner with Engineering, Product, and domain experts to improve how we model healthcare data, identify new opportunities for automation, and influence the evolution of our AI-native platform. Bring curiosity, strong technical judgment, and a willingness to learn from the people closest to the problems we're solving.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experienced in applied AI and machine learning: You have 2–8 years of experience in data science, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, or related fields. We're hiring across multiple levels and value demonstrated ability over years of experience alone.

 - Strong in data analysis and experimentation: You're proficient in Python, with a solid foundation in statistics, experimental design, and data modeling. You can quickly investigate unfamiliar datasets, identify meaningful patterns, and form well-reasoned hypotheses.

 - Hands-on with AI agents: You have experience building, debugging, and improving LLM-powered agents or workflows. You understand how to design effective evaluations, identify failure modes, and systematically improve performance without introducing unnecessary complexity.

 - A rigorous problem-solver: You combine analytical curiosity with sound technical judgment. You use AI tools to accelerate your work but develop your own understanding of the underlying data, models, and problems you're solving.

 - Outcome-oriented: You're motivated by solving real business problems and can connect technical improvements to measurable results. You care as much about the value your work creates as the sophistication of the approach.

 - A high-ownership builder: You thrive in fast-moving environments, take initiative when faced with ambiguity, and know when to ask questions, involve others, or independently push a problem toward resolution.

 - Collaborative and thoughtful: You actively seek expertise, communicate openly, and work well across technical and non-technical teams. You take ownership of mistakes, welcome feedback, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

 - Curious and mission-driven: You enjoy experimenting with new ideas, learning complex domains, and applying emerging technology to meaningful problems. You're excited by the opportunity to use AI to transform how health systems identify and recover financial value.

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

Remote positions open to the US only.

As a Principal Product Marketing Manager, you are a senior strategic leader within Product Marketing, setting the direction for how KnowBe4 positions, launches, and grows a major portfolio or platform pillar. You bring deep market and customer expertise to shape company-wide go-to-market strategy, influence product and pricing decisions, and elevate the craft of the broader Product Marketing team.

We are looking for a highly strategic, experienced product marketer who can operate with significant autonomy, translate ambiguous market signals into clear strategy, and represent Product Marketing in front of senior leadership, industry analysts, and top customers. This role partners closely with Product Marketing leader, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering and Executive leadership to define how KnowBe4 wins in the market, and mentors other product marketers to raise the bar across the function.

Responsibilities:

• Drive product and portfolio positioning and messaging strategy across a major product line or platform pillar, ensuring differentiation and consistency across all customer-facing channels

• Set the go-to-market strategy and narrative for major product launches, new market entries, and platform-level initiatives, coordinating execution across Marketing, Sales, Product, Competitive Intelligence, and Customer Success

• Serve as a strategic advisor to Product Management on roadmap and pricing/packaging decisions, bringing market, competitive, and customer insight to influence what KnowBe4 builds

• Drive and elevate KnowBe4's competitive strategy, translating competitive and market intelligence into actionable positioning, sales plays, and executive briefings

• Represent Product Marketing in industry-analyst forums and support research/reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester); build and maintain relationships with key analysts and influencers

• Drive thought leadership initiatives (speaking engagements, bylines, executive content) that establish KnowBe4 and its leaders as category authorities

• Mentor and coach Senior and Product Marketing Managers, providing guidance on positioning, messaging, and go-to- market craft, and helping to scale best practices across the team

• Partner cross-functionally to support integrated marketing campaigns, sales plays, and ABM motions that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, and brand impact across all go- to-market channels

• Conduct advanced market research, competitive analysis, and buyer/persona development to inform long-range GTM and product strategy

• Assist and evolve sales enablement strategy for the portfolio (battlecards, feature comparisons, datasheets), ensuring sales is equipped to win against evolving competitive threats

• Leverage AI tools for research, content creation, and data analysis to increase speed and quality of strategic output

Qualifications:

• BA/BS or equivalent working experience

• 8+ years of experience in product marketing, with a track record of leading GTM strategy for major product launches or portfolios

• 8+ years of experience in product marketing, product positioning, messaging, and market research & analysis, including experience operating at a strategic/portfolio level

• Extensive experience in the cybersecurity industry and B2B SaaS is required

• Proven ability to independently set and drive GTM strategy with minimal oversight, and to influence senior stakeholders and executives

• Demonstrated experience advising Product Management on roadmap and pricing/packaging strategy

• Experience building and maintaining relationships with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, etc.) and representing a company in analyst or executive briefings

• Proven experience creating and executing product launch programs that drive customer engagement, advocacy, and measurable revenue outcomes

• Deep familiarity with enterprise sales processes and culture, including the tools and assets needed by a high-volume, high- complexity sales organization

Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.

Founded in 2014, Ogury operates in 18 countries with over 400 employees worldwide.
Ogury is a global adtech company powered by Persona Intelligence, its proprietary technology that enables brands and agencies to activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable brand outcomes.
Ogury enables marketers to scale audience strategies with consistency in a fragmented media landscape. By maintaining persona integrity, we help brands activate high-value audiences more efficiently, strengthen campaign performance, and unlock sustainable growth.
 
At Ogury, our vision unites us all. But we know that it takes people from all walks of life to come together and make it happen. We embrace and celebrate what makes us different, creating a unique and winning culture where everyone feels safe, has access to the same opportunities, and is excited about bringing their most authentic self to work. Everyday.

We understand that to have Ogurians who are engaged, respected, and who feel proud to belong, means creating a safe space where everyone feels comfortable bringing their most authentic selves to work. Everyday.


The Opportunity
Ogury is seeking a driven and strategic Account Executive to join our Los Angeles team and play a critical role in accelerating growth across top-tier agencies and brand-direct accounts throughout the West Coast.
You’ll represent a privacy-first ad tech platform powered by Persona Intelligence, helping agencies and brand-direct clients across the West Coast activate consistent persona-based strategies across channels and drive measurable outcomes.

Drive adoption of Ogury’s Personified Advertising solutions through strategic outreach, compelling presentations, and consistent engagement with media agencies and brand-direct marketers across the West Coast.
Cultivate and grow relationships with key agency stakeholders by understanding their objectives, success metrics, and challenges—and positioning Ogury as a value-driven partner.
Manage the end-to-end sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline development through negotiation and close.
Build strategic sales plans that unlock long-term revenue growth and deepen consultative client partnerships.
Own forecasting, pipeline development, and high standards of CRM hygiene.
Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution, client satisfaction, and post-sale success.
Represent Ogury at industry conferences and networking events to increase market visibility and identify emerging opportunities.

Act as a client advocate, managing and resolving sales escalations with professionalism and urgency.

5+ years of experience selling digital advertising solutions to media agencies in the West Coast market, including Los Angeles and other key markets such as San Francisco, Denver, and Colorado.
Strong existing relationships with key contacts at West Coast media agencies and brands, with the ability to build business across the region.
A proven record of both new business development and account growth, with a passion for building long-term client value.
Commercial acumen and the ability to identify revenue opportunities, educate clients on new product developments, and connect their goals to smart, data-led solutions.
Excellent presentation and communication skills, with confidence engaging agency stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
An entrepreneurial, self-starter mindset with a high level of creativity, motivation, and accountability.
Comfort working in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, autonomy, and team spirit are essential.
A passion for adtech and a strong interest in staying ahead of industry trends and developments.
