jobs.title: Content Strategist (Remote US)
jobs.description:
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B marketing agency for brands that are serious about the metrics that matter most. 


With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands under our belt, we've earned our reputation on real outcomes. We run through 3 divisions: Performance, Communications, and Commerce, all wired to share intelligence and answer to revenue. That system spans everything from Paid Media and Content Marketing, to PR and Paid Social, to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing. Tying it all together is our methodology, DiscoverabilityOS™, which aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point.

We move fast. We think boldly. We hire people who challenge the status quo, build campaigns worth talking about, and make bold brands impossible to ignore. If you live for performance, love solving hard problems, and want your work to actually mean something, you'll fit right in.



About The Role:

The Content Strategist is a crucial, client-facing role that is responsible for day-to-day client deliverables, creating and managing custom client strategies, and communicating both with clients and internal stakeholders. The Strategist is responsible for more Enterprise clients and is expected to have a deep understanding of their service line and how it impacts other areas of business to create a holistic marketing strategy.



Please note: internally, this role is titled Account Strategist, Content & SEO.



What You'll Do:

 1. Strategic Excellence and Best Practices: Strategists are responsible for creating custom strategies and implementing best practices for their clients that ultimately result in achieving our NSMs. The strategist will use project phase as a foundational moment for building the initial client strategy, but will also use our clients overall marketing goals, current and ongoing campaigns, and historical performance to optimize and revise strategies over the lifetime of the client while adhering to Directive best practices
    
    1. Strategists will work closely with their Associate Director (AsD) when roadblocks arise that impact their strategy and goal attainment.
    
    2. Strategists display a strong ability to craft creative briefs and compelling content campaigns with a focus on ideation based on competitor and audience insights.
    
    3. Best practices should be used to inform our strategies to ensure our clients are in the best position to exceed their goals. In particular:
       
       1. LTV:CAC modeling
       
       2. Customer Generation
       
       3. Share of SERP
       
       4. Content Production

 2. Goal Setting: Strategists are responsible for using available data to set goals for clients during their engagement period. These goals will be reviewed and approved by their Associate Director (AsD), who should be in the meeting with them.
    
    1. Data sources include Google Analytics, CRM data, SEMRush reporting, and Ahrefs reporting
    
    2. All Goals must be approved by the Associate Director (AsD) before the Strategist can present it to their client alongside their Associate Director (AsD).

 3. Project Management: Strategists are responsible for ensuring that their planned strategy is executed. Project Management ensures that the Directive team and the client team knows who is responsible for specific tasks to ensure we make progress towards our goals.
    
    1. Use of the project management tool Asana is required.
    
    2. This includes delegating tasks to other team members, such as Specialists, as well as our clients and then ensuring that these tasks are completed in a timely manner.
    
    3. In pods where Project Managers are present, Strategists will ensure they partner with Project Managers to ensure all tasks are created, assigned and due dates are met and communicated to the client
    
    4. Strategists will work closely with content writers and designers to complete content campaigns for clients on time while also being responsible for ensuring that the quality is up to client standards.

 4. Internal and External Communication: Strategists are the main interface between our clients and our team. Strategists are expected to build relationships with our clients that goes beyond just deliverables and get to know them on a human level with the primary goal of being the best consultant for our clients and their business. Additionally Strategists are expected to proactively communicate to clients and internal leadership on a regular basis to ensure we are driving the best results for clients.
    
    1. When proactively communicating with clients we want to ensure we communicate timeline expectations for deliverables, goal attainment progress, and actively use our shared communication channels, such as Slack, to communicate between bi-weekly meetings. This includes sending deliverables on a regular cadence instead of only during bi-weekly meetings
    
    2. When proactively communicating with internal leadership this should include communicating any roadblocks, opportunities for account growth, and any moments of change on clients accounts. Moments of change can look like a needed change in strategy, internal client marketing changes, point of contact changes, and more.

 5. Reporting: Strategists are expected to regularly report to clients the progress and impact of their strategy. In support of this pilar strategists are expected to report on the following cadence:
    
    1. Bi-weekly meetings with the client
       
       1. Note in these meetings strategists are expected to report on NSM progress and ongoing deliverables
    
    2. Monthly reports
    
    3. Quarterly reports
    
    4. 2 Bi-Annual business review presentation
    
    

What You'll Bring:

 - A proven track record of success around implementing SEO principles and content strategy: keyword research, on-page optimization, and link building

 - Analytical insight: ability to analyse website traffic and SEO metrics using tools like Google Analytics

 - Strong Communication skills: comfortable client facing and owning relationships with key stakeholders

 - Strong familiarity with industry tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMRush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog/crawling tools

 - Proven organisational, project, and time management skills

 - Genuine enthusiasm for digital marketing, SEO and Content

 - Must have agency experience

 - Must have B2B tech and/or SaaS experience

 - Driven to stay ahead of industry trends, including actively learning how AI and automation can enhance marketing and operations.



Goals:

 1. NSM Attainment: 100%

 2. MRR Retainment: 96%

 3. CSAT > 4.2

 4. Upsells / Cross-sells / Referrals -
    
    1. Strategists are expected to regularly look for opportunities for our clients to grow their business with Directive.
       
       1. Examples of this include:
          
          1. Growing into another service line such as SEO or Paid Media
          
          2. Growing within their current service line such as increasing content, SEO, or Paid Media budgets
    
    2. Referrals are a natural extension of building a solid relationship with our clients and strategists should be in the habit of asking for a referral at key moments.
       
       1. Example of moments to ask for a referral:
          
          1. Point of contact starts a new job
    
    3. Client leaves a 5 CSAT score



What We Offer

🏠 Compensation for this role includes a competitive base salary in the $75,000-95,000 USD range, commensurate with experience and geography.

🙏  Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle

Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents

Benefits to Support the Whole Person:

🧠  Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace

💪  Physical - Gympass

🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave

💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match

🌟  Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time

🌴  Annual Anniversary Trip with peers and executive leadership for fun and entertainment! 



Work Environment Requirements

As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from your home office. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.

This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.



Additional Information

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We’re committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse (RN) - International Medical Escort (PRN)
jobs.description:
Employment Type: PRN

Schedule: Flight schedules, hours, and international travel will vary based on operational needs.

We are seeking experienced Registered Nurses to provide standby medical oversight and in-flight support for medically cleared individuals during domestic and international transportation.

As the RN supporting individuals who have been evaluated and cleared for travel, you’ll provide clinical monitoring and judgment and be prepared to provide BLS emergency response should an unexpected medical need arise.

This opportunity is well suited for experienced Emergency Department, Intensive Care Unit, critical care, transport, and acute-care nurses who are comfortable working independently outside a traditional hospital setting. Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

• Monitor individuals during flight for changes in physical or behavioral health status.

jobs.title: Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant (South End)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant, internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist, at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Americas
jobs.description:
ABOUT THIS ROLE

Hi, I’m Loren https://www.linkedin.com/in/lfoseid/, the Head of Strategic Customer Success here at Ashby. My team is dedicated to building deep, consultative partnerships within the Enterprise space. 

Our Customer Success Team is passionate about shaping and scaling an exceptional upmarket customer experience across the Enterprise Segment. We’re thrilled to be hiring our next Strategic CSM as we continue to grow the team.

In this role, you'll guide Ashby's biggest customers - focusing on improved product adoption and increased customer health. You will shape how we serve customers ranging from high growth organizations to public companies.

Ashby is designed to be powerful and flexible, allowing users to adjust it to their needs. This means that there is a lot to learn. You will become a product and domain expert in order to enable our customers to make the best use of Ashby to drive hiring excellence.

Role Requirements:

 - You have a strong track record of customer success experience in B2B SaaS (at least five years), supporting the implementation and adoption of complex technologies through the customer journey.

 - You’re comfortable managing a book of ~20 strategic customers, exceeding $2m in total ARR. You enjoy multi-threading, developing relationships across a broad set of stakeholders while supporting existing teams to drive adoption and retention.

 - You have experience working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations.

 - You love becoming a product and industry expert. You create ‘Ah ha!’ moments by tailoring configuration, driving product adoption, and crafting training to address a customer’s specific challenges so they achieve their intended business outcomes.

 - You’ve worked with technically complex products and show a strong curiosity to explore details and understand how things work.

You Should Apply If:

 - 📣 You communicate with precision and clarity. You can take something complex (like a multi-layered report or a nuanced workflow) and explain it simply and confidently.

 - 🎧 You are a listener first. You seek to understand what customers actually need and then advocate for them internally to shape how Ashby evolves for enterprise use cases.

 - ⚙️You thrive in complexity. Ashby is powerful and highly configurable; you’re energized by learning a product with depth, and you can translate that knowledge into creative solutions for your customers.

 - 🧑‍🏫 You’re excited to help shape a new segment. Our Strategic customer motion is still evolving; you’ll be iterating on playbooks, helping us learn what works, and turning those learnings into repeatable processes for the team.

 - 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You send crisp follow-up emails, on time. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.

 - 📊 You are always looking for ways to improve your work through data.

 - 👥You may have been a recruiter, hiring manager, or interviewer before. That experience helps you quickly connect Ashby’s workflows to real-world hiring problems (though it’s not required).

Why you shouldn’t apply:

 - You prefer managing a broad, high-volume book of business (if so, see our Mid-Market or Startup roles).

 - You're interested in managing customer accounts with infrequent and well-defined touchpoints (rather than excited by the fluidity required of early stage CS work).

 - You shine as an exclusively commercial CSM, motivated by variable compensation. While our team's north star metric is revenue retention, we focus on adoption and engagement as leading indicators. For renewal negotiation and upsell, we have a remarkable team of Contract Managers. As such, this role does not currently include variable pay, aligning with our strategy to hire product-oriented CSMs rather than adhering to the conventional Account Manager model.

 - You’re afraid of rolling up your sleeves. If the idea of getting in the weeds with a customer about the nuance between a time in process report and a time to hire report feels too granular, or project managing a workflow change for offer approvals isn’t interesting, this job isn’t going to be for you.


ABOUT ASHBY

We’re building the next generation of enterprise software, and we’re starting with a suite of products that help talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. 

https://www.ashbyhq.com/%EF%BF%BC%EF%BF%BCWeWe are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!). Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. In short, it's the perfect time to join! 🚀



INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is thorough — we aim to ensure each person that joins the team is the right fit for Ashby and will provide ample information for you to assess if Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is as follows:

 - Intro Call with Ashby Recruiting - 30 Minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview - 45 Minutes

 - Mock Customer Call - 45 Minutes

 - Final Round - 1 hour
   
   - Rather than a traditional panel interview with a large group, we structure our panel into two focused conversations. This gives you the opportunity to meet with multiple team members in a more conversational setting centered on specific topics, instead of a formal Q&A. You'll discuss how you approach problem solving, dive into a product complexity exercise, then wrap up with a quick closing call with the hiring manager.


BENEFITS

 - You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. We also offer a 3% 401k match.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


INFORMATION SYSTEMS SECURITY ENGINEER (PRINCIPAL)


ABOUT THE ROLE

Snowflake's national security deployments are authorized to operate inside classified environments, and each authorization stands or falls on the security documentation behind it. This role owns that documentation. You assess the system against its security control baseline, assemble the evidence the authorizing official reviews, and you are accountable for the package getting to authorization on schedule.

Arc Reactor, a classified deployment for a US government customer, is the immediate assignment. The same work will apply to the deployments that follow it.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Lead the security control assessment for an assigned deployment, from control selection and tailoring through the body of evidence to authorization.

 - Produce the assessment plan, the evidence collection schedule and the residual risk that goes to the authorizing official, and keep them current.

 - Direct the engineers and security staff producing control artifacts. Tell them which evidence to collect, review what they produce, and catch gaps in the requirements before they surface during assessment.

 - Be the person who can explain a Snowflake control implementation to a government security reviewer, and explain a reviewer's finding back to the engineering team in terms they can act on.

 - Track authorization status and blockers, and report them weekly to the engineering lead and the program.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - You have taken at least one system through authorization to operate under a government security control framework (NIST 800-53 / RMF, FedRAMP, or the DoD RMF and its Impact Levels), and you can point to the package you were responsible for.

 - You can read an engineering implementation and decide which control it satisfies and what evidence it produces.

 - You have worked with government authorizing officials or security control assessors, and you know what they reject and why.

 - You write the plan down. Assessment scope, control status, evidence gaps and residual risk live in a document the team can run without you, not in your head.

 - You are eligible for TS/SCI with a full-scope polygraph, or already hold it.


HOW THIS TEAM WORKS

The ISSE does not work alone and does not do all the collection. Engineers and supporting security staff produce the artifacts; you decide what is needed, review it, and own the result. The role reports into national security engineering and sits in the deployment's weekly engineering and security cadence. The work is done from the Washington, DC area, with regular time on site.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Why join us

Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

Recruiting at Brex

Recruiting is where every career at Brex begins. We’re the first point of connection for future builders and leaders, helping candidates see what’s possible. We partner with leaders across the company to find exceptional talent and build high-performing teams. We move quickly, think strategically, and take pride in creating a thoughtful, welcoming candidate experience from the very first contact. We don’t just fill roles, we shape the culture at Brex, finding the next generation of builders and leaders.

What you’ll do

As a Recruiter on the Business Recruiting team, you play a pivotal role in scaling the critical G&A and GTM functions at Brex. You will work closely with hiring managers to create the strategy and roadmap to attract the best talent to Brex. As the expert in talent acquisition, you will help attract, evaluate, and hire the best for our business teams. We are moving quickly so you will own projects and programs extending beyond the typical recruiting activities, ensuring process excellence and top-notch experience for all candidates.

Where you’ll work

This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

Responsibilities

• Partner closely with GTM hiring managers to create hiring strategies and ensure a strong pipeline of candidates

• Proactively source passive candidates through various channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter and networking

• Own the full candidate experience from sourcing to close, ensuring a seamless and engaging hiring process

• Create comprehensive talent maps to share insights on the talent market

• Represent Brex to candidates, helping to find and attract exceptional talent

• Interview candidates combining various methods (e.g. structured interviews, technical assessments, and behavioral questions)

Requirements

• 1+ years of full-cycle high volume recruiting experience

• Strong ability to build relationships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and providing strategic hiring support

• Strong organizational skills to coordinate recruiting efforts across multiple stakeholders

• Knowledge of HR practices and employment practices

• Must be willing to work in office 3 days per week on Monday, Wednesday and Thursday

Bonus points

• Experience with a modern recruiting tech stack. We use Greenhouse ATS, Modernloop andGem

• Experience working in a high-growth startup or a staffing firm

Compensation

The expected salary range for this role is $96,728 - $120,910. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demand

jobs.title: Phlebotomist / Administrative Assistant (Seaport)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a One Medical Phlebotomist/Administrative Assistant, internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist, at one of our offices, you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices

The range for this role is $24 to $26 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place Monday - Friday  between 7:30am-6:30pm based at our Seaport office in Boston, MA.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Director of Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B performance marketing agency that delivers real revenue—not just leads.

We use Customer Generation (a marketing methodology developed by us) to cut through the noise. Forget MQLs—we’re here to drive pipeline, fuel SQLs, and scale brands that are serious about growth. From Paid Media and SEO to CRO, RevOps, and Go-To-Market Strategy, we build marketing engines that win in SaaS and across B2B industries.

We move fast. We think boldly. We are elite. We hire people who challenge the status quo and push campaigns past what’s expected - sparking demand for bold, innovative brands. If you live for performance, love solving hard problems, and want your work to actually mean something, you’ll fit right in.

But here’s the fun part—we don’t just deliver results; we’re shaping the future of marketing. Ready to build something that breaks the mold?



Directive is seeking a hands-on Director of Finance & Accounting to oversee the accounting function behind a leading B2B performance marketing agency. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you’ll run close, reporting, controls and treasury, while having FP&A responsibilities.


Direct Reports:

 - Controller

 - IT Department
   

Top Priorities:

 - Move the finance department into a more strategic function. The primary opportunity is strengthening our labor model, optimizing staffing and billable utilization, and driving disciplined cost management to expand direct margins and overall profitability.

 - Be a strong voice with department heads so budgets have power and under-performance can be wisely identified.

 - Create a strong understanding/model of how growth investments impact EBITDA and ensure we are optimized in our capital allocation.

 - Deep improvement of tax planning. With strong EBITDA, we need better tax planning. We are weak here.

 - Build visibility into capital investment and have strong hypothesis around outcomes and timelines. It’s important that we are able to invest cash while still growing EBITDA.

 - Build a high-performance financial operating engine that enhances visibility, margin discipline, and scalability as we prepare the business for long-term growth, incubation opportunities and potential future capital events.

 - Become investment ready. We are going to market in the next 36 months and need the right financial leadership in place.

Role and Responsibilities:

 1. Close and Reporting: Holding team accountable for a timely and GAAP-compliant 5 day financial close. Deliver financial reports and department P&Ls.

 2. Controls: Design and enforce accounting policies, internal controls and segregation of duties.

 3. Treasury: Cash is the most important number for Directive. Need to ensure it is managed at safe levels and continues to grow
    
    1. Properly monitor AR/AP process to keep overdue receivables down and escalate when necessary

 4. Revenue & Margin: Oversee revenue recognition for retainer and project-based client contracts. Prepare FP&A report to support the company’s gross margin and EBITDA targets.

 5. Treasury & Banking: Manage cash, banking relationships and 13-week cash flow forecast.

 6. Team Leadership: Manage and develop the Controller, who covers AR/AP reconciliations and close support.

 7. Systems & Processes: Improve system and reporting automation.
    

Goals:

 1. 65% Gross Margin

 2. 35% ADJ. EBITDA
    

Requirements:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; CPA a bonus

 - 10+ years of progressive experience in finance and accounting roles, with at least 5 years in a leadership position within performance marketing agencies

 - Experience in a digital agency or similar services related industries a plus

 - Strong knowledge of financial regulations, accounting principles, and financial management systems

 - Proven ability to hold business units accountable to budget and goals

 - Solid understanding and experience with tax regulations and compliance

 - Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities



What We Offer:

 - 🏠 We have a set living wage at Directive; the actual salary may vary based on Directive's compensation practices, job related skills, and depth of experience

 - 🙏 Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle
   
   - Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents (US, CAD, MX)

 - Benefits to Support the Whole Person:
   
   - 🧠 Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
   
   - 💪 Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
   
   - 🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
   
   - 💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
   
   - 🌟 Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time
   
   - 🌴 Annual Company-wide Retreat



Work Environment Requirements

As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from your home office. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.

This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.



Additional Information

At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We’re committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Executive Creative Director
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.



Job Responsibilities

 - Set the creative standard for Socure. Define what excellent work looks like, hold every team, vendor and campaign to it, and give direct, specific feedback that visibly improves the work and raises the bar for creative outputs.

 - Define and lead the global creative strategy, setting a multi-year vision and roadmap for Socure's brand and creative function to align with business goals.

 - Build and lead the in-house creative organization. Recruit, hire, develop and retain designers, art directors, motion designers, content creators and creative managers, and define the team structure as the function scales.

 - Direct breakthrough creative for flagship campaigns, advertising, web, video, events and product launches, with work that is distinctive and recognizably Socure.

 - Serve as the final authority on global creative standards. Build and evolve the brand and design system so teams across regions and channels can produce consistent, high-quality work quickly.

 - Oversee the end-to-end creative lifecycle, from brief to concept to production to delivery. Optimize workflows (for example Agile Design) for high-velocity delivery without lowering quality, and measure output, speed and impact.

 - Partner with executive leadership, Product, Marketing, Sales and Engineering so creative initiatives directly support business strategy, revenue and product goals.

 - Manage vendor partnerships. Decide what to build in-house and what to buy, and keep production scalable and cost-effective.

 - Lead the selection and implementation of creative technology, including DAM systems and AI design tools, and define the organization's approach to generative AI in creative workflows, covering production efficiency, copyright and brand safety.

 - Oversee creative risk management, balancing innovation with brand integrity and commercial goals.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, acting as a strategic advisor and advocate for creative excellence.


JOB REQUIREMENTS

 - Bachelor's degree in design, art direction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. A master's degree is not required.

 - 12+ years of progressive experience in creative leadership roles, with at least 5 years as a Creative Director, Executive Creative Director or Head of Creative leading managers as well as individual contributors.

 - Proven experience at a high-growth technology or SaaS scale-up, ideally B2B, where you raised the creative bar and built an in-house team into a multidisciplinary function.

 - A portfolio and case studies showing brand-defining work and its business impact, such as a rebrand, a market-defining campaign, or a measurable step change in quality and consistency that you drove.

 - Expert-level art direction and taste across brand, digital, motion, video, experiential and advertising, with a track record of building and extending design systems and brand standards globally.

 - Demonstrated success recruiting, developing and retaining creative talent, including coaching creative managers and building career paths.

 - Experience managing large budgets, external agencies and high-value vendor partnerships.

 - Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate business objectives into creative strategy and to measure creative ROI using performance and audience data.

 - Experience making complex technical products clear, credible and culturally relevant. Experience in trust-driven categories such as security, fintech or infrastructure is a plus.

 - Track record of running scalable creative operations that deliver speed and quality together.

 - A practical point of view on AI-assisted creative workflows, including governance, brand safety and copyright. Advanced proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite and modern creative and project management tools.

 - Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to present and defend creative decisions to the C-suite and influence at all levels.

 - Commitment to continuous learning, professional integrity and high standards of business ethics.


SUCCESS PROFILE: HIGH-PERFORMING EXECUTIVE CREATIVE DIRECTOR AT SOCURE


CORE COMPETENCIES

 - Creative Standard-Setting: Defines what excellent looks like, raises the bar across the organization, and gives feedback that improves the work.

 - Visionary Creative Leadership: Sets and articulates a compelling creative vision and inspires teams to achieve it.

 - Strategic Influence: Shapes organizational thinking on brand and creative direction and influences executive stakeholders.

 - Team Building: Builds, scales, mentors and retains an in-house creative team, including its managers.

 - Operational Excellence: Manages projects, resources and budgets to deliver high-quality work on time and within scope.

 - Business Acumen: Integrates business strategy, market trends and customer insight into creative solutions that drive measurable impact.

 - Change Agility: Leads through ambiguity, drives adoption of new technologies and processes, and adapts as the business scales.

 - Collaboration: Builds strong partnerships across disciplines and levels and fosters a culture of inclusion and teamwork.


MODEL BEHAVIORS

 - Champions a culture of craft, creativity and continuous improvement, and is visibly the person who sets the bar.

 - Proactively identifies opportunities to advance the brand and the business through creative solutions.

 - Seeks and integrates feedback from executive leadership, customers and industry peers.

 - Empowers managers and teams by delegating authority, providing guidance and encouraging creative risk-taking.

 - Hires and promotes people who are stronger than they are in a given craft.

 - Demonstrates resilience and adaptability when priorities shift.

jobs.title: Preventive Medicine Physician
jobs.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

To support our growing network of clinics and clinical services, we are building the preventive health system of the future. We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and highly collaborative physician to join Prenuvo Medical Group as a Preventive Medicine Physician working out of our Chicago clinic.

This position combines direct patient care with clinical education, quality improvement, and strategic leadership. The physician will contribute to a defined leadership portfolio aligned with their experience and organizational priorities. Within the broader clinical team, nurse practitioners (NPs) provide excellent care within established consult and clinical pathways, while the physician manages the exceptions, assumes physician-specific supervisory responsibilities, and helps define and govern the clinical standards within which the broader team practices.

The ideal candidate will have an M.D. or D.O. degree, at least five years of clinical experience, and a strong foundation in primary care and evidence-based disease prevention. We are looking for someone who can operate independently in a rapidly evolving environment, translate clinical concerns into practical solutions, and take meaningful projects from early concept through execution.

Experience or demonstrated interest in medical genetics, genomics, longevity medicine, advanced imaging, biomarkers, and emerging preventive health technologies is strongly preferred.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

• Conduct high-quality telehealth and in-person consultations with patients following Prenuvo imaging and other preventive assessments, providing clear education, clinical context, and appropriate follow-up guidance.

• Help patients understand imaging findings, laboratory results, risk factors, and evidence-based preventive strategies without replacing the role of their established primary care physician or specialist.

• Collaborate with radiologists and other clinical specialists to support the patient journey from screening results to appropriate clinical follow-up.

• Serve as a supervising or collaborating physician for Nurse Practitioners as required and determined by business need.

• Manage top-tier clinical escalations for complex, urgent, or high-risk cases outside standard NP protocols, including discordant findings, serious patient concerns, and physician-to-physician coordination.

• Participate in clinical quality and safety review, including serious events, complex complaints, potential deviations from standards of care, and higher-level peer or case review. Execute on assigned related education and projects.

• Participate in physician coverage for critical-result workflows, including international consultations where appropriate. Serve as backup coverage for other physicians, as needed.

• Develop expertise in Prenuvo’s evolving clinical products, technologies, and workflows, including whole-body MRI, advanced neuroimaging, body composition analysis, cardiac imaging applications, laboratory testing, and genetics or genomics services as applicable.

• Assume responsibility for a defined physician leadership portfolio based on experience, organizational priorities, and team needs, and leading or contributing to assigned focused clinical projects with clear objectives, deliverables, timelines, outcome measures, dependencies, and escalation needs.

• Help establish and approve clinical standards, appropriateness criteria, escalation pathways, protocols, and medical risk boundaries, including physician review or signature where required.

• Identify clinical, operational, or patient-safety improvement opportunities and recommend practical, proportionate solutions informed by the available evidence and potential risk.

• Partner with Quality, Radiology, Nursing, Product, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Marketing, Sales, and other teams to translate clinical standards into safe, accurate, and operationally feasible workflows, patient communications, and educational resources.

• Provide physician-level clinical validation, risk assessment, and safety input for new products, services, AI tools, imaging pathways, and patient-facing communications before launch.

• Assess emerging technologies and clinical decision-support systems for clinical utility, limitations, and regulatory considerations to inform adoption decisions.

• Develop and deliver clinical education for physicians, nurse practitioners, other healthcare professionals, enterprise partners, and internal teams, and supporting clinician development and mentorship while respecting established operational and reporting structures.

• Represent Prenuvo in physician-to-physician interactions with enterprise partners, referring clinicians, professional conferences, media, and external clinical stakeholders.

• Proactively escalate any scheduling constraints, project dependencies, and competing priorities.

• Stay informed about developments in preventive medicine, medical imaging, digital health, genetics, artificial intelligence, clinical regulation, and evidence-based longevity science.

• Support Chicago in-clinic staff with appropriate escalations as needed.

What You’ll Bring

• An M.D. or D.O. degree from an accredited U.S. medical school or an equivalent domestic or international institution.

• An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in Illinois, with the ability and willingness to obtain and maintain licensure in additional states as required.

• Board certification in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Preventive Medicine, or another relevant primary care specialty.

• At least five years of clinical experience in primary care, preventive medicine, lifestyle medicine, integrative medicine, or a closely related field.

• Experience providing personalized preventive care, including risk-based disease prevention, lifestyle counseling, and coordination of appropriate clinical follow-up.

• Strong telehealth experience and confidence conducting complex virtual patient consultations.

• Experience or demonstrated expertise in genetics, genomics, longevity medicine, biomarkers, advanced imaging, or emerging preventive technologies is strongly preferred.

• The ability to understand clinical evidence, recognize the limitations of emerging tests and technologies, and communicate uncertainty responsibly.

• A record of taking initiative, making reasonable first-draft decisions, and advancing projects without waiting for perfect information or complete consensus.

• The ability to translate a concern into a clear description of the evidence, patient or organizational risk, and a proposed solution.

• Demonstrated experience developing clinical programs, educational materials, quality initiatives, policies, protocols, or other measurable work products.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to educate patients, clinicians, business leaders, and nonclinical stakeholders.

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work productively across clinical, operational, technical, legal, and commercial teams.

• Comfort using electronic medical records, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, virtual communication tools, and other healthcare technology platforms.

• Familiarity with artificial intelligence, LLMs, clinical decision-support tools, or digital health product development is preferred.

• Excellent judgment, organization, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.

• The ability to manage competing priorities and execute reliably in an ambiguous, fast-growing, evolving healthcare environment.

• Prior healthcare startup or innovation experience is preferred.

• A strong commitment to patient confidentiality, ethical clinical practice, evidence-based care, and professional accountability.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

• Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

• We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

• We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

• An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health

• We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member

• Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way

• Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize

• Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it

• We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!

• Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family

• The base salary for this role ranges from $240,000 to $300,000 per year, depending upon experience.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [prenuvo.com]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

jobs.title: Director, NPI Operations Engineering
jobs.description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors https://www.skydio.com/solutions/energy-and-utilities to first responders https://www.skydio.com/solutions/public-safety, soldiers in battlefield scenarios https://www.skydio.com/solutions/national-security/tactical-isr, and beyond https://www.skydio.com/solutions.

About the Role:

The NPI Operations Engineering leader builds and leads the team responsible for making Skydio's next generation of autonomous robotics, including drones, docks and accessories, at our internal manufacturing facility in Hayward. You’ll deliver the process, manufacturing know-how and technology needed to build the most capable flying robots on the planet. The team combines Manufacturing Design Engineering and Supply Base Engineering into one organization that is 100% focused on new product development.

You will own the manufacturability of every new product: assembly time, assembly yield and the processes, fixtures, equipment and supplier readiness needed to hit them. You and your team will engage with Product Engineering from early architecture, carry products through EVT, DVT and PVT, and hand them to Process Engineering for sustaining once they meet clear production-readiness criteria.

This is a leadership role with significant scope to shape how Skydio develops hardware. You'll set the team's direction, hire and grow engineers, and be the single operations voice in product development. Sustaining engineering for products already in production sits with Process Engineering, so this team stays focused on getting new products right before they reach the line.



How You’ll Make an Impact:


OWN MANUFACTURABILITY OF NEW PRODUCTS

 - Own the operations engineering development for NPI programs across supply chain and in-house manufacturing

 - Drive design-for-manufacturing, assembly and serviceability (DFx) input from early architecture onward

 - Set and commit to assembly time and assembly yield targets for each new product, and track them at every build

 - Own operations sign-off at product development gates, and escalate manufacturability risks with clear trade-offs

 - Use PFMEA, DFM reviews and prototype yield, quality and process data to align product design with manufacturing strategy

 - Identify manufacturing risks early and drive mitigation plans to closure before production ramp


LEAD NPI EXECUTION THROUGH PRODUCTION READINESS

 - Own the manufacturing plan for new products and major design changes, from prototype through PVT

 - Define assembly flow, line layout, fixtures and equipment for new products, with labor, cost and capacity estimates that sharpen at each build

 - Coordinate engineering, design and production validation builds with Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Test and Quality

 - Define production-readiness and handoff criteria, and lead manufacturing readiness reviews

 - Develop and continuously improve Skydio's NPI process

 - Transfer products to Process Engineering with complete documentation, released tooling, and yield and cycle time at target


DEVELOP PROCESSES, FIXTURES AND ASSEMBLY EQUIPMENT

 - Own development and validation of assembly processes, including mechanical assembly, electronics integration, adhesive bonding, fastening, soldering and calibration

 - Own design and qualification of assembly fixtures, error-proofing, and assembly equipment such as dispense systems and torque-controlled drivers

 - Own the capital budget for new-product assembly fixtures and equipment. Capital for the running production line stays with Manufacturing

 - Develop process specifications, control plans, component and assembly CTQs, inspections, inline tests, work instructions and manufacturing BOMs, all complete before handoff

 - Use statistical process control (SPC), capability studies and structured experiments to establish robust process windows


DEVELOP CORE MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGIES

 - Build a roadmap of core process technologies that future products depend on, such as waterproofing and ingress protection, conformal coatings, sealing and advanced bonding

 - Partner with material suppliers, equipment vendors and technology partners to develop, qualify and industrialize these processes ahead of product need

 - Serve as the technical owner for these technologies after production launch


LEAD SUPPLY BASE ENGINEERING FOR NEW PRODUCTS

 - Drive supplier selection, part qualification and supplier process readiness for new products

 - Own NPI automation at the process level during development, and partner with the Factory Automation team for production handoff

 - Work with suppliers on component DFM, process capability, capacity and quality before production launch

 - Partner with Supply Chain and Quality on make-versus-buy decisions, supplier development and capital business cases


LEAD AND BUILD THE TEAM

 - Set the vision, strategy and execution plan for NPI Operations Engineering

 - Lead, hire and develop a team of manufacturing design engineers and supply base engineers, acting as the team's lead technical expert and mentor

 - Integrate MDE and SBE into one team with shared programs, goals and ways of working

 - Set priorities and staffing across multiple concurrent programs and SKUs at different stages, working with leaders across the company to understand build targets and focus the team on hitting them

 - Protect the team's focus on new products, with a clean handoff to Process Engineering for sustaining

 - Build an inclusive, diverse, engaged and high-performing team through a mix of external hiring and developing internal talent, with regular coaching and growth opportunities

 - Build a culture of technical rigor, ownership and close partnership with design engineering


COLLABORATION

 - Work closely with Product Engineering leaders on airframes, propulsion, cameras, sensors, batteries, gimbals and payloads

 - Align with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Test Engineering and Automation Engineering on capacity, equipment and handoff plans

 - Communicate program status, risks and manufacturability trade-offs clearly to executive leadership
   
   

What Makes You a Good Fit:

 - Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial or Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

 - 10+ years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, NPI or production engineering for complex electromechanical products, ideally including high-volume production.

 - [4+] years leading engineering teams, including hiring and developing engineers [and managers].

 - A track record of taking multiple complex hardware products from early development into high-quality production.

 - Deep expertise in DFM/DFA and a history of influencing product design early, not only fixing problems at the build.

 - Hands-on fixture design experience, and a strong understanding of factory lines, assembly flow and how to optimize them.

 - SPC, Lean and Six Sigma experience.

 - Experience working with suppliers on part qualification, process capability and production readiness.

 - Strong data skills: you set yield, cycle-time and cost targets, measure them and use the data to drive decisions.

 - Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, working collaboratively with people at every level, from technicians to executive leadership.

 - Strong project management, analytical skills and attention to detail, with sound independent judgment on complex, broad-scope problems.

 - Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving products, and willingness to be on the floor during critical builds.

 - Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with drones, aerospace, robotics, autonomous systems or consumer electronics.

 - Experience developing waterproofing and ingress-protection solutions (IP-rated products), conformal coating, sealing or adhesive processes.

 - Experience with PCBAs, cameras and optics, gimbals, inertial sensors, motors, batteries or composite structures.

 - Experience working with contract manufacturers or managing NPI across in-house and outsourced production.
   
   

Compensation: At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $229,500 - $302,500*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans.
