jobs.title: Senior Manager, Field Operations and Customer Data Management
jobs.description:
Amylyx has an audacious mission to usher in a new era for treating diseases with high unmet needs. Where others see challenges, we see opportunities that we pursue with urgency, rigorous science, and unwavering commitment to the communities we serve. We are a clinical-stage company currently focused on post-bariatric hypoglycemia (PBH), Wolfram syndrome, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS).

Our mission is powered by our people. Our core values – be audacious, be curious, be authentic, be engaged, and be accountable – creating a culture of caring. Amylyx has assembled an experienced team ready to take action because the communities we serve have no time to wait. If you share our passion and are determined to tackle some of medicine’s toughest problems, we encourage you to read the opportunity below and apply.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Director, Field Operations & Data Management, the Senior Manager, Field Operations & Customer Data Management is a hands-on, execution-focused role within Commercial Operations. This position will support the reliable movement and use of customer and field data across the commercial data ecosystem, including CRM, specialty pharmacy, claims, hub, and other third-party data sources. The Senior Manager will work closely with data aggregators, source-data vendors, Information Technology, analytics partners, and field stakeholders to ensure data is delivered accurately, consistently, and on schedule into Amylyx data warehouses and downstream reporting solutions.

This role is highly tactical and detail oriented. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in the data, investigating issues, coordinating fixes, validating outputs, documenting processes, and resolving the daily operational challenges that can affect field execution. The role will also provide substantial support for customer targeting, field force sizing, territory alignment, roster and assignment maintenance, and the evaluation of new commercial data sources.

Responsibilities

• Customer data operations: Support the day-to-day receipt, processing, integration, validation, and availability of customer and commercial data, including CRM, specialty pharmacy, claims, affiliations, customer reference, field activity, and other vendor-supplied datasets.

• Data quality and issue resolution: Monitor recurring data deliveries and warehouse outputs; identify missing, late, incomplete, duplicated, or inconsistent data; conduct root-cause analysis; coordinate corrective actions; and follow issues through resolution.

• Vendor management: Serve as an operational point of contact for data and field operations vendors, including possible data aggregator. Manage delivery calendars, file specifications, data transfer dependencies, service expectations, issue logs, status updates, and follow-up actions.

• Data validation and reconciliation: Perform detailed quality control checks and reconciliations across source files, staging layers, warehouse tables, CRM outputs, vendor reports, and downstream dashboards; document findings and escalate material risks. Ensure quality data is available for incentive compensation administration.

• Data documentation and controls: Maintain business rules, source-to-target mappings, data dictionaries, file layouts, standard operating procedures, validation checklists, issue histories, and other documentation needed for repeatable and auditable operations.

• New data source evaluation: Support the assessment of potential new data sources by documenting business use cases, reviewing coverage and field definitions, evaluating quality and usability, coordinating sample-data testing, identifying integration requirements, and summarizing findings and tradeoffs.

• Stakeholder needs and data recommendations: Engage field teams, field leadership, Commercial leadership, Analytics, and other stakeholders to clarify business questions and operational needs. Translate requests into defined data requirements and recommend the data sources, measures, analyses, or reporting approaches best suited to answer the question, while clearly communicating data limitations and tradeoffs.

• Customer master and alignment support: Help maintain accurate customer, account, affiliation, territory, roster, and assignment data across relevant systems. Investigate and resolve alignment, ownership, hierarchy, and customer identity issues that affect field teams.

• Field targeting & alignment: Execute and maintain customer targeting processes, including data preparation, business-rule application, final list deployment. Support territory alignment activities, including geographic and customer-level analyses, scenario development, balance assessments etc.

• CRM and field support: Partner with CRM owners and field operations colleagues to troubleshoot customer, roster, territory, targeting, and data visibility issues; provide timely updates and practical solutions to field users and leadership.

• Operational coordination: Maintain project plans, action logs, decision records, recurring status materials, release calendars, and stakeholder communications across concurrent data and field operations workstreams.

• Continuous improvement: Identify recurring pain points and opportunities to improve data quality, vendor performance, controls, documentation, automation, and the efficiency of field operations processes.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree required in business, analytics, information systems, data management, life sciences, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, commercial operations, data operations, sales operations, CRM operations, analytics, or a related discipline.

• Hands-on experience working with commercial/customer data such as CRM, specialty pharmacy, claims, affiliations, customer master, targeting, roster, territory, or field activity data.

• Experience working with healthcare or commercial data aggregators and translating stakeholder questions into practical data requirements, source recommendations, or analytical approaches strongly preferred.

• Experience managing recurring data feeds and working with vendors and technical teams to investigate and resolve data delivery, transformation, quality, or availability issues.

• Working knowledge of commercial data warehouses, data integration processes, master data concepts, business rules, data quality controls, and downstream reporting dependencies.

• Experience supporting customer targeting, territory alignment, field force sizing, roster management, or other field operations processes strongly preferred.

• Advanced Excel skills required; experience with SQL, business intelligence tools, CRM platforms, data quality tools, geographic mapping tools, or data warehouse environments preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and persistence to trace issues across datasets, systems, vendors, and business processes.

• Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage recurring operational deliverables while responding effectively to urgent, unplanned issues.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical and business rules, explain issues, coordinate decisions, and provide concise status updates.

• Ability to build productive working relationships across Commercial Operations, field leadership, Analytics, Information Technology, Finance, Compliance, and external partners.

• High degree of accountability, organization, judgment, and comfort working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and incomplete information.

Work Location and Conditions:

• At Amylyx, we proudly support remote work opportunities within the United States. However, due to business considerations related to health insurance coverage and state tax regulations, we are unable to hire employees who reside and/or work in certain states. Currently, we are not considering applicants from Alaska and Hawaii.

• You will be expected to travel to our corporate location in Cambridge, MA several times a year and attend other company-related events as necessary and requested, which may include travel by air, driving or public transportation.

• You must have access to work in setting that meets all requirements of the role (including privacy, reliable internet access, phone, ability to communication via video conference, etc.) at your remote location.

Compensation

The pay range posted below represents our good faith estimate of compensation for this role, based on market data and internal benchmarks. The final offer may vary depending on a candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, as well as considerations of internal equity.

Estimated Pay Range

$162,000—$182,000 USD

jobs.title: Veterinary Assistant - Memorial Veterinary Hospital
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Veterinary Assistant | Memorial Veterinary Hospital | Dickson City and Throop, PA

Compensation: $17–$24/hour, commensurate with licensure and experience

Position Summary:

The Veterinary Assistant provides essential support to the veterinarian during outpatient exams and throughout the diagnosis and treatment of patients. They care for all patients, assist with medical procedures, and help ensure each patient receives high-quality, compassionate care. In this role, the Veterinary Assistant also serves as a key connection between the veterinarian and clients. Through exceptional service and communication, the Veterinary Assistant helps build trust and foster lasting relationships with clients and their pets.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provides compassionate, professional care to patients and clients at all times.

• Communicates clearly and respectfully with clients, doctors, and team members, including answering phones and routing inquiries as needed.

• Handles sensitive client situations with empathy and discretion, escalating medical questions appropriately.

• Assists the veterinarian during exams, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures.

• Safely restrains animals of varying sizes and temperaments using low-stress handling techniques.

• Administers medications, draws up vaccines, collects lab samples, and performs basic lab tests as directed.

• Creates, reviews, and enters treatment plans accurately in the medical record system.

• Educates clients on common vaccinations, medications, and treatment protocols to ensure understanding of care plans and follow-up recommendations.

• Accurately records patient information and maintains organized, up-to-date medical records.

• Enters charges accurately and assists with the client check-out process, including processing payments when needed.

• Ensures exam rooms, treatment areas, and hospital spaces are clean, stocked, and well maintained.

• Demonstrates consistent reliability, punctuality, and commitment to supporting patients, clients, and hospital operations.

• Performs all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• Basic computer proficiency, including the ability to use practice management software and Microsoft Office applications.

• Previous experience working with animals preferred; veterinary or animal care background strongly valued.

• Able to work safely around cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Maintains composure and professionalism in emotionally challenging or high-stress situations.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 130 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations.

Compensation and Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays and access to employee assistance program.

Ready to Learn More?

We look forward to learning about your unique priorities and goals and working together with our local hospital teams to support you.

jobs.title: PS Operations Data and Digital Specialist
jobs.description:
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta's North America Product Safety team is seeking a PS Operations Data and Digital Specialist in Greensboro, NC. As a PS Operations Data and Digital Specialist, you will be responsible for exploring and implementing innovative digital tools and solutions to drive business improvement and operational efficiency.

• Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement by evaluating emerging technologies and identifying scalable solutions that improve Product Safety operations, processes, and business outcomes.
• Collect, curate, assess, and maintain scientific data from databases, study reports, public literature, regulatory reviews, and other sources in consistent, usable formats. Ensure data quality, traceability, and fitness for downstream scientific and operational use.

• Experience using digital, data, reporting, or automation technologies, with working knowledge of tools or programming/scripting languages such as SQL, Python, R, Visual Basic, Power Apps, SharePoint, Smartsheet, or similar technologies.

Desired Qualifications:

• Experience developing or supporting databases, applications, automation, reporting, or other scalable digital solutions in a scientific, regulatory, Product Safety, or similar technical environment.
• Experience leading digital transformation, process improvement, or technology adoption initiatives, including stakeholder engagement and change management.

What We Offer:

• A culture that celebrates belonging and collaboration, promotes professional development and strives for a work-life balance that supports the team members. Offers flexible work options to support your work and personal needs.

• Paid Vacation, Paid Holidays, Maternity and Paternity Leave, Education Assistance, Wellness Programs, Corporate Discounts, among other benefits.

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Help Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Title: Help Desk Technician
Location: Hanscom, AFB
Program: BLITS 3.0
Clearance: Secret
 
Company/ Program Description: 
 
Centuria, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), has been delivering IT, Engineering, and Scientific solutions to the Federal Government since 2002. During our two decades of service we have earned the trust and respect of our government clients for the simple reason that we have great people who are experts in their fields and take pride and ownership in everything they do. 
 
The Washington Post has recognized Centuria Corporation as one of the top workplaces in the DC Metro area for 2024. This award celebrates nationally recognized companies that make the world a better place to work together by prioritizing a people-centered culture and giving employees a voice. The Top Workplaces USA award is based entirely on feedback from an employee engagement survey completed by the employees of participating workplaces. Centuria is honored to have been awarded this distinction.  
 
This role will be to directly support the mission of the 66th Air Base Group (66 ABG) to secure information and information systems; to support mission success through effective and efficient service delivery; and to sustain required infrastructure and capabilities. As one part of the greater Air Force Information Network (AFIN) enterprise, the 66 ABG Communications and Information Division (66 ABG/SC) has responsibilities in two categories (1) direct actions in support of Hanscom Air Force Base (HAFB) and geographically separated units (GSUs); and (2) indirect actions to support the AFIN enterprise. Successful solutions for this requirement are expected to have strengths in four areas: integration, flexibility, AFIN knowledge, and technical expertise. 
 
Job Responsibilities:
·        Complies with ticket procedures, creating tickets immediately when contact is made with the customer, updating tickets immediately after working on the issue, and reviewing the tickets assigned daily.
·        As part of an enterprise help desk team, handles daily maintenance and monitoring of managed hardware and software for Hanscom AFB clients and customers, both classified and unclassified systems
·        Comply with all ticket and call center metrics (measured in daily reports
·        Review tickets assigned daily and keep customers up to date on any and all changes.
·        Support client voice issues, to include VoIP and SIP services.
·        Staff “split / rotational” Client Service Center (Help Desk) phone shifts (coverage windows for phones run 730AM-430PM) depending on shift needs.
·        Conducts troubleshooting and repairs over the phone remotely utilizing Dameware, and in the office when a customer is able to bring the device in, and on-site with the customer when needed.
·        Deliver quality timely customer service while also meeting contract threshold metrics for phone and ticket resolutions.
·        Using Unit Software License Management procedures, install and troubleshoot authorized software for customers in a timely manner; ensures all software installed on customer organization systems is appropriately licensed, authorized, and recorded in the base software license inventory.
·        Supports and complies with established IT procedures (team and client usage)
·        Support classified NSA Type-1 encryption operations - may include COMSEC key -installation/coordination processes, device configurations and/or troubleshooting.
·        Support classified desktops / laptops which may be physical hardware based or virtualized desktop instantiations (VDI)
·        Ensures workstations, peripherals, communications devices, and operating system/application software are properly configured for network operation, are on-line, and are available to users.
·        Periodically reviews processes and procedures and client configurations for completeness, effectiveness and compliance with information assurance polices and DISA STIGs
·        Contacts the customer organization point of contact to coordinate hardware maintenance when necessary.
·        Implements software patches and security fixes when it cannot be done using enterprise SCCM.
·        Support expanded/ related IT project efforts as/if directed.
·        Install, configure, and troubleshoot multi-function devices and printers.
·        Ensure all changes to devices are annotated in Equipment Custodian Asset Management System (ECAM) to include computer names, and IP information for printers.
 
Job Requirements: 
·        Secret Level DoD Security Clearance - required (ability to get clearance with waiver possible if background check shows potential)
·        CompTIA Security+ certification - required (valid certification on day one of employment)
·        High School Diploma and 1-5 years of experience
·        CompTIA A+, and CompTIA Network+ certifications desired.
·        ITIL certification desired
·        Windows Desktop Operating Systems (Windows 10)
·        Working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory
·        Microsoft Office Products (O365/2016) Teams, Skype for Business, Outlook
·        Ability to resolve issues quickly and efficiently to comply with metric requirements.
·        Proficient with computer, network and server hardware
·        Strong troubleshooting skills on both hardware and software
·        Leadership skills
·        Strong customer service skills
·        Strong written and verbal communication skills
·        Self-motivated to work on behalf of the customer, the contract and section performance.
·        Ability to work in a team environment.
·      Stay up to date with evolving processes and procedures for regular troubleshooting and repairs.

jobs.title: H&M Seasonal Sales Advisor - West County
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $15.50 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: NVCAS visiting professor (part-time/remote)
jobs.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

Collaborating with national academic partners and colleagues, the NVCAS Visiting Professor (VP) provides strategies and academic reinforcement to nursing students throughout their academic program and until NCLEX-RN exam pass has been achieved. The NVCAS VP assesses learning styles, identifies strengths, and discovers opportunities for academic development while working with students virtually, either individually or in group setting. The NVCAS VP uses Evidence-Based strategies to foster deep-learning and clinical judgment in nursing students throughout the curriculum and in preparation for the NCLEX-RN exam. In addition, the NVCAS VP supports an array of projects including the development of resources to support the team to enhance the student learning experience.

Responsibilities

• Facilitate virtual tutoring and virtual workshops for nursing students

• Demonstrate current, detailed, accurate knowledge of current nursing practice as well as nursing concepts, client needs, the Next Generation NCLEX-RN Test Plan, and the clinical judgement model.

• Facilitate virtual NCLEX coaching and mentoring

• Assist in the creation of Next Generation NCLEX-RN virtual activities/case studies, and workshops

• Coordinate study materials to align with course objectives and the NCLEX-RN blueprint

• Attend virtual meetings to support NVCAS project needs

• Demonstrates effective behaviors and accountability in meeting the following standards of service, excellence to students, fellow team members, national team members external agencies

• Demonstrates friendliness and courtesy, professional environment, effective communication and collaboration, and first-class service in alignment with Chamberlain Care.

• Communicates and documents students’ academic and co-curricular progress toward achievement of student and program learning outcomes

• Performs other duties as assigned

• Complies with all policies and standards

EDUCATION

• Bachelor's Degree in Nursing Required and
• Master's Degree in Education or Master's Degree Nursing Preferred
• Doctoral Degree in Nursing Preferred

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS

• Maintenance of a current, unencumbered RN license (in any state) Required
• Compact Nurse Licensure Preferred
• Certification in nursing education (i.e. CNE) Preferred

WORK EXPERIENCE

• 2+ year experience as a Registered Nurse in a patient care setting Required
• 2+ year experience supporting Pre-Licensure nursing students and NCLEX-RN preparation in an academic environment (i.e. course instructor, clinical instructor, NCLEX instructor, nursing tutor, lab and simulation specialist, etc.) Required
• 2+ year experience with nursing education content development Preferred

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

• Excellent communication skills with proven ability to communicate via telephone and computer in a virtual environment.
• Excellent technology skills: Ability to learn multiple technology platforms to navigate and access virtual resources.
• Comfortable speaking on camera in a virtual individual, small, or large group setting.
• Must be a team player, willing to collaborate and communicate with other members of the team.
• Ability to work with individuals from diverse cultural and professional backgrounds, showing empathy and compassion while interacting with students and colleagues.
• Generalized knowledge of nursing education across the curriculum and NCLEX-RN, showing a passion for nursing education.
• Demonstrated working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (especially Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook).
• Demonstrated working knowledge of online teaching platforms (Canvas).
• Must be autonomous, self-driven.
• Must be flexible with scheduling and adaptable to change.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Must have excellent attention to detail and proofreading skills.

Chamberlain Visiting Professor Position - Online:

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is between $715/Earned Credit Hour to $1,261/Earned Credit Hour, depending on the candidate’s education and experience.

Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. jobs.title: IT Analyst
jobs.description:
This position is located onsite in our Morrisville, NC office.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Science 37 accelerates clinical research by expanding patient access to trials, leading to faster approvals and better health outcomes for all. Our solutions empower life sciences companies to reach diverse populations beyond traditional means of conducting clinical research.

The IT Analyst assists with daily helpdesk user issues, provides hands-on in-office technical support, supports facility and IT maintenance projects, and performs needed repairs and regular preventative maintenance of equipment. The IT Analyst will serve as the lead in managing equipment procurement, provisioning, and inventory control. The IT Analyst is responsible for supporting the Science 37 staff under the direction of the Associate Director, IT.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Duties include but are not limited to:

• Provide full user support including but not limited to service desk tickets, emails, direct messages, and IT hotline calls during assigned 24-hour on-call rotations

• Triage and assess all incoming requests/issues from any method of user communication (service desk, email, hotline calls, direct messages, walk-ups, etc.) and escalate to higher-tier support when necessary

• Provide in-person, walk-up support to office staff for hardware, software, account, and peripheral issues

• Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot conference rooms and meeting spaces, including video conferencing systems, displays, cameras, microphones, and other AV equipment; support meetings and events as needed

• Perform first-line network troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi connectivity, wired connections, switches, access points, and cabling, and escalate complex network issues to the appropriate team or vendor

• Set up and maintain office workstations, printers, and peripherals, including desk setups for new hires and office moves

• Assist with managing procurement/provisioning vendor relationships and related processes in support of user onboarding and offboarding activities

• Coordinate shipping and receiving of IT equipment for remote staff, including preparing and shipping devices for new hires, arranging returns during offboarding, processing repairs and replacements, and tracking shipments to keep inventory records accurate

• Independently create both internal and external training documentation and provide user training when necessary

• Collaborate with IT System Administrators on IT-related projects/tasks which may include but are not limited to new system implementations, system maintenance, routine audits/analysis, and other IT-related tasks

• Coordinate with the Security Team for the office’s physical security and access control

• Use expertise and experience to research and evaluate emerging technologies, hardware, and software

• Accurately convey information/requirements necessary for each project/task

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related technology field

• Strong technical knowledge of computers and mobile devices (Macs, iPhones, iPads, Android, etc.)

• Basic familiarity with Mobile Device Management (MDM) concepts and tools such as Jamf, Kandji, Intune, or Apple Business Manager, and with Apple Configurator for device setup; hands-on experience is a plus but not required, and training will be provided

• Hands-on experience troubleshooting basic network issues (Wi-Fi, switches, access points, cabling)

• Experience setting up and supporting conference room and AV equipment (e.g., Zoom Rooms, Google Meet hardware, displays, and audio systems)

• Knowledge of SSO (Okta)

• Understanding of access control and physical security measures

• Prior experience with in-person and remote user support and training

Skills/Competencies

• Demonstrated ability to successfully collaborate with people and manage projects/tasks

• Demonstrated ability to meet timelines for deliverables, and flexibility to get the work done

• Experience in managing multiple projects simultaneously and meeting expectations

• Proactive problem-solving abilities and follow-through

• Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing work environment and priorities

• Successful situational responsive decision-making

• Demonstrated ability to be resourceful

• Demonstrated ability to foster concepts of teamwork and cooperation

• Detail oriented

• Results oriented

• Exhibits excellent time management and organizational skills

• Exhibits responsibility, ownership, accountability, and pride in one’s work

• Customer service and interpersonal skills, including a professional, approachable presence for in-person support

Capabilities

• Ability to communicate in English (both verbal and written)

• Ability to ship/package/unpack equipment and supplies (up to 50 lbs.)

• Up to 20% travel, as needed for project team meetings, client presentations and other professional meetings/conferences as needed

BENEFITS

At Science 37, our focus is to provide you with a comprehensive and competitive total reward package that supports you at all stages of your career - both now and into the future. Our success depends on the knowledge, capabilities, and quality of our people. That’s why we are committed to developing our employees in a continuous learning culture – one where we challenge you with engaging work that adds to your professional development.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Controller
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/5ac97b31-49cd-4012-8bb0-5caf15e33c69/B25.png]




SENIOR FINANCE CONTROLLER, ACCRA, GHANA



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/aa0e5d84-98d7-46dc-ae5a-cfa6c37168f5/image.png]




YOUR BOOKS ARE CLEAN. DO THEY MEAN ANYTHING?



You're good at this. Your closes land on time, your reconciliations hold up under audit, and your team trusts your judgement. You're probably happy where you are. But when did you last sign off a set of accounts knowing that behind every line sat a real person: a first-time smartphone owner, a trader who started earning, a household that got light after dark?



At M-KOPA, the financial statements are not an abstraction. We serve over 7 million customers and have unlocked $2+ billion in credit. 55% of our customers are accessing formal financial services for the first time, 70% use our products to generate income, and 86% report an improved quality of life. Those figures only mean something if the numbers underneath them are right, and in Ghana, the person who makes sure of that is the Senior Finance Controller.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/098a0e4b-0cae-4b83-97c9-3c904c25da2c/image.png]




WHY YOU MAY BE SEEING SEVERAL FINANCE ROLES FROM US



If you've noticed us hiring across the business, that's deliberate. We grew from 5 million customers to 7 million, and we're building towards 10 million. Today that means 2,300+ employees, 35,000 agents, $45 million in taxes contributed, 2 million smartphones assembled in Kenya, and 4,000+ e-motorbikes financed, saving riders $5.62 a day.



Growth at that pace puts real weight on a finance function: more products, more entities, more regulatory surface, more audit scrutiny. We aren't adding people for the sake of it. We're building the close discipline and control environment that a 10-million-customer business needs, and we're doing it now rather than after something breaks.




WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM A TYPICAL CONTROLLERSHIP

Most controller roles ask you to protect a stable ledger. This one asks you to build rigour for a ledger that grows more complex every quarter. You'll account for a consumer credit book with expected credit losses under IFRS 9, revenue under IFRS 15, inventory, fixed assets and leases, and mobile money flows that rarely feature in traditional corporate finance.

You'll own the close in Ghana, work directly alongside the Senior Finance Manager, and have a genuine say in how our ERP, planning and reporting tools evolve. You'll also work with a team that's growing alongside the business, which means your judgement on who to coach, what to standardise and what to automate carries real weight. Process improvement here isn't a side project. It's part of the job, and the people who do it well shape how finance runs across the business.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/af98f776-34ca-40ef-bb29-bf9cd878603f/image.png]






WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A demonstrable record of running monthly, quarterly and annual closes to deadline, including review of journals, accruals, provisions, balance sheet reconciliations and intercompany balances, backed by a recognised professional accounting qualification (ACCA, ICAG, CPA, ACA or equivalent).

 - Proven working knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 9 and IFRS 15, applied to preparing management accounts and financial statements, together with hands-on experience supporting internal and external audits, including PBC lists and audit queries.

 - Extensive progressive experience in a supervisory accounting role, with strong Excel and ERP skills and a track record of owning statutory reporting and tax compliance, including VAT, withholding tax and payroll tax reconciliations.

Beyond the technical, you're meticulous, you communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you'd rather fix a broken process than work around it. If you've come from fintech, consumer finance, telecoms or another regulated environment, or have handled multi-entity consolidation, you'll recognise the terrain quickly. It helps, but it isn't a gate.




WHAT YOUR DAYS WILL LOOK LIKE

 - Running the close and the numbers that come out of it: reviewing journals, accruals, provisions and reconciliations, and turning them into management accounts and financial statements in line with IFRS and group policy.

 - Keeping the control environment honest: documenting controls, chasing down gaps until they're closed, applying accounting policy consistently, and meeting auditors with answers rather than excuses.

 - Coaching the accounting team while keeping statutory filings, tax accounts, and bank and mobile money reconciliations accurate and on time.

Success here is measured simply: closes delivered on time with few post-close adjustments, reconciliations reviewed when they should be, audit and control findings closed on schedule, and filings that are right the first time.




THE REALITY CHECK

This role is demanding. Close deadlines don't move, audit queries arrive on their own schedule, and a business growing this quickly won't pause while you reconcile. You'll be holding a team to a high standard of accuracy while also pushing process change, and sometimes both in the same week as a year-end close. The reward is a seat close to the work that matters, with finance treated as a function that shapes decisions rather than one that records them. And you're probably ready for exactly this.




LET'S TALK

If you're reading this and thinking that your next chapter should be one where the accounts carry weight beyond the audit opinion, that's probably the signal to explore it. Ready to build the finance discipline behind 10 million customers? Let's talk.




WHY M-KOPA?

At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility.



Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com http://m-kopa.com.



[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/369018b8-cf9c-49c7-95f1-1d414482ba57/B13.png]

Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/1d985516-2a99-43c0-b591-957f5adaceb9/481f6724-8375-4f39-b514-fbe00b8fc3b5/B13.png]

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Enterprise Governance
jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?




YOUR MISSION

We're seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Governance team. You'll drive product direction across human, robot, and agent identity, delegated and scoped authorization, guardrails, and audit and attribution for non-human actors, and you'll work the patterns the industry is still standardizing right now: on-behalf-of delegation chains, OAuth flows for autonomous callers, just-in-time elevation, sandboxing, and policy-as-code for tool access.

This is a high-agency, AI-native role. You will be deep in the product: testing, prototyping with coding agents, talking to customers, and turning what you learn into a coherent roadmap to build.

Your north star is an agentic enterprise’ trust translating into adoption: governance with required coverage, and monitoring, for enterprises; and frictionless for builders to code it in.


WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH

 - Own the 12–18 months roadmap for identity, auth, and access governance across UiPath's agentic platform, in coherence with company priorities and evolving standards in the ecoystem.

 - Evolve how identity works for agents, robots, and humans at UiPath (provisioning, scoping, delegation, attestation), ship the patterns, and drive their adoption across the product teams that build on them.

 - Drive the auth model for LLM tool-calling (for internal and external agents),  enterprise-managed authorization, scoped consent, least-privilege execution, step-up and just-in-time elevation, and OOTB monitoring views, audit trails that hold up in front of a compliance team.

 - Enhance the guardrail layer around agent action: policy-as-code for tool access, sandboxing boundaries, approval and elevation flows, and the attribution model that answers "which agent, on whose behalf, under which policy" after the fact.

 - Define how UiPath agents present themselves to the outside world and how outside agents present themselves to UiPath: agent identities registered in enterprise directories, on-behalf-of delegation chains that survive multiple hops, and agent-to-agent trust.

 - Partner with our largest and most regulated customers (financial services, healthcare, public sector) on production deployments. Go deep enough to know which specific control failed and ship the fix.

 - Use the platform as a builder. Stand up agents, wire up auth flows, use coding agents aggressively to prototype and ship reference implementations.

 - Instrument and own the metrics that matter (e.g. time-to-grant, audit coverage, policy violations caught, developer friction) and prioritize against them.

 - Present UiPath's governance capabilities and roadmap to customers, partners, and consider authoring any external content that earns CISO trust.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 7+ years in technical PM or engineering roles, with sustained time in the governance space: identity, access, and guardrails for enterprise software. You have shipped infrastructure that enterprises trusted with production traffic.

 - A visible record of innovating in agentic governance specifically: owned capabilities, reference implementations, spec or working-group contributions.

 - Fluency in enterprise identity and access: how users, services, and now agents authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how actions get audited.

 - Working knowledge of the agent auth stack as it stands today: MCP authorization, on-behalf-of delegation, and how IdPs like Okta and Entra now model agents as identities.

 - Working understanding of agentic AI (tool-calling, MCP, RAG, agent design patterns) and a view on how identity, access, and guardrails should evolve to support autonomous actors.

 - First-principles thinker, comfortable in ambiguity. Can produce a defensible direction and can tell the difference between a problem the standards will solve for us.

 - Clear communicator, in writing and in person: you can write a short position doc that frames a decision, explain a concept well to a CISO or auditor, and walk a customer through a working demo without overselling it.


IDEAL BACKGROUND

 - Several years in identity, access, or security-platform product work in enterprise vendors - hyperscaler identity team, IAM vendors, workload-identity or secrets vendor, or as an early PM at a startup in the space, with focus on agents.

 - Has been working on the enterprise agentic governance problem for a while: a product or feature in market, a spec or working-group contribution.

 - Has opinions about where agent identity, access, and guardrails are going in the next 24 months, with receipts.

 - Has shipped into regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, public sector) and has sat through a customer security or compliance review to shape product roadmap.

 - Works closely with engineering and field teams and is trusted by both to make technical trade-offs without a committee.

 - Prototypes before writing: has used code or coding agents to test an idea and brought the working version to the discussion.

#LI-MH1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

jobs.title: Director of Integration & Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com http://Scan.com.  We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging.  Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.



We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end.  Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway.  Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.



We're looking for a Director of Integration & Operational Excellence at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.




WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE

You'll report to our Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder and work closely with the CEO, Corporate Development, our CFO and leaders across Operations, Commercial, Product, Technology, People and Clinical. Your mandate is to make acquisitions work in practice and build the operating capability that allows Scan.com http://Scan.com to integrate businesses repeatedly as we grow.



You'll join before upcoming acquisitions close, learn how Scan.com http://Scan.com operates, and help prepare both our business and acquired teams for integration. You'll own the integrated plan, budget, dependencies, and delivery cadence from operational diligence through Day 1, the first 100 days, and the handover to business-as-usual owners. Functional leaders retain accountability for decisions in their areas; you'll hold the overall plan together, drive execution, and bring unresolved trade-offs to the COO.



Success means retained customers and referral relationships, uninterrupted patient service, reliable billing and collections, and measurable improvements in operating performance.

 - Lead integration planning before close. Work with Corporate Development and Finance to test the operating assumptions behind each acquisition, identify integration costs and working-capital needs, and turn diligence findings into a practical delivery plan.

 - Build the integration playbook. Establish Day 1 readiness criteria, 100-day plans, workstream owners, decision rights, budgets, and escalation routes. Adapt the approach to founder-owned businesses, carve-outs, referral networks and imaging centers.

 - Prepare Scan.com http://Scan.com to receive acquired businesses. Identify capacity constraints in scheduling, billing, customer support, technology and management. Resolve gaps before moving additional volume onto our platform.

 - Own execution across workstreams. Lead the integration cadence across Finance, Operations, Commercial, People, Product, Technology and Clinical, working with Legal and Compliance on the approvals needed in their areas. Sequence concurrent integrations around available capacity.

 - Protect the business through change. Build relationships with acquired founders and teams, identify key people and customer relationships to retain, and coordinate clear communications and responsibilities.

 - Make systems and process changes work operationally. Partner with technical and operational owners on referral routing, scheduling, imaging systems, reporting and billing migrations. Agree testing, reconciliation, cutover criteria and contingency plans before switching.

 - Deliver the financial case. Establish baselines with Finance and track revenue retention, collections, operating costs, and realized synergies. Separate one-time integration costs from recurring benefits and avoid counting growth or savings already included in the plan.

 - Improve operating performance across Scan.com http://Scan.com. Lead focused projects on center and mobile-unit economics, staffing, vendor costs, workflows and capacity. Build the business case, implement the changes, and demonstrate the result in operating metrics and the P&L.

 - Build a practical operating cadence. Maintain a reliable view of owners, milestones, budgets, risks, and decisions. Use automation and AI to reduce reporting work and give leadership concise updates on what needs attention.

 - Make improvements stick. Document repeatable processes, train the teams who will run them, and hand over completed workstreams with clear ownership and measures of success.

Example projects

 - Prepare a founder-owned imaging business for Day 1, retaining key relationships while aligning financial reporting and collections.

 - Build a carve-out plan that identifies essential staff, systems and shared services, with costed transitional arrangements and clear exit dates.

 - Validate referral-level unit economics and center capacity before moving new patient volume onto Scan.com http://Scan.com's network.

 - Reconcile an acquired company's billing and receivables data, establish collection baselines and resolve issues before a systems migration.
   
   


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Your ramp begins inside Scan.com http://Scan.com, before an acquisition closes. The timing of live integrations will depend on the deal pipeline; preparation and operating improvement start immediately.

 - Days 1–30: learn the business at ground level. Spend time with scheduling, center operations, Commercial, Finance, and revenue-cycle teams. Follow cases from referral through scan, report, billing, and payment. Review prior integrations, map the core systems and handoffs, and establish baseline service and financial metrics.

 - Days 31–60: build readiness. Assess upcoming acquisitions alongside the deal team. Identify receiving-team capacity constraints, retention risks, and operational dependencies. Produce costed Day 1 and 100-day plans with named owners, and deliver an initial improvement to an existing Scan.com http://Scan.com workflow.

 - Days 61–90: test and lead delivery. Rehearse critical workflows and agree readiness criteria with functional owners. Launch the integration reporting cadence and lead the first implementation workstreams as transactions permit. Give leadership a clear view of what is ready, what needs fixing, and what should be sequenced later.

How we'll measure success

 - Customer, referral volume, and key-employee retention.

 - Patient access, scheduling performance and report turnaround through transitions.

 - Billing accuracy, cash collections and receivables performance.

 - Realized margin improvement and synergies, validated with Finance and measured against integration costs.

 - Delivery against agreed budgets and milestones, followed by a successful handover to operational owners.
   
   


WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE

You don't need to meet every criterion. We are looking for someone who has personally led acquisitions through operational integration and can show what changed after close.

 - A record of delivering integrations. You've led multiple post-acquisition integrations or substantial workstreams with direct accountability for outcomes. You can explain what went wrong, how you responded, and what the financial and operational results were.

 - Healthcare operating experience. You've worked in a multisite healthcare, diagnostic imaging, healthcare-services, or similarly complex operating business. Experience in a PE-backed platform, founder-owned acquisition, or carve-out is particularly relevant.

 - Operational and financial depth. You've owned a P&L, an operating function, or an integration programme with measurable financial responsibility. You can connect staffing, capacity, pricing, service quality, and collections to profitability and cash flow.

 - Understanding of the revenue cycle. You understand how provider contracts, credentialing, billing workflows, denials, and receivables affect delivery and cash. Imaging-specific experience is valuable.

 - Experience implementing change. You've worked with technical and operational teams on systems migrations, process standardization, or service transitions, including testing and reconciliation.

 - Credibility with acquired teams. You can earn the trust of founders and frontline staff, retain what makes a business successful and make difficult changes clearly and respectfully.

 - Strong financial and analytical judgment. You can build and challenge unit economics, integration budgets and business cases, distinguish recurring benefits from one-off effects, and investigate the detail behind a misleading headline metric.

 - Leadership across functions. You establish clear accountability, resolve competing priorities and escalate decisions early. You are comfortable holding senior stakeholders to commitments.

 - A hands-on approach. You're willing to spend time in centers and alongside operating teams, investigate individual cases and improve processes before they are fully documented. The role involves travel to Scan.com http://Scan.com operations and acquired businesses.

 - Practical use of AI and automation. You improve how work gets done while keeping appropriate human review over sensitive data, financial decisions, and operational changes.

Experience in consulting, transaction services, or strategic finance can be valuable when combined with direct responsibility for implementation and results after close.




AI REQUIREMENTS

At Scan.com http://Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.

 - Tier 1 — For this role, the expectation is that you are an AI-Native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.
   
   - You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.
   
   - You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.
   
   - You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.
   
   - Assessment: a practical exercise where you use AI tools live or in a take-home.
     
     


A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.




HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

 1. 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent Team.

 2. A 45-minute discussion with the COO covering integrations you've led, the operating decisions you owned, and the results you delivered.

 3. A practical integration case and 'Scan Standard' interview. You'll assess a fictional acquisition, identify the key risks and build a prioritized Day 1 and 100-day plan. We'll discuss how you would protect service and collections, measure success, and use AI tools in your work.

 4. Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.

 5. Offer!
    
    


WHAT WE OFFER

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

 - Salary range of $150,000 - $175,000

 - Equity

 - Flexible remote or hybrid work options

 - Dedicated personal development budget

 - Medical, vision, and dental coverage

 - 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best

 - Paid parental leave

 - 401k retirement plan

 - All the equipment you need to do your best work

 - Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team




DIVERSITY AT SCAN.COM http://Scan.com

Scan.com http://Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer/Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Skyflow secures the flow of data across datastores, models, and agents. Enterprises turn to Skyflow as their runtime AI data control layer to protect sensitive data, enable safe AI deployment, and unlock full value from their applications, data platforms, and AI systems. 

Skyflow is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, and leading SaaS companies in financial services, healthcare, retail, travel and hospitality.



Skyflow is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and was founded in 2019. For more information, visit www.skyflow.com http://www.skyflow.com or follow on X https://twitter.com/SkyflowAPI and LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/skyflow/.

 

About the role



We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help build and run the infrastructure that powers a multi-tenant, security-sensitive B2B cloud product used by enterprise customers around the world. Our platform spans multi-tenant environments and single-tenant (BYOC) deployments into customer cloud accounts, so the bar for automation, consistency, and reliability is high  every environment needs to be provisioned, upgraded, monitored, and recovered the same way, at scale, with minimal manual intervention.


This is a hands-on engineering role, not a ticket-queue ops role. You'll spend most of your time writing Go and Python to turn repeatable infrastructure work into platform capabilities  provisioning pipelines, internal CLIs, self-service tooling, and automation that lets the rest of engineering ship without waiting on infrastructure as a bottleneck. You'll also carry deep operational ownership: on-call, incident response, and root-cause analysis on the systems you build.


Collaborate with enterprise customers to understand their infrastructure and security needs, then build reusable, scalable solutions using Terraform, Helm, and self-service tools that can be standardized across customer environments with minimal customization.





You have:



 - 8+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or SRE roles, with real ownership of production cloud infrastructure.

 - Strong software engineering skills in Go and/or Python you write tested, maintainable code and think of infrastructure automation as software, not scripting.

 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (workload scheduling, networking, autoscaling, upgrades) and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling such as Terraform, Pulumi, or OpenTofu.

 - Solid experience with at least one major public cloud (AWS or GCP or Azure); experience operating in all the three is a strong plus given our multi-cloud footprint.

 - Track record of building tools or platforms that other engineers use internal CLIs, provisioning frameworks, self-service portals, or automation pipelines not just maintaining existing infrastructure.

 - Comfort operating in a B2B environment with enterprise customers, where infrastructure changes carry compliance, security, and contractual weight (e.g. dedicated/BYOC deployments, uptime SLAs, audit requirements).

 - Strong incident-response instincts: you can debug distributed systems under pressure, drive a root-cause analysis to a real fix, and communicate clearly during and after an incident.

 - A bias toward root-causing and automating away recurring problems over repeatedly firefighting the same issue.

 - Lead, mentor, and technically guide a team of junior/early-career platform engineers.





You will:



 - Design and build automation that provisions and manages cloud infrastructure end-to-end new environment onboarding, upgrades, scaling, and decommissioning across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP) and multiple deployment models (multi-tenant and dedicated/BYOC).

 - Write production-grade Go and Python services and CLIs that turn infrastructure operations into self-service platform capabilities for other engineering teams, rather than one-off scripts or manual runbooks.

 - Own and evolve the Infrastructure-as-Code stack (Terraform/OpenTofu, Helm, GitOps/ArgoCD) that defines every environment, and drive migrations across the fleet (Kubernetes version upgrades, node pool migrations, service mesh changes) with minimal customer impact.

 - Operate and scale core platform services Kubernetes clusters, service mesh (Istio), data stores (Aerospike, PostgreSQL), messaging (Kafka), and GPU-backed inference workloads with a focus on capacity planning, cost efficiency, and right-sizing.

 - Build and improve observability and alerting (metrics, logs, synthetic monitoring) so that failures are caught before customers notice, and drive the automation that turns repeat incidents into permanent fixes.

 - Work directly with large enterprise customers and their infrastructure, security and platform teams to gather platform requirements. Design solutions that are built once for one customer and then reused across all environments as standard Terraform modules, Helm charts or self-service tooling, with minimal custom work.

 - Own the infrastructure side of customer onboarding, from technical discovery to go-live, and act as the bridge between customers and engineering. Anticipate integration gaps early, turn customer requests into well-scoped platform features, and drive feature expansion based on customer demand while keeping the architecture consistent.

 - Participate in an on-call rotation, lead incident response for the systems you own, and write root-cause analyses that result in concrete corrective action not just documentation.

 - Partner with security and compliance stakeholders to build guardrails (secrets management, access control, network policy, audit logging) directly into the platform, so secure-by-default is the path of least resistance for every team.

 - Continuously identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone infrastructure work and eliminate it — the measure of success in this role is less manual toil across the org, not more tickets closed.




Nice to have:



 - Experience with service mesh (Istio/Envoy), GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), or policy-as-code (OPA).

 - Experience operating stateful systems in production — distributed databases (Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Cassandra), message queues (Kafka), or GPU-backed inference workloads.

 - Experience with security-sensitive or regulated environments (PCI, SOC 2, HIPAA) and building compliance controls into infrastructure by default.

 - Experience with cost optimization and capacity planning at fleet scale (right-sizing, autoscaling policy design, spot/preemptible usage).

 - Contributions to open-source infrastructure tooling, or experience building an internal developer platform (IDP).





Our stack:

Go, Python · Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD · Terraform/OpenTofu · AWS, GCP · Istio · Aerospike, PostgreSQL, Kafka · Coralogix/Prometheus-style observability · GitHub Actions and Spacelift-style CI/CD for infrastructure changes.





Benefits:



 - Work from home expense

 - Excellent Health Insurance Options

 - Very generous PTO

 - Flexible Hours

 - Generous Equity



At Skyflow, we believe that diverse teams are the strongest teams. We invite applicants of all genders, races, ethnicities, nationalities, ages, religions, sexual orientations, disability statuses, educational experiences, family situations, and socio-economic backgrounds.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Product Reliability Engineer to support the evaluation, analysis, and improvement of mechanical and electrical product designs. The ideal candidate will have a multidisciplinary engineering background with experience identifying potential product failure modes, performing risk assessments, developing validation test methods, and providing actionable design recommendations. This role will also leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance engineering analysis and improve process efficiency.
