jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future.  The NYISO’s Market Structures department invites applications for a full-time Project Manager.

The Project Manager will fulfill Project Management leadership and coordination roles with accountability for achieving successful project results on time and within budget. This individual will plan and direct the work of project teams, monitor close adherence to project schedules, effectively use project management principles, oversee day-to-day project activities, provide timely reporting of project status and budget and interact regularly with employees in other groups, senior management and project stakeholders. Additionally, the Project Manager will identify, report, mitigate and escalate risks and issues as appropriate and provide Project Management services across various functional areas.

This individual  must be a self-motivated professional who displays effective leadership in a team-based environment and have experience working in a dynamic changing environment, with a commitment to providing value- based customer service, the ability to anticipate risks and address stakeholder needs. The ideal candidate will possess knowledge of supported Markets and business applications and display a clear understanding of internal and external stakeholder needs and regularly interface with both groups, as well as NYISO Management to provide progress and status updates and to generate alignment.  The Project Manager must have experience in managing multiple competing priorities, use of good judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills and a thorough knowledge and experience with software development life cycle methodology along with vendor management experience.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES

• Effectively manage multiple large, complex, cross-departmental, multi-phase projects.

• Manage project activities through the effective use of project management principles, best practices and methodologies adopted by NYISO to achieve timely project completion within budget and to meet the defined project business objectives.

• Possess/gain technical expertise in the relevant/supported NYISO Markets in order to effectively manage scope as well as implementation of the overall solution.

• Develop and apply specialized business and technical knowledge and expertise, in supported NYISO Business Areas, to implement solutions that meet project commitments on time and on budget.

• Review, report, resolve, mitigate, and escalate risks and issues as appropriate.

• Develop and execute project plans for assigned NYISO initiatives, in a matrix capacity with project team members throughout the organization. Regularly interface with NYISO Senior Management, Business Owners, IT Leadership, and all relevant internal and external stakeholders to provide timely updates on project status and progress, any identified or anticipated risks, issues and to present mitigation strategies.

• Present recommendations for effective consensus decision making, taking into consideration risk analysis and impact assessment for project milestones.

• Manage RFP / RFI processes, plan and present vendor selection recommendations in coordination with NYISO Procurement and in conjunction with the project team members.

• Manage vendor budget and relationships. Identify and manage project-related risks, measure and report on timely basis. Review project progress on a regular basis, analyze and assess information from various sources to develop accurate status reporting. Make recommendations and / or implement corrective action when deviations are found.

• Develop project resource plan and cost estimates. Monitor actual project expenditures against project estimates and budget. Provide accurate and timely budget reporting. Maintain effective communication and coordination with all project stakeholders to ensure that business objectives are met, and any changes are clearly communicated. Recommend process improvements and influence change across the organization.

• Possess in-depth knowledge of project management principles, best practices, processes and tools used to effectively manage projects.

• Actively participate in Project Management Working Group meetings.

• Support NYISO strategic and business plan objectives

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field required.

• Five years of demonstrated success in managing project development life-cycle processes and practical experience creating, monitoring and maintaining technical project plans in a multi-project environment

• Demonstrated success / advanced knowledge of vendor selection (RFP/RFI processes), project planning, estimating, risk management and budgeting; strong leadership and the ability to influence across the organization; strong aptitude for understanding complex business processes; strong organizational skills

• Superior communication and interpersonal skills

• Experience in a related industry desired; knowledge of electric power systems or wholesale electric markets is desired; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Project Management Professional® (PMP) certification as defined by the Project Management Institute (PMI) is desirable.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must have excellent verbal and written communication and organizational skills. Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from market participants, regulatory agencies or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches, and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or board of directors.

• Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference and fundamentals of algebra. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations.

• Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written oral, diagram or schedule form.

• Intermediate competency in Windows operating environment using MS Office suite of applications to include: MS Project, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Internet Explorer. Must have an understanding of the functionality of various IT software and hardware architectures and ability to apply that knowledge within the NYISO systems and wholesale energy marketplace.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit and use hands to perform routine office tasks. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Contact with staff and public will occur. Travel may be required to attend and/or conduct meetings, conferences and training. This position may require work on nights, weekends or holidays.

At the NYISO, we realize the importance of balancing the availability of remote work with the inherent value of bringing people together to attain success in the areas of maximum collaboration, relationship building and growth, teamwork, innovation and problem solving, as well as professional development and mentoring. In this role, you will be required to work onsite from our Rensselaer, NY location several days per workweek, with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. You will also be expected to respond to all business needs that may require any increase to the regular onsite requirements.

The NYISO takes pride in recruiting, developing and retaining highly talented individuals. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and innovative reward programs.

All offers of employment will be made contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screening and background check.

The NYISO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, does not discriminate in its hiring or employment practices.

Salary Range

$92,300—$153,900 USD

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Traffic Signal Operations Technician
jobs.description:
AECOM is actively seeking a highly motivated Traffic Signal Technician for immediate employment. This position will be based in the southeast Michigan area and will work out of client traffic operations center facilities. Traffic operations centers provide a centralized location for stakeholder communications, information dissemination, asset management, and traffic monitoring. The applicant will need to be professional, self-motivated, resourceful, and able to successfully execute various tasks in a fast-paced environment with ever changing priorities. This position will be located full-time on-site at our client location in Mt Clemens, MI.

Job Description:  The successful candidate provides hands-on technical services and support for various traffic signal and intelligent transportation systems. Responsibilities include utilization, programming, configuration, and troubleshooting. The technician also evaluates and analyzes extensive data from multiple sources to detect roadway incidents, assess equipment setup, and monitor road sensor data. Effective communication with stakeholders ensures accurate information dissemination about traffic incidents. Additionally, the technician collaborates closely with the engineering team to address mobility impact and safety implications, deploying operational changes to alleviate congestion and enhance safety and mobility. Maintaining the quality and timeliness of all disseminated information, including social media and text messages, is a key responsibility. These systems play a vital role in managing safety and mobility on roadways overseen by the Macomb County Traffic Operations Center (TOC) project team.

The candidate may be required to work weekends, major holidays, and overnight shifts, as typically assigned. A typical daily office schedule will be set; however, the applicant will be expected to work additional hours either before or after the typical shift, as needed.

Responsibilities: The successful candidate for the Traffic Signal Technician role will receive specific training tailored to the systems, services, and procedures used by the Macomb TOC project team. The general responsibilities of this position, but are not limited to:

• Monitor traffic detectors, sensors, central systems, and automated traffic management systems to identify and manage roadway incidents, congestion, and device deficiencies.
• Disseminate traffic information through various communication channels (telephone, e-mail, instant messaging, and social media).
• Send real-time incident notifications and follow-up updates.
• Create, maintain, and troubleshoot work orders for ITS equipment and troubleshoot service requests related to traffic operations.
• Communicate effectively with engineers, technicians, transportation agency personnel, first responders, and other safety agencies.
• Verify and compare deployed traffic signal timing plans for accuracy.
• Deploy pre-designed traffic signal timing plans to address mobility concerns.
• Utilize central traffic signal systems for device integration, historical data access, and troubleshooting.
• Configure traffic signal systems, including controllers and detection.
• Develop graphs, charts, tables, maps, and descriptive statistics for traffic operations analysis.
• Conduct office and field testing of traffic signal system programming and configuration to support the delivery of construction and operational projects.
• Provide technical support during traffic signal ‘cut overs’ during construction or operational changes.
• Assist with data collection for studies and management needs.
• Deliver technical training on traffic signal system utilization, programming, configuration, and troubleshooting.
• Capacity to maintain composure and precision while working under pressure.

Minimum Requirements

• High School Diploma + 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• A valid driver's license is required, along with the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check in accordance with company policy

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 1 year experience in a traffic operations center environment is a plus - Traffic Operations Center/Traffic Management Center knowledge and/or experience.
• Experience with traffic signal controller software and detection systems.
• Experience with the usage of Centralized Traffic Signal Software Systems to configure, program, and manage traffic signal systems.
• Understanding of traffic signal operations and traffic management relative to safety and mobility of travelers.
• International Municipal Signal Association Certifications (Traffic Signal Technician I, Traffic Signal Field Technician II, Work Zone Temporary Traffic Control Technician)
• Other related training, certification and demonstrated experience in traffic signal controllers, detection systems, centralized traffic signal systems, etc.
• Effective communication skills and ability to covey information to leadership. Clear communication with stakeholders and general public.
• Self-motivation and adherence to operational policies. Adaptability to changing environments and priorities. Multitasking capability.
• Ability to synthesize information from diverse sources including automated road sensor data, CCTV cameras, and much more.
• Data manipulation and management skills.
• Capability to apply both technical and analytical skills in overall execution of services.

• This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. Are you eager to develop your technical and professional excellence and advance your career in a collaborative, inclusive, diverse, and empowering culture? Ramboll is a leading scientific and environmental consulting firm providing a broad range of technical services to both public and private sector clients. When you join Ramboll, you will become part of a company that strives to make a difference – for our employees, clients, and society.

Ramboll is seeking an entry-level to mid-level consultant to join the Risk Assessment and Community Health group in the firm’s Princeton, New Jersey office. Hybrid work arrangements are available, with office presence required at least two days a week.

Your new role

As an entry-level health sciences consultant at Ramboll, you will support a range of human health risk assessment and community health projects in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Your work will include independent, detail-oriented technical tasks as well as coordination with colleagues and project teams. Projects may be related to hazardous waste and other contaminated sites, Brownfield redevelopment, vapor intrusion, ambient and indoor air quality, product safety, regulatory interactions, community engagement, and litigation. Tasks may include data management, statistical analysis, fate and transport modeling, spatial analysis, sampling/remediation/risk management planning, and technical reporting. This is a unique opportunity to work with Ramboll experts to advance your technical and consulting skills.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Compiling, organizing, and managing environmental data and databases; performing statistical and geospatial analyses of environmental and health data.
• Evaluating the environmental fate and transport of chemicals
• Estimating human exposures to chemicals in different environmental media (e.g., air, soil, sediment, fish tissue, produce, water, etc.) and exposure scenarios, and calculating associated health risks.
• Assisting with preparation of technical reports, written communication, proposals, and presentations
• reviewing and evaluating technical documents (e.g., scientific articles, regulations)

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your professional development and advancement in the company!  Successful candidates will typically possess:

• Advanced degree (M.S., MPH or equivalent) in Environmental Science or Engineering, Environmental Health Science and/or Environmental Toxicology
• Exemplary individuals with bachelor’s degree and 2 + years of relevant experience may be considered.
• Strong analytical, quantitative, organizational, problem-solving, critical thinking skills, and time management skills; excellent written and oral communication skills
• 2+ years of chemistry coursework required.
• Current authorization to work in the United States on a full-time basis, where required for the position.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

• Knowledge of risk assessment, exposure assessment, and fate and transport of chemicals in the environment
• Proficiency with MS Office; experience with MS Access or other relational databases (e.g., SQL) for managing, querying, and analyzing environmental data.
• Demonstrated strong quantitative and problem-solving skills; experienced with statistical and data analysis using R, Python, SQL, or SAS
• GIS capability is a plus
• Experience reviewing and evaluating technical documents, scientific articles, regulations, and regulatory guidance

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $75,603 - $94,504 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Where People Flourish

jobs.title: High End Residential Estimator
jobs.description:
SENIOR HIGH-END RESIDENTIAL CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR

Level: Senior (10–15+ years of construction estimating or engineering experience)
Location: Remote
Compensation: $4,000–$5,000/month, depending on assessment and experience




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Construction Estimator to support a specialized luxury residential construction company handling ultra-high-end custom home projects valued at $10M+.

This role requires more than traditional estimating experience. The ideal candidate has extensive hands-on construction and field experience, strong technical knowledge, and the ability to accurately model costs for complex builds, particularly those involving remote island locations and challenging logistics.

The estimator will work directly with the owner, who will provide guidance on the company's estimating methodology, project requirements, and quality standards. This is a remote, independent role that does not require site visits.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Develop detailed and accurate cost estimates for luxury custom residential projects valued at $10M+.

 - Perform comprehensive material quantity takeoffs, including concrete cubic yards, lumber and framing requirements, roofing specifications, and other construction materials.

 - Calculate and model project costs, factoring in materials, labor, equipment, and construction requirements.

 - Estimate remote construction logistics, including shipping, fuel, transportation, material sourcing, and delivery timelines to isolated island locations.

 - Account for unique site conditions, labor productivity, material availability, and scheduling constraints that may affect project costs.

 - Use Microsoft Excel as the primary tool for estimating, cost modeling, and calculations.

 - Work directly with the owner to refine and adapt estimating methodologies to the company's specific standards and project requirements.

 - Independently review estimates, identify potential cost risks, and ensure accuracy and completeness.

 - Work autonomously in a fully remote environment while maintaining clear communication with the owner.




IDEAL CANDIDATE

 - 10–15+ years of hands-on experience in construction estimating, engineering, or related construction roles.

 - Technical background in civil, structural, or mechanical engineering, architecture, or extensive field-based construction estimating.

 - Strong understanding of construction fundamentals, including material takeoffs, concrete calculations, lumber framing, roofing systems, and general building science.

 - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, particularly for complex calculations, cost modeling, and estimating.

 - Experience with complex, high-value construction projects, preferably in luxury residential or specialized construction markets.

 - Familiarity with remote or island construction logistics, including shipping schedules, material sourcing, transportation, fuel costs, and labor productivity challenges.

 - Experience with international supply chains or logistics-heavy construction projects is a strong advantage.

 - Strong analytical skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to identify potential cost and project risks.

 - Self-directed, adaptable, and willing to learn and align with the owner's established estimating methodology.

 - Humble, coachable, and confident in applying practical field knowledge to technical estimating work.

 - Fluent in English, with the ability to communicate directly and effectively with the owner.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Proven experience estimating complex, high-value residential or commercial construction projects.

 - Background in luxury custom homes, remote locations, island developments, or offshore construction.

 - Demonstrated ability to estimate projects involving challenging material procurement and international logistics.

 - Strong understanding of how site conditions, transportation limitations, and labor constraints affect overall construction costs and timelines.




WORKING ARRANGEMENT

 - Location: Fully remote

 - Schedule: To be discussed with the client

 - Reporting: Directly to the company owner

 - Tools: Microsoft Excel as the primary estimating tool

 - Site Visits: Not required

 - Engagement: Long-term partnership opportunity




CLIENT & WORKING STYLE

The client operates a highly specialized luxury construction business serving ultra-high-net-worth clients. Projects are primarily reputation-driven, with a strong emphasis on quality, precision, and exceptional attention to detail.

The owner is hands-on and directly involved in the estimating process. He values professionals who have substantial field experience, understand real-world construction challenges, and can translate that knowledge into accurate cost estimates.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working closely with the owner, receiving direct mentorship, and adapting to the company's specific estimating standards. The goal is to establish a reliable, long-term working partnership.




NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS

 - Minimum 10+ years of relevant construction field, estimating, or engineering experience.

 - Strong technical understanding of construction materials, methods, and cost estimation.

 - Ability to understand and account for remote or island construction logistics and constraints.

 - Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency.

 - Fluent English for direct communication with the owner.

 - Willingness to work independently and adapt to the client's estimating methodology.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Analog Architect – Data Converters
jobs.description:
This position is in the Core Analog Division (CAD), which is part of Renesas’ Analog & Mixed Signal product group. The CAD R&D team develops and industrializes a broad portfolio of standard products as well as a family of highly configurable mixed-signal products for a wide range of applications, including but not limited to consumer, communication, computing, data center, industrial, and automotive applications. The CAD team is the pioneer and dominant market leader of the highly successful GreenPAKTM family of products. This customer configurable product and platform enables customers to differentiate their products, reduces BOM cost and development cost and time. The CAD team is continuously expanding our product portfolio that includes high-performance analog IP’s, DC-DC, and FPGA.

As a Senior Data Converter Architect, you will be responsible for leading the development of high-resolution data converter IP for standard products as well as integration in CAD’s broad portfolio of configurable products. As our data converter specialist, guiding and mentoring team members is essential and one of your most important responsibilities. This is a senior technical leadership position, and you will be working with design and program managers to drive NPI (New Product Introduction) execution as well as continuous efficiency and performance improvement.

Responsibilities:

• Architect and design high-performance AFE (analog frontends) and signal-chain ecosystems, which include IP such as PGA (programmable gain amplifiers), precision voltage references, and data converters.
• Develop high-accuracy IP with voltage accuracy on the order of 1uV.
• Develop Delta Sigma A/D converters with resolution of 24-bit or higher.
• Design Nyquist D/A converters with resolution of 18-bit or higher.
• Architect and design SAR A/D converters with resolution of 16-bit or higher.
• Guide and mentor CMSD’s global Design, Characterization, and Test Engineering team on high-voltage and high-accuracy design and test techniques.
• Develop product definition and specifications to achieve optimal tradeoffs between product competitiveness and development cost.
• Collaborate with Product Definition and Marketing on product roadmaps and long-term IP development plans.
• Represent CAD R&D and contribute to key technical meetings and initiatives at product group (AMS) and company level.

• MSEE or PhD in EE + 15 years semiconductor design leadership experience
• Proven track record in designing high-accuracy products with resolution better than 1uV.
• Proven track record in designing high-performance AFE products with ENOB of 16-bit or above.
• Proven track record in designing high-resolution SAR (16-bit or above) and Delta-Sigma (24-bit or above) A/D converters.
• Proven track record in designing high-resolution Nyquist D/A converters (18-bit or above).
• Proven track record in designing high-speed A/D converters with data rate over 100MSPS.
• Highly knowledgeable in ESD, Latch-up, and IC reliability issues.
• Highly knowledgeable in state-of-the-art design methodologies and tools.
• Highly knowledgeable in state-of-the-art mixed-signal and BCD process technologies.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Full Cycle
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About The Role

Steer is building one of the fastest-growing GTM engines in automotive SaaS, and we’re launching a dedicated Mid-Market segment. We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to own a new business with full-service auto repair groups running 4–10 locations.

These are serious operators. They’ve built multi-million-dollar businesses, they’ve seen plenty of vendors, and they buy on results. You’ll run consultative, multi-stakeholder deals with owners, operations leaders, and finance, and you’ll win them with sharp discovery and a business case that holds up.

This is a builder role. You’ll carry a number while helping shape the Mid-Market playbook, and you’ll work directly with our CRO on how this segment grows.

We measure success three ways: MRR added, rooftops added, and how well you build the foundation for the team that follows.

You Will:

• Own the Full Sales Cycle: Prospect, run discovery, demo, build the business case, negotiate, and close new multi-location accounts.

• Build Your Own Pipeline: Generate pipeline with 4–10 shop groups through outbound, events, and marketing programs. Partner with SMB AEs and BDRs on accounts that grow into your segment.

• Sell to the Whole Buying Group: Multi-thread across owners, operations directors, marketing managers, and finance, and align them on why Steer and why now.

• Lead With Business Impact: Tie Steer to the numbers operators care about: car count, average repair order, customer retention, and location-by-location performance.

• Build the Playbook: Help define our Mid-Market ICP, discovery framework, ROI model, and mutual action plans. Document what works so the team that follows can scale it.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Work with Customer Success on multi-location rollouts and expansion, and bring customer insight back to Marketing and Product.

• Forecast With Precision: Keep HubSpot clean and deliver accurate forecasts.

You Have:

Must Have

• 3+ years of full-cycle, quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales experience, with a track record of exceeding quota

• Experience closing multi-stakeholder deals and building business cases that win approval

• Strong discovery skills: you diagnose before you prescribe

• Proven ability to build your own pipeline

• Forecasting discipline and strong deal control

• A builder mentality: you create process where none exists and don’t wait to be told what to do next

• Direct, plain-spoken communication that earns the trust of business owners

Nice to Have

• Experience selling to multi-location businesses (automotive, home services, dental, veterinary, franchise, etc.)

• Automotive aftermarket or shop management software experience

• Experience as the first rep in a new segment or territory

• Familiarity with HubSpot and Nooks

Interview Process

• Initial Screen (Lead Recruiter) – 30 min

• Hiring Manager Interview (CRO) – 45 min

• Career Journey + Critical Thinking Exercise (Head of People) – 60 min

• Mock Discovery + Demo (CRO, [Parker’s title]) – 45 min

• Reference Checks

We also require completion of the Wonderlic Assessment before the end of the process. It’s done independently and takes about 20–30 minutes.

We Offer

• Medical, Dental and Vision insurance within 30 days

• 100% employer-paid medical insurance

• Equity package

• Flexible PTO with 15 days minimum

• Generous Parental Leave

• FSA and HSA options

• 401(k)

• Learning Stipend

• WFH Equipment

• Chance to work with the latest technology

• A collaborative, high-ownership culture

• Opportunities for development and career growth

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Solutions Lead, Assessments
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

We are building Protege to solve the biggest unmet need in AI — getting access to the right training data. The process today is time intensive, incredibly expensive, and often ends in failure. The Protege platform facilitates the secure, efficient, and privacy-centric exchange of AI training data.

Solving AI’s data problem is a generational opportunity. We’re backed by world-class investors and already powering partnerships with some of the most ambitious teams in AI. The company that succeeds will be one of the largest in AI — and in tech.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, high-trust team of builders who are obsessed with velocity and impact. Our culture is built for people who thrive on ambiguity, own outcomes, and want to shape the future of data and AI.




SUMMARY

You will shape and deliver healthcare AI assessments around the decisions customers need to make. Translate their needs into feasible scopes and own delivery across DataLab, engineering, verification and data partners, from initial feasibility through customer acceptance.

Combine solution design, hands-on delivery and strategic judgment. Weigh trade-offs across data sources, evaluation approaches and capacity; recommend priorities and reusable investments. Stay close to the technical work to challenge assumptions and troubleshoot dependencies, and turn delivery experience into playbooks and better operating decisions.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Translate customer goals into assessment scopes, success criteria and delivery plans with clear technical and commercial assumptions.

 - Coordinate DataLab, engineering, commercial teams and data partners through each delivery stage.

 - Coordinate partner specifications and data-readiness checks across relevant EHR, claims, imaging, pathology and text sources.

 - Serve as the primary delivery contact, making technical decisions, progress, risks and trade-offs clear to customers.

 - Assess technical feasibility and recommend scope, source or execution options based on customer value, effort, risk and capacity.

 - Coordinate data-quality, privacy, scientific and technical readiness reviews with the responsible experts before work advances.

 - Manage changing requirements and competing projects, recommending priorities and showing the impact on timing, effort and deliverables.

 - Build reusable playbooks for intake, feasibility, QA, partner handoffs, escalation and acceptance.

 - Use delivery evidence to prioritize process and tooling improvements, explaining expected customer value and capacity benefits.

 - Coordinate results delivery, customer acceptance and the handoff into the next assessment or rerun.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - First 30 days: Understand the customer decisions, healthcare data needs and technical dependencies across the assigned portfolio. Establish a delivery cadence, baseline effort and rework, and identify the most important constraints on delivery.

 - By 60 days: Lead assigned customer deliveries, move at least one through a meaningful milestone, and apply the playbook across two projects or delivery cycles. Secure agreement on a scope or prioritization recommendation that balances customer value, technical feasibility and capacity.

 - By 90 days: Lead a project to acceptance or its agreed checkpoint, demonstrate improvement against a delivery baseline, and make the playbook usable by another teammate. Recommend a prioritized delivery roadmap with concrete process or tooling investments and expected benefits.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - You have shaped and delivered complex customer or partner engagements, translating an ambiguous need into a feasible solution and a concrete outcome.

 - You have coordinated technical, operational and external stakeholders, making dependencies and decision ownership clear without relying on direct authority.

 - You have managed changing requirements and difficult timelines while maintaining clear expectations and customer trust.

 - You have built a playbook or operating process that other people adopted, and can show how it reduced confusion, delay or repeated work.

 - Optional: You have worked with healthcare data before

 - Optional: Experience with AI evaluations, ML products or enterprise data delivery is valuable. SQL, Python and API tooling are helpful, not required; you must be able to interpret technical evidence and work effectively with the specialists who produce it.


PROTEGE VALUES

Pass the Loved Ones’ Test

We act with integrity and do the right thing — especially when it’s hard and no one is watching.

Always Find a Way

We are resourceful, resilient builders who solve hard problems and push through obstacles.

Go Fast and Grow Fast

Velocity matters. We move with urgency, learn quickly, and continuously improve as individuals and as a company.

Practice Kindness and Candor

We communicate directly and respectfully, building trust through honest feedback and genuine care for one another.

Deliver Together

We win as one team. Collaboration, accountability, and shared ownership drive our success.

Own the Outcome. Hone the Craft.

We take pride in our work, sweat the details, and continuously raise the bar for excellence.

jobs.title: Sales Team Administrator / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Department: Sales

Location: Austin, Texas (Hybrid — min. 3 days in office)

Positions: 1



ABOUT XYZ REALITY

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom — a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat — but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with delivery timescales and budgets.

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.



THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality's Strategic Account Executive team is responsible for some of the most complex and high-value enterprise construction technology deals in AMER — working with hyperscalers and neocloud operators where every day of schedule slippage carries a significant cost. These AEs need to be in front of customers and on job sites. What they don't need to be doing is managing their own diaries, chasing down travel bookings, or wrestling with administrative tasks.

That's where you come in. As a Sales Team Administrator and EA, you'll provide dedicated, proactive executive support to a group of Strategic AEs — owning their calendars, coordinating travel, managing expense submissions, and handling the full range of day-to-day administrative tasks that keep a high-performing sales team running.

This is a hands-on, relationship-driven role. You'll be embedded with the team in Austin, you'll understand the rhythm of each AE's week, and you'll build the kind of trust that means they can hand something off and focus entirely on selling.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Own and manage AE calendars end-to-end — scheduling customer meetings, internal syncs, QBRs, and cross-functional touchpoints across AMER time zones, proactively resolving conflicts and prioritising accordingly.

• Book and manage all domestic and international travel — flights, hotels, ground transport, and site visit logistics. Prepare detailed itineraries, confirm arrangements ahead of time, and handle real-time changes as plans shift.

• Process and submit expense reports accurately and on time on behalf of AEs — reconcile corporate card activity, chase missing receipts, and flag policy issues before they reach finance.

• Prepare meeting materials, agendas, and briefing documents ahead of customer calls and internal reviews; take notes and track actions where required.

• Support CRM hygiene in Salesforce on behalf of the team — updating contact records, opportunity data, and activity logs so the revenue org always has an accurate picture.

• Coordinate with Marketing, Legal, and Finance on behalf of AEs — routing NDAs and contracts, requesting collateral, and managing ad hoc administrative requests so AEs stay focused on selling.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

1. 2+ years in an EA, personal assistant, or team administrator role — experience supporting a sales team, quota-carrying executives, or senior leaders in a B2B environment is strongly preferred.

2. Proven track record managing complex, multi-person diaries across time zones with minimal oversight.

3. Based in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX — this role requires regular in-office presence alongside the team.

4. Proficiency with calendar and productivity tools (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365) and working knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable CRM.



KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail — this role is the administrative backbone of a high-stakes sales team, and dropped balls have real consequences.

• Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable corresponding professionally with senior customer contacts and internal stakeholders on behalf of AEs.

• Proactive and anticipatory by nature — able to identify what's needed before it's asked and act without being prompted.

• Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — a fast-moving construction technology company does not operate on a predictable schedule.

• Familiarity with travel booking platforms and expense management tools (e.g. Expensify, Concur, or similar).

• Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential commercial information — this role sits close to sensitive deal activity.



BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

• 🩺 Private medical

• 🎄 Extra Christmas shutdown days

• 🏝️ 15 days PTO + public holidays

• 🏠 Hybrid working

• 🪙 Biannual salary reviews

• 🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

• 💰 Employee referral scheme

• 🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

jobs.title: Account Executive - Attribute™, North America
jobs.description:
Location
This role is fully remote in US East or West, with travel as needed.

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. You'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.

As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.

You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.

You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.

Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscaler teams, and show up at industry events that matter.

Responsibilities

• Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets

• Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA

• Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on

• Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share

• Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face

• Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver

• Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience

• Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job

• Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you

Qualifications

• Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch

• A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work

• Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently

• Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.

• Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way

• Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture

• Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care

• Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships

• "Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities

Are You a Doer?
Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.

We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun! Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT.

Sounds too good to be true? Check out our Glassdoor reviews.

We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.

Full-time employee benefits include:

• Unlimited PTO

• Flexible Working Options

• Health Insurance

• Professional Development Stipend

Many Doers, One Team
DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for an exceptional sales trainer and builder to help architect and train the next generation of Ethos Sales Agents. This role will work closely with the leaders across sales and product to build Ethos' training, coaching, and script strategy across multiple direct-to-consumer sales verticals, and will personally lead the trainings, workshops, and coaching sessions that bring that strategy to life.

This role will partner with multiple leaders to craft best-in-class sales strategies, test new concepts, and evolve how Ethos Agents engage with customers. The right candidate will have strong sales acumen, the ability to translate that into dynamic, hands-on training delivery, and a passion for building the systems and content that motivate Agents to excel at their role.

This is a highly autonomous, builder-oriented role where success is delivering onboarding and coaching sessions live, improving customer experience, developing systems to track performance, and building agents into top performers.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Training Delivery - Actively lead onboarding, ramp, and ongoing skills trainings for new and existing agents across verticals. You are the primary facilitator, not just a designer of materials.

• Script Support & Execution - Help develop, test, and refine sales scripts in partnership with sales leaders, and product; train agents on script changes and reinforce adherence through live coaching.

• Agent Development - Build and run onboarding curriculum and the ramp process for new agents. Lead remedial training sessions for underperforming reps and deliver coaching programs designed with the Head of Sales Development & Training.

• AI Call Insights Support - Use AI transcription analysis and script adherence tools to identify coaching opportunities, then translate those insights directly into training content and live coaching sessions.

• Testing & Experimentation - Help design and run structured pilots and A/B script tests; deliver training updates as scripts evolve and gather floor feedback to inform the next iteration.

• Manager Enablement - Help build and deliver programs that make managers effective coaches, including supporting rollout of the "Ethos Management Philosophy" through direct training sessions with managers.

• Cross-Functional Support - Bring sales floor feedback into planning conversations with the Head of Sales Development & Training and Product; translate product and script changes into clear, deliverable training content for the sales team.

Qualifications and Skills:

• You've delivered or built sales training/enablement programs before, ideally in a high-velocity, script-driven, or regulated sales environment.

• You're a builder - energized by creating training content and materials, not just executing someone else's playbook.

• You think like a scientist about scripts and training - you form a hypothesis, test it, measure the result, and iterate rather than relying on gut feel or seniority.

• You're highly autonomous - you take direction and support from the Head of Sales Development & Training but need minimal hand-holding to get things built and delivered.

• You're comfortable being in front of a room (physical or virtual), facilitating, coaching, and engaging agents directly.

• You thrive partnering closely with sales leaders and the Head of Sales Development & Training to shape and execute strategy on the ground.

jobs.description:

This role will serve as the technical lead for power and analog solutions, supporting system-level design engagements across key customers, including pre- and post-design support activities such as schematic review, component selection, technical resource guidance, and issue resolution to help drive design-in to design-win success.

The FAE will:

· Lead customer power architecture development, including power tree design, device selection, and system optimization.

· Perform technical design reviews, root-cause analysis, and hands-on debug for complex analog and power-related issues.

· Drive new product evaluations and competitive positioning for Renesas power and analog portfolio (PMICs, DC/DC, GaN & MOSFETs, LDOs, battery management, signal chain).

· Execute extensive hands-on lab work, including board bring-up, measurement, validation, and failure analysis.

· Support system-level design integration, ensuring alignment between power, processor, and connectivity subsystems.

· Provide direct technical guidance to customers to accelerate designs from concept to production revenue.

· Deliver field feedback to product divisions, influencing roadmap, feature prioritization, and system solution gaps.

· Develop and present customer trainings, technical seminars, and internal enablement content.

Success in this role requires the ability to translate component-level expertise into system-level solutions, while building strong, trusted relationships with customers and internal teams.

· REMOTE - MUST BE WILLING TO BE LOCATED IN NEW ENGLAND - PREFERRED BOSTON AREA

· BS Electrical Engineering (MSEE preferred).

· 3+ years of experience in Analog and Power Electronics (customer-facing or design role).

To be effective in this role, this engineer is expected to:

· Establish strong relationships with sales, FAEs, and distribution, acting as the regional expert for power/analog.

· Partner closely with product marketing and BU teams to drive alignment between field needs and roadmap.

· Lead customers through power design challenges, from architecture through debug and production readiness.

· Provide actionable, system-level feedback to influence new product development.

· Support cross-functional engagements where power is a critical system dependency (MCU/MPU, AI, connectivity platforms).

· Deliver technical presentations, customer training, and design workshops.

· Travel as needed to support key customer engagements (approx. ≤10–20%).

Preferred Qualifications:

· Deep expertise in power conversion and management:

o Buck/boost converters, PMICs, LDOs

o Power tree sequencing and optimization

o Battery-powered system design (fuel gauging, charging, protection)

· Strong understanding of analog signal chain:

o Amplifiers, data converters, sensors, filtering, Noise, stability, and signal integrity considerations

· Proven experience in:

o System-level power architecture design, Schematic and PCB layout review, especially for power integrity and thermal considerations, Bench characterization, validation, and debug of power systems

· Ability to work across domains:

o Interaction of power with MCUs/MPUs, DDR, high-speed interfaces, and connectivity subsystems

· Hands-on lab proficiency:

o Oscilloscopes, power analyzers, thermal analysis, transient response measurements

· Strong communication skills:

o Capable of translating deep technical content into customer-facing solutions and value propositions

· Self-driven, highly collaborative, able to own complex technical engagements

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
Kickstarter is the leading crowdfunding platform for creative projects across film, games, music, art, design, and technology. Since our founding in 2009, our mission to help bring creative projects to life has been powered by the people behind the work.

Together, we’ve helped creators around the world launch creative projects that have generated billions of dollars in pledges. That same commitment extends inward. Rooted in shared values, Kickstarter invests in the growth and success of our team, treating employees as whole people and empowering them with the autonomy and space to participate in decisions that shape their work and our company.

Kickstarter is seeking an experienced Community Manager to join our Marketing team. This role sits at the heart of how Kickstarter shows up and is perceived across the places our community talks: social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the corners of the internet where creators and backers compare notes. Reporting to the Director, Brand and Communications, the Community Manager will listen, respond, and engage, and will work closely with cross-functional teams to route what they hear to the people who can act on it.

As the owner of Kickstarter’s community presence and reputation, they serve as our early-warning system when sentiment shifts or a problem starts to spread. This is not a “schedule posts and check metrics” role. The ideal candidate is already deep in these communities, knows the norms of each one, and gets a little twitchy when a thread starts to turn.

The salary for this role in the United States is $115,905.50.

In This Role, You Will:

Reputation Management and Monitoring

• Monitor brand mentions, sentiment, and emerging narratives across social, Reddit, Discord, review sites, forums, and the broader web, in real time.

• Spot early signals of reputational risk (a viral complaint, a controversial project, a misunderstanding of our policies), assess severity, and lead the response, partnering with Communications, Trust & Safety, Legal, and leadership on sensitive or high-stakes moments.

• Design and own the escalation framework with Communications, Trust & Safety, Support, Product, Legal, and leadership, including severity tiers, owners, and response timelines.

• Build, own, and continuously refine response playbooks for common scenarios (project controversies, creator disputes, outages, policy changes, and press-driven moments), and run post-incident reviews to improve them.

• Define how we measure community sentiment and reputation, and deliver regular reporting to senior stakeholders that connects trends to business and mission impact, with clear recommendations.

Community Engagement

• Show up as Kickstarter in public conversations, in a voice that is human, direct, and well-informed.

• Participate credibly in Reddit and Discord communities, following each community’s rules and culture rather than treating them as broadcast channels.

• Correct misinformation helpfully, de-escalate heated threads, and know when not to respond.

• Support creators and backers by pointing them to the right resources, and handing off to Support when an issue needs a ticket.

• Celebrate creator milestones and engage with backers and make Kickstarter feel present and human beyond our owned social channels.

• Set voice, tone, and engagement guidelines for Kickstarter’s presence in community spaces, and coach teammates who engage on the company’s behalf.

Feedback Loop

• Own a community feedback program that turns unstructured community input into prioritized, evidence-backed insights for Product, Design, Policy, Support, and Creator Success, and track what gets acted on.

• Maintain a living picture of the top recurring pain points, feature requests, and trust issues, with examples.

• Close the loop publicly when we ship something the community asked for.

• Build and run a creator and backer advocacy program, identifying enthusiastic community members for testimonials, campaigns, and storytelling.

Programs and Operations

• Own the strategy and operation of Kickstarter-owned community spaces (e.g., Discord, creator forums), including moderation guidelines, tooling, and volunteer or mod programs.

• Align Social, Comms, and our creator-facing teams on campaigns, launches, and announcements so community context is built in from the start.

• Select, manage, and optimize our social listening and community tooling, including vendor evaluation and measurement.

• Track emerging creator communities, cultural trends, competitor conversations, new platforms and community behaviors.

• Translate community insights into recommendations that inform marketing, acquisition, and product priorities.

About You

• You have 4+ years in community management, social media, reputation management, or a related role, ideally at a platform, marketplace, or consumer tech company.

• You have deep, demonstrable fluency in Reddit and Discord, as a longtime participant and not just a brand account. You know what a good community looks like and what gets a brand banned or mocked.

• You have hands-on experience across the major social platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Threads), including how norms and audiences differ on each.

• You have experience monitoring and managing sentiment on review and feedback sites (e.g., Trustpilot, App Store and Google Play reviews, Hacker News, and niche forums).

• You have strong judgment under pressure and ambiguity: you can tell a vocal minority from a real problem and a mistake from a crisis, and you make clear recommendations or calls without waiting to be told what to do.

• You are an excellent writer. You can be warm, plain-spoken, and precise, and you can adapt tone to the platform and the moment.

• You have experience with social listening and community tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Brandwatch, Sprinklr, Meltwater, Mention, or similar).

• You have experience building processes and aligning cross-functional partners, and you communicate clearly and credibly with executives, Legal, and Trust & Safety when stakes are high.

• You have a track record of owning a community, reputation, or voice-of-customer program end to end, with measurable results.

• You are familiar with crowdfunding, creator economy, or maker communities (games, comics, film, music, design, publishing, tech).

• You are familiar with platform-specific communities like BoardGameGeek, Product Hunt, Indie Hackers, or creator-focused Discords.

• You have experience handling public-facing communications during controversies or policy changes.

• You have data skills: you are comfortable building dashboards or pulling insights from large volumes of unstructured text.

Our Fully Virtual Team

We’re currently able to support employees based in the following US locations: CA, CO, CT, GA, IL, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NY, OR, SC, VA, VT, and WA. We're also able to support employees in the United Kingdom. If you live in—or are willing to move to—any of these locations, we look forward to your application! If there is a required or preferred location for an open role, it will be listed in the job description.

Kickstarter is an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to fight for equality, we work to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. We celebrate diversity, and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.

Reminder to applicants: Authentic communications from Kickstarter will always originate from official Kickstarter email domains (@kickstarter.com). Exercise caution and verify the legitimacy of anyone who claims to be representing Kickstarter on other platforms.

Please reach out to Kickstarter’s Help Center to report potentially fraudulent contact here: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.description:
Paid Media Specialist — Reunion Marketing

Remote or hybrid (US) · Full time · Paid Media team · Automotive

Make every dealer's ad dollar work harder

Reunion Marketing runs Google, Meta, and Microsoft ads for automotive dealerships across the country. You will own a portfolio of more than 200 dealers: building and tuning their campaigns, reading the numbers, and sitting down with each one every month to show them what is working and what comes next.

This is a client-facing seat on a close team. You will talk with dealers, work side by side with our SEO and Client Success teams every day, and keep a lot of accounts moving at once. If you like variety, people, and a well-organized plan, you will fit right in.

What your days look like

• A full, busy portfolio. You manage 50+ dealer accounts across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and Microsoft Advertising in the Fluency platform: budgets, bids, search terms, audiences, creative, and inventory updates.

• A steady monthly rhythm. Every account gets the same optimization checklist each month, and every budget lands on plan. You keep the plates spinning and nothing slips.

• Monthly dealer conversations. You lead each dealer's performance review in plain language: what happened, what it means, and what we recommend.

• Reports people trust. You build the monthly reporting package from platform and GA4 data so every number is right and every recommendation ties to a result.

• A real team. You stay in close contact with Client Success, so they hear about risks and wins from you before the client brings them up. You share what you learn with the Paid Media team and help improve our templates and standards.

• Backup when you need it. For complex tracking, GA4, or feed problems, you have a senior specialist to escalate to. You handle the routine fixes and keep the account moving.

How success is measured

You will know exactly where you stand. We track cost per lead against each dealer's target, lead volume and return on ad spend, budget pacing, how consistently each account gets its monthly optimization, the quality and timing of your client reviews, how early you flag concerns to Client Success, and whether your dealers stay with us.

This role fits you if

• You like working with people and are at your best on a team, not off on your own.

• You enjoy a day full of variety and lots of accounts more than one long, repetitive task.

• You are naturally organized and you keep track of the details.

• You read people well, and you can walk a dealer through the numbers so they leave the call confident.

• You move quickly and like being the one who keeps everyone informed.

• You want your work to be noticed, and you want a clear path to the next title.

What you bring

• 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads experience

• Automotive digital marketing experience

• Agency experience managing a multi-client portfolio

• Proficiency in GA4

• Experience in the Fluency platform

A plus: OEM co-op program experience, Microsoft Advertising, Google Merchant Center and vehicle inventory feeds, and Google Ads, GA4, or Meta Blueprint certifications.

Where this role leads

This seat typically leads to Senior Paid Media Specialist in 18 to 24 months, and later to Paid Media Team Lead or Client Success Manager. Hit your portfolio targets, earn your dealers' trust, and help coach a newer teammate, and the next step is yours.

What we offer

• Remote or hybrid work, your choice

• A close, collaborative team that works across Paid Media, SEO, and Client Success

• A team that lives by Grit, Elevating Others, Embracing Growth, and Continuous Improvement

Reunion Marketing is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Hospital At Home Part Time Days
jobs.description:
The Home Hospital RN reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Registered Nurse embodies the attributes of the Relationship Based Care model and performs to PPM core functions. Under the direction of the department leadership, consistently reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the State of Illinois Nurse Practice Act, the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Home Hospital Nurse treats acutely ill patients in the home as a substitute for in-hospital care. The Home Hospital Nurse is a forward-thinking, creative individual who wants to practice in an innovative clinical setting and values interdisciplinary teamwork and patient-centered care. The Nurse will provide hospital-level acute care in a patient’s home and will be part of the NM Hospital at Home team including (depending on each patient’s needs) Physicians, Paramedics, Advanced Practice Providers, Pharmacists, Case Managers, Social Workers, Home Health Aides, Physical Therapists, and other operational staff. Provides home visits within defined radius around site hospitals according to Hospital at Home care Model

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Care Coordination

• Performs a comprehensive assessment on all assigned patients as evidenced by completed documentation.
• Communicates changes in patient’s condition promptly.
• Utilizes appropriate nursing diagnosis and data from the assessment to derive realistic outcomes and documents them as measurable goals on the plan of care; modifies care plan, if indicated, in order to identify realistic patient goals.
• Identifies and prioritizes patient needs and/or nursing diagnosis for patients and documents.
• Collaborates with patient, family, and other members of the health care team when planning patient care and documents accordingly. Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary.
• Evaluates and documents the patient response to nursing interventions and alters the plan of care as necessary.
• Assesses patients with regard to discharge planning and makes the appropriate referrals as necessary, including palliative care.
• Assures completed discharge instructions, medication reconciliation and provide information to patient/family regarding the use of the patient portal and other pertinent resources.

Patient Education/Ethic and Diversity

• Supports patient/family/spiritual/cultural needs when assessing the patient and family needs for teaching; identifies the patient's learning level and readiness, and documents education record.
• Utilizes the teach back methodology for advancing patient education about medication side effects and new medication education.
• Utilizes and distributes Krames for patient education /clinical condition.
• Utilizes culture vision as a resource in care planning and delivery.
• Treats patients, families and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity.
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care.
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice.
• Calls for an ethics consult when appropriate.

EBP and Research

• Implements nursing interventions consistent with the established plan of care based on evidenced based care.
• Maintains and advances the professional image and science of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through use of best available evidence utilizing resources such as Ovid/Joanna Briggs, Up to Date, Culture Vision, and other reliable sources of evidence.
• Demonstrates active involvement in clinical LADDER project or process improvement at the unit/organization level.

Healing Safe Environment

• Demonstrates safe medication administration through the use of bar coding
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Conveys complete, timely, and accurate information at bedside shift report/hand-off
• Rounds hourly in collaboration with patient care technician
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment of excellence
• Demonstrates innovation and participation in meeting unit based and organizational quality metrics on the exceptional care dashboard
• Ensures clinical practice excellence that focuses on preventing pressure ulcers, falls, CAUTI’s and central line infections (as appropriate to area of practice).
• Participates as a unit safety facilitator or as identified resource for quality initiatives as requested
• Participates in unit huddles

Relationship to Colleagues

Shared Leadership

• Oversees and directs the work of patient care or support techs; maintains overall accountability for the care of assigned patients.
• Demonstrates effective interpersonal skills in leading and directing others; deals with conflict directly and appropriately.
• Demonstrates proficiency in the charge nurse/preceptor role when assigned; assumes responsibility for coordinating patient care for the entire unit.
• Takes the clinical lead when patient’s condition changes and confers with the primary care physician about the appropriate treatment plan or the need to transfer to the appropriate level of care.
• Serves as a resource and role model for new staff, students, and other system personnel
• Assists with precepting, unit orientation, and mentoring as requested.
• Participates in the peer evaluation process by providing feedback to colleagues on a regular basis, and through participation in clinical case peer review.
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to responsibly accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence.
• Identifies barriers to effective clinical practice and communicates to nursing leadership and practice operations council.

Resource Utilization

• Ensures an appropriate level of care order is documented in the EMR for all admissions.
• Understands and adheres to the charging of supplies.
• Participates in any value-based unit/organizational initiative.
• Demonstrates a personal commitment to decreasing utilization overtime hours.

Use of Technology

• Assures all electronic and paper documentation is complete.
• Utilizes the guardrails for the Alaris pump.
• Understands physiologic monitoring and the implications to drive changes to clinical management of the patient.
• Utilizes the bed management system
• Identifies new technologies for unit, hospital or system use.
• Participates in CEOC activities for the advancement and optimization of the medical record as requested.

Relationship to Self

Professional Practice

• Attends internal professional development offerings i.e. Schwartz Rounds, Nursing Grand Rounds.
• Obtains certification in the nursing specialty of practice.
• Demonstrates accountability for his/her professional practice-competencies, ELM learning, dress code adherence
• Participates in professional organization through membership, leadership, or committee work
• Takes assigned lunch breaks.

Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)*
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS)
• Minimum of one-year of recent nursing experience in acute or emergency setting
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• Travel required within designated geographic area
• At point of hire and annually, required to have a valid driver’s license and an annual driving abstract

*Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) acceptable with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.

Preferred:

• Home Care experience

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.
